<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>THE SIEGE OF KVATCH, BOLD MOUNTAIN<BR>$0A$0A<BR>$0A$0ASo it is said that for the sin of murdering Vythu Far-Handed, prince of Brumath, on the pilgrim's road to Sancre Tor, Irroth of the Kvetchi was rightly cursed, and for this insult the kings of Chorral and Brumath made pact, swearing to defeat the lords of Kvatch in righteous battle, to take the city on the hill, and pillage and burn, as is their right. These kings they were Cirthes Oath-Oak, and Rein Manellis the Beggar, and their army was led by Hermwnthe-of-Thistles, and consisted of many heroes and saints of great renown. Also the king of the Kvetchi was Banathil, who hid his face in sorrow. Let it be known that all this transpired.<BR>$0A$0A<BR>$0A$0AThus the mighty host of Chorral and Brumath arrived at the hill-walls of Kvatch, and saw that the city was the mightiest fortress that has ever been, built on a cliff that none could scale, and girdled with eight-and-one wooden walls, and many towers. They set about attacking this city, and did so for nine months, and this was one of the Fifteen Ineffectual Sieges of the City of Kvatch. And after nine months had passed, Hermwnthe-of-Thistles said this to Cirthes king of Chorral: "This siege will be without end, for the city of Kvatch has never yielded to a hostile force, it is a rock, firm and uncompromising, it is unshakable, and no force on earth could break its wall of stone, open its oaken gates. I ask of thee, king of Chorral, call for the Shore-King to settle our dispute, for he is both wise and impartial."<BR>$0A$0A<BR>$0A$0ASo Cirthes of Chorral called for Cioracet of the Trident Coast, who is called the Shore-King. He was both wise and impartial, staunch defender against the Elves and the hand of Thras, and knowledgeable of the stars. Sad, the fate of Cioracet and his kin, which is told in many other fables, and need not be repeated here! Now Cioracet called for a council, and listened to grievances, and made wise truce: "Each will choose a champion, and he will set off to complete a task, and it will be a most arduous task, requiring mastery of the chivalric virtues, the likes of which we have not seen since the days of the Nords, that is to say, when they lived in Old-Wood-Stead. And the one who completes this task, and brings back proof that he has done so, will be of the party of the virtuous, and the justified, and the other will be in disgrace, and his party will give tribute in foul blood-money." To which both assailant and defender agreed, and both they sent forth their champions, they were Irroth the Lark and Hermwnthe-of-Thistles. But Hermwnthe cared not for such talk: "Child of the Kvetchi! You think you can defeat me in combat? I am Hermwnthe-of-Thistles, killer of giants, of men, of elves, killer of demons, killer of drakes! When I was but a youth, I made ancient and hot-headed oath, to never ignore challenge, and for every challenge I have met, I have been victorious!" So she came before Chir-Al-Al-Boal, who took the shape of a copper snake with a boar's head. Thus he spoke: "Many the child-fools enter my domain, and I have piled their skulls high, making from their remains a fine tea, the likes of which would give a weakling the strength of thirty mer. Today, I am the zenith of Ayleidoon of old, carrying on my back one hundred and eight wings, and speaking eight secret spells, and knowing the names of nineteen beings from the outer void who will jump at my command and smite my enemy, by fire, stone, and lightness. Have you come to challenge me, mortal?" To answer such challenge on the day of hospitality is in clear opposition to the Law of Three-Days, the Fifth and the Sixth Pennant of Hospitality, and proper Knightly Conduct. But Hermwnthe was bound by ancient and hot-headed oath, to never ignore or deny challenge, and also she was proud and afraid of nothing. There they contested, first by the horse and lance, then by the great mace, then by the big sword, then by the little sword, then by biting-dagger, then by the spear, a weapon for which Hermwnthe had great affection. She wielded the weapon named Thistle-Thorn, and with it she inflicted on Irroth a terrible wound to the face, so that he would never again dare show it to the likes of man, and the wound grew infected so that people now speak of Irroth, the Festering.<BR>$0A$0A<BR>$0A$0AAnd Cioracet awarded victory to the forces of Chorral and Brumath, and the Kvetchi were forced into the giving of blood-money. """<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>科瓦奇围城战，雄山<BR>

<BR>

据说，因在通往桑克雷·托的朝圣之路上谋杀布鲁马斯王子远手维苏之罪，科维奇的伊罗斯受到了应有的诅咒，为雪此辱，科洛尔和布鲁马斯的国王们结盟，发誓要以正义之战击败科瓦奇的领主们，夺取那座山丘上的城市，并按照他们的权利进行掠夺和焚烧。这两位国王是橡誓西尔塞斯和乞丐赖因·马内利斯，他们的军队由蓟草赫姆温特率领，由许多著名英雄和圣徒组成。科维奇的国王是巴纳西尔，他因悲伤而掩面。让所有人知道这一切都发生了。<BR>

<BR>

于是，科洛尔和布鲁马斯的强大军队抵达了科瓦奇的山丘城墙，他们看到这座城市是前所未有的最强大的堡垒，建在无人能攀爬的悬崖上，环绕着八层加一层木墙和众多塔楼。他们开始进攻这座城市，持续了九个月，这是科瓦奇城十五次无效围城之一。九个月后，蓟草赫姆温特对科洛尔国王西尔塞斯说：“这场围城将永无止境，因为科瓦奇城从未向敌对势力屈服过，它是一块岩石，坚固而不妥协，不可动摇，世上没有任何力量能打破它的石墙，打开它的橡木大门。我请求你，科洛尔国王，召唤滨海王来解决我们的争端，因为他既明智又公正。”<BR>

<BR>

于是科洛尔的西尔塞斯召唤了三叉戟海岸的西奥拉塞特，他被称为滨海王。他既明智又公正，是抵御精灵和瑟拉斯之手的坚定捍卫者，并且通晓星辰。西奥拉塞特及其亲族的命运令人悲伤，这在许多其他寓言中都有讲述，在此无需赘述！西奥拉塞特召集了一次会议，听取了双方的申诉，并做出了明智的休战决定：“双方各选一名冠军，他将出发完成一项任务，这将是一项最艰巨的任务，需要掌握骑士美德，自诺德人时代 -- 即他们居住在古木之地时 -- 以来我们从未见过这样的美德。完成这项任务并带回已完成证明的一方，将属于有德和正义的一方，另一方将蒙羞，其一方将以污秽的血钱进贡。”攻击者和防御者都同意了，他们派出了各自的冠军，他们是云雀伊罗斯和蓟草赫姆温特。“你们的任务将是前往卡拉奇贝卡夫的堡垒，那里亚历德国王奇尔-阿尔-阿尔-博阿尔主持着一个死人法庭，杀死这位国王，并将他的头颅带回来给我。”<BR>

<BR>

于是伊罗斯和赫姆温特出发了，他们长途跋涉，越过古冢之地、石楠荒原和小沙漠，直到来到他们称为格姆哈-阿夫的土地，即在桑克雷·托以西。在那里，伊罗斯 confronted 赫姆温特，并说道：“我的手虽沾满鲜血，却是正义的。回去吧，赫姆温特，因为我听说过你的许多事迹，认为你远在你地位的所有骑士之上，我不愿杀死你。”但赫姆温特不在意这种话：“科维奇的孩子！你以为你能在战斗中击败我吗？我是蓟草赫姆温特，巨人的杀手，人类的杀手，精灵的杀手，恶魔的杀手，龙兽的杀手！我还是个少年时，就立下了古老而热血的誓言，永不忽视挑战，而我遇到的每一个挑战，我都取得了胜利！”在那里，赫姆温特在通往格姆哈-夫的路上击败了云雀伊罗斯，不是用她那可怕的蓟草尖矛，而是仅凭她装甲双手的力量。<BR>

<BR>

击倒了云雀之后，赫姆温特继续前往卡拉奇贝卡夫的隐秘大厅，那里亚历德国王奇尔-阿尔-阿尔-博阿尔主持着死人法庭。赫姆温特在城门处表明身份，守门人是死人，马厩的工人是死人，给她端来酒的仆人是死人。于是她来到奇尔-阿尔-阿尔-博阿尔面前，他化身为一个长着野猪头的铜蛇。他说道：“许多愚蠢的孩子进入我的领地，我把他们的头颅高高堆起，用他们的遗骸制成一种上好的茶，能让一个弱者拥有三十个精灵的力量。今天，我是古老亚历德人的巅峰，背上长着一百零八只翅膀，能说八个秘密咒语，知道来自外部虚空的十九个存在的名字，他们会听从我的命令跳跃而出，用火、石头和轻盈来打击我的敌人。你是来挑战我的吗，凡人？”在款待之日回应这样的挑战，明显违反了三天律法，款待的第五和第六面旗帜，以及正当的骑士行为。但赫姆温特受古老而热血的誓言约束，永不忽视或否认挑战，而且她骄傲无畏。于是她说道：“是的，我是来杀你的，这将有助于正义的伸张，正义将降临到我所有的众多敌人身上。”<BR>

<BR>

在那里进行了一场激烈的战斗，奇尔-阿尔-阿尔-博阿尔施展了亚历德人的所有秘密和污秽的知识，多次改变自己的形状，变成野兽、虫子、野猪、狐狸、狼、手、眼睛、老鼠、蛇、云、树、老虎、獾、又变成狐狸、青蛙，等等。但一切都未能奏效，因为赫姆温特以虔诚和武力对抗了一切，取得了胜利，于是她将奇尔-阿尔-阿尔-博阿尔的头颅挑在长矛尖端，带回了科瓦奇被围困的城墙前。<BR>

<BR>

在那里她受到了盛宴款待，布鲁马和科洛尔的军队聚集在她周围，设宴款待她。于是潮石西奥拉塞特准备宣判，这时云雀伊罗斯走上前来反对程序。“蓟草赫姆温特违背了美德准则，我察觉到了！我仍秘密跟踪她，看到她进入了奇尔-阿尔-阿尔-博阿尔的大厅，享用了他的酒（因此接受了他的款待），而当上述奇尔-阿尔-阿尔-博阿尔现身并公式化地发出挑战时，蓟草赫姆温特肯定地回答了他，违反了三天律法，款待的第五和第六面旗帜，以及正当的骑士行为！我要求决斗，以判定权利！”<BR>

<BR>

西奥拉塞特发现年轻伊罗斯的论点并无不妥，便允许这场决斗进行。于是云雀伊罗斯和蓟草赫姆温特再次在战斗中相遇，这场决斗持续了很久，因为伊罗斯现在准备充分，而赫姆温特在与精灵王的争斗后仍很虚弱。他们在那里较量，先是骑马持矛，然后用大钉锤，然后是大剑，然后是小剑，然后是咬刃匕首，然后是长矛，一种赫姆温特非常喜爱的武器。她挥舞着名为蓟刺的武器，用它给伊罗斯的脸上造成了一道可怕的伤口，使他再也不敢在人前露面，伤口感染化脓，以至于人们现在称他为溃烂伊罗斯。<BR>

<BR>

西奥拉塞特将胜利判给了科洛尔和布鲁马斯的军队，科维奇人被迫缴纳血钱。尽管科瓦奇的巴纳西尔曾计划献上他儿子伊罗斯的鲜血，但后者因伤羞愧，已逃往北方的荒野，巴纳西尔便用猪血清洗了黄金，所有人都满意了。科瓦奇围城战的故事到此结束，雄山，被广泛认为是那座庄严城市中更有趣且更有教育意义的围城战之一。<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>血钱围城<BR>

乞丐国王赖因·马内利斯从他最近与科维奇人的世仇中获益颇丰，以至于回到布鲁马斯时，他有一辆堆满红金色金子的大车，上面溅有猪血。但雪之国王对他的金子并不小心，以至于在渡过斯卡哈特河时，马匹失蹄滑倒，金子几乎全部被冲到鲁玛雷湖中，只留下一把血金，从此斯卡哈特河被称为吝啬河，泽尼萨尔在那里收取过路费。于是赖因·马内利斯说：“我真是倒霉，因为十一年前我向斯金格拉德国王海姆特借了一大笔钱，今天我必须还给他。但我知道许多令人烦恼的把戏，许多从尼贝斯人那里学来的愚弄之词，我会让金币国王听命于我的！”于是赖因·马内利斯前往斯金格拉德国王 -- 骄傲的海姆特的宫廷，他被称为金币国王，因为他的金库里装满了那些在尼贝斯进行贸易的人的黄金。<BR>

于是赖因·马内利斯抵达了富庶的宫廷，那里斯金格拉德城统治着贸易渡口，其桥梁横跨金色大道，月旗高悬，铁皮屋顶和勇敢的塔楼。斯金格拉德的领地宏伟壮丽，其居民深知商业的乐趣，但从未忘记科洛维亚的理想：勇敢和虔诚！在那里，赖因·马内利斯走过悲剧桥，来到五剑海姆特的宫廷。布鲁马斯国王说道：“海姆特！王座兄弟，我今天来到你面前，是为了结束那压在我背上的沉重债务。这笔债如此沉重，我本想偿还你，却被科洛尔的多须国王西尔塞斯及其部落的背叛所阻。”斯金格拉德国王海姆特回答说：“你在说什么？西尔塞斯一直是我忠实的盟友，总是帮助我，就像我帮助他一样，而且因为所有这一切联系在一起，我一直是科洛尔的西尔塞斯的盟友。”赖因·马内利斯回答说：“但事实就是如此！我通过科瓦奇围城战赚取的血币，他拿走了，藏在他的堡垒里，而我只能留下一小把，看，这就是证据！”乞丐国王展示了他持有的那把血金。<BR>

<BR>

海姆特被诱惑了，因为他渴望得到科洛尔的财富，几乎不需要说服。于是他召集了他的军队，其中包括阿尔姆之子马尔，颅骨切割者塔鲁斯，马恩 -- 他曾决定一位皇帝的生命，记录他的美德与过失，科克特和他的十七个儿子，一个比一个强大，七溪的阿娜莎，哈姆尔·格雷夫-查尔德和他的八条狗，哈姆尔·格雷夫-查尔德本人，梅哈德之子阿哈德，佩特之子卡特里，苏特奇的尼内特，哈尔德人科马尔，波特里 -- 他曾在一个酒桶里待了七天，并深悔自己伟大的功绩中，这件事最被人们记住 -- 马萨特雷，卡特里科，穆塔克 -- 他从不用十个字去说一个字 -- 霍伦赫布·歌卫，萨查尔的梅德，还有许多其他著名英雄，他们的名字和事迹无需一一列举，他任命巴顿·半巨人为这支军队的领袖，他比任何人都强大。<BR>

<BR>

于是斯金格拉德的军队向科洛尔进军，在那座与世隔绝的城门前，他们提出了要求：将那被血玷污的钱财全额交出，科洛尔国王必须出来跪下，科洛尔国王的子孙直到第三代都必须向斯金格拉德和布鲁马的领主们下跪。但科洛尔的西尔塞斯拒绝了，并派出了他的冠军 -- 蓟草赫姆温特 -- 来捍卫他的荣誉。此外，他还要求这场争端在科洛尔神圣橡树的树荫下解决，在那里所有不当行为都将受到神圣力量 -- 一种高于他们自身且无可指责的力量 -- 的惩罚。<BR>

<BR>

巴顿出场了，威严的巴顿！他的母亲是巨人，父亲是超过平均身高的人，因此促成了他们的结合！巨大的战士，双腿如同树干，双臂之粗壮，是集结的科洛维亚骑士们在那之前从未见过的！<BR>

<BR>

在那里，蓟草赫姆温特和巴顿·半巨人首先交谈，交换了寒暄和严重的侮辱，直到流血时刻的到来。巴顿挥舞着一把巨大的矛锤，那是一根不亚于树木的长矛，他用铜带缠绕着生活在诺德人之地和之前的诺德人之地之间的大海中的鱼的骨头，他们称之为古木之地。蓟草赫姆温特挥舞着她的银矛，矛尖是一根蓟草刺，原因与这个故事无关，但在从博里查尔到维伊的客栈里都能听到许多相关故事。<BR>

<BR>

在激烈的战斗中，他们劈裂了大地，击倒了高耸之物，因为赫姆温特知道一种秘密的方法，可以从石头中击出血来，而巴顿是半个巨人，力量强大。然后，当科洛尔的大橡树仍然矗立时，赫姆温特看到了机会，砍下了巴顿的右手，巴顿蒙羞，爬行乞求饶恕。但当他爬行乞求饶恕时，他的左手将一种秘密毒药藏在大橡树的根部，这是尼贝斯人用被背叛的国王阿尔塞姆的血制成的，以渗入树堡的核心。这是半人代表科洛维亚一位品行高尚的统治者所犯下的十二项不光彩行为之一。<BR>

<BR>

于是海姆特和赖因·马内利斯的军队被击败了，他们因贪婪和愚蠢付出了沉重的代价。科洛尔王国在接下来的两年零三个月里生活在和平与繁荣中，但仅此而已，因为尼贝斯的毒药知晓时机，并会相应行动。血钱围城就这样结束了，它在许多方面是可耻的，除了参与者对科洛维亚骑士美德表现出适当尊重的时候。<BR>

A Commentary on the Covenants of Saints<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
As dictated by Primate Dierem of the Temple-School of Julianos<BR>

<BR>
A Covenant, also known as an Illustrious Pact or a Diathaka in the old tongue, is a spiritual commitment between a Divine and a mortal saint, generally considered to be the one true path to sainthood, and the only way to directly interface with the unknowable Divines (as we categorize the Manifestations and Oracular Visions as indirect contacts). The Divines, it is sung, created this world from the blood their blood, giving their life freely to the benefit of the lesser spirits (that is to say, all living things). However, we mortals are blind and unfeeling to the world's gentle directions, spinning feebly in malfeasance and ignorance. We long to touch Aetherius and live in blessed repose beyond the crucible, but ever again we return to earth, dragged down by our imperfections, or fall victim to the predations of foreign or outsider spirits (such as the Daedra or the Dmath).<BR>
<BR>
Our world, deigned a cruel arena by the ignorant, is a Divine engine designed to reforge our unworthy spirits, breathe divinity in our souls and open the path to the heavens. In order to understand the Law and the Will of the world, we must receive guidance in the way of signs, which reveal the world's resplendent workings. These signs come to us in many ways: the Laws of Empire, the Commandments, the Visions and Errands of the Oracles, the cryptic words of the Manifestations. But the one true path, by which the Divines most clearly reveal to us the hidden workings of their creation, is the Covenant of Saints.<BR>
<BR>
A Covenant is never initiated by the Divines themselves, as they are far and removed form the world. It finds root in the hearts of those exceptional mortals who, in earnest desire or great distress, find within themselves a secret aspiration that elevates them beyond lesser men. Called heroes or saints, these nominates find common cause with the Divines, making a pact through which the Divines may directly influence the world. They bring signs and wonders into the world, for us lesser mortals to see and study, so that we in turn may be brought to find Covenant, in this life or the next. A maker of Covenant who fulfills his duties and follows the Law and Will true and with honest intent shall, in death, transcend and sit at the foot of the nine sublime thrones in high Aetherius, forever free of the world's crucible.<BR>
<BR>
But guard yourself against idle Covenant, for it is said that many, who felt called, and made pact with the Divines, were in truth unworthy. These spirits found the blessing and the curse too much to bear, and, breaking under the strain of the Divine, they renounced their Covenant to fade away as spirits of nill, or haunt the world as Un-Saints, dreadful and violent apparitions that mean harm to all living things.<BR>
<BR>
Akatosh commands us to study the Covenants of the past, so that we may take heed and learn the path to sainthood ourselves. Let us pray, and meditate, on the myriad Saint of Cyrod, to take knowledge of the substance of their lives, and find a mirror there.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
圣徒圣约评注<BR>

尤利安诺斯神殿学院主教迪雷姆 口述<BR>

圣约，也称为辉煌盟约或古语中的迪亚萨卡，是圣灵与凡人圣徒之间的精神契约，通常被视为通往圣徒之位的唯一正道，也是与不可知的圣灵（我们将显圣和神谕幻象归类为间接接触）直接沟通的唯一方式。据说，圣灵们用他们的血中之血创造了这个世界，自由地献出他们的生命以造福于较低等的灵体（即所有生物）。然而，我们凡人对于世界温和的引导是盲目而无感的，在恶行和无知中无力地打转。我们渴望触及光界，在坩埚之外享受受祝福的安息，但我们总是回到尘世，被我们的不完美所拖累，或成为外来或外部灵体（如迪德拉或德玛斯）掠食的牺牲品。<BR>
<BR>
我们的世界，被无知者视为残酷的竞技场，是一部神圣的引擎，旨在重铸我们不值得的灵魂，将神性注入我们的灵魂，并开辟通往天堂的道路。为了理解这个世界的律法与意志，我们必须接受符号之道的指引，这些符号揭示了世界辉煌的运作。这些符号以多种方式来到我们身边：帝国的法律、戒律、神谕的幻象与使命、显圣的神秘话语。但圣灵们最清晰地向我们揭示其创造之隐秘运作的唯一真正道路，是圣徒圣约。<BR>
<BR>
圣约绝非由圣灵自身发起的，因为他们远离并超脱于世界。它根植于那些非凡凡人的心中，他们怀着真诚的渴望或巨大的痛苦，在自身内部发现了一种秘密的抱负，将他们提升至超越普通人。被称为英雄或圣徒的这些被提名者，与圣灵找到了共同目标，立下契约，通过此契约，圣灵得以直接干预世界。他们将迹象和奇迹带入世界，供我们这些较渺小的凡人观察和学习，以便我们反过来能够被引导去寻找圣约，无论是今生还是来世。一位履行其职责、遵循律法与意志并怀有真诚意图的圣约缔造者，死后将会超脱，坐在高耸光界中九座崇高宝座的脚下，永远摆脱世界的坩埚。<BR>
<BR>
但要警惕轻率的圣约，因为据说许多感到被召唤并与圣灵立约的人，实际上并不配。这些灵魂发现祝福与诅咒都太过沉重，在神圣的重压下崩溃，他们放弃了圣约，化为虚无之灵消失，或作为非圣徒徘徊世间，成为对所有生物怀有恶意的可怕暴力幽灵。<BR>
<BR>
阿卡托什命令我们研究过去的圣约，以便我们能够留意并亲自学习通往圣徒之路。让我们祈祷和冥想西罗德无数圣徒的事迹，了解他们生活的实质，并在其中找到一面镜子。<BR>

> BOOK.FNAM T_Bk_CompendiumArtifactsTR
Compendium of Lost Artifacts
失落神器纲要

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Compendium of Lost Artifacts<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
This is a gathering of research notes collected over the years on items once in mortal possession, or lost to the ages. My sources assure me that the following items exist. Although some have not been seen for years, they are pursued by many, including high ranking officials of the Empire. <BR>
<BR>
Auriel's Bow<BR>
<BR>
Auriel's Bow appears as a modest Elven Longbow, but it is one of the mightiest ever to exist in Tamriel's history. Allegedly created and used, like its sister Auriel's Shield, by the great Elvish demi-god, the Bow can turn any arrow into a missile of death and destruction. Without Auriel's power behind it, however, the bow uses its own store of energy for its power. Once exhausted of this energy, the bow will vanish and reappear wherever chance puts it. Its most recent appearances have been the subject of gossip for hundreds of years.<BR>
<BR>
Auriel's Shield<BR>
<BR>
Auriel's Shield, an Ebony shield said to have once belonged to the quasi-mythical Elvish deity Auriel, can make its wielder highly invulnerable. In its resistance to fire and magick, Auriel's Shield is unsurpassed. Like many artifacts of Tamriel, the Shield has life and personality of its own, and does not feel bound to its user. A popular fable tells the tale of it abandoning one wielder in her greatest hour of need, but this is perhaps apocryphal.<BR>
<BR>
Azura's Star<BR>
<BR>
Few mortals have the stomach to trade in souls. The Dark Brotherhood does it, as do certain groups within the Mages Guild. For these cruel folk, Azura's Star has a particular fascination. The Star acts as a reusable soul gem. The soul of any creature killed by the bearer of the Star is trapped within it. If the Star already carries a soul, nothing happens. Using Azura's Star empties it, freeing the trapped soul to make its journey to Oblivion. Azura's Star can be used to make enchanted items over and over and over.<BR>
<BR>
Boots of Peace<BR>
<BR>
Not much is known about the Boots of Peace. All that is known is that they aid the wearer with enhanced mobility, stealth, ablity to do more damage in combat, and increased martial prowess.<BR>
<BR>
Bow of Heaven's Hail<BR>
<BR>
One of the deadliest weapons in Tamrielic legend, the Bow of Heaven's Hail was used during the invasion of the Battlespire, wielded by a famous Elven archer. The bow is known to allow a novice marksman to become a master. Every arrow fired will meet its target, even from a long distance. There has been no reports of the Legion recovering the bow from the wreckage of the Battlespire, to their dismay, as such a potent weapon would be an asset for the Empire.<BR>
<BR>
Ebony Blade<BR>
<BR>
The Ebony Blade, sometimes called the Vampire or the Leech, resembles an ebony katana, and its power is very dark indeed. Every time the Ebony Blade strikes an opponent, part of the damage inflicted flows into the wielder as raw power. The Blade itself may not be any more evil than those who have used it, but at some point in its history, a charm was cast on it so it would not remain with any one bladesman for long. The wizard who cast this charm sought to save the souls of any too infatuated by the Blade, and perhaps he was right to do so.<BR>
<BR>
Flask of Lillandril<BR>
<BR>
The Flask of Lillandril; is a magical flask discovered during the First Era of Tamriel by a group of Elves living in Lillandril, a port city on the Northern shore of Summerset Isle. Upon learning that the flask had the marvelous ability to absorb magic of any persuasion, the founders realized its importance and spread word of their discovery. According to legend the Flask was used by Cyrus the Redguard during the Battle of Stros M'kai in the late Second Era. Cyrus faced the great Sload Necromancer, N'Gasta, defeating him in his tower with the power of the Flask. Rumor has it that the Daedric Prince of Bargains, Clavicus Vile, currently possesses the Flask, and is waiting to strike a deal that no mortal can resist.<BR>
<BR>
Gauntlets of the Poor<BR>
<BR>
The lost spirits of Dagon's Hunting Lodge exist in a fate worse than death. Through their everlasting limbo, the wraiths created the Gauntlets of the Poor, as a way to contact the outside world through a curious adventurer. The Gauntlets of the Poor's enchantment is unknown. All that is known is that no one can wear them for long. With time, the body becomes forfeit to the spirits that reside inside the gloves, waiting to become whole once again.<BR>
<BR>
Hammer of Gharen<BR>
<BR>
The Hammer of Gharen is a legendary hammer created by the Dwarf, Gharen. Twinned with the Anvil of Mithas, the Hammer is strong enough to not shatter when shaping metal upon the Anvil. It is rumored that the Hammer, when it strikes the Anvil of Mithas, it can reveal secret entrances of the ancient Dwarves, one such case is the entrance to a city under the Star Wound.<BR>
<BR>
Helm of Light Within<BR>
<BR>
The Helm of Light Within allows one to draw magicka from their opponent. This unusual helm is one of the few examples where the Battlespire enchanters were able to create magicka through the use of mechanized components. Artificers are searching for the helm to this day, a very useful helm for exploring the Void.<BR>
<BR>
Hircine's Ring<BR>
<BR>
The curse of lycanthropy has its advantages. The incredible strength, speed, and ferocity of a werebeast makes it a fearsome opponent. There are, of course, disadvantages. The bearer of Hircine's Ring can choose when to be a lycanthrope and when not to, giving the wearer all the advantages of lycanthropy with few of the disadvantages.<BR>
<BR>
King Orgnum's Coffer<BR>
<BR>
King Orgnum's Coffer is a small-sized chest, ordinary in appearance. It is remarkably light, almost weightless, which offers a clue to its true magic. Once a day, the Coffer will create gold from naught. When King Orgnum himself possessed the Coffer, the supply within was limitless. Those who have found it since report that the Coffer eventually disappears after having dispersed enough gold to shame even the wealthiest of merchants. Where and why it vanishes is still a mystery.<BR>
<BR>
Lord Methats' Pauldrons<BR>
<BR>
One of the most famous Daedra, Lord Methats of the Dremora clan, servant of Mehrunes Dagon. Rumor has it that upon summoning this powerful spirit, the conjurer is granted the chance to enter service to the Daedroth. If successful in carrying out the lord's bidding, his pauldrons are granted to the mortal in question. The pauldrons are known to allow the wearer to swim with little resistance, while also allowing them to breathe underwater.<BR>
<BR>
Necromancer's Amulet<BR>
<BR>
The legendary Necromancer's Amulet, a relic of the mad sorcerer Mannimarco, grants any spellcaster who wears it the ability to regenerate from injury, and absorb magicka. The wearer also becomes wise beyond their years. This artifact is popular amongst mages. The one flaw of the Amulet is that it is unstable in this world, and is forever doomed to fade in and out of existence, reappearing at locations distant from the site of its last disappearance.<BR>
<BR>
Oghma Infinium<BR>
<BR>
The Oghma Infinium is a tome of knowledge written by the Ageless One, the wizard-sage Xarxes. All who read the Infinium are filled with the energy of the artifact, which can be manipulated to raise one's abilities to near demi-god proportions. Once used, legend has it, the Infinium will disappear from its wielder.<BR>
<BR>
Ring of Namira<BR>
<BR>
Namira is aligned with the darker side of nature, as is her ring. While the ring is being worn, any damage the bearer takes is suffered by the attacker as well. Spells and missile attacks are ignored.<BR>
<BR>
Sanguine Rose<BR>
<BR>
The Sanguine Rose summons a lesser daedra to the user. The daedra will attack any other creature in the area except the bearer of the Rose. The Rose is like any other, in that it will wilt. The more one weilds the Rose, the more wilted it becomes. Eventually all its petals fall off and it loses its powers. Somewhere in Oblivion a new Rose blooms and is plucked by Sanguine himself to be given to a new champion.<BR>
<BR>
Savior's Hide<BR>
<BR>
The pieces of the Savior's Hide are some of the the most sought after artifacts in Tamrielic history. The armor is crafted from the hides of many creatures of unkown origin, and its pieces are granted to the most faithful devotees of Malacath. One such champion was the great Chimere Graegyn of Caecilly, who used the armor to defy Mehrunes Dagon in the early Third Era.<BR>
<BR>
Skeleton Key<BR>
<BR>
The power of the Skeleton's Key is very simple, indeed. With it, any non-magically locked door or chest is instantly accessible to even the clumsiest of lockpickers. A particularly skillful lockpicker may even open some magically barred doors with the Key. Some of those who have possessed the Key have made themselves rich before it disappeared, while others have broken into places they never should have entered.<BR>
<BR>
Skull of Corruption<BR>
<BR>
Using the Skull of Corruption on an opponent creates a duplicate of the victim. However, this duplicate will attack the original, not the wielder of the Skull. There is a story about the Thieves Guild Master and the skull that is probably fiction, but highly amusing. The Master used the skull on her enemy, creating a clone of him to fight. After defeating the original, the clever duplicate snatched the Skull from the Master and used it on her. Although the cloned enemy could not directly attack the Master, it could use the Skull to create a duplicate Master. The two clones jointly ruled the Thieves Guild for years.<BR>
<BR>
Staff of the Typos Sophia<BR>
<BR>
Little is known about this staff, and even less about its origin, besides that it was known to protect the wielder from dangerous magicks. The Emperor's chief artificer Clarentavious Valisious was the last known person to possess the Staff of the Typos Sophia. During the invasion of the Battlespire, the staff was lost in the chaos, and never to be heard of again.<BR>
<BR>
Sword of the Moon Reiver<BR>
<BR>
The Moon Reiver is a powerful broadsword created by the Daedric Prince, Mehrunes Dagon. The sword came into existence during the invasion of the Imperial Battlespire, though, there has been no record of the sword appearing since. It may possibly still remain in the ruined Battlespire to this day. The Sword of the Moon Reiver was known to enhance the wielder's swordsmanship, while inflicting a strong poison on its victims. The blade apparently also has the power to cast the Prince of Destruction himself back into Oblivion.<BR>
<BR>
Volendrung<BR>
<BR>
The Hammer of Might, Volendrung, is said to have been created by the Dwarves of the now lost clan Rourken, hundreds of years before their disappearance from the world. Volendrung has the ability to grant health to its wielder, but it is best known for its paralyzing and strength leeching effects. Like the Dwarves who created it, Volendrung is prone to disappearing suddenly, resurfacing sometimes in days, sometimes in eons.<BR>
<BR>
Wabbajack<BR>
<BR>
Madness and chaos are the trademarks of Sheogorath. The Wabbajack embodies these same traits. Using the artifact on a creature will transform it into something else.<BR>
"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
失落神器纲要<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
这是多年来收集的关于曾被凡人拥有或已失传于岁月的物品的研究笔记汇编。我的消息来源向我保证以下物品确实存在。尽管有些已多年未见，但它们被许多人追寻，包括帝国的高层官员。<BR>
<BR>
奥瑞埃尔之弓<BR>
<BR>
奥瑞埃尔之弓看似一把普通的精灵长弓，但它是泰姆瑞尔历史上最强大的武器之一。据称，与其姐妹神器奥瑞埃尔之盾一样，它由伟大的精灵半神创造并使用，能将任何箭矢转化为死亡与毁灭的投射物。然而，没有奥瑞埃尔之力加持时，弓会使用自身储存的能量。一旦能量耗尽，弓就会消失，并在机缘巧合之处重新出现。它最近的出现已成为数百年来议论的话题。<BR>
<BR>
奥瑞埃尔之盾<BR>
<BR>
奥瑞埃尔之盾，一面据说曾属于半神话精灵神祇奥瑞埃尔的黑檀盾牌，能让持有者获得极高的抵御能力。在抵抗火焰和魔法方面，奥瑞埃尔之盾无与伦比。如同泰姆瑞尔的许多神器，这面盾牌拥有自己的生命和个性，并不认为自己必须效忠于使用者。一个流行的寓言讲述了它在其持有者最需要时遗弃了她的故事，但这也许只是杜撰。<BR>
<BR>
阿祖拉之星<BR>
<BR>
很少有凡人能忍受交易灵魂的行为。黑暗兄弟会这样做，法师公会中的某些团体也这样做。对于这些残忍的人来说，阿祖拉之星有着特别的吸引力。这颗星的作用类似于一个可重复使用的灵魂石。任何被持有者杀死的生物的灵魂都会被囚禁其中。如果星内已有灵魂，则不会有任何反应。使用阿祖拉之星会将其清空，释放被囚禁的灵魂，让它踏上前往湮灭的旅程。阿祖拉之星可以被反复用于制作附魔物品。<BR>
<BR>
和平之靴<BR>
<BR>
关于和平之靴知之甚少。只知道它们能增强穿戴者的机动性、潜行能力、战斗中的伤害输出，并提高武艺。<BR>
<BR>
天雹之弓<BR>
<BR>
泰姆瑞尔传说中最致命的武器之一，天雹之弓在战栗堡入侵期间被使用，由一位著名的精灵弓箭手持有。据说这把弓能让新手射手变成大师。射出的每一支箭都会命中目标，即使是从很远的距离。令军团失望的是，没有关于他们从战栗堡残骸中找回这把弓的报告，因为如此强大的武器对帝国来说将是一笔宝贵的财富。<BR>
<BR>
黑檀之刃<BR>
<BR>
黑檀之刃，有时被称为吸血鬼或水蛭，形似一把黑檀武士刀，其力量确实非常黑暗。每次黑檀之刃击中对手，部分造成的伤害会以原始力量的形式流入持有者体内。这把刃本身可能并不比使用过它的人更邪恶，但在其历史上的某个时刻，一个魅惑被施于其上，使其不会长时间留在任何一个剑士手中。施放此魅惑的法师试图拯救那些过于沉迷于这把刃的灵魂，也许他这样做是对的。<BR>
<BR>
利兰德瑞尔之瓶<BR>
<BR>
利兰德瑞尔之瓶是一个魔法瓶子，在第一纪元由居住在夏暮岛北岸港口城市利兰德瑞尔的一群精灵发现。当发现这个瓶子拥有吸收任何种类魔法的奇妙能力时，发现者们意识到了它的重要性，并传播了他们的发现。根据传说，红卫人赛勒斯在第二纪元晚期的斯特罗斯·姆'凯之战中使用了这个瓶子。赛勒斯面对强大的斯洛德死灵法师恩'加斯塔，利用瓶子的力量在他的塔楼中击败了他。有传言说，交易与契约的迪德拉大君克拉威库斯·维尔目前拥有这个瓶子，正等待达成一笔无人能抗拒的交易。<BR>
<BR>
穷人之护手<BR>
<BR>
大衮狩猎小屋的失落灵魂遭受着比死亡更糟糕的命运。在永恒的炼狱中，这些幽魂创造了穷人之护手，作为一种通过好奇的冒险者与外界联系的方式。穷人之护手的附魔效果未知。只知道没人能长时间佩戴它们。随着时间的推移，身体会逐渐被寄居在手套内的灵魂所占据，它们等待着再次变得完整。<BR>
<BR>
加伦之锤<BR>
<BR>
加伦之锤是一把由矮人加伦创造的传奇战锤。它与米萨斯之砧成对，锤子足够坚固，在砧上锻造金属时不会碎裂。有传言说，当锤子敲击米萨斯之砧时，可以揭示古代矮人的秘密入口，其中一个例子就是星伤之下城市的入口。<BR>
<BR>
内光之盔<BR>
<BR>
内光之盔允许佩戴者从对手那里汲取魔能。这顶不寻常的头盔是战栗堡的附魔师能够通过使用机械化组件创造魔能的少数例子之一。工匠们至今仍在寻找这顶头盔，它对于探索虚空非常有用。<BR>
<BR>
希尔辛之戒<BR>
<BR>
兽化症的诅咒也有其优势。兽化人惊人的力量、速度和凶残使其成为可怕的对手。当然，也有缺点。希尔辛之戒的佩戴者可以选择何时成为兽化人，何时不成为，让佩戴者享有兽化症的所有优势，而几乎没有缺点。<BR>
<BR>
奥格努姆王之箱<BR>
<BR>
奥格努姆王之箱是一个小箱子，外表普通。它异常轻便，几乎失重，这为其真正的魔力提供了线索。每天一次，箱子会凭空产生金子。当奥格努姆王本人拥有箱子时，里面的供应是无限的。此后发现它的人报告说，在散发了足以让最富有的商人都自愧不如的金子后，箱子最终会消失。它消失的地点和原因仍然是个谜。<BR>
<BR>
梅萨茨领主之肩甲<BR>
<BR>
梅鲁涅斯·大衮的仆人，德雷莫拉族的梅萨茨领主，是最著名的迪德拉之一。有传言说，在召唤这个强大的灵体时，召唤者有机会为这个代德洛斯服务。如果成功地执行了领主的命令，他的肩甲就会授予该凡人。已知这对肩甲能让佩戴者几乎无阻力地游泳，同时也能让他们在水下呼吸。<BR>
<BR>
死灵法师护符<BR>
<BR>
传奇的死灵法师护符，是疯狂巫师曼尼马克的遗物，赋予任何佩戴它的施法者从伤害中再生和吸收魔能的能力。佩戴者也会变得比同龄人更睿智。这件神器在法师中很受欢迎。护符的一个缺陷是它在这个世界不稳定，注定会不断消失和重现，出现在离它上次消失地点很远的地方。<BR>
<BR>
无限智典<BR>
<BR>
《无限智典》是由不朽者、巫师贤者扎克西斯所著的知识巨著。所有阅读《智典》的人都会充满神器的能量，这种能量可以被操纵，将一个人的能力提升到接近半神的程度。传说，一旦使用，《智典》就会从持有者手中消失。<BR>
<BR>
娜米拉之戒<BR>
<BR>
娜米拉与自然的阴暗面结盟，她的戒指也是如此。当戒指被佩戴时，佩戴者受到的任何伤害，攻击者也会遭受。法术和投射物攻击被忽略。<BR>
<BR>
桑吉恩玫瑰<BR>
<BR>
桑吉恩玫瑰会为使用者召唤一个较低等的迪德拉。迪德拉会攻击该区域内的任何其他生物，除了玫瑰的持有者。这朵玫瑰和其他玫瑰一样，会枯萎。使用玫瑰越多，它就越枯萎。最终，它的所有花瓣都会凋落，失去力量。在湮灭的某个地方，一朵新的玫瑰会绽放，并被桑吉恩亲自摘下，赠予新的冠军。<BR>
<BR>
救世者之皮<BR>
<BR>
救世者之皮的部件是泰姆瑞尔历史上最受追捧的神器之一。这套盔甲由许多来历不明的生物的皮制成，它的部件被赐予马拉卡斯最忠诚的信徒。其中一位这样的冠军是卡西利的伟大奇米尔·格雷金，他在第三纪元早期使用这套盔甲对抗梅鲁涅斯·大衮。<BR>
<BR>
骷髅钥匙<BR>
<BR>
骷髅钥匙的力量其实非常简单。有了它，即使是最笨拙的开锁匠也能瞬间打开任何非魔法锁定的门或箱子。特别熟练的开锁匠甚至可以用钥匙打开一些魔法封锁的门。一些拥有过钥匙的人，在它消失之前就借此发了财，而另一些人则闯入了他们本不该进入的地方。<BR>
<BR>
腐坏头骨<BR>
<BR>
对对手使用腐坏头骨会创造一个受害者的复制品。然而，这个复制品会攻击本体，而不是头骨的持有者。有一个关于盗贼公会会长和头骨的故事，很可能是虚构的，但非常有趣。会长对她的敌人使用了头骨，创造了一个他的克隆体来战斗。在击败本体后，聪明的克隆体从会长手中夺走了头骨，并对她使用了头骨。虽然克隆的敌人不能直接攻击会长，但它可以用头骨创造一个克隆会长。这两个克隆体共同统治了盗贼公会多年。<BR>
<BR>
谬误索菲亚之杖<BR>
<BR>
关于这根法杖知之甚少，关于其起源更是鲜为人知，除了它已知能保护持有者免受危险魔法的影响。皇帝的首席工匠克莱伦塔维厄斯·瓦利修斯是已知的最后一位拥有谬误索菲亚之杖的人。在战栗堡入侵期间，法杖在混乱中丢失，此后便杳无音讯。<BR>
<BR>
月掠者之剑<BR>
<BR>
月掠者是一把由迪德拉大君梅鲁涅斯·大衮创造的强大宽刃剑。这把剑是在帝国战栗堡入侵期间出现的，然而，此后没有关于它出现的记录。它可能至今仍留在被毁的战栗堡中。已知月掠者之剑能增强持有者的剑术，同时对受害者施加强力毒素。这把剑显然还有力量将毁灭大君本人打回湮灭。<BR>
<BR>
沃伦德朗<BR>
<BR>
力量之锤沃伦德朗，据说是由现已失落的鲁尔肯氏族的矮人创造的，在他们从世界上消失的数百年之前。沃伦德朗有能力为持有者恢复生命，但它最出名的是其麻痹和吸取力量的效果。如同创造它的矮人一样，沃伦德朗也容易突然消失，有时在几天后重新出现，有时则是在数亿年后。<BR>
<BR>
瓦巴杰克<BR>
<BR>
疯狂与混乱是谢尔格拉斯的标志。瓦巴杰克体现了这些特质。对生物使用这件神器会将其转化为其他东西。<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Final Confessions and Last Resort<BR>
Salar Nydendan.<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
I am ashamed. I never thought it would come to this. I am broken, sobbing, and desperate. I am a shadow of the man I once was. My dignity is gone. I have nothing left in this life. Everything that I have loved or cared about is gone from me. This is my final testament.<BR>
My life was not always so.<BR>
Once, I was a respected Mer of House Indoril and a Temple Ordinator on top of that. Such was my skill and standing that I was stationed nowhere other than Vivec city at the High Fane, where I frequently policed the Saint Olms canton. I spent the first sixty years of my service as an Ordinator on that patrol. My record was exceptional. I managed to arrest some of the most notorious criminals in the city, including a band of Morag Tong impersonators, and a thief who bad been robbing Hlaalu nobles blind.<BR>
<BR>
When I celebrated my 150th birthday, the Temple announced a raid against a series of Daedric shrines in the Ascadian Isles region. I was one of the first Ordinators selected for the duty. I was honored beyond words at my promotion. Three days later, I found myself amongst twenty-nine of my Indoril kin, all of us fully-armored, sailing on the three ships that carried us on the raid.<BR>
Our first target was on a small island to the west of Vivec. We attacked under the cover of darkness, slaughtering the handful of followers with no losses ourselves. We then set about burning their books and destroying everything else the Temple had labeled as heretical. Our final action was to topple the statue of Mehrunes Dagon.
We left the shrine a broken, burning wreck.<BR>
And so it went on like this for a month. We attacked and destroyed twelve bases for Daedra worshippers, losing only six of our brothers. Each of our kin that fell did so in the most glorious and honorable of ways, fighting to the last breath against the enemies of the Tribunal Temple.<BR>
<BR>
Our final target was far south of Tel Branora. It was the largest shrine we had encountered yet. Even in the dead of night, the infernal place seemed to glow with a sickening light. We anchored and rushed at the entrance to the shrine, seeing only one guard on duty. As we came at him, a look of sheer delight crossed his face. <br>
"Visitors, come to kill us all! Take our heads, friends, they're no good to us anyhow. Leave our feet though! We can't dance without our feet!"<BR>
He broke into a fit of laughter and fell to the ground, holding his
sides as tears poured down his face. I ended his life, feeling a mix of utter revulsion and pity.<BR>
We stormed into the shrine, cutting down dozens on the worshippers. As we reached the first room of the shrine, we saw Khajiit and Argonians dressed as House Dres nobles, and Dunmer dressed as slaves crawling on the ground. The beasts were pretending to whip the Dunmer, and all were giggling at what they must have viewed as a highly comedic play. We cut them all down before they registered our presence.<BR>
In the second room, men and Mer were wearing pants on their arms, shirts on their legs, shoes on their hands and gloves on their feet. They were all dancing in perfect synchronization with each other, although no music could be heard. Unlike the previous room, these loons turned on us the moment we opened the door, attacking us with bare hands and claws. Some even bit into our armor. The fight lasted only a few minutes, and although none of us were killed, two of our men received broken limbs, and one was knocked unconscious. We split up, ten of us going left, and eleven going right. I was one of those that went right, and we passed through several rooms with no event. Eventually we entered a small room. It appeared empty, but as the last of us passed through the doorway, the door slammed shut behind us, and
three Golden Saints materialized out of thin air and laid into us. Our ebony weapons met their Daedric blades, and we were able to send them back to Oblivion, but not before losing seven comrades.<BR>
We were disheartened, but forced ourselves to push on. We finally entered the main room of the shrine. The room was dominated by a huge statue to the Mad God. What we saw in this room horrified us.<BR>
Children, no older than eight, were playing with the corpses of our brothers that had separated from us. Some were wearing pieces of Indoril armor, pretending to be Ordinators themselves. Others were jumping up and down on the dead bodies, squealing in delight. I saw one using a severed head as a puppet.<BR>
Our rage and horror were beyond words. In our state of blind fury, we ran into the room, hacking the children to pieces. Some cried as we attacked, others laughed. Some simply sat and stared at us.<BR>
Of the thirty of us that had set out, there were seven of us left, three of which were injured. We backtracked and recovered our injured brothers, and brought them to the main room of the shrine. We set about our work with heavy hearts, burning the books and destroying the blasphemous material. When it came to toppling the statue, it took us two hours. While twenty of us could have done it in a matter of minutes, the handful of us that remained had quite a difficult time. By this point, our unconscious brother had regained his senses, and was able to help us. For the entire two hours we were working to bring down the statue, I felt its eyes on me. Each time I looked up at it, it was staring straight back at me, a cocky smile on its face. Even as its ankles cracked and it fell off its base, I swear it was staring at me, all the way down on its fall to the floor.<BR>
<BR>
The seven of us returned to Vivec and were celebrated as heroes. I was able to retire to a small house in Methren-Ruhn. Life was treating me well. I met a weaver's daughter and married her. We had a son together. I was truly happy.<BR>
<BR>
Then the voices started.<BR>
<BR>
They were subtle at first, whispering strange suggestions into my ears at the most bizarre times. At the market, I would suddenly get the urge to throw fruit at someone for the comic value. My mind would tell me to trip a woman carrying a box of glasses, just to see them shatter. A voice would provoke me to start singing and dancing in the middle of a crowded bazaar. Silly stuff, really. Although I now realize I should
have immediately gone to the Temple for help, I paid the voices no heed. Even though as the years went by, the voices became more numerous and insistent, I still did not obey them.<BR>
I believe this was the turning point in my life, where I officially started down the path of madness. At the time I did not realize it, but I now know that when I was refusing to obey the voices, I would do so out loud. Oh, what my wife and son must have thought of me then, a decorated Ordinator and member of House Indoril talking to himself
about the most ridiculous of subjects.<BR>
The voices began to control me, however. It came to a point where I could no longer tell the voices from my own intuition and reason. Those days were my most shameful. I have no recollection of what I did. The acts of madness that I undoubtedly committed were as normal to me as working in my garden. All I know is that by the time I regained my distinction of reality and insanity, my wife and son had left me. I never saw or heard from them again.<BR>
<BR>
I slipped into a deep depression. The voice no longer spoke to me. I was left to exist in the ruins of what my madness had left me. I had created multiple drawings of smiling faces on the wall by stabbing the wood with a fork thousands of times. I had somehow attached all my furniture to the ceiling. My urns had been broken open, and the pieces
had been glued back together to form a giant sculpture of a fish.<BR>
And the worst part was that I felt lonely without the voices. As much as it sickened me, I knew deep down that the voices were what kept me company. I was happy when I was mad, and now that the voices were gone I was depressed. It was horrible, but I actually began to wish for the voices to come back. Each day was worse than the last. After a few months, I was reduced to a mewing wreck, curled into a sobbing ball on the floor, whispering through tears for the sweet madness to take me away from this horrible, lonely world that it had created for me in the first place.<BR>
And I remained in solitude for more days than I could count.<BR>
<BR>
I awoke one morning to the sun on my face, stinging my red, dry eyes. I rose off the hard floor of my house, and made my way to a cupboard, where I had some pieces of stale bread. I took out the remainder of my food and set it on the counter, next to my water basin. I would have to get more later, meaning I would have to leave my house and expose myself to the outside world. I was afraid, people whispered about me behind my back.<BR>
I looked at my reflection in the water basin. My skin was dirty, and sagging off my thin face. My eyes were sunken deep into my skull, and I had lost most of my hair. The tips of my ears were beginning to droop. I stared into that water basin for longer than I can recall. I must have dozed off.<BR>
When I came back to my senses, I saw that a different face was in the basin. It was handsome, with a well-trimmed goatee, carefully groomed hair, and piercing eyes. The face in the basin smiled at me.<BR>
"Boo," it said.<BR>
I almost had a heart attack.<BR>
By the time I was done screaming, the basin was flipped over, with the last of my clean water until the next rainfall absorbing into the floorboards. My heart was slamming in my chest, and I was heaving to catch my breath. Did I imagine that?<BR>
"No, you did not, dear Salar."<BR>
That voice! It was as if all the voices were speaking to me again! But it was a single voice. I searched around the room for the source.<BR>
I didn't see it at first. Then I looked up at my ceiling. Sitting on a chair fastened to the ceiling, quite upside-down, was an apparition of what could only be the Laughing God.<BR>
He regarded me from the ceiling, smiling a wicked half-smile, and floated out of the chair. He rotated in mid-air, righting himself as he set down on the floor in front of me. The way he stood, one hand on his hip and one resting on his cane brought a flashback of all those years ago when I was in the service of the Temple as an Ordinator, of the statue that I and my six comrades had to bring down by ourselves. It
was him.<BR>
"Oh dear boy don't look so shocked, I thought you would be glad to hear my voice again, let alone see my apparition."<BR>
I was stammering for words. Was this what I had prayed for?<BR>
"I'll be honest old boy. I am a busy Daedra. I have work to do. I offer you a choice. You can come with me, and be lost in the delightful mindlessness that I will bestow upon you. Or, you can stay here and be miserable."<BR>
My mind raced. The implications of his words set in. Yes, this was the Mad God standing in front of me. Yes, he was offering to answer my prayers. Then why was I hesitating?<BR>
Honor?<BR>
Did I still have honor?<BR>
Yes, I did. Not much, but I did. I gathered my courage and spoke to him.<BR>
"Come back in a day. I need to take care of a few things. Then I will give myself to you."<BR>
"Fair enough, but do be ready when I get here. I don't like to be kept waiting. There is far too much fun to be had to just sit around and wait all day."<BR>
With that, he was gone.<BR>
<BR>
I searched my house frantically for ink, a pen and paper. What I wrote then is what you are reading now. I stayed up for 24 hours straight, organizing my thoughts and writing them down.<BR>
So this is it; my last confessions.<BR>
To my Indoril and Temple brethren, I am sorry. For every year I was in service to the both of you, I was happier than I could have imagined. May Great House Indoril and the Holy Tribunal Temple live on to see the end of this world, and beyond that too. Although I have failed you both, I owe you as well. While I may not have fallen from grace had I not been an Ordinator, my life would not have been filled with the righteous thrill that one can only get from doing the holy work of the Tribunal, bless them thrice each and thrice again.<BR>
To my wife and son, whose names I am not fit to even write, for they have brought me too much joy to measure, I hope you have moved on and have found a better life away from the raving madman that was once your husband and father. I never wanted anything but the best for you, and I hope that when I die, I can look upon you from the next life and see you smile.<BR>
And to the reader, I have an explanation. I am not happy to join the ranks of loons that serve the Laughing God. It has become a necessity. I have nothing left in this world. I hope that as I join the Mad God and lose my mind, one day a warrior of the Temple will come and take my life, as I did so many years ago. Perhaps then I shall be absolved for my sins, and my spirit will be able to join my ancestors.<BR>
<BR>
It has been 24 hours. I see him now, standing in the corner, twirling his cane idly. I best not keep him waiting. I never thought that my last resort would be to allow a Daedra to take my mind. May the Holy Tribunal have mercy upon me.<BR>
<BR>
Farewell<BR>
Salar Nydendan<BR>
Kinsman of Great House Indoril<BR>
Diviner of the Tribunal Temple<BR>
Loving Father and Husband<BR>
Disgraced and a Failure, to be absolved in Death.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
最终忏悔与最后手段<BR>
萨拉尔·尼登丹。<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
我感到羞愧。我从没想过会走到这一步。我崩溃了，哭泣着，绝望着。我是我曾经那个人的影子。我的尊严已荡然无存。我在这世上已一无所有。我所爱过或关心过的一切都已离我而去。这是我的最终遗言。<BR>
我的生活并非一直如此。<BR>
曾经，我是一位受人尊敬的因多瑞尔家族的精灵，同时还是一名神殿调度使。凭借我的技能和地位，我只被派驻在维威克城的高殿，经常在圣奥姆斯行政区巡逻。我在最初的六十年服务中，作为一名调度使从事着巡逻任务。我的记录非常出色。我成功逮捕了城里一些最臭名昭著的罪犯，包括一伙莫拉格·堂的冒牌货，以及一个让哈拉鲁贵族们损失惨重的窃贼。<BR>
<BR>
当我庆祝我150岁生日时，神殿宣布对阿斯卡迪亚群岛地区的一系列迪德拉圣祠发动突袭。我是首批被选中执行任务的调度使之一。我对这次晋升感到无比的荣幸。三天后，我发现自己和其他二十九位因多瑞尔同胞一起，全副武装，登上三艘船只，前往执行突袭任务。<BR>
我们的第一个目标在维威克以西的一个小岛上。我们在夜幕的掩护下发动了攻击，没有损失一兵一卒，就屠杀了那为数不多的信徒。然后我们开始焚烧他们的书籍，摧毁神殿认定为异端的一切东西。我们最后的行动是推倒梅鲁涅斯·大衮的雕像。
我们离开时，那座圣祠已是一片破碎燃烧的废墟。<BR>
就这样持续了一个月。我们攻击并摧毁了十二个迪德拉崇拜者的基地，只牺牲了六位兄弟。我们每一位倒下的同胞，都以最光荣和体面的方式，为对抗审判席神殿的敌人战斗到了最后一息。<BR>
<BR>
我们的最后一个目标在泰尔·布勒诺拉以南很远的地方。这是我们迄今遇到的最大的圣祠。即使在夜深人静时，那地狱般的地方似乎也散发着令人作呕的光芒。我们抛锚停船，冲向圣祠入口，只看到一个守卫在值班。当我们朝他冲去时，他脸上露出了纯粹的喜悦表情。<br>
“访客们，是来杀光我们的！拿走我们的脑袋吧，朋友们，反正对我们也没什么用了。不过，请留下我们的脚！没有脚我们可跳不了舞！”<BR>
他爆发出一阵大笑，倒在地上，捂着肚子，眼泪
顺着脸颊流淌。我结束了他的生命，心中充满了极度的厌恶和怜悯。<BR>
我们冲进圣祠，砍倒了数十名信徒。当我们到达圣祠的第一个房间时，我们看到卡吉特和阿尔贡人装扮成德雷斯家族的贵族，而丹莫则装扮成奴隶在地上爬行。那些兽类假装鞭打丹莫，他们都为他们必定认为是一出非常喜剧的表演而咯咯笑着。在他们意识到我们的存在之前，我们就把他们全部砍倒了。<BR>
在第二个房间里，男人和精灵们把裤子穿在胳膊上，衬衫穿在腿上，鞋子戴在手上，手套穿在脚上。他们都在完美同步地跳舞，尽管听不到任何音乐。与之前的房间不同，这些疯子在我们打开门的瞬间就转向我们，用赤手空拳和爪子攻击我们。有些甚至咬我们的盔甲。战斗只持续了几分钟，虽然我们没人阵亡，但有两人骨折，一人被击昏。我们分开了，十个人向左，十一个人向右。我是向右走的人之一，我们穿过了几个房间，没有发生任何事。最后我们进入了一个小房间。它看起来是空的，但当我们最后一个人穿过门口时，门在我们身后砰地关上了，
三个黄金圣徒凭空出现，向我们发起攻击。我们的黑檀武器迎向他们的迪德拉利刃，我们设法将他们送回了湮灭，但在此之前我们失去了七位战友。<BR>
我们灰心丧气，但强迫自己继续前进。我们终于进入了圣祠的主厅。这个房间被一尊巨大的疯神雕像所占据。我们在房间里看到的景象让我们惊恐万分。<BR>
孩子们，年龄不超过八岁，正在摆弄我们分开行动的那些兄弟的尸体。有些穿着因多瑞尔盔甲的碎片，假装自己是调度使。另一些则在尸体上跳来跳去，高兴地尖叫着。我看到一个孩子把一个砍下的头颅当作木偶。<BR>
我们的愤怒和恐惧难以言表。在盲目狂怒的状态下，我们冲进房间，把那些孩子砍成碎片。我们攻击时，有些孩子哭了，另一些则大笑。还有一些只是坐在那里盯着我们。<BR>
出发时的三十人，最后只剩下我们七个，其中三人受伤。我们原路返回，找回受伤的兄弟，把他们带到主厅。我们怀着沉重的心情开始工作，焚烧书籍，销毁亵渎神灵的材料。轮到推倒雕像时，我们花了两个小时。二十个人的话，几分钟就能搞定，但我们剩下的这几个人干得非常吃力。这时，我们昏迷的兄弟已经苏醒，能够帮上忙。在我们努力推倒雕像的两个小时里，我一直感觉到它的眼睛在盯着我。每次我抬头看它，它都在直直地回瞪着我，脸上带着傲慢的笑容。即使在它的脚踝断裂、从基座上倒下时，我发誓它也在盯着我，一直盯着它摔到地上。<BR>
<BR>
我们七个人回到了维威克，被当作英雄来庆祝。我得以退休，在梅斯伦-鲁恩的一所小房子里安顿下来。生活对我很好。我遇到了一个织工的女儿，并与她结了婚。我们有了一个儿子。我真的很幸福。<BR>
<BR>
然后，声音开始了。<BR>
<BR>
起初它们很微妙，在最古怪的时刻向我耳语奇怪的暗示。在市场，我会突然有冲动向某人扔水果，只为取乐。我的脑子会告诉我去绊倒一个端着玻璃盒子的女人，只是为了看它们摔碎。一个声音会怂恿我在拥挤的集市中央开始唱歌跳舞。真的，都是些愚蠢的事。虽然我现在意识到我应该
立刻去神殿寻求帮助，但我没有理会那些声音。尽管随着岁月流逝，声音变得越来越频繁和执着，我仍然没有服从它们。<BR>
我相信这是我人生的转折点，是我正式开始走上疯狂之路的时刻。当时我没有意识到，但现在我知道，当我拒绝服从声音时，我会大声说出来。哦，那时我的妻子和儿子一定会把我当成什么了，一个功勋卓著的调度使和因多瑞尔家族的成员，竟然自言自语
谈论着最荒谬的话题。<BR>
然而，声音开始控制我。到了我再也无法分辨声音与我自己的直觉和理智的地步。那些日子是我最羞耻的时光。我不记得我做了什么。我无疑犯下的疯狂行为，对我来说就像在花园里劳作一样正常。我只知道，当我重新能够区分现实与疯狂时，我的妻子和儿子已经离开了我。我再也没有见过他们，也没有他们的消息。<BR>
<BR>
我陷入了深深的抑郁。声音不再对我说话了。我被遗弃在我疯狂所留下的废墟中生存。我用叉子在木墙上戳了数千次，画出了许多笑脸。我不知怎的把我所有的家具都固定在了天花板上。我的骨灰瓮被打碎了，碎片
被重新粘在一起，形成了一尊巨大的鱼形雕塑。<BR>
最糟糕的是，没有那些声音，我感到孤独。尽管这让我感到恶心，但我内心深处知道，那些声音是我的陪伴。当我疯狂时我是快乐的，而现在声音消失了，我很沮丧。这太可怕了，但我竟然开始希望那些声音回来。一天比一天更糟。几个月后，我沦为一个哭泣的废人，蜷缩在地板上，成为一个哭泣的球，泪流满面地低语着，祈求那甜蜜的疯狂将我带离它最初为我创造的这可怕、孤独的世界。<BR>
我又在孤独中度过了数不清的日子。<BR>
<BR>
一天早上，我醒来时阳光照在我脸上，刺痛了我发红干涩的眼睛。我从房子里坚硬的地板上爬起来，走到橱柜前，那里还有一些陈面包。我把剩下的食物拿出来，放在柜台上，旁边是我的水盆。我以后得再弄些食物，这意味着我必须离开房子，暴露在外面的世界。我很害怕，人们在我背后窃窃私语。<BR>
我看着水盆里自己的倒影。我的皮肤很脏，从瘦削的脸上耷拉下来。我的眼睛深深凹陷进头骨，头发也掉得差不多了。我的耳尖开始下垂。我盯着那个水盆看了不知多久。我一定是打瞌睡了。<BR>
当我回过神来时，我看到盆里是一张不同的脸。它很英俊，留着修剪整齐的山羊胡，精心打理的头发，和锐利的眼睛。盆里的脸对我笑了。<BR>
“嘣，”它说。<BR>
我差点心脏病发作。<BR>
当我尖叫完，水盆已经被打翻了，我最后一点干净水（下一次下雨前）都渗进了地板。我的心脏在胸腔里狂跳，我喘着粗气，试图平复呼吸。那是我的幻觉吗？<BR>
“不，你没有，亲爱的萨拉尔。”<BR>
那个声音！就像所有声音又在对我说活了！但那只是一个声音。我环顾房间，寻找声音的来源。<BR>
起初我没有看到。然后我抬头看向天花板。坐在一把固定在天花板上的椅子上，完全倒挂着，是一个只能是笑神的幽灵。<BR>
他从天花板上注视着我，脸上挂着邪恶的半个微笑，从椅子上飘了下来。他在半空中旋转，在我面前的地板上站定，恢复了正位。他站立的姿态，一手叉腰，一手拄着拐杖，让我回想起多年前我作为调度使为神殿服务时，我和我的六位战友不得不亲自推倒的那尊雕像。就
是他。<BR>
“哦，亲爱的孩子，别这么惊讶，我以为你会很高兴再次听到我的声音，更别说看到我的幽灵了。”<BR>
我结结巴巴说不出话来。这就是我祈祷的结果吗？<BR>
“老实说吧，老伙计。我是个忙碌的迪德拉。我还有事要做。我给你一个选择。你可以跟我走，迷失在我将赐予你的愉快无意识中。或者，你可以留在这里，继续痛苦下去。”<BR>
我的思绪飞快地转动。他的话中的含义开始显现。是的，站在我面前的是疯神。是的，他愿意回应我的祈祷。那我为什么还在犹豫？<BR>
荣誉？<BR>
我还有荣誉感吗？<BR>
是的，我有。不多，但确实还有。我鼓起勇气，对他说。<BR>
“一天后再来。我需要处理一些事情。然后我会把自己交给你。”<BR>
“好吧，但我来的时候你可得准备好。我不喜欢等人。有太多好玩的事等着我，可没工夫整天坐着干等。”<BR>
说完，他就消失了。<BR>
<BR>
我疯狂地在房子里翻找墨水、笔和纸。我写下的东西，就是你现在看到的这些。我连续二十四小时没睡，整理思绪并写了下来。<BR>
所以，就是这样；我最后的忏悔。<BR>
致我的因多瑞尔和神殿的兄弟们，我很抱歉。在我为你们服务的每一年里，我都比想象中更快乐。愿因多瑞尔大豪族和神圣审判席神殿能延续到这个世界终结，乃至更久。虽然我辜负了你们两位，但我也欠你们。如果我不是调度使，我也许不会失宠，但我的生命也不会充满那种只有执行审判席神圣工作才能获得的正义的快感，愿他们受三倍祝福，再受三倍祝福。<BR>
致我的妻子和儿子，我甚至不配写下你们的名字，因为你们带给了我太多无法衡量的快乐。我希望你们已经继续前行，远离那个曾是你们丈夫和父亲的胡言乱语的疯子，找到了更好的生活。我从来都只希望你们能得到最好的一切，我希望当我死后，能在来世看到你们微笑。<BR>
致读者，我有一个解释。我并不乐意加入侍奉笑神的疯子行列。这已成为一种必然。我在这世上已一无所有。我希望当我加入疯神并失去理智后，有一天会有神殿的战士来取我性命，正如我多年前所做的那样。也许那时我的罪孽就能得到赦免，我的灵魂就能与祖先团聚。<BR>
<BR>
已经二十四个小时了。我现在看到他站在角落里，漫不经心地转着他的手杖。我最好别让他久等。我从没想过，我最后的手段会是让一个迪德拉夺走我的理智。愿神圣审判席怜悯我。<BR>
<BR>
永别了<BR>
萨拉尔·尼登丹<BR>
因多瑞尔大豪族族人<BR>
审判席神殿神谕者<BR>
慈爱的父亲和丈夫<BR>
蒙羞的失败者，将在死亡中得到宽恕。<BR>
<BR>"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Confessions of a Thief<BR><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
I'm a thief. Now, don't get me wrong. I ain't saying this out of pride, but I ain't ashamed of my occupation neither. Thieves got a perfect right to exist in the Empire. People say we're dishonest. Of course, those people are usually either merchants or priests, which really gets me. Like a snake calling a worm 'legless'.<BR>
<BR>
Rulers like us. Crime in moderation is good for the economy. The trick is to keep it at a good, even pace with well-timed lulls to keep the fat bottoms from becoming complacent. Of course, the stupid thieves will keep stealing, empty their pockets, and steal some more. This ain't good for no-one. That's where the guilds come in.<BR>
<BR>
The Thieves Guild is what they call a crime regulator. We protect each other and punish the clumsy and greedy. The kings depend on us to keep amateurs out of business.<BR>
<BR>
Yeah, occasionally a king will come down on us. I've even seen a Guildmaster get himself stuck in prison once or twice. A cohort of mine said her first Guildmaster got himself hanged. If that happens, we have to get dirt on the king. Let me tell you, it ain't pretty.<BR>
<BR>
I got into the guild the way I've seen most thieves do it. It was a few years back, when that bully Jagar Tharn was sitting on the throne and everyone thought he was the Emperor. My parents' farm got turned into eight acres of dust and rock, and they threw me and my brothers out. I was always thin, but by the time we made it to the closest town, I had become a good deal skinnier.<BR>
<BR>
The town had some dirt that plants could grow in, but it didn't make them any richer than us. I tried to get all kinds of jobs, but the more desperate I became, the faster I'd get kicked out. When the rainy season finally came, it came like a sea and I didn't have nowhere to stay. Luckily, I found an unlocked cellar door.<BR>
<BR>
Turns out that the owners of the house slept like old dogs, because I robbed them blind and they never even woke up. I sold it all to a shady merchant I knew and spent the next two days living like a potentate. Then I got my first visit from the Guild.<BR>
<BR>
I remember what he looked like, but not what he said. Something like, "Hey kid, if you want to steal in these parts, you're going to have to join the Thieves Guild. Otherwise, someone like me is going to break your skinny arms so you can't steal."<BR>
<BR>
I've known some people who refused membership in the Guild and kept on stealing. I've broken some of their arms myself.<BR>
<BR>
For me, it was my first career offer since my pa told me that if I didn't milk the cow, he'd rip my head off. By comparison, this guy at the tavern was almost a gentleman. I agreed right away.<BR>
<BR>
Sure, I had to prove my worth to the Guild before I could join. But having two working arms is only part of the benefit: they trained me, taught me, and kept me out of prison. How many other guilds boast a forgery expert on the premises?<BR>
<BR>
So, the next time you're calling some swindling merchant or usurious priest a thief, think about it. There is honor among thieves -- I should know.<BR><BR>"""

<BR>
结果那房子的主人睡得死沉，我把他们偷了个精光，他们甚至都没醒。我把所有东西都卖给了一个我认识的奸商，接下来的两天我过得像个摄政王。然后，我迎来了公会的第一次拜访。<BR>
<BR>
我记得他长什么样，但不记得他说了什么。大概像这样：“嘿，小子，如果你想在这片地方偷东西，就得加入盗贼公会。否则，像我这样的人就会打断你那瘦胳膊，让你没法再偷。”<BR>
<BR>
我知道有些人拒绝加入公会，继续偷窃。我自己也打断过他们中一些人的胳膊。<BR>
<BR>
对我来说，这是自从我父亲告诉我，如果我不去挤牛奶，他就拧断我的脖子以来，我收到的第一份工作邀请。相比之下，酒馆里的这个家伙几乎可以算是个绅士了。我立刻就同意了。<BR>
<BR>
当然，加入之前我得向公会证明我的价值。但拥有两只健全的手臂只是好处之一：他们训练我，教导我，让我远离监狱。还有哪个公会能吹嘘自己场子里有伪造专家？<BR>
<BR>
所以，下次你再骂某个奸商或放高利贷的祭司是贼的时候，想想吧。盗贼之间是有道义的 -- 这一点我清楚。<BR><BR>"""

我记得他长什么样，但不记得他说了什么。大概像这样：“嘿，小子，如果你想在这片地方偷东西，就得加入盗贼公会。否则，像我这样的人就会打断你那瘦胳膊，让你没法再偷。”<BR>
<BR>
我知道有些人拒绝加入公会，继续偷窃。我自己也打断过他们中一些人的胳膊。<BR>
<BR>
对我来说，这是自从我父亲告诉我，如果我不去挤牛奶，他就拧断我的脖子以来，我收到的第一份工作邀请。相比之下，酒馆里的这个家伙几乎可以算是个绅士了。我立刻就同意了。<BR>
<BR>
当然，加入之前我得向公会证明我的价值。但拥有两只健全的手臂只是好处之一：他们训练我，教导我，让我远离监狱。还有哪个公会能吹嘘自己场子里有伪造专家？<BR>
<BR>
所以，下次你再骂某个奸商或放高利贷的祭司是贼的时候，想想吧。盗贼之间是有道义的 -- 这一点我清楚。<BR><BR>"""

> BOOK.FNAM T_Bk_CoronationOfEplear
The Coronation of Eplear
埃普勒尔加冕

> BOOK.TEXT T_Bk_CoronationOfEplear
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards">
<BR>The Coronation of Eplear<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Foreword and translation by Harman Maurus<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
[The Song of Eplear is a Bosmeri epic dating back to the First Era. It tells the story of King Eplear, founder of the Camoran Dynasty and the modern kingdom of Valenwood, whose unification of the Bosmeri tribes is counted among the greatest military feats of all time. His conquest, needless to say, was a seminal moment in the history of the Bosmer and Eplear remains a giant in Bosmeri history. Strangely, his song has never achieved the fame of lesser epics of the Bosmer, such as the Dansir Gol or the Meh Ayleidion.<BR>
<BR>
The poem itself is very lengthy, and more an amalgamation of separate songs and poems than a single work. Its verse is all but impenetrable to the translator; too much of the Bosmeri poetic meaning would be lost for the endeavor to be worthwhile. However, the notes, annotations, and comments that accompany many ancient copies of the Song could fill volumes of their own, and it is these I have aimed to collate and translate.<BR>
<BR>
This section deals with the coronation of King Eplear, and offers a fascinating insight into First Era Bosmer and the many ancient civilizations that once shared their homeland. While the account (ostensibly factual and prosaic) is replete with poetic imagery and, no doubt, exaggeration, it remains a worthy subject for study, and the best clues we have as to how the first year of the First Era played out.]<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
After many years of the hunt-against-wise-foes Eplear of the Camorans was supreme among the Boiche. Every tribe and clan had promised itself to Eplear and the green-sap by Eplear's words or his thousand arrows and blades, and Eplear had welcomed them. All the Boiche were as one and the green-sap was true-whole. The forest rejoiced to know Y'ffre's touch, and Falinesti graht-oak sang as Eplear climbed to its highest branch.<BR>
<BR>
There he stood, mightiest among Boiche and root of the sap. Atop Green-Sap-Walking Eplear king-of-all saw all his forest and praised Y'ffre that it was good. He promised all things good to Y'ffre who gave all things good to Bosmer. Y'ffre smiled on Eplear, most favored among most favored green-sap, and Falinesti graht-oak, most favored among most favored green-sap also, rose to walk Eplear king-of-all through the forest. A thousand thousand Boiche followed in the great graht-oak's wake and the Valenwood sang to see them run through it, as sap through a tree.<BR>
<BR>
Great Falinesti came to rest at last, as if in summer (for it was summer-of-the-heart for all green-sap). And a thousand thousand Boiche climbed its branches to crown their king-of-all, Eplear Elf-King Camoran.<BR>
<BR>
The greatest graht-oak stretched and sang and grew a new shape, only for Eplear Elf-King, a throne of the green-sap, living wood vibrant in honor of the king-of-all. Eplear sat and his people bowed. Every tribe of the Boiche came to lay gifts before Eplear Camoran, gifts for all the Bosmer.<BR>
<BR>
Abragoth of the Kahnik gave the head of Great-Gold-Ape-King, war chief of the golden apes who would not promise to Eplear (but not of those who would), and who the Kahnik shot with many arrows for their king-of-all. His bones were golden moonstone, and Eplear ate his face that his skull would be a helm for a king.<BR>
<BR>
Wendilac of the Parikh gave a hundred hundred pearls from the Blue Divide, treasures of Y'ffre's eyes-in-the-water, now Eplear's eyes-in-the-woods.<BR>
<BR>
Boleron of the Andrulo gave the hide of a terrible time-lizard, that the great hunter had chased over every footprint.<BR>
<BR>
Hormilrimor of the Guleld gave a feather, which was very beautiful.<BR>
<BR>
Ungalithor of the Liilgur Matilion gave himself to guard the king-of-all with every day, even when joy led him elsewhere.<BR>
<BR>
Silvenar of the Edinil gave his everything-that-is to Eplear to give to all the Boiche to speak.<BR>
<BR>
Oolathar of the Oolathar gave a million arrows of every make for Eplear to shoot a million things.<BR>
<BR>
Kidragon of the Tithihk gave all the colors, every one that is, on his own body.<BR>
<BR>
Yuuligon of the Calobar gave a great dead bug.<BR>
<BR>
Fogorth of the Jalkin gave a hundred vessels of honey that was sweet and good and fit for the king-of-all.<BR>
<BR>
And many other tribes gave many other gifts, and Eplear had many hundreds. And when all the tribes had given all the gifts, others came as well.<BR>
<BR>
The giants gave Eplear a city of Haven. They walked in the sea and made great buildings of stone they fetched, only tiny buildings to them because giants are great-large.<BR>
<BR>
The bird-men of the rivers gave Eplear five-and-twenty tongues of their own, and after he ate them all he spoke them all and sang.<BR>
<BR>
The satyrs of the woods gave a secret, whispered one more benefit of hiding even Eplear had not thought of. Eplear told everyone the secret because he did not like them, but everyone liked the satyrs' benefit of hiding.<BR>
<BR>
The centaurs gave Eplear an idea that many things would happen and one day men would rule.<BR>
<BR>
Kulathuah the Haredda gave much tree-flesh that Eplear knew was useful to the clever men.<BR>
<BR>
Juuk the Kothithiri gave ten strange beasts from far away.<BR>
<BR>
Hadhuul the king of elves-elsewhere gave a handful of magic, which his people were clever at.<BR>
<BR>
And many other peoples gave many other gifts, and at the end of it all Eplear had many many hundreds. And he gave them all to all his people, because the green-sap was true-whole and Eplear wanted only that. He called to the priests of Y'ffre, who were all wise and holy Boiche who knew many things, and knew what Y'ffre wanted almost as well as Eplear Camoran. All the Boiche sang and the forest sang with them, and Jone and Jode smiled to hear such a beautiful song of the green-sap, and listened as they sang for a whole turn.<BR>

Eplear never missed, and when some time was passed, the sky grew darker, and the Great-Bird-of-the-Hunt fell from the sky to land at the feet of Green-Sap-Walking. Eplear Camoran ate its great elf heart, and much more besides, and tore one great wing from its body. He ate that too, until only a great long bone was left, and that was his new bow, fit for king-of-all. And then Eplear declared that all were his clan, and all the Boiche feasted on the Great-Bird-of-the-Hunt until they were full.<BR>
<BR>

Eplear told the Boiche that Y'ffre smiled on all of them, and Eplear knew no falsehood, and he was right.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards">
<BR>埃普勒尔加冕<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
哈曼·毛鲁斯 前言与翻译<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
[《埃普勒尔之歌》是一部波斯莫史诗，可追溯至第一纪元。它讲述了卡莫兰王朝和现代瓦伦伍德王国的奠基者埃普勒尔国王的故事，他统一波斯莫各部落的壮举被视为有史以来最伟大的军事成就之一。他的征服，无需多言，是波斯莫历史上的一个开创性时刻，埃普勒尔在波斯莫历史上仍是一位巨人。奇怪的是，他的史诗从未像波斯莫那些较次要的史诗（如《丹西尔·戈尔》或《梅·亚历迪昂》）那样闻名遐迩。<BR>
<BR>
这首诗本身非常冗长，与其说是一部单一作品，不如说是不同歌曲和诗作的融合。其诗句对译者来说几乎无法破译；进行翻译会损失太多波斯莫诗歌的意义，得不偿失。然而，伴随许多古老抄本的注释、评注和评论，本身就能汇集成册，而我的目标正是整理和翻译这些内容。<BR>
<BR>
这一部分讲述了埃普勒尔国王的加冕典礼，为我们了解第一纪元的波斯莫以及曾经共享其家园的众多古代文明提供了引人入胜的视角。虽然这段叙述（表面上是事实和散文式的）充满了诗意的意象，并且无疑有夸张之处，但它仍然是一个值得研究的主题，也是我们了解第一纪元元年是如何展开的最佳线索。]<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
在对智敌的多年追猎之后，卡莫兰的埃普勒尔在波切人中至高无上。每个部落和氏族都通过埃普勒尔的言辞或他的千箭万刃，向埃普勒尔和青液宣誓效忠，而埃普勒尔也接纳了他们。所有波切人合为一体，青液真正完整。森林为感受到伊'弗瑞的触摸而欢欣鼓舞，当埃普勒尔爬上法琳奈斯提的格拉特橡树最高枝时，它放声歌唱。<BR>
<BR>
他站在那里，是波切中最强者，也是树液的根基。在行走青液之上，万物之王埃普勒尔俯瞰他的整片森林，并赞美伊'弗瑞，因它甚好。他向赐予波斯莫一切美好事物的伊'弗瑞承诺了一切美好之事。伊'弗瑞向埃普勒尔微笑，他是最受眷顾的青液中最受眷顾者，而法琳奈斯提的格拉特橡树，同样是最受眷顾的青液中最受眷顾者，它拔地而起，带着万物之王埃普勒尔穿行于森林之中。成千上万的波切人跟随着巨大的格拉特橡树的轨迹，瓦伦伍德为看到他们如同树液般穿梭其间而歌唱。<BR>
<BR>
伟大的法琳奈斯提终于停驻下来，如同身处夏日（因为对所有青液而言，那是心中的盛夏）。成千上万的波切人爬上它的枝桠，为他们的万物之王、精灵王埃普勒尔·卡莫兰加冕。<BR>
<BR>
最伟大的格拉特橡树伸展、歌唱并生长出新的形态，专为精灵王埃普勒尔而生的青液王座，鲜活的木材为万物之王而熠熠生辉。埃普勒尔就座，他的子民鞠躬致敬。波切人的每个部落都来到埃普勒尔·卡莫兰面前献上礼物，献给所有波斯莫的礼物。<BR>
<BR>
卡尼克的阿布拉戈斯献上了大金猿王的头颅，他是那些不肯向埃普勒尔效忠（但并非那些愿意效忠的）的金色猿猴的战争首领，卡尼克人为他们的万物之王向他射了许多箭。他的骨骼是金色的月亮石，埃普勒尔吃掉了他的脸，以便他的头骨能成为国王的头盔。<BR>
<BR>
帕里克的温迪拉克献上了来自蓝界的万颗珍珠，那是伊'弗瑞水中之眼的珍宝，如今成了埃普勒尔的林中之眼。<BR>
<BR>
安德鲁洛的博莱隆献上了一头可怕的时间蜥蜴的皮，那是伟大的猎手踏遍每一处足迹才追到的。<BR>
<BR>
古尔德的霍尔米里莫献上了一根羽毛，非常美丽。<BR>
<BR>
利尔古尔·马蒂利翁的温加利索献出了自己，日日夜夜守护万物之王，即使欢愉将他引向他处。<BR>
<BR>
埃迪尼尔的希尔维纳献出了他的一切，让埃普勒尔交给所有波切人传颂。<BR>
<BR>
奥拉萨的奥拉萨献上了百万支各式各样的箭，让埃普勒尔能射中百万种事物。<BR>
<BR>
提提克的基德拉贡献出了所有的色彩，每一种存在之色，都绘在他自己的身体上。<BR>
<BR>
卡洛巴的尤利贡献上了一只巨大的死虫。<BR>
<BR>
贾尔金的福戈斯献上了一百罐甜美而优质的蜂蜜，适合万物之王享用。<BR>
<BR>
还有许多其他部落献上了许多其他礼物，埃普勒尔收到了成百上千件。当所有部落都献完礼后，其他族群也来了。<BR>
<BR>
巨人们献给埃普勒尔一座哈文城。他们在海中行走，用他们搬运的石头建造了宏伟的建筑，但对他们来说只是些小建筑，因为巨人们非常高大。<BR>
<BR>
河流中的鸟人献给了埃普勒尔他们自己的二十五种语言，他全部吃掉后，便能说会唱了。<BR>
<BR>
森林中的萨提尔们献上了一个秘密，耳语了一个连埃普勒尔都未曾想到的隐藏好处。埃普勒尔因为不喜欢他们，所以把这个秘密告诉了所有人，但所有人都喜欢萨提尔们的隐藏好处。<BR>
<BR>
半人马们给了埃普勒尔一个想法：许多事情将会发生，有一天人类会统治。<BR>
<BR>
哈雷达的库拉图阿献上了许多树木之肉，埃普勒尔知道这对那些聪明人很有用。<BR>
<BR>
科西西里的朱克献上了十只来自远方的奇异野兽。<BR>
<BR>
异乡精灵之王哈杜乌尔献上了一把魔法，这是他的人民所擅长的。<BR>
<BR>
还有许多其他族群献上了许多其他礼物，到最后埃普勒尔收到了成百上千件。他把所有礼物都分给了他的子民，因为青液真正完整，而埃普勒尔只希望如此。他呼唤伊'弗瑞的祭司们，他们都是睿智而神圣的波切人，知晓许多事物，几乎和埃普勒尔·卡莫兰一样了解伊'弗瑞的意愿。他们与埃普勒尔一起爬上最高枝，将大金猿王的金色头骨戴在他头上，用一首歌来加冕他为王。所有的波切人都唱起了歌，森林与他们一同歌唱，乔恩和乔德听到如此美妙的青液之歌时露出了微笑，并倾听了他们整整一个轮转的歌唱。<BR>
<BR>
歌声结束时，埃普勒尔拿起他的弓，从百万支箭中取出一支，射出如此之远、如此之快、如此之强，以至于弓身碎裂成灰，箭矢飞得比乔恩和乔德还要高。埃普勒尔从未失手，过了一段时间，天空变暗，狩猎巨鸟从天而降，落在行走青液的脚下。埃普勒尔·卡莫兰吃掉了它那巨大的精灵心脏，还有许多其他部分，并从它身上撕下一只巨大的翅膀。他也吃掉了那只翅膀，直到只剩下一根巨大的长骨，那成了他的新弓，适合万物之王使用。然后埃普勒尔宣布所有人都是他的氏族，所有的波切人都尽情享用了狩猎巨鸟，直到吃饱为止。<BR>
<BR>
经过数小时的盛宴、数小时的歌唱、数小时的舞蹈和数小时的欢爱，埃普勒尔成为了瓦伦伍德的万物之王，精灵王卡莫兰深受所有人爱戴，所有人都知晓。埃普勒尔告诉波切人，伊'弗瑞对他们所有人都微笑，而埃普勒尔不说谎，他是对的。<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards">
<BR>The Coronation of Eplear<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Foreword and translation by Harman Maurus<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
[The Song of Eplear is a Bosmeri epic dating back to the First Era. It tells the story of King Eplear, founder of the Camoran Dynasty and the modern kingdom of Valenwood, whose unification of the Bosmeri tribes is counted among the greatest military feats of all time. His conquest, needless to say, was a seminal moment in the history of the Bosmer and Eplear remains a giant in Bosmeri history. Strangely, his song has never achieved the fame of lesser epics of the Bosmer, such as the Dansir Gol or the Meh Ayleidion.<BR>
<BR>
The poem itself is very lengthy, and more an amalgamation of separate songs and poems than a single work. Its verse is all but impenetrable to the translator; too much of the Bosmeri poetic meaning would be lost for the endeavor to be worthwhile. However, the notes, annotations, and comments that accompany many ancient copies of the Song could fill volumes of their own, and it is these I have aimed to collate and translate.<BR>
<BR>
This section deals with the coronation of King Eplear, and offers a fascinating insight into First Era Bosmer and the many ancient civilizations that once shared their homeland. While the account (ostensibly factual and prosaic) is replete with poetic imagery and, no doubt, exaggeration, it remains a worthy subject for study, and the best clues we have as to how the first year of the First Era played out.]<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
After many years of the hunt-against-wise-foes Eplear of the Camorans was supreme among the Boiche. Every tribe and clan had promised itself to Eplear and the green-sap by Eplear's words or his thousand arrows and blades, and Eplear had welcomed them. All the Boiche were as one and the green-sap was true-whole. The forest rejoiced to know Y'ffre's touch, and Falinesti graht-oak sang as Eplear climbed to its highest branch.<BR>
<BR>
There he stood, mightiest among Boiche and root of the sap. Atop Green-Sap-Walking Eplear king-of-all saw all his forest and praised Y'ffre that it was good. He promised all things good to Y'ffre who gave all things good to Bosmer. Y'ffre smiled on Eplear, most favored among most favored green-sap, and Falinesti graht-oak, most favored among most favored green-sap also, rose to walk Eplear king-of-all through the forest. A thousand thousand Boiche followed in the great graht-oak's wake and the Valenwood sang to see them run through it, as sap through a tree.<BR>
<BR>
Great Falinesti came to rest at last, as if in summer (for it was summer-of-the-heart for all green-sap). And a thousand thousand Boiche climbed its branches to crown their king-of-all, Eplear Elf-King Camoran.<BR>
<BR>
The greatest graht-oak stretched and sang and grew a new shape, only for Eplear Elf-King, a throne of the green-sap, living wood vibrant in honor of the king-of-all. Eplear sat and his people bowed. Every tribe of the Boiche came to lay gifts before Eplear Camoran, gifts for all the Bosmer.<BR>
<BR>
Abragoth of the Kahnik gave the head of Great-Gold-Ape-King, war chief of the golden apes who would not promise to Eplear (but not of those who would), and who the Kahnik shot with many arrows for their king-of-all. His bones were golden moonstone, and Eplear ate his face that his skull would be a helm for a king.<BR>
<BR>
Wendilac of the Parikh gave a hundred hundred pearls from the Blue Divide, treasures of Y'ffre's eyes-in-the-water, now Eplear's eyes-in-the-woods.<BR>
<BR>
Boleron of the Andrulo gave the hide of a terrible time-lizard, that the great hunter had chased over every footprint.<BR>
<BR>
Hormilrimor of the Guleld gave a feather, which was very beautiful.<BR>
<BR>
Ungalithor of the Liilgur Matilion gave himself to guard the king-of-all with every day, even when joy led him elsewhere.<BR>
<BR>
Silvenar of the Edinil gave his everything-that-is to Eplear to give to all the Boiche to speak.<BR>
<BR>
Oolathar of the Oolathar gave a million arrows of every make for Eplear to shoot a million things.<BR>
<BR>
Kidragon of the Tithihk gave all the colors, every one that is, on his own body.<BR>
<BR>
Yuuligon of the Calobar gave a great dead bug.<BR>
<BR>
Fogorth of the Jalkin gave a hundred vessels of honey that was sweet and good and fit for the king-of-all.<BR>
<BR>
And many other tribes gave many other gifts, and Eplear had many hundreds. And when all the tribes had given all the gifts, others came as well.<BR>
<BR>
The giants gave Eplear a city of Haven. They walked in the sea and made great buildings of stone they fetched, only tiny buildings to them because giants are great-large.<BR>
<BR>
The bird-men of the rivers gave Eplear five-and-twenty tongues of their own, and after he ate them all he spoke them all and sang.<BR>
<BR>
The satyrs of the woods gave a secret, whispered one more benefit of hiding even Eplear had not thought of. Eplear told everyone the secret because he did not like them, but everyone liked the satyrs' benefit of hiding.<BR>
<BR>
The centaurs gave Eplear an idea that many things would happen and one day men would rule.<BR>
<BR>
Kulathuah the Haredda gave much tree-flesh that Eplear knew was useful to the clever men.<BR>
<BR>
Juuk the Kothithiri gave ten strange beasts from far away.<BR>
<BR>
Hadhuul the king of elves-elsewhere gave a handful of magic, which his people were clever at.<BR>
<BR>
And many other peoples gave many other gifts, and at the end of it all Eplear had many many hundreds. And he gave them all to all his people, because the green-sap was true-whole and Eplear wanted only that. He called to the priests of Y'ffre, who were all wise and holy Boiche who knew many things, and knew what Y'ffre wanted almost as well as Eplear Camoran. They climbed to the highest branches with Eplear and placed the golden skull of the Great-Gold-Ape-King on his head and called him king with a song. All the Boiche sang and the forest sang with them, and Jone and Jode smiled to hear such a beautiful song of the green-sap, and listened as they sang for a whole turn.<BR>
<BR>
When the song was done, Eplear took his bow, and one of his million arrows, and loosed it so far and so fast and so strongly that the bow shattered into dust, and the arrow flew higher than Jone and Jode. Eplear never missed, and when some time was passed, the sky grew darker, and the Great-Bird-of-the-Hunt fell from the sky to land at the feet of Green-Sap-Walking. Eplear Camoran ate its great elf heart, and much more besides, and tore one great wing from its body. He ate that too, until only a great long bone was left, and that was his new bow, fit for king-of-all. And then Eplear declared that all were his clan, and all the Boiche feasted on the Great-Bird-of-the-Hunt until they were full.<BR>
<BR>
After many hours of feasting, and many hours of singing, and many hours of dancing, and many hours of lovemaking, Eplear was king-of-all in Valenwood, Elf-King Camoran beloved by all and all knew. Eplear told the Boiche that Y'ffre smiled on all of them, and Eplear knew no falsehood, and he was right.<BR>

<BR>
最伟大的格拉特橡树伸展、歌唱并生长出新的形态，专为精灵王埃普勒尔而生的青液王座，鲜活的木材为万物之王而熠熠生辉。埃普勒尔就座，他的子民鞠躬致敬。波切人的每个部落都来到埃普勒尔·卡莫兰面前献上礼物，献给所有波斯莫的礼物。<BR>
<BR>
卡尼克的阿布拉戈斯献上了大金猿王的头颅，他是那些不肯向埃普勒尔效忠（但并非那些愿意效忠的）的金色猿猴的战争首领，卡尼克人为他们的万物之王向他射了许多箭。他的骨骼是金色的月亮石，埃普勒尔吃掉了他的脸，以便他的头骨能成为国王的头盔。<BR>
<BR>
帕里克的温迪拉克献上了来自蓝界的万颗珍珠，那是伊'弗瑞水中之眼的珍宝，如今成了埃普勒尔的林中之眼。<BR>
<BR>
安德鲁洛的博莱隆献上了一头可怕的时间蜥蜴的皮，那是伟大的猎手踏遍每一处足迹才追到的。<BR>
<BR>
古尔德的霍尔米里莫献上了一根羽毛，非常美丽。<BR>
<BR>
利尔古尔·马蒂利翁的温加利索献出了自己，日日夜夜守护万物之王，即使欢愉将他引向他处。<BR>
<BR>
埃迪尼尔的希尔维纳献出了他的一切，让埃普勒尔交给所有波切人传颂。<BR>
<BR>
奥拉萨的奥拉萨献上了百万支各式各样的箭，让埃普勒尔能射中百万种事物。<BR>
<BR>
提提克的基德拉贡献出了所有的色彩，每一种存在之色，都绘在他自己的身体上。<BR>
<BR>
卡洛巴的尤利贡献上了一只巨大的死虫。<BR>
<BR>
贾尔金的福戈斯献上了一百罐甜美而优质的蜂蜜，适合万物之王享用。<BR>
<BR>
还有许多其他部落献上了许多其他礼物，埃普勒尔收到了成百上千件。当所有部落都献完礼后，其他族群也来了。<BR>
<BR>
巨人们献给埃普勒尔一座哈文城。他们在海中行走，用他们搬运的石头建造了宏伟的建筑，但对他们来说只是些小建筑，因为巨人们非常高大。<BR>
<BR>
河流中的鸟人献给了埃普勒尔他们自己的二十五种语言，他全部吃掉后，便能说会唱了。<BR>
<BR>
森林中的萨提尔们献上了一个秘密，耳语了一个连埃普勒尔都未曾想到的隐藏好处。埃普勒尔因为不喜欢他们，所以把这个秘密告诉了所有人，但所有人都喜欢萨提尔们的隐藏好处。<BR>
<BR>
半人马们给了埃普勒尔一个想法：许多事情将会发生，有一天人类会统治。<BR>
<BR>
哈雷达的库拉图阿献上了许多树木之肉，埃普勒尔知道这对那些聪明人很有用。<BR>
<BR>
科西西里的朱克献上了十只来自远方的奇异野兽。<BR>
<BR>
异乡精灵之王哈杜乌尔献上了一把魔法，这是他的人民所擅长的。<BR>
<BR>
还有许多其他族群献上了许多其他礼物，到最后埃普勒尔收到了成百上千件。他把所有礼物都分给了他的子民，因为青液真正完整，而埃普勒尔只希望如此。他呼唤伊'弗瑞的祭司们，他们都是睿智而神圣的波切人，知晓许多事物，几乎和埃普勒尔·卡莫兰一样了解伊'弗瑞的意愿。他们与埃普勒尔一起爬上最高枝，将大金猿王的金色头骨戴在他头上，用一首歌来加冕他为王。所有的波切人都唱起了歌，森林与他们一同歌唱，乔恩和乔德听到如此美妙的青液之歌时露出了微笑，并倾听了他们整整一个轮转的歌唱。<BR>
<BR>
歌声结束时，埃普勒尔拿起他的弓，从百万支箭中取出一支，射出如此之远、如此之快、如此之强，以至于弓身碎裂成灰，箭矢飞得比乔恩和乔德还要高。埃普勒尔从未失手，过了一段时间，天空变暗，狩猎巨鸟从天而降，落在行走青液的脚下。埃普勒尔·卡莫兰吃掉了它那巨大的精灵心脏，还有许多其他部分，并从它身上撕下一只巨大的翅膀。他也吃掉了那只翅膀，直到只剩下一根巨大的长骨，那成了他的新弓，适合万物之王使用。然后埃普勒尔宣布所有人都是他的氏族，所有的波切人都尽情享用了狩猎巨鸟，直到吃饱为止。<BR>
<BR>
经过数小时的盛宴、数小时的歌唱、数小时的舞蹈和数小时的欢爱，埃普勒尔成为了瓦伦伍德的万物之王，精灵王卡莫兰深受所有人爱戴，所有人都知晓。埃普勒尔告诉波切人，伊'弗瑞对他们所有人都微笑，而埃普勒尔不说谎，他是对的。<BR>

It should also be noted that corprus can bring on disease such as the blight's many forms yet I do not believe that corprus itself is in fact a disease.<BR><BR>

"Corprus Stalkers" look mostly humanoid (except for the disgusting corprus growths that cover their skin) and are the lowest category of the mindless beast form of corprus.<BR><BR>

"Ash Slaves" are the lowest rank of Dagoth Ur's personal servants. They are covered in corprus and their faces appear to be covered in ash. They have limited magical abilities and can be very dangerous.<BR><BR>
The next step in the evolutionary process is the "Ash Zombie". During this phase the Ash Slave's face becomes brittle and falls off leaving a gaping hole. During this time the servant loses his magical abilities but gains considerable strength.<BR><BR>
Next comes the "Ash Ghoul." After a certain amount of time the corprus inside the Ash Zombie starts to grow a strange tentacle-like appendage out of the hole in the zombie's face. In this form they gain a considerable amount of magical abilities and become very strong fighters. Some of Dagoth Ur's closest companions are Ash Ghouls.<BR><BR>
The final step would seem to be the "Ascended Sleeper." The tentacle growths inside the ghoul's head eventually completely emerge, and a new head is grown where the old one was. These beings are incredibly strong, and are the pinnacle of what a servant of Dagoth Ur can achieve.<BR><BR>
In a separate category from the creatures above are the "Ash Vampires." They are Dagoth Ur's closest kin of old house Dagoth. They share the most of Lorkhan's heart's power with him. Apparently even if killed they can be brought back to life by Dagoth Ur.<BR><BR>
Also of note are "Ash Poets". I am unsure exactly what these creatures are except that they are more of Dagoth Ur's corprus servants. I have never seen one of these beings nor have I heard any reliable reports, save the name. It is possible that "Ash Poet" is just another name for the Ascended Sleepers.<BR><BR>
Many believe that corprus was created by Dagoth Ur after he gained the power of Lorkhan's heart. I on the other hand think that corprus is in fact the gift/curse of a divine, like Divayth would suggest. But not a false divine like the Sharmat; it is the gift of a true divine, Lorkhan. I think that the corprus that flows through the heart and mutates all of Dagoth Ur's servants is the reason for Ur's unusual connection with Lorkhan's heart.<BR><BR>

“跛足尸化者”是那些长期患有尸化病的可怜灵魂。他们身上的增生物失控地生长，使其难以移动。同样的增生物也让他们变得异常强大，对普通精灵或人类非常危险。<BR><BR>
“灰烬奴隶”是达格斯·乌尔私人仆从中的最低等级。他们全身覆盖着尸化病，脸上看起来覆盖着灰烬。他们有有限的魔法能力，可能非常危险。<BR><BR>

与上述生物不同类别的还有“灰烬吸血鬼”。他们是达格斯·乌尔在旧达格斯家族中最亲近的亲属。他们与达格斯·乌尔共享了洛克汗之心的绝大部分力量。显然，即使被杀，他们也能被达格斯·乌尔复活。<BR><BR>

许多人认为尸化病是达格斯·乌尔获得洛克汗之心力量后创造的。而我则认为，尸化病实际上是如同迪维斯所暗示的那样，是神祇的恩赐/诅咒。但不是像沙玛特那样的伪神；它是真正神祇洛克汗的馈赠。我认为，流淌于心并使达格斯·乌尔所有仆从发生变异的尸化病，正是乌尔与洛克汗之心产生非凡联系的原因。<BR><BR>

<BR>
Cowardice of the Enemy<BR>
By Rentilis Lleroth<BR>
<BR>
Skaering barely managed to duck another crushing blow, and was beginning to wonder how long he would be able to evade. He knew his Dremora Lord opponent thoroughly outclassed him in every respect, but Skaering was determined to hold the daedra here until his allies could flee the ruin. The merciless and tireless Dremora cared little for what Skaering wanted, as yet another swing of its mace passed harmlessly overhead.<BR>
<BR>
In ducking this time, Skaering didn't merely bow, but dropped to one knee. Exhaustion was taking a toll, and the menacing gleam in the Dremora's eye said it knew as much. Striving to put some distance between it and himself, Skaering tried to use his wooden staff to trip the daedra. To his horror, the staff not only did not have the desired effect, but also splintered into pieces.<BR>
<BR>
The Dremora Lord took a wider stance, to bring its mace down upon Skaering with brutally malevolent force. The Nord scurried backward, his ringmail jangling against the stone floor. Once, twice, three times the mace failed to find its mark and instead left valleys in the stone of the cold floor. But then Skaering encountered a wall, and he knew his life was surely nearing its end. The daedra lifted the mace high into the air, laughing with wintery humour.<BR>
<BR>
Skaering's last, desperate act was not to raise his hands in a futile gesture of defense. Instead, he tried something he thought would confuse the Dremora, and allow him time to get to his feet. Lunging toward the daedra's feet, he cast a spell to heal the few meager injuries he had been able to inflict upon the Dremora. It continued to hold the mace high in the air for a moment, a beat longer than expected. Then it threw the mace to the ground in disgust, its demonic face contorting in denied rage.<BR>
<BR>
"Who would imagine honor in a beast so pathetic?" It rumbled in a voice that made Skaering's blood run cold. Shaking its horned head, it dismissively added "I will allow you to leave this shrine. Your allies, however, are lost. Do not come back. Ever." It turned its back on Skaering as it walked back into the depths of the shrine.<BR>
<BR>
Taking the opportunity presented, Skaering happily abandoned his companions to the tender mercies of the Dremora. In light of his own life, theirs did not seem so worth protecting. <BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>

敌人的懦弱<BR>
伦蒂利斯·莱罗斯 著<BR>

斯凯林勉强躲过了又一次毁灭性的打击，他开始怀疑自己还能躲避多久。他知道他的对手 -- 德雷莫拉领主 -- 在各方面都远超于他，但斯凯林决心在这里拖住那个迪德拉，直到他的盟友能逃离废墟。那个无情而不知疲倦的德雷莫拉根本不在乎斯凯林想要什么，它的钉锤又一次挥过，从他头顶无害地掠过。<BR>
<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

<BR>
“谁会想到在这种可悲的畜生身上能找到荣誉？”它用一种让斯凯林血液冰冷的低沉声音说道。它摇了摇长角的头，轻蔑地补充道：“我会允许你离开这座圣祠。然而，你的盟友就没那么幸运了。别再回来。永远。”它背对着斯凯林，走回了圣祠深处。<BR>
<BR>
斯凯林抓住了这个机会，欣然将他的同伴们抛弃给了德雷莫拉的“仁慈”。考虑到自己的生命，他们的似乎不值得保护。<BR>

Crimes of the Tribunal
审判席的罪行

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Crimes of the Tribunal<BR>
<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">
   The Ancient Times were those of freedom, times when Mer could do whatever they chose to do. They honored the true gods. They lived as nomads, moving where they wished, when they wished. They simply lived their lives in the freedom conferred by a loose polytheism. More importantly, the Daedra did not directly interfere with the ways of the people. <BR><BR>
   The ascent of the mortal gods, however, uprooted the system and destroyed the old ways. By utilizing a position of leadership in the battle against Dagoth Ur, the Tribunes slew the savior, the victor of Red Mountain. They robbed the Heart of its powers not meant for Man or Mer, and in doing so, they conjured the Devil into this world. But, such a creation was necessary for the fledgling gods to assume control. <BR><BR>
   They quickly established a theocratic system of control, a system which would taint every aspect of the culture of Resdayn and its people. By utilizing Dagoth Ur's existence as "the threat," they wrested power from the old gods, the Daedra. The people needed tangible protectors, and through guile and deception, the "gods" of the Tribunal managed to assume that position. <BR><BR>
   In order to maintain that kind of control, those reigns around the necks of the people, the Tribunal established a strict moral code of conduct and a vast theocratic hierarchy to do their wishes. Furthermore, they created groups of elite murderers, Ordinators and Armigers, to eliminate any who doubted the verity of their claims to godhood. To appear infallible, they killed. They spilled the blood of the truth-sayers to preserve their power. Finally, they performed minor feats of generosity to instill the conception that they loved and protected the people. Small donations and alms for the poor hardly make up for the crimes they commit to maintain power, but as long as they show the people only the positive aspects of their rule, they can do almost anything they choose. <BR><BR>
   The priests themselves are not without wickedness either. By arbitrarily naming a number of saints and employing the names of the Tribunes, they robbed the commoners and Great Houses alike of their hard-earned wealth. They even force poor workers to pay for minor blessings! Blessings cannot be bought, but the Temple persists in demanding those payments. Why? They wish to preserve control through economics as well as religious rites. The allure of wealth would not be set aside from their minds either. <BR><BR>
   What can ordinary commoners do to battle such a force? How can a man or woman hope to stand against a mighty theocracy tied to the "Living Gods?" Simply ignore it. The Temple's system will cease to exist if it is not supported. If the people of Morrowind ignore the monster, it will simply fade away. The people will finally be able to reassume the pure, old ways. A simple life will bring freedom to us all.<BR>"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
审判席的罪行<BR>
