"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
The Fall of the Usurper<BR>
By Palaux Illthre<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
The people of Dwynnen celebrate Othroktide every 5th of Suns Dawn, the date when, according to legend, a man emerged from the wilderness of High Rock and defeated the undead of Castle Wightmoor to become the first Baron of Dwynnen. Few people believe the legend anymore, but there most certainly was a Baron Othrok of Dwynnen who was destined to become one of the greatest heroes of High Rock, if not all of Tamriel.<BR><BR>
The legend, as most any Dwynnen child will tell you, is that years and years ago (archivists have agreed to the year 3E253), the people of Dwynnen were ruled by a lich and its armies of zombies, ghosts, vampires, and skeletons. Othrok was blessed by gods and given an army of men and animals to destroy the dead. He brought peace and prosperity to the land, growing more powerful as the land improved. Years later, he led the tiny barony against the Camoran Usurper, and saved all of Tamriel.<BR><BR>
How much credit the Baron ought to receive for the defeat of the Camoran Usurper has been debated, but it is an incontestable fact that in the year 3E 267, the Camoran Usurper's relentless move north through High Rock was halted around the area of contemporary Dwynnen. Dwynnen is actually larger than it was in the first Baron's day -- it did not, in fact, have a sea port -- but the Battle of Firewaves was a coastal battle. The fact that the battle probably did not occur in Dwynnen does not in itself belittle the Baron's participation in it.<BR><BR>
The Camoran Usurper had conquered Hammerfell and Valenwood by means of a large army, which by legend consisted entirely of undead and daedra, but was mostly composed of Redguards and Wood Elves. In all probability, the Usurper summoned the daedra and undead in Arenthia and slowly replaced the original summoned creatures with the armies of his conquered territories. Most armies of Valenwood have been historically mercenary.<BR><BR>
Word of the Usurper's conquests reached High Rock in early 266, but preparations to repel the invasion did not begin until early the following year. Historians attribute two factors to High Rock's hesitancy. The primary powers of the Bay were ruled by particularly inept monarchs -- Wayrest and Sentinel both had kings in their minority, and Daggerfall was torn by contention between Helena and her cousin Jilathe. The Lord of Reich Gradkeep (now Anticlere) was deathly ill through 266 and finally died at the end of the year. There were, in short, no leaders to unite the province against the Usurper. Of the leaders with any influence, at least eight (the "Eight Traitors" of legend) made secret allegiances with the Usurper to protect their lands.<BR><BR>
The secondary reason for the lethargy of High Rock had to do with the depth of relations between the province and the Septim Empire. For the first time since the beginning of the Dynasty, an Emperor ruled Tamriel who was neither Breton nor had spent any of his childhood in High Rock. The difference between Cephorus II and his cousin Uriel IV who preceded him was appalling to the people of High Rock. Even mad Emperors like Pelagius III revered the Bretons over all other races, and cousins and younger siblings of the Emperors have ruled in High Rock since the foundation of the Empire. Cephorus was a Nord, with Skyrim and Morrowind sympathies. The attitude of the common men of High Rock was sympathetic toward the Camoran Usurper as an archfoe of this hated Emperor.<BR><BR>
The Baron and his less legendary allies, the rulers of Ykalon, Phrygias, and Kambria, changed this favorable perception. News of the Usurper's barbaric treatment of captives and abuse of conquered lands, mostly true, spread rapidly through their territories, and then to other neutral lands. Within a few months, the greatest navy ever combined organized along the High Rock edge of the Iliac Bay. Only the navy of Uriel V's illfated invasion of Akavir was comparable.<BR><BR>
How the combined forces of High Rock defeated the endless army of the Camoran Usurper is certainly worthy of a lengthy book in itself. And perhaps, it is best left to the public imagination. Certainly the weather worked against the Usurper, which is reason in itself to attribute divine intervention.<BR><BR>
Baron Othrok's divine purpose is the central theme to Othroktide, after all. And as the poet Braeloque wrote, "To find the facts, the wisest always look first to the fiction."<BR>"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
篡位者的覆灭<BR>
帕劳克斯·伊尔斯雷 著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
德温宁的人们每年日晓月5日庆祝奥瑟罗克节，根据传说，那天一个男人从高岩荒野中走出，击败了幽魂城堡的亡灵，成为德温宁的第一任男爵。如今很少有人相信这个传说，但确实存在过一位德温宁的奥瑟罗克男爵，他注定要成为高岩乃至整个泰姆瑞尔最伟大的英雄之一。<BR><BR>
传说，正如任何德温宁孩子都会告诉你的那样，很多很多年前（档案保管员同意为第三纪元253年），德温宁的人民被一个巫妖及其僵尸、幽灵、吸血鬼和骷髅大军统治。奥瑟罗克受到众神祝福，并获得了一支由人类和动物组成的军队来消灭亡灵。他为这片土地带来了和平与繁荣，随着土地改善，他变得更强。多年后，他率领这个小男爵领对抗篡位者卡莫兰，拯救了整个泰姆瑞尔。<BR><BR>
关于男爵在击败篡位者卡莫兰中应得多少赞誉，一直存在争议，但无可争辩的事实是，在第三纪元267年，篡位者卡莫兰向北穿越高岩的势不可挡的推进，在现今德温宁地区附近被阻止了。德温宁实际上比第一任男爵时代要大 -- 事实上，它当时没有海港 -- 但火浪之战是一场沿海战斗。战斗可能并未发生在德温宁这一事实本身并不贬低男爵在其中所起的作用。<BR><BR>
篡位者卡莫兰通过一支大军征服了落锤和瓦伦伍德，据传说那支军队完全由亡灵和迪德拉组成，但实际上主要成分是红卫人和木精灵。很可能，篡位者在阿伦提亚召唤了迪德拉和亡灵，并逐渐用他征服领土的军队替换了最初召唤的生物。历史上，瓦伦伍德的大多数军队都是雇佣兵。<BR><BR>
篡位者征服的消息于266年初传到高岩，但抵御入侵的准备直到次年年初才开始。历史学家将高岩的犹豫归因于两个因素。海湾的主要权力由特别无能的君主统治 -- 途歇和哨卫的国王都年幼，而匕落则因海伦娜和她的表妹吉拉特之间的争斗而四分五裂。帝国守卫领（现在的安提克莱尔）领主在266年期间病危，最终在年底去世。简而言之，没有领导者能团结行省对抗篡位者。在有影响力的领导者中，至少八位（传说中的“八大叛徒”）与篡位者秘密结盟以保护自己的土地。<BR><BR>
高岩行动迟缓的次要原因与该省与塞普汀帝国关系的深度有关。自王朝建立以来，第一次有一位既不是布莱顿人、也没有在高岩度过任何童年的皇帝统治泰姆瑞尔。塞弗鲁斯二世与他前任表兄尤利尔四世之间的差异让高岩人民感到震惊。即使是像佩拉基乌斯三世这样的疯狂皇帝也推崇布莱顿人甚于其他种族，自帝国建立以来，皇帝的表亲和弟妹曾统治过高岩。塞弗鲁斯是诺德人，对天际和晨风有同情心。高岩平民的态度是对篡位者卡莫兰抱有同情，视其为这位被憎恨的皇帝的主要敌人。<BR><BR>
男爵和他那些不那么传奇的盟友 -- 伊卡隆、弗里吉亚和坎布里亚的统治者 -- 改变了这种有利看法。关于篡位者野蛮对待俘虏和虐待被征服土地的新闻，大部分属实，迅速在他们的领土上传开，然后传到其他中立地区。几个月内，有史以来最庞大的联合海军在髂骨湾高岩一侧集结。只有尤利尔五世远征阿卡维尔那不幸的海军规模可与之相比。<BR><BR>
高岩联军如何击败了篡位者卡莫兰那无穷无尽的军队，这本身当然值得写一本大部头的书。也许，最好还是留给公众想象。当然，天气对篡位者不利，这本身就是归因于神灵干预的理由。<BR><BR>
毕竟，奥瑟罗克男爵的神圣使命是奥瑟罗克节的核心主题。正如诗人布蕾洛克所写：“要找到事实，最聪明的人总是先看虚构。”<BR>"""

帕劳克斯·伊尔斯雷 著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
德温宁的人们每年日晓月5日庆祝奥瑟罗克节，根据传说，那天一个男人从高岩荒野中走出，击败了幽魂城堡的亡灵，成为德温宁的第一任男爵。如今很少有人相信这个传说，但确实存在过一位德温宁的奥瑟罗克男爵，他注定要成为高岩乃至整个泰姆瑞尔最伟大的英雄之一。<BR><BR>
传说，正如任何德温宁孩子都会告诉你的那样，很多很多年前（档案保管员同意为第三纪元253年），德温宁的人民被一个巫妖及其僵尸、幽灵、吸血鬼和骷髅大军统治。奥瑟罗克受到众神祝福，并获得了一支由人类和动物组成的军队来消灭亡灵。他为这片土地带来了和平与繁荣，随着土地改善，他变得更强。多年后，他率领这个小男爵领对抗篡位者卡莫兰，拯救了整个泰姆瑞尔。<BR><BR>
关于男爵在击败篡位者卡莫兰中应得多少赞誉，一直存在争议，但无可争辩的事实是，在第三纪元267年，篡位者卡莫兰向北穿越高岩的势不可挡的推进，在现今德温宁地区附近被阻止了。德温宁实际上比第一任男爵时代要大 -- 事实上，它当时没有海港 -- 但火浪之战是一场沿海战斗。战斗可能并未发生在德温宁这一事实本身并不贬低男爵在其中所起的作用。<BR><BR>
篡位者卡莫兰通过一支大军征服了落锤和瓦伦伍德，据传说那支军队完全由亡灵和迪德拉组成，但实际上主要成分是红卫人和木精灵。很可能，篡位者在阿伦提亚召唤了迪德拉和亡灵，并逐渐用他征服领土的军队替换了最初召唤的生物。历史上，瓦伦伍德的大多数军队都是雇佣兵。<BR><BR>
篡位者征服的消息于266年初传到高岩，但抵御入侵的准备直到次年年初才开始。历史学家将高岩的犹豫归因于两个因素。海湾的主要权力由特别无能的君主统治 -- 途歇和哨卫的国王都年幼，而匕落则因海伦娜和她的表妹吉拉特之间的争斗而四分五裂。帝国守卫领（现在的安提克莱尔）领主在266年期间病危，最终在年底去世。简而言之，没有领导者能团结行省对抗篡位者。在有影响力的领导者中，至少八位（传说中的“八大叛徒”）与篡位者秘密结盟以保护自己的土地。<BR><BR>
高岩行动迟缓的次要原因与该省与塞普汀帝国关系的深度有关。自王朝建立以来，第一次有一位既不是布莱顿人、也没有在高岩度过任何童年的皇帝统治泰姆瑞尔。塞弗鲁斯二世与他前任表兄尤利尔四世之间的差异让高岩人民感到震惊。即使是像佩拉基乌斯三世这样的疯狂皇帝也推崇布莱顿人甚于其他种族，自帝国建立以来，皇帝的表亲和弟妹曾统治过高岩。塞弗鲁斯是诺德人，对天际和晨风有同情心。高岩平民的态度是对篡位者卡莫兰抱有同情，视其为这位被憎恨的皇帝的主要敌人。<BR><BR>
男爵和他那些不那么传奇的盟友 -- 伊卡隆、弗里吉亚和坎布里亚的统治者 -- 改变了这种有利看法。关于篡位者野蛮对待俘虏和虐待被征服土地的新闻，大部分属实，迅速在他们的领土上传开，然后传到其他中立地区。几个月内，有史以来最庞大的联合海军在髂骨湾高岩一侧集结。只有尤利尔五世远征阿卡维尔那不幸的海军规模可与之相比。<BR><BR>
高岩联军如何击败了篡位者卡莫兰那无穷无尽的军队，这本身当然值得写一本大部头的书。也许，最好还是留给公众想象。当然，天气对篡位者不利，这本身就是归因于神灵干预的理由。<BR><BR>
毕竟，奥瑟罗克男爵的神圣使命是奥瑟罗克节的核心主题。正如诗人布蕾洛克所写：“要找到事实，最聪明的人总是先看虚构。”<BR>"""

Fate of the Snow Elves<BR>
by Keviskar the Otter<BR>

Canst thou see?
There's a Snow Elf behind thee!<BR>
<BR>
That's how my mother used to mock me, when I was a small child and we would venture into the forest to pick up sticks and logs for the fire.
And that is also one of the many various songs about Snow Elves that Nord mothers usually sing to their children.
As a youngling I was always eager to see these mysterious little beings which seemed to be everywhere save for where I cast my gaze and I was extremely furious that I always turned around too late and did not manage to see one.<BR>
<BR>
Most Nord children stop believing in Snow Elves when they grow up and they lose all their childish interest in them in favor of much more practical things like hunting, wrestling and mead. However, my interest in them survived to my adult age and even now, in the autumn of my life, they do not cease to provoke my curiosity and spark my imagination.<BR>
<BR>
FATE OF THE SNOW ELVES:<BR>
<BR>
How does the history become a legend? How did these ancient mer, once engaged in lengthy and bloody conflict with our fathers, transform into the fairy-like bugaboo race of children's songs? How can an entire civilization disappear without leaving any, even the smallest, evidence of its existence?
These were the questions which aroused my curiosity during my youth, when I was studying at the world-famous bard college in Haafingar.<BR>
<BR>
Many Nord children know the Snow Elves from their mothers' songs and sayings, but how many of these children, when they reach adulthood, realize that there is a true story behind the folklore? That these stories and songs derive from actual history, and were not merely invented to frighten children?
We Nords are extremely selective in what we remember of our history. We are proud of our bold ancestors, who came from Atmora to colonize Tamriel; we remember deeds of ancient heroes who fought fierce monsters and met with gods face to face; we praise mighty warriors in our songs and recall the glorious battles they won. That is all well and good!<BR>
<BR>
But what do we know about these who inhabited our lands long before us? How much are we interested in the history, culture and character of those we defeated and whom we overwhelmed in passing of time?
These are the questions Nords need to ask, but in fact want not to ask.
At least, that is what I have been told during my studies at the Bard college. And that is perhaps one of the reasons I decided to leave it and to choose my own path.<BR>
<BR>
I dedicated my life to the research and rediscovery of those parts of our history I considered important and not just those which have been already preserved and interpreted and in some degree transformed by our adored bardic tradition.
That is why I became a pilgrim, instead of bard, and why I spent 20 years of my life on the journeys through the land of my fathers, seeking understanding more fully our customs and traditions.<BR>
<BR>
However, in spite of the long years I spent on these journeys the multitude of locales I visited and people I interviewed could show me absolutely no trace of the Snow Elves. I did not see or explore any ruin, encounter any artifact or scroll, or discover any site which could suggest that it once belonged to Snow Elves.
This fact stole sleep from my yearning eyes many a night. How was it possible that if Snow Elves once inhabited -- dominated, truly -- our lands, they did not leave behind anything of their ways and culture that would survive to this modern age for those of the present era to discover?
I searched for explanations in libraries and familiarized myself with many scholarly theories explaining this mystery, only to refute them all at the end.
None dared to challenge the problem as it was and to conclude proper consequences from the true state of being. They just offered plain excuses for our ignorance instead.
For example, according to one, Snow Elves once lived at the peaks of high mountains because that was the mildest climate in their time, but now not even the heartiest of Nords can climb that mountain to see these remnants to bear witness of their existence and survive to share tales of what they have seen. What an insult to the brave highlanders who reached even the most remote places of our lands that these library worms in their cabinets do not even dare to think of!<BR>
<BR>
More say that Snow Elves actually lived deep underground, far beneath the icy cave tunnels. In favor of this "underground" theory, its defenders argue that it is also the image of Snow Elves in the traditional songs and sayings, where Snow Elves lived in dens, caves and holes in the ground. I would not put too much credence in this fact and rather asked a question: How could any race survive in such hostile conditions like those in the ice caverns, where there was no sunlight and temperatures were so low that human breath freezes almost immediately?
The most absurd theory says that the Snow Elves actually did not build any architecture and lived in trees with symbiosis with the nature. I would not even comment on such a ridiculous theory.
Least but not last, there is also small and often overlooked group of scholars, whose influence is growing in recent times.<BR>
<BR>
According to them, Snow Elves are not truly extinct, and we can still find their descendants in our lands; per example, on the wild island of Solstheim. Yes, Rieklings are the twisted image they intend to hold the legend and majesty of the Snow Elves.<BR>
<BR>
For myself, I possess considerable doubt that these wild and primitive 'blue goblins' have any connection to the magnificent and noble race of Snow Elves.
Perhaps there might be some hereditary connection and Rieklings actually might be bewildered descendants of the Snow Elves, but even so they would necessarily be dark and distant relations.<BR>
<BR>
It is more than obvious that these primitive savages do not bear any sign of possessing the rich cultural heritage of their hypothetical ancestors.
This theory again gives no explanation to the central question: What happened to the civilization of the Snow Elves, and where did all of their marvelous artifacts and architecture vanish?<BR>
<BR>
My explanation, however, is far more simple and persuasive; it is just the one least pleasant to fellow archaeologists and to their hopes and expectations.
Time swallows everything, and so it swallows even the Snow Elves, however grandiose and spectacular their civilization might have been.<BR>
<BR>
Unlike the Deep Elves of Morrowind, who disappeared suddenly at the peak of their civilization, and who left behind great fortresses and shrines for archaeologists to explore and rogues to loot, Snow Elves were supposedly extinguished by our ancestors, millennia ago.
Their cities were razed to the ground by our fathers; their settlements were covered by snow and ice; their bones were crushed into dust under the conquering boots of our armies; their finery and craft melted down to forge our weapons; and their shrines slowly brushed away by merciless wind.
There is nothing left for us to discover; nothing but these legends and fairy-tales.<BR>
<BR>
It is surely no coincidence that nowadays we can still visit ancient ruins, which remain near our fathers' citadels, but there is not even the slightest trace of the culture of their enemies, the Snow Elves. Perhaps what I have been taught at the college was right, and we Nords should not remember more of the past than is necessary for preserving the proud ideals we have of ourselves today.<BR>"""

雪精灵的命运：<BR>
<BR>

<BR>
但我们对那些早在我们之前就居住在这片土地上的人了解多少？我们对那些我们击败过、在时间流逝中压倒过的人的历史、文化和性格有多少兴趣？
这些是诺德人需要问，但实际上不愿问的问题。
至少，这是我在吟游诗人学院求学时听到的。也许这是我决定离开它并选择自己道路的原因之一。<BR>
<BR>
我毕生致力于研究和重新发现我们历史中我认为重要的部分，而不仅仅是那些已被保存、解释并在某种程度上被我们所珍视的吟游诗人传统所改造的部分。
这就是为什么我成为朝圣者而非吟游诗人，也是为什么我花了20年时间在祖先的土地上游历，寻求更全面地理解我们的习俗和传统。<BR>
<BR>
然而，尽管我花了多年时间游历，我访问过的众多地点和采访过的人们都无法向我展示任何雪精灵的踪迹。我未见、也未探索过任何废墟，未遇到任何神器或卷轴，也未发现任何可能表明曾属于雪精灵的地点。
这个事实让我许多个夜晚无法入眠。如果雪精灵曾居住 -- 实际上是统治 -- 过我们的土地，他们怎么可能没有留下任何他们的生活方式和文化的痕迹，能留存到现代供当代人发现呢？
我在图书馆中寻找解释，熟悉了许多解释这一谜团的学术理论，但最终都一一驳斥。
没有人敢于直面这个问题，并从真实状态中得出恰当的结论。他们只是为我们的无知提供简单的借口。
例如，有一种说法认为雪精灵曾住在高山之巅，因为那是他们时代最温和的气候，但如今即使最健壮的诺德人也无法爬上那些山去见证这些遗迹的存在并活着回来分享所见。这对那些曾到达我们土地最偏远地区的勇敢高地人来说是多么侮辱，而这些书柜里的书虫想都不敢想！<BR>
<BR>
更多人认为雪精灵实际上住在地下深处，远在冰洞隧道之下。支持这种“地下”理论的人辩称，这也是传统歌谣和谚语中雪精灵的形象，他们住在地洞、洞穴和坑里。我不会太相信这一点，而是问一个问题：任何种族怎么可能在冰穴那样恶劣的条件下生存，那里没有阳光，温度低到人的呼吸几乎立刻冻结？
最荒谬的理论称雪精灵实际上不建造任何建筑，而是与自然共生住在树上。我甚至不想评论这种荒谬的理论。
最后但并非最不重要的是，还有一小群常常被忽视的学者，他们的影响力近来在增长。<BR>
<BR>
根据他们的说法，雪精灵并未真正灭绝，我们仍能在我们的土地上找到他们的后裔；例如，在荒蛮的索瑟泰姆岛上。是的，裂客灵就是他们认为能承载雪精灵传说与威严的扭曲形象。<BR>
<BR>
对我而言，我相当怀疑这些野蛮原始的“蓝色哥布林”与辉煌高贵的雪精灵种族有任何联系。
也许可能存在某种遗传联系，裂客灵实际上可能是雪精灵困惑的后裔，但即便如此，他们也必然只是阴暗而疏远的远亲。<BR>
<BR>
显而易见，这些原始野蛮人没有任何迹象表明拥有他们假设祖先的丰富文化遗产。
这个理论再次没有回答核心问题：雪精灵文明发生了什么，他们所有奇妙的工艺品和建筑都消失到哪里去了？<BR>
<BR>
然而，我的解释要简单得多，也更有说服力；只是这对考古学家同行及其希望和期望来说最不令人愉快。
时间吞噬一切，因此也吞噬了雪精灵，无论他们的文明曾经多么宏伟壮观。<BR>
<BR>
不像晨风的深精灵，他们在文明巅峰时突然消失，留下了巨大的堡垒和圣祠供考古学家探索、恶棍掠夺，雪精灵据称在数千年前就被我们的祖先灭绝了。
他们的城市被我们的祖先夷为平地；他们的定居点被冰雪覆盖；他们的骸骨在我们军队的征服之靴下碾成尘土；他们的精美物品和工艺被熔化锻造我们的武器；他们的圣祠被无情之风慢慢抹去。
没有什么留给我们去发现了；除了这些传说和童话，什么都没有。<BR>
<BR>
如今我们仍能参观那些保留在我们祖先要塞附近的古代废墟，却找不到他们敌人 -- 雪精灵 -- 文化的丝毫痕迹，这绝非巧合。也许我在学院学到的是对的，我们诺德人不应记住比维持我们今日自豪理想所需更多的过去。<BR>"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Father of the Niben<BR>
By Florin Jaliil<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Introduction:<BR>
<BR>
Writing the biography of anyone is a challenge. Usually the problem lies in assessing one's sources, comparing the prejudices of one chronicle versus another versus another. Waughin Jarth, I have been told, in writing his well-regarded series on the Wolf Queen of Solitude used over a hundred contemporary narratives. I cannot complain about my task having a similar issue.<BR>
<BR>
There is but one record of the man called Topal the Pilot, the earliest known Aldmer explorer of Tamriel. Only four short verse fragments of the epic "Father of the Niben" have survived to present day, but they offer an interesting if controversial look at the Middle Merethic Era when Topal the Pilot may have sailed the seas around Tamriel.<BR>
<BR>
Though "Father of the Niben" is the only written record of Topal the Pilot's voyages, it is not the only proof of his existence. Among the treasures of the great Crystal Tower of Summerset Isle are his crude but fascinating maps, his legacy to all Tamriel.<BR>
<BR>
The translation of the Aldmeri Udhendra Nibenu, "Father of the Niben," is my own, and I accept that other scholars may disagree with some of my choice of words. I cannot promise my translation lives up to the beauty of the original: I have only strived for simple coherence.<BR>
<BR>
Fragment One:<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR><BR>
Second ship, the Pasquiniel, manned by pilot
Illio, was to follow the southern pointing
Waystone; and the third, the Niben, manned
By pilot Topal, was to follow the north-east
Pointing waystone; the orders from the
Crystal Tower, they were to sail forth for
Eighty moons and then return to tell.
Only Niben returned to Firsthold, laden high with
Gold and spice and fur and strange creatures,
Dead and live.
Though, alas, Old Ehlnofey Topal never found, he
Told the tales of the lands he had visited to the
Wonderment of all.
For sixty-six days and nights, he sailed, over crashing
Waves of dire intent, past whirlpools, through
Mist that burned like fire, until he reached the
Mouth of a great bay and he landed on a
Sun-kissed meadow of gentle dells.
As he and his men rested, there came a fearsome howl,
And hideous orcs streamed forth from the murky
Glen, cannibal teeth clotted with gore<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
For centuries, strange crystalline balls were unearthed at the sites of ancient Aldmer shipwrecks and docks, peculiar artifacts of the Merethic and Dawn Eras that puzzled archeologists until it was demonstrated that each had a tendency to rotate on its axis in a specific direction. There were three varieties, one that pointed southward, one that pointed northeast, and one that point northwest.<BR>
<BR>
It is not understood how they work, but they seemed attuned to particular lines of power. These are the "waystones" of the fragment, which each of the pilots used to point their craft in the direction they were assigned to go. A ship with a name not mentioned in the fragment took his vessel north-west, towards Thras and Yokuda. The Pasquiniel took the southern waystone, and must have sailed down toward Pyandonea. Topal and his north-east waystone found the mainland of Tamriel.<BR>
<BR>
It is clear from this fragment what the three ships were assigned to do - find a passage back to Old Ehlnofey so that the Aldmer now living in Summerset could learn what became of their old homeland. As this book is intended to be a study of Topal the Pilot, there is scarcely room to dedicate to different theories of the Aldmeri exodus from Old Ehlnofey.<BR>
<BR>
If I were using this poem as my only source, I would have to agree with the scholars who believe in the tradition that several ships left Old Ehlnofey and were caught in a storm. Those who survived found their way to Summerset Isle, but without their waystones, they did not know what direction their homeland was. After all, what other explanation is there for three ships heading in three opposite directions to find a place?<BR>
<BR>
Naturally, only one of the ships returned, and we do not know if either or both of the other two found Old Ehlnofey, or perished at sea or at the hands of the ancient Pyandoneans, Sload, or Yokudans. We must assume, unless we think the Aldmer particularly idiotic, that at least one of them must have been pointing in the right direction. It may well have even been Topal, and he simply did not go north-east far enough.<BR>
<BR>
So, Topal setting sail from Firsthold heads north-east, which coincidentally is the longest one can travel along the Abecean Sea without striking land of any kind. Had he traveled straight east, he would have struck the mainland somewhere in what is now the Colovian West of Cyrodiil in a few weeks. Had he traveled south-east, he might have reached the hump of Valenwood in a few days. But our pilot, judging by his own and our modern maps, sailed in a straight line north-east, through the Abecean sea, and into the Iliac Bay, before touching ground somewhere near present day Anticlere in two months time.<BR>
<BR>
The rolling verdant hills of southern High Rock are unmistakable in this verse, recognizable to anyone who has been there. The question, of course, is what is to be made of this apparent reference to orcs occupying the region? Tradition has it that the orcs were not born until after the Aldmer had settled the mainland, that they sprung up as a distinct race following the famous battle between Trinimac and Boethiah at the time of Resdayn.<BR>
<BR>
It is possible that the tradition is wrong. Perhaps the orcs were an aboriginal tribe predating the Aldmeri colonization. Perhaps these were a cursed folk -- "Orsimer" in the Aldmeris, the same word for "Orc" - of a different kind, whose name was to be given the orcs in a different era. It is regrettable that the fragment ends here, for more clues to the truth are undoubtedly lost.<BR>
<BR>
What's missing between the first fragment and the second is appreciable. It must be more than eighty months that have passed, because Topal is on the opposite side of mainland Tamriel now, attempting to sail south-west to return to Firsthold, after his failure at finding Old Ehlnofey.<BR>
<BR>
Fragment Two:<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR><BR>
No passage westward could be found in the steely cliffs
That jutted up like giant's jaw, so the Niben
Sailed south.
As it passed an sandy, forested island that promised
Sanctuary and peace, the crew cheered in joy.
Then exultation turned to terror as a great shadow rose
From the trees on leathered wings like a unfurling Cape.
The great bat lizard was large as the ship, but good pilot
Topal merely raised his bow, and struck it in its Head.
As it fell, he asked his Bo 'sun, "Do you think it's dead?"
And before it struck the white-bearded waves, he
Shot once more its heart to be certain.
And so for another forty days and six, the Niben sailed south.<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
We can see that in addition to Topal's prowess as a navigator, cartographer, survivalist, and raconteur, he is a master of archery. It may be poetic license, of course, but we do have archeological proof that the Merethic Aldmer were sophisticated archers. Their bows of layers of wood and horn drawn by silver silk thread are beautiful, and still, I have heard experts say, millennia later, very deadly.<BR>
<BR>
It is tempting to imagine it a dragon, but the creature that Topal faces at the beginning of this fragment sounds like an ancestor of the cliffracer of present day Morrowind. The treacherous cliff coastline sounds like the region around Necrom, and the island of Gorne may be where the nest of the "bat lizard" is. No creatures like that exist in eastern Morrowind to my knowledge at the present day.<BR>
<BR>
Fragment Three:<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR><BR>
The fetid, evil swamp lands and their human lizards
Retreated to the east, and Topal and his men's
Hearts were greatly gladdened by the sight of
Diamond blue, pure, sweet ocean.
For three days, they sailed in great cheer north-west
Where Firsthold beckoned them, but hope died
In horror, as land, like a blocking shield rose
Before them.
Topal the Pilot was sore wroth, and consulted he
The maps he had faithfully drawn, to see
Whether best to go south where the
Continent must end, or take the river that
Snaked through a passage north.
"North!" cried he to his sad men. "North we go
Now! Fear not, north!"<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Tracing Topal's movements, we see that he has skirted the edge of Morrowind and delved into southern Blackmarsh, seemingly determined to follow his waystone as best as he can. The swamp he is leaving is probably near present day Gideon. Knowing what we now know about Topal's personality, we can understand his frustration in the bay between Black Marsh and Elsweyr.<BR>
<BR>
Here is a man who follows his orders explicitly, and knows that he should have been going south-east through river ways to reach Firsthold. Looking at his maps, we can see that he attempted to find passages through, as he has mapped out the Inner Sea of Morrowind, and several of the swampy tributaries of Black Marsh, no doubt being turned away by the disease and fierce Argonian tribes that dissuaded many other explorers after him.<BR>
<BR>
With a modern map of Tamriel in hand, we can see that he makes the wrong choice in electing to go north-east instead of pushing southward. He could not have known then that what he perceived to be the endless mainland was only a jutting peninsula. He only knew that he had traveled too far southward already, and so he made a smart but incorrect decision to go up the river.<BR>
<BR>
It is ironic that this great miscalculation would today bear his mark of history. The bay he thought was an endless ocean is now known as Topal Bay, and the river that took him astray shares the name of his boat, the Niben River.<BR>
<BR>
Fragment Four:<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR><BR>
The cat demons of four legs and two ran the river's
Length, always keeping the boat in their
Green-eyed sight, hissing, and spitting, and
Roaring with rage.
But the sailors never had to brave the shores, for
Fruit trees welcomed them, dropping their
Arms down to the river's edge as if to
Embrace the mer, and the men took the
Fruit quickly before the cats could pounce.
For eleven days, they traveled north, until they came
To a crystalline lake, and eight islands of
Surpassing beauty and peace.
Brilliant flightful creatures of glorious colors
Greeted them in Aldmeri language,
Making the mer wonder, until they
Understood they were only calling back
The word they were speaking without
Understanding it, and then the sailors
Laughed.
Topal the Pilot was enchanted with the islands
And the feathered men who lived there.
There the Niben stayed for a moon, and the bird
Men learned how to speak their own words,
And with taloned feet, to write.
In joy for their new knowledge, they made Topal
Their lord, giving him their islands for the
Gift.
Topal said he would return someday, but first he
Must find the passage east to Firsthold, so
Far away.<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
This last fragment is bittersweet for a number of reasons.<BR>
<BR>
We know that this strange, friendly feathered people the Pilot encounters will be lost - in fact, this poem is the only one where mention is made of the bird creatures of Cyrodiil. The literacy that Topal gives them is evidently not enough to save them from their eventual fate, likely at the hands of the "cat demons," who we may assume are ancient Khajiiti.<BR>
<BR>
We know that Topal and his crew never find a route from the eight islands which are the modern day Imperial City through to the Iliac Bay. His maps tell the tale where this lost poem cannot.<BR>
<BR>
We see his hand as he traces his route up the Niben to Lake Rumare; and, after attempting a few tributaries which do not lead him where he wants to go, we can imagine Topal's frustration -- and that of his long-suffering crew -- as they return back down the Niben to Topal Bay.<BR>
<BR>
There, they evidently discovered their earlier mistake, for we see that they pass the peninsula of Elsweyr. Eventually they traveled along its coastline, past the shores of Valenwood, and eventually home. Usually epic tales end with a happy ending, but this one begins with one, and the means to which it was accomplished is lost.<BR>
<BR>
Besides the extraordinary bird creatures of present day Cyrodiil, we have caught glimpses of ancient Orcs (perhaps), ancient cliff-racers, ancient Argonians, and in this fragment, ancient Khajiit. Quite a history in a few lines of simple verse, all because a man failed to find his home, and took all the wrong turns to retrace his steps back.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
尼本之父<BR>
弗洛林·贾利尔 著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
引言：<BR>
<BR>
为任何人写传记都是一项挑战。通常问题在于评估资料来源，比较不同编年史的偏见。我听说沃金·贾斯在写他那广受好评的独孤城狼女王系列时，使用了超过一百份当代叙述。我不能抱怨我的任务有类似问题。<BR>
<BR>
关于被称为领航者托帕尔的人 -- 泰姆瑞尔已知最早的奥德莫探险家 -- 只有一份记录。史诗《尼本之父》仅存四段短诗残片，但它们提供了对中精灵纪元的趣味而颇具争议的视角，当时领航者托帕尔可能曾在泰姆瑞尔周围海域航行。<BR>
<BR>
虽然《尼本之父》是领航者托帕尔航行的唯一书面记录，但并非他存在的唯一证据。在夏暮群岛伟大的水晶塔的宝藏中，有他粗糙却迷人的地图，那是他留给整个泰姆瑞尔的遗产。<BR>
<BR>
奥德莫语《乌德亨德拉·尼本努》 -- “尼本之父” -- 的翻译是我自己做的，我接受其他学者可能不同意我某些用词的选择。我不能保证我的翻译能配得上原文之美：我只力求简单连贯。<BR>
<BR>
残篇一：<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR><BR>
第二艘船，帕斯奎尼尔号，由领航员
伊利奥指挥，应跟随指向南方
的引路石；第三艘，尼本号，由
领航员托帕尔指挥，应跟随指向东北
的引路石；来自
水晶塔的命令，他们要出航
八十个月亮周期，然后归来报告。
只有尼本号返回首堡，满载
黄金、香料、毛皮和奇异生物，
死的和活的。
虽然，可惜，托帕尔从未找到古艾诺菲，但他
向所有惊奇的听众讲述了他到访之地的故事。

六十六个昼夜，他航行，穿越汹涌
凶险的波涛，经过漩涡，穿过
燃烧如火的迷雾，直到他抵达
一个大海湾的入口，他在一片
阳光亲吻的温柔谷地草地登陆。
当他和他的部下休息时，传来可怕的嚎叫，
丑陋的兽人从阴暗的
峡谷涌出，食人獠牙沾满血污<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
几个世纪以来，在古奥德莫沉船和码头遗址中出土了奇怪的水晶球，这些精灵和黎明纪元的奇特器物曾令考古学家困惑，直到证明每个都有绕轴朝特定方向旋转的倾向。有三种类型，一种指向南方，一种指向东北，一种指向西北。<BR>
<BR>
人们不清楚其工作原理，但它们似乎与特定的能量线协调。这就是残篇中的“引路石”，每位领航员用它指引船只前往指定方向。一艘在残篇中未提及名字的船向西北航行，前往瑟拉斯和尤库达。帕斯奎尼尔号携带南方引路石，一定向南驶向派安多尼亚。托帕尔和他的东北引路石找到了泰姆瑞尔大陆。<BR>
<BR>
从这段残篇可以清楚看出三艘船的任务 -- 找到返回古艾诺菲的通道，以便如今住在夏暮的奥德莫了解他们古老家园的下落。由于本书旨在研究领航者托帕尔，几乎没有篇幅讨论奥德莫人从古艾诺菲出逃的不同理论。<BR>
<BR>
如果我只以这首诗为来源，我就得同意那些相信传统的学者，认为几艘船离开古艾诺菲后遭遇风暴。幸存者找到了夏暮群岛，但没有引路石，他们不知道家乡在哪个方向。毕竟，三艘船朝三个相反方向去寻找一个地方，还有什么其他解释？<BR>
<BR>
自然，只有一艘船返回，我们不知道另外两艘中的一艘或两艘是否找到了古艾诺菲，或是在海上丧生，或是死于古代派安多尼亚人、斯洛德或尤库达人手中。我们必须假设，除非我们认为奥德莫人特别愚蠢，至少其中一艘一定指向了正确方向。甚至很可能就是托帕尔，他只是向东北走得不够远。<BR>
<BR>
因此，托帕尔从首堡出发向东北航行，巧合的是，这是沿着阿碧希安海最长的一段不靠任何陆地的航线。如果他直向东航行，几周内就会在现今西罗帝尔科洛维亚西部某处登陆。如果他向东南航行，几天内可能到达瓦伦伍德的突出部。但根据他自己的地图和我们的现代地图，我们的领航员直线向东北航行，穿过阿碧希安海，进入髂骨湾，两个月后在现今安提克莱尔附近的某处登陆。<BR>
<BR>
这段诗中对高岩南部连绵青翠山丘的描写毫无疑问，任何去过那里的人都能辨认出来。当然，问题是该如何理解这明显提及兽人占据该地区？传统认为，兽人是在奥德莫定居大陆之后才诞生的，他们是在雷斯丹时期崔尼马克与波耶西亚著名战斗之后崛起为一个独特种族的。<BR>
<BR>
可能传统是错误的。也许兽人是早于奥德莫殖民的土著部落。也许这些是被诅咒的族群 -- 奥德莫语中的“奥斯莫”，与“兽人”同词 -- 不同种类，其名称将在不同时代赋予兽人。遗憾的是残篇到此结束，更多真相线索无疑已失。<BR>
<BR>
第一段与第二段之间缺失的内容相当可观。一定过去了超过八十个月，因为托帕尔现在在泰姆瑞尔大陆的另一侧，在寻找古艾诺菲失败后，试图向西南航行返回首堡。<BR>
<BR>
残篇二：<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR><BR>
在钢铁般的悬崖中找不到西行通道
如巨人之颚般耸立，于是尼本号
向南航行。
当它经过一个沙质、林木葱郁、似乎充满
庇护与宁静的岛屿时，船员们欢呼雀跃。
但欢腾转为恐惧，一个巨大阴影从
树丛中升起，皮翼如展开的斗篷。
那巨大的蝙蝠蜥蜴和船一样大，但优秀的领航员
托帕尔只是举起弓，射中了它的头。
当它坠落时，他问他的水手长：“你觉得它死了吗？”
在它击中白须波浪之前，他又
射了一箭穿心以确保。
于是又航行了四十六天，尼本号向南航行。<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
我们可以看到，除了作为领航员、制图师、生存者和健谈者的技艺外，托帕尔还是射箭大师。当然，这可能是诗意的夸张，但我们确实有考古证据表明精灵纪元的奥德莫人是精良的弓箭手。他们用多层木和角制成、以银丝弦拉的弓非常精美，我听专家说，数千年后仍极具杀伤力。<BR>
<BR>
人们容易想象它是龙，但托帕尔在残篇开头面对的动物听起来像现今晨风峭壁鸟的祖先。险峻的悬崖海岸听起来像亡者之城周边地区，而戈恩岛可能是“蝙蝠蜥蜴”巢穴所在。据我所知，现今东晨风没有这样的生物。<BR>
<BR>
残篇三：<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR><BR>
恶臭的邪恶沼泽之地及其类人蜥蜴
向东退去，托帕尔和他的部下的
心因看到
钻石般湛蓝、纯净、甜美的海洋而大大高兴。
他们兴高采烈地向西北航行了三天，
首堡在召唤他们，但希望
在恐惧中破灭，因为陆地如阻挡的盾牌般
出现在他们面前。
领航员托帕尔极为愤怒，他查阅
他忠实绘制的地图，以判断
最好是向南走，那里
大陆必须终结，还是走那条
蜿蜒穿过北方通道的河流。
“向北！”他对沮丧的部下喊道，“我们向北走
现在！不要怕，向北！”<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
追踪托帕尔的航迹，我们看到他已经绕过晨风边缘，深入南黑沼泽，似乎决心尽可能跟随他的引路石。他正在离开的沼泽可能靠近现今的吉德昂。以我们现在对托帕尔性格的了解，我们能理解他在黑沼泽与艾斯维尔之间的海湾的沮丧。<BR>
<BR>
这是一个严格服从命令的人，他知道自己本该向东南通过水路到达首堡。查看他的地图，我们可以看到他曾试图寻找通道，因为他已绘制了晨风内海和黑沼泽几条沼泽支流，无疑是被疾病和凶猛的阿尔贡部落所阻，这些也劝阻了他之后的许多探险者。<BR>
<BR>
手持现代泰姆瑞尔地图，我们可以看到他选择向东北而非继续向南是错误的。他当时不可能知道他以为是无尽大陆的只是一块突出的半岛。他只知道自己已向南走得太远，于是做出了聪明但错误的溯河而上的决定。<BR>
<BR>
讽刺的是，这个巨大的误判如今却留下了他的历史印记。他以为是无尽海洋的海湾如今被称为托帕尔湾，而那条让他误入歧途的河与他船的名字相同 -- 尼本河。<BR>
<BR>
残篇四：<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR><BR>
四足和两足的猫魔沿着河流
奔跑，始终用他们绿色的眼睛
盯着船，嘶嘶作响，喷吐口水，
愤怒咆哮。
但水手们从不必冒险上岸，因为
果树欢迎他们，将它们的
枝臂垂到河边，仿佛要
拥抱精灵，人们迅速
在猫扑来之前取走了果实。
他们向北航行了十一天，直到他们来到
一个水晶般的湖，和八个
无与伦比美丽与宁静的岛屿。
灿烂的、色彩斑斓的飞行生物
用奥德莫语问候他们，
令精灵们惊讶，直到他们
明白它们只是在重复
他们所说的词，却不
理解其意，于是水手们
笑了。
领航员托帕尔被这些岛屿
和住在那里羽人迷住了。
尼本号在那里停留了一个月亮周期，鸟
人学会了说自己的话，
并用爪足书写。
为他们的新知识而喜悦，他们尊托帕尔
为领主，将他们的岛屿作为
礼物献给他。
托帕尔说他有天会回来，但首先他
必须找到向东通往首堡的通道，如此
遥远。<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
这最后一段残篇因多种原因令人苦乐参半。<BR>
<BR>
我们知道领航员遇到的这些奇怪友善的羽人最终会消失 -- 事实上，这首诗是唯一提到西罗帝尔鸟形生物的作品。托帕尔给他们的读写能力显然不足以拯救他们免于最终命运，很可能亡于“猫魔”之手，我们可以推测那是古代卡吉特。<BR>
<BR>
我们知道托帕尔和他的船员从未找到从八岛（即现代的帝都）通往髂骨湾的路线。他的地图讲述了这首失传之诗无法讲述的故事。<BR>
<BR>
我们看到他的笔迹，他沿尼本河向上追踪到鲁玛雷湖；在尝试了几条不能通往目的地的支流后，我们可以想象托帕尔 -- 以及他长期受苦的船员 -- 返回尼本河下游到托帕尔湾时的沮丧。<BR>
<BR>
在那里，他们显然发现了之前的错误，因为我们可以看到他们经过艾斯维尔半岛。最终他们沿着海岸线航行，经过瓦伦伍德海岸，最终回家。通常史诗以幸福结局告终，但这一首以幸福开始，而实现它的方式却已失传。<BR>
<BR>
除了现今西罗帝尔奇特的鸟形生物外，我们还瞥见了古代兽人（也许）、古代峭壁鸟、古代阿尔贡，以及在这段残篇中的古代卡吉特。短短几行简单诗句中蕴含如此丰富的历史，只因一个人未能找到家，并在返回途中走错了所有弯路。<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Father of the Niben<BR>
By Florin Jaliil<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Introduction:<BR>
<BR>
Writing the biography of anyone is a challenge. Usually the problem lies in assessing one's sources, comparing the prejudices of one chronicle versus another versus another. Waughin Jarth, I have been told, in writing his well-regarded series on the Wolf Queen of Solitude used over a hundred contemporary narratives. I cannot complain about my task having a similar issue.<BR>
<BR>
There is but one record of the man called Topal the Pilot, the earliest known Aldmer explorer of Tamriel. Only four short verse fragments of the epic "Father of the Niben" have survived to present day, but they offer an interesting if controversial look at the Middle Merethic Era when Topal the Pilot may have sailed the seas around Tamriel.<BR>
<BR>
Though "Father of the Niben" is the only written record of Topal the Pilot's voyages, it is not the only proof of his existence. Among the treasures of the great Crystal Tower of Summerset Isle are his crude but fascinating maps, his legacy to all Tamriel.<BR>
<BR>
The translation of the Aldmeri Udhendra Nibenu, "Father of the Niben," is my own, and I accept that other scholars may disagree with some of my choice of words. I cannot promise my translation lives up to the beauty of the original: I have only strived for simple coherence.<BR>
<BR>
Fragment One:<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR><BR>
Second ship, the Pasquiniel, manned by pilot
Illio, was to follow the southern pointing
Waystone; and the third, the Niben, manned
By pilot Topal, was to follow the north-east
Pointing waystone; the orders from the
Crystal Tower, they were to sail forth for
Eighty moons and then return to tell.
Only Niben returned to Firsthold, laden high with
Gold and spice and fur and strange creatures,
Dead and live.
Though, alas, Old Ehlnofey Topal never found, he
Told the tales of the lands he had visited to the
Wonderment of all.
For sixty-six days and nights, he sailed, over crashing
Waves of dire intent, past whirlpools, through
Mist that burned like fire, until he reached the
Mouth of a great bay and he landed on a
Sun-kissed meadow of gentle dells.
As he and his men rested, there came a fearsome howl,
And hideous orcs streamed forth from the murky
Glen, cannibal teeth clotted with gore<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
For centuries, strange crystalline balls were unearthed at the sites of ancient Aldmer shipwrecks and docks, peculiar artifacts of the Merethic and Dawn Eras that puzzled archeologists until it was demonstrated that each had a tendency to rotate on its axis in a specific direction. There were three varieties, one that pointed southward, one that pointed northeast, and one that point northwest.<BR>
<BR>
It is not understood how they work, but they seemed attuned to particular lines of power. These are the "waystones" of the fragment, which each of the pilots used to point their craft in the direction they were assigned to go. A ship with a name not mentioned in the fragment took his vessel north-west, towards Thras and Yokuda. The Pasquiniel took the southern waystone, and must have sailed down toward Pyandonea. Topal and his north-east waystone found the mainland of Tamriel.<BR>
<BR>
It is clear from this fragment what the three ships were assigned to do - find a passage back to Old Ehlnofey so that the Aldmer now living in Summerset could learn what became of their old homeland. As this book is intended to be a study of Topal the Pilot, there is scarcely room to dedicate to different theories of the Aldmeri exodus from Old Ehlnofey.<BR>
<BR>
If I were using this poem as my only source, I would have to agree with the scholars who believe in the tradition that several ships left Old Ehlnofey and were caught in a storm. Those who survived found their way to Summerset Isle, but without their waystones, they did not know what direction their homeland was. After all, what other explanation is there for three ships heading in three opposite directions to find a place?<BR>
<BR>
Naturally, only one of the ships returned, and we do not know if either or both of the other two found Old Ehlnofey, or perished at sea or at the hands of the ancient Pyandoneans, Sload, or Yokudans. We must assume, unless we think the Aldmer particularly idiotic, that at least one of them must have been pointing in the right direction. It may well have even been Topal, and he simply did not go north-east far enough.<BR>
<BR>
So, Topal setting sail from Firsthold heads north-east, which coincidentally is the longest one can travel along the Abecean Sea without striking land of any kind. Had he traveled straight east, he would have struck the mainland somewhere in what is now the Colovian West of Cyrodiil in a few weeks. Had he traveled south-east, he might have reached the hump of Valenwood in a few days. But our pilot, judging by his own and our modern maps, sailed in a straight line north-east, through the Abecean sea, and into the Iliac Bay, before touching ground somewhere near present day Anticlere in two months time.<BR>
<BR>
The rolling verdant hills of southern High Rock are unmistakable in this verse, recognizable to anyone who has been there. The question, of course, is what is to be made of this apparent reference to orcs occupying the region? Tradition has it that the orcs were not born until after the Aldmer had settled the mainland, that they sprung up as a distinct race following the famous battle between Trinimac and Boethiah at the time of Resdayn.<BR>
<BR>
It is possible that the tradition is wrong. Perhaps the orcs were an aboriginal tribe predating the Aldmeri colonization. Perhaps these were a cursed folk -- "Orsimer" in the Aldmeris, the same word for "Orc" - of a different kind, whose name was to be given the orcs in a different era. It is regrettable that the fragment ends here, for more clues to the truth are undoubtedly lost.<BR>
<BR>
What's missing between the first fragment and the second is appreciable. It must be more than eighty months that have passed, because Topal is on the opposite side of mainland Tamriel now, attempting to sail south-west to return to Firsthold, after his failure at finding Old Ehlnofey.<BR>
<BR>
Fragment Two:<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR><BR>
No passage westward could be found in the steely cliffs
That jutted up like giant's jaw, so the Niben
Sailed south.
As it passed an sandy, forested island that promised
Sanctuary and peace, the crew cheered in joy.
Then exultation turned to terror as a great shadow rose
From the trees on leathered wings like a unfurling Cape.
The great bat lizard was large as the ship, but good pilot
Topal merely raised his bow, and struck it in its Head.
As it fell, he asked his Bo 'sun, "Do you think it's dead?"
And before it struck the white-bearded waves, he
Shot once more its heart to be certain.
And so for another forty days and six, the Niben sailed south.<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
We can see that in addition to Topal's prowess as a navigator, cartographer, survivalist, and raconteur, he is a master of archery. It may be poetic license, of course, but we do have archeological proof that the Merethic Aldmer were sophisticated archers. Their bows of layers of wood and horn drawn by silver silk thread are beautiful, and still, I have heard experts say, millennia later, very deadly.<BR>
<BR>
It is tempting to imagine it a dragon, but the creature that Topal faces at the beginning of this fragment sounds like an ancestor of the cliffracer of present day Morrowind. The treacherous cliff coastline sounds like the region around Necrom, and the island of Gorne may be where the nest of the "bat lizard" is. No creatures like that exist in eastern Morrowind to my knowledge at the present day.<BR>
<BR>
Fragment Three:<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR><BR>
The fetid, evil swamp lands and their human lizards
Retreated to the east, and Topal and his men's
Hearts were greatly gladdened by the sight of
Diamond blue, pure, sweet ocean.
For three days, they sailed in great cheer north-west
Where Firsthold beckoned them, but hope died
In horror, as land, like a blocking shield rose
Before them.
Topal the Pilot was sore wroth, and consulted he
The maps he had faithfully drawn, to see
Whether best to go south where the
Continent must end, or take the river that
Snaked through a passage north.
"North!" cried he to his sad men. "North we go
Now! Fear not, north!"<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Tracing Topal's movements, we see that he has skirted the edge of Morrowind and delved into southern Blackmarsh, seemingly determined to follow his waystone as best as he can. The swamp he is leaving is probably near present day Gideon. Knowing what we now know about Topal's personality, we can understand his frustration in the bay between Black Marsh and Elsweyr.<BR>
<BR>
Here is a man who follows his orders explicitly, and knows that he should have been going south-east through river ways to reach Firsthold. Looking at his maps, we can see that he attempted to find passages through, as he has mapped out the Inner Sea of Morrowind, and several of the swampy tributaries of Black Marsh, no doubt being turned away by the disease and fierce Argonian tribes that dissuaded many other explorers after him.<BR>
<BR>
With a modern map of Tamriel in hand, we can see that he makes the wrong choice in electing to go north-east instead of pushing southward. He could not have known then that what he perceived to be the endless mainland was only a jutting peninsula. He only knew that he had traveled too far southward already, and so he made a smart but incorrect decision to go up the river.<BR>
<BR>
It is ironic that this great miscalculation would today bear his mark of history. The bay he thought was an endless ocean is now known as Topal Bay, and the river that took him astray shares the name of his boat, the Niben River.<BR>
<BR>
Fragment Four:<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR><BR>
The cat demons of four legs and two ran the river's
Length, always keeping the boat in their
Green-eyed sight, hissing, and spitting, and
Roaring with rage.
But the sailors never had to brave the shores, for
Fruit trees welcomed them, dropping their
Arms down to the river's edge as if to
Embrace the mer, and the men took the
Fruit quickly before the cats could pounce.
For eleven days, they traveled north, until they came
To a crystalline lake, and eight islands of
Surpassing beauty and peace.
Brilliant flightful creatures of glorious colors
Greeted them in Aldmeri language,
Making the mer wonder, until they
Understood they were only calling back
The word they were speaking without
Understanding it, and then the sailors
Laughed.
Topal the Pilot was enchanted with the islands
And the feathered men who lived there.
There the Niben stayed for a moon, and the bird
Men learned how to speak their own words,
And with taloned feet, to write.
In joy for their new knowledge, they made Topal
Their lord, giving him their islands for the
Gift.
Topal said he would return someday, but first he
Must find the passage east to Firsthold, so
Far away.<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
This last fragment is bittersweet for a number of reasons.<BR>
<BR>
We know that this strange, friendly feathered people the Pilot encounters will be lost - in fact, this poem is the only one where mention is made of the bird creatures of Cyrodiil. The literacy that Topal gives them is evidently not enough to save them from their eventual fate, likely at the hands of the "cat demons," who we may assume are ancient Khajiiti.<BR>
<BR>
We know that Topal and his crew never find a route from the eight islands which are the modern day Imperial City through to the Iliac Bay. His maps tell the tale where this lost poem cannot.<BR>
<BR>
We see his hand as he traces his route up the Niben to Lake Rumare; and, after attempting a few tributaries which do not lead him where he wants to go, we can imagine Topal's frustration -- and that of his long-suffering crew -- as they return back down the Niben to Topal Bay.<BR>
<BR>
There, they evidently discovered their earlier mistake, for we see that they pass the peninsula of Elsweyr. Eventually they traveled along its coastline, past the shores of Valenwood, and eventually home. Usually epic tales end with a happy ending, but this one begins with one, and the means to which it was accomplished is lost.<BR>
<BR>
Besides the extraordinary bird creatures of present day Cyrodiil, we have caught glimpses of ancient Orcs (perhaps), ancient cliff-racers, ancient Argonians, and in this fragment, ancient Khajiit. Quite a history in a few lines of simple verse, all because a man failed to find his home, and took all the wrong turns to retrace his steps back.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
尼本之父<BR>
弗洛林·贾利尔 著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
引言：<BR>
<BR>
为任何人写传记都是一项挑战。通常问题在于评估资料来源，比较不同编年史的偏见。我听说沃金·贾斯在写他那广受好评的独孤城狼女王系列时，使用了超过一百份当代叙述。我不能抱怨我的任务有类似问题。<BR>
<BR>
关于被称为领航者托帕尔的人 -- 泰姆瑞尔已知最早的奥德莫探险家 -- 只有一份记录。史诗《尼本之父》仅存四段短诗残片，但它们提供了对中精灵纪元的趣味而颇具争议的视角，当时领航者托帕尔可能曾在泰姆瑞尔周围海域航行。<BR>
<BR>
虽然《尼本之父》是领航者托帕尔航行的唯一书面记录，但并非他存在的唯一证据。在夏暮群岛伟大的水晶塔的宝藏中，有他粗糙却迷人的地图，那是他留给整个泰姆瑞尔的遗产。<BR>
<BR>
奥德莫语《乌德亨德拉·尼本努》 -- “尼本之父” -- 的翻译是我自己做的，我接受其他学者可能不同意我某些用词的选择。我不能保证我的翻译能配得上原文之美：我只力求简单连贯。<BR>
<BR>
残篇一：<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR><BR>
第二艘船，帕斯奎尼尔号，由领航员
伊利奥指挥，应跟随指向南方
的引路石；第三艘，尼本号，由
领航员托帕尔指挥，应跟随指向东北
的引路石；来自
水晶塔的命令，他们要出航
八十个月亮周期，然后归来报告。
只有尼本号返回首堡，满载
黄金、香料、毛皮和奇异生物，
死的和活的。
虽然，可惜，托帕尔从未找到古艾诺菲，但他
向所有惊奇的听众讲述了
他到访之地的故事。
六十六个昼夜，他航行，穿越汹涌
凶险的波涛，经过漩涡，穿过
燃烧如火的迷雾，直到他抵达
一个大海湾的入口，他在一片
阳光亲吻的温柔谷地草地登陆。
当他和他的部下休息时，传来可怕的嚎叫，
丑陋的兽人从阴暗的
峡谷涌出，食人獠牙沾满血污<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
几个世纪以来，在古奥德莫沉船和码头遗址中出土了奇怪的水晶球，这些精灵和黎明纪元的奇特器物曾令考古学家困惑，直到证明每个都有绕轴朝特定方向旋转的倾向。有三种类型，一种指向南方，一种指向东北，一种指向西北。<BR>
<BR>
人们不清楚其工作原理，但它们似乎与特定的能量线协调。这就是残篇中的“引路石”，每位领航员用它指引船只前往指定方向。一艘在残篇中未提及名字的船向西北航行，前往瑟拉斯和尤库达。帕斯奎尼尔号携带南方引路石，一定向南驶向派安多尼亚。托帕尔和他的东北引路石找到了泰姆瑞尔大陆。<BR>
<BR>
从这段残篇可以清楚看出三艘船的任务 -- 找到返回古艾诺菲的通道，以便如今住在夏暮的奥德莫了解他们古老家园的下落。由于本书旨在研究领航者托帕尔，几乎没有篇幅讨论奥德莫人从古艾诺菲出逃的不同理论。<BR>
<BR>
如果我只以这首诗为来源，我就得同意那些相信传统的学者，认为几艘船离开古艾诺菲后遭遇风暴。幸存者找到了夏暮群岛，但没有引路石，他们不知道家乡在哪个方向。毕竟，三艘船朝三个相反方向去寻找一个地方，还有什么其他解释？<BR>
<BR>
自然，只有一艘船返回，我们不知道另外两艘中的一艘或两艘是否找到了古艾诺菲，或是在海上丧生，或是死于古代派安多尼亚人、斯洛德或尤库达人手中。我们必须假设，除非我们认为奥德莫人特别愚蠢，至少其中一艘一定指向了正确方向。甚至很可能就是托帕尔，他只是向东北走得不够远。<BR>
<BR>
因此，托帕尔从首堡出发向东北航行，巧合的是，这是沿着阿碧希安海最长的一段不靠任何陆地的航线。如果他直向东航行，几周内就会在现今西罗帝尔科洛维亚西部某处登陆。如果他向东南航行，几天内可能到达瓦伦伍德的突出部。但根据他自己的地图和我们的现代地图，我们的领航员直线向东北航行，穿过阿碧希安海，进入髂骨湾，两个月后在现今安提克莱尔附近的某处登陆。<BR>
<BR>
这段诗中对高岩南部连绵青翠山丘的描写毫无疑问，任何去过那里的人都能辨认出来。当然，问题是该如何理解这明显提及兽人占据该地区？传统认为，兽人是在奥德莫定居大陆之后才诞生的，他们是在雷斯丹时期崔尼马克与波耶西亚著名战斗之后崛起为一个独特种族的。<BR>
<BR>
可能传统是错误的。也许兽人是早于奥德莫殖民的土著部落。也许这些是被诅咒的族群 -- 奥德莫语中的“奥斯莫”，与“兽人”同词 -- 不同种类，其名称将在不同时代赋予兽人。遗憾的是残篇到此结束，更多真相线索无疑已失。<BR>
<BR>
第一段与第二段之间缺失的内容相当可观。一定过去了超过八十个月，因为托帕尔现在在泰姆瑞尔大陆的另一侧，在寻找古艾诺菲失败后，试图向西南航行返回首堡。<BR>
<BR>
残篇二：<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR><BR>
在钢铁般的悬崖中找不到西行通道
如巨人之颚般耸立，于是尼本号
向南航行。
当它经过一个沙质、林木葱郁、似乎充满
庇护与宁静的岛屿时，船员们欢呼雀跃。
但欢腾转为恐惧，一个巨大阴影从
树丛中升起，皮翼如展开的斗篷。
那巨大的蝙蝠蜥蜴和船一样大，但优秀的领航员
托帕尔只是举起弓，射中了它的头。
当它坠落时，他问他的水手长：“你觉得它死了吗？”
在它击中白须波浪之前，他又
射了一箭穿心以确保。
于是又航行了四十六天，尼本号向南航行。<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
我们可以看到，除了作为领航员、制图师、生存者和健谈者的技艺外，托帕尔还是射箭大师。当然，这可能是诗意的夸张，但我们确实有考古证据表明精灵纪元的奥德莫人是精良的弓箭手。他们用多层木和角制成、以银丝弦拉的弓非常精美，我听专家说，数千年后仍极具杀伤力。<BR>
<BR>
人们容易想象它是龙，但托帕尔在残篇开头面对的动物听起来像现今晨风峭壁鸟的祖先。险峻的悬崖海岸听起来像亡者之城周边地区，而戈恩岛可能是“蝙蝠蜥蜴”巢穴所在。据我所知，现今东晨风没有这样的生物。<BR>
<BR>
残篇三：<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR><BR>
恶臭的邪恶沼泽之地及其类人蜥蜴
向东退去，托帕尔和他的部下的
心因看到
钻石般湛蓝、纯净、甜美的海洋而大大高兴。
他们兴高采烈地向西北航行了三天，
首堡在召唤他们，但希望
在恐惧中破灭，因为陆地如阻挡的盾牌般
出现在他们面前。
领航员托帕尔极为愤怒，他查阅
他忠实绘制的地图，以判断
最好是向南走，那里
大陆必须终结，还是走那条
蜿蜒穿过北方通道的河流。
“向北！”他对沮丧的部下喊道，“我们向北走
现在！不要怕，向北！”<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
追踪托帕尔的航迹，我们看到他已经绕过晨风边缘，深入南黑沼泽，似乎决心尽可能跟随他的引路石。他正在离开的沼泽可能靠近现今的吉德昂。以我们现在对托帕尔性格的了解，我们能理解他在黑沼泽与艾斯维尔之间的海湾的沮丧。<BR>
<BR>
这是一个严格服从命令的人，他知道自己本该向东南通过水路到达首堡。查看他的地图，我们可以看到他曾试图寻找通道，因为他已绘制了晨风内海和黑沼泽几条沼泽支流，无疑是被疾病和凶猛的阿尔贡部落所阻，这些也劝阻了他之后的许多探险者。<BR>
<BR>
手持现代泰姆瑞尔地图，我们可以看到他选择向东北而非继续向南是错误的。他当时不可能知道他以为是无尽大陆的只是一块突出的半岛。他只知道自己已向南走得太远，于是做出了聪明但错误的溯河而上的决定。<BR>
<BR>
讽刺的是，这个巨大的误判如今却留下了他的历史印记。他以为是无尽海洋的海湾如今被称为托帕尔湾，而那条让他误入歧途的河与他船的名字相同 -- 尼本河。<BR>
<BR>
残篇四：<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR><BR>
四足和两足的猫魔沿着河流
奔跑，始终用他们绿色的眼睛
盯着船，嘶嘶作响，喷吐口水，
愤怒咆哮。
但水手们从不必冒险上岸，因为
果树欢迎他们，将它们的
枝臂垂到河边，仿佛要
拥抱精灵，人们迅速
在猫扑来之前取走了果实。
他们向北航行了十一天，直到他们来到
一个水晶般的湖，和八个
无与伦比美丽与宁静的岛屿。
灿烂的、色彩斑斓的飞行生物
用奥德莫语问候他们，
令精灵们惊讶，直到他们
明白它们只是在重复
他们所说的词，却不
理解其意，于是水手们
笑了。
领航员托帕尔被这些岛屿
和住在那里羽人迷住了。
尼本号在那里停留了一个月亮周期，鸟
人学会了说自己的话，
并用爪足书写。
为他们的新知识而喜悦，他们尊托帕尔
为领主，将他们的岛屿作为
礼物献给他。
托帕尔说他有天会回来，但首先他
必须找到向东通往首堡的通道，如此
遥远。<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
这最后一段残篇因多种原因令人苦乐参半。<BR>
<BR>
我们知道领航员遇到的这些奇怪友善的羽人最终会消失 -- 事实上，这首诗是唯一提到西罗帝尔鸟形生物的作品。托帕尔给他们的读写能力显然不足以拯救他们免于最终命运，很可能亡于“猫魔”之手，我们可以推测那是古代卡吉特。<BR>
<BR>
我们知道托帕尔和他的船员从未找到从八岛（即现代的帝都）通往髂骨湾的路线。他的地图讲述了这首失传之诗无法讲述的故事。<BR>
<BR>
我们看到他的笔迹，他沿尼本河向上追踪到鲁玛雷湖；在尝试了几条不能通往目的地的支流后，我们可以想象托帕尔 -- 以及他长期受苦的船员 -- 返回尼本河下游到托帕尔湾时的沮丧。<BR>
<BR>
在那里，他们显然发现了之前的错误，因为我们可以看到他们经过艾斯维尔半岛。最终他们沿着海岸线航行，经过瓦伦伍德海岸，最终回家。通常史诗以幸福结局告终，但这一首以幸福开始，而实现它的方式却已失传。<BR>
<BR>
除了现今西罗帝尔奇特的鸟形生物外，我们还瞥见了古代兽人（也许）、古代峭壁鸟、古代阿尔贡，以及在这段残篇中的古代卡吉特。短短几行简单诗句中蕴含如此丰富的历史，只因一个人未能找到家，并在返回途中走错了所有弯路。<BR>

废柴先祖墓穴指南<BR>
未知<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Fire and Darkness: The Brotherhoods of Death<BR>
by Ynir Gorming<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
"Brother, I still call you brother for we share our bonds of blood, tested but unbroken by hatred. Even if I am murdered, which seems inevitable now, know that, brother. You and I are not innocents, so our benedictions of mutual enmity is not tragedy, but horror. This state of silent, shadowed war, of secret poisons and sleeping men strangled in their beds, of the sudden arrow and the artful dagger, has no end that I can see. No possibility for peace. <BR>
This note was found where it had fallen beneath the floorboards of an abandoned house in the Nordic village of Jallenheim in the 358th year of the Second Era. It was said that a quiet cobbler lived in the house, whispered by some to be a member of the dread Morag Tong, the assassin's guild outlawed throughout Tamriel thirty-four years previously. The house itself was perfectly in order, as if the cobbler had simply vanished. There was a single drop of blood on the note.<BR>
<BR>
The Dark Brotherhood had paid a call.<BR>
<BR>
This note and others like it are rare. Both the Morag Tong and its hated child, the Dark Brotherhood, are scrupulous about leaving no evidence behind - their members know that to divulge secrets of their orders is a lethal infraction. This obviously makes the job of the historian seeking to trace their histories very difficult.<BR>
<BR>
The Morag Tong, according to most scholars, had been a facet of the culture of Morrowind almost since its beginning. After all, the history of Resdayn, the ancient name of Morrowind, is rife with assassination, blood sacrifice, and religious zealotry, hallmarks of the order. It is commonly said that the Morag Tong then as now murdered for the glory of the Daedra Prince Mephala, but common assumptions are rarely completely accurate. It is my contention that the earliest form of the Tong additionally worshipped an even older and more malevolent deity than Mephala. As terrifying as that Prince of Oblivion is, they had and have reverence for a far greater evil.<BR>
<BR>
Writs of assassination from the first era offer rare glimpses into the Morag Tong's earliest philosophy. They are as matter of fact as current day writs, but many contain snatches of poetry which have perplexed our scholars for hundreds of years. "Lisping sibilant hisses,' 'Ether's sweet sway,' 'Rancid kiss of passing sin,' and other strange, almost insane insertions into the writs were codes for the name of the person to be assassinated, his or her location, and the time at which death was to come. They were also direct references to the divine spirit called Sithis.<BR>
<BR>
Evidence of the Morag Tong's expertise in assassination seems scarcely necessary. The few instances of someone escaping a murder attempt by them are always remarkable and rare, proving that they were and are patient, capable murderers who use their tools well. A fragment of a letter found among the effects of a well-known armorer has been sealed in our vaults for some time. It was likely penned by an unknown Tong assassin ordering weapons for his order, and offers some illumination into what they looked for in their blades, as well the mention of Vounoura, the island where the Tong sent its agents in retirement --<BR>
<BR>
'I congratulate you on your artistry, and the balance and heft of your daggers. The knife blade is whisper thin, elegantly wrought, but impractical. It must have a bolder edge, for arteries, when cut, have a tendencies to self seal, preventing adequate blood loss. I will be leaving Vounoura in two weeks time to inspect your new tools, hoping they will be more satisfactory.'<BR>
<BR>
The Morag Tong spread quietly throughout Tamriel in the early years of the second era, worshipping Mephala and Sithis with blood, as they had always done.<BR>
<BR>
When the Morag Tong assassinated the Emperor Reman in the year 2920 of the First Era, and his successor, Potentate Versidue-Shaie in the 324th year of the second era, the assassins so long in the shadows were suddenly thrust into the light. They had become brazen, drunk with murder, literally painting the words 'MORAG TONG' on the wall in the Potentate's blood.<BR>
<BR>
The Morag Tong was instantly and unanimously outlawed in all corners of Tamriel, with the exception of its home province of Morrowind. There they continued to operate with the blessings of the Houses, apparently cutting off all contact with their satellite brothers to the west. There they continue their quasi-legal existence, accepting black writs and murdering with impunity.<BR>
<BR>
Most scholars believe that the birth of the Dark Brotherhood, the secular, murder-for- profit order of assassins, was as a result of a religious schism in the Morag Tong. Given the secrecy of both cults, it is difficult to divine the exact nature of it, but certain logical assumptions can be made.<BR>
<BR>
In order to exist, the Morag Tong must have appealed to the highest power in Morrowind, which at that time, the Second Era, could only have been the Tribunal of Almalexia, Sotha Sil, and Vivec. Mephala, whom the Tong worshipped with Sithis, was said to have been the Anticipation of Vivec. Is it not logical to assume that in exchange for toleration of their continued existence, the Tong would have ceased their worship of Mephala in exchange for the worship of Vivec?<BR>
<BR>
The Morag Tong continues, as we know, to worship Sithis. The Dark Brotherhood is not considered a religious order by most, merely a secular organization, offering murder for gold. I have seen, however, proof positive in the form of writs to the Brotherhood that Sithis is still revered above all.<BR>
<BR>
So where, the reader, asks, is the cause for the schism? How could a silent war have begun, when both groups are so close? Both assassin's guilds, after all, worship Sithis. And yet, a figure emerges from history who should give those with this assumption pause.<BR>
<BR>
The Night Mother.<BR>
<BR>
Who the Night Mother is, where she came from, what her functions are, no one knows. Carlovac Townway in his generally well-researched historical fiction 2920: The Last Year of the First Era tries to make her the leader of the Morag Tong. But she is never historically associated with the Tong, only the Dark Brotherhood.<BR>
<BR>
The Night Mother, my dear friend, is Mephala. The Dark Brotherhood of the west, unfettered by the orders of the Tribunal, continue to worship Mephala. They may not call her by her name, but the daedra of murder, sex, and secrets is their leader still. And they did not, and still do not, to this day, forgive their brethren for casting her aside.<BR>
<BR>
The cobbler who met his end in the second era, who saw no end in the war between the Brotherhood and the Tong, was correct. In the shadows of the Empire, the Brothers of Death remain locked in combat, and they will likely remain that way forever. <BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
火与暗：死亡兄弟会<BR>
伊尼尔·戈明 著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
“兄弟，我仍称你为兄弟，因为我们血脉相连，历经考验，虽遭仇恨却未断裂。即使我被谋杀 -- 如今看来似乎已不可避免 -- 请你知晓，兄弟。你我并非无辜之人，因此我们彼此敌视的‘祝福’不是悲剧，而是恐怖。这种无声、阴暗的战争，秘密的毒药，睡梦中被扼死在床上的人，突如其来的箭矢和精巧的匕首，在我看来永无止境。没有和平的可能。我看到房间里的影子在移动，尽管烛火平稳。我认得那些迹象，我......”<BR>
<BR>
这张便条是在第二纪元358年，于诺德村庄雅伦海姆一间废弃房屋的地板下发现的。据说曾有一位沉默寡言的鞋匠住在那屋里，有人私下传言他是令人畏惧的莫拉格堂成员 -- 该刺客公会在三十四年前已在整个泰姆瑞尔被宣布为非法。房屋本身井然有序，仿佛鞋匠只是凭空消失了一般。便条上有一滴血迹。<BR>
<BR>
黑暗兄弟会曾造访此地。<BR>
<BR>
这张便条及其同类之物非常罕见。莫拉格堂及其被憎恨的产物 -- 黑暗兄弟会，都极其谨慎，不留下任何证据 -- 他们的成员深知泄露公会秘密是死罪。这显然使得试图追溯其历史的历史学家的工作极为困难。<BR>
<BR>
根据大多数学者的说法，莫拉格堂几乎自晨风文化诞生之初就是其一部分。毕竟，雷斯达因 -- 晨风的古称 -- 的历史充斥着暗杀、血祭和宗教狂热，这正是该公会的标志。人们常说，莫拉格堂无论过去还是现在，都是为了迪德拉王子梅法拉的光荣而杀人，但通常的假设很少完全准确。我认为，莫拉格堂最早的形态还崇拜着一个比梅法拉更古老、更邪恶的神祇。尽管那位湮灭王子已足够令人恐惧，但他们过去和现在都崇敬着一种远为巨大的邪恶。<BR>
<BR>
第一纪元的暗杀令状提供了难得的机会，让我们得以窥见莫拉格堂最早的哲学。它们与现今的令状一样平实，但许多令状中包含的一些诗歌片段，数百年来一直困扰着学者们。“咝咝作响的嘶嘶声”、“乙太的甜蜜摇摆”、“逝罪的腐臭之吻”以及令状中插入的其他奇怪、近乎疯狂的文字，是被暗杀者姓名、地点和死亡时间的密码。它们也是直接指向被称为西帝斯的神灵。<BR>
<BR>
莫拉格堂暗杀技艺精湛的证据似乎无需多言。极少有人能从他们的谋杀企图中逃脱，每一次都令人瞩目且极为罕见，证明他们过去和现在都是耐心、能干、善用工具的杀手。在一著名护甲匠的遗物中发现的一封信件碎片，已在我们金库中封存了一段时间。这封信很可能是一位不知名的莫拉格堂刺客为其公会订购武器时所写，其中揭示了一些他们对刀刃的偏好，以及提到了沃努拉 -- 莫拉格堂将退役特工送往的岛屿 -- <BR>
<BR>
“祝贺你的工艺精湛，你的匕首平衡与重量俱佳。但刀刃薄如耳语，锻造得过于精巧，却不实用。它必须有更锋利的刃口，因为动脉被切开后有自我闭合的倾向，会导致失血不足。我将两周后离开沃努拉，前去检验你的新作品，希望它们能更令人满意。”<BR>
<BR>
莫拉格堂在第二纪元早期悄然遍布泰姆瑞尔，一如既往地用鲜血崇拜梅法拉和西帝斯。<BR>
<BR>
当莫拉格堂在第一纪元2920年刺杀了皇帝雷曼，并在第二纪元324年刺杀了其继任者、执政官维尔西杜-沙伊时，这些长期潜伏在阴影中的刺客突然被推到了台前。他们变得肆无忌惮，沉醉于杀戮，甚至用执政官的鲜血在墙上涂写了“莫拉格堂”的字样。<BR>
<BR>
莫拉格堂立即被泰姆瑞尔所有地区一致宣布为非法，只有其家乡行省晨风除外。在那里，他们继续在大家族的默许下运作，显然切断了与西部卫星兄弟的所有联系。在那里，他们继续着半合法的存在，接受黑色令状，肆无忌惮地进行谋杀。<BR>
<BR>
大多数学者认为，黑暗兄弟会 -- 那个世俗的、以谋杀牟利的刺客组织 -- 的诞生，源于莫拉格堂内部的一次宗教分裂。鉴于两个教派都极为隐秘，很难推断其确切性质，但可以做出一些合乎逻辑的假设。<BR>
<BR>
为了生存，莫拉格堂必定曾向晨风的最高权力 -- 在第二纪元，只能是阿玛莱西娅、索萨·希尔和维威克组成的审判席 -- 寻求过认可。梅法拉，莫拉格堂与西帝斯一同崇拜的对象，据说是维威克的“前身”。假设莫拉格堂以停止崇拜梅法拉、转而崇拜维威克，来换取对其继续存在的容忍，这难道不合逻辑吗？<BR>
<BR>
莫拉格堂继续崇拜西帝斯，这是我们所知的。大多数人并不认为黑暗兄弟会是一个宗教组织，而只是一个世俗组织，以黄金换取谋杀。然而，我见过一些寄往兄弟会的令状，那是明确的证据，表明西帝斯仍然被奉为至高无上。<BR>
<BR>
那么，读者会问，分裂的原因何在？当两个团体如此接近时，一场无声的战争如何能开始？毕竟，两个刺客公会都崇拜西帝斯。然而，历史中出现了一个人物，应该会让那些持有这种假设的人停下思考。<BR>
<BR>
夜母。<BR>
<BR>
夜母是谁，她来自何方，她的职能是什么，无人知晓。卡洛瓦克·汤威在其通常研究充分的历史小说《2920，第一纪元最后一年》中，试图将她塑造为莫拉格堂的领袖。但在历史上，她从未与莫拉格堂有过关联，只与黑暗兄弟会有关。<BR>
<BR>
夜母，我亲爱的朋友，就是梅法拉。西方的黑暗兄弟会，不受审判席教令的束缚，继续崇拜梅法拉。他们或许不直呼其名，但那位掌管谋杀、性与秘密的迪德拉仍然是他们的领袖。而且他们过去没有，至今也没有原谅他们的兄弟将梅法拉抛弃。<BR>
<BR>
那位在第二纪元丧生、认为兄弟会与莫拉格堂之间的战争永无止境的鞋匠是正确的。在帝国的阴影中，死亡兄弟会仍深陷战斗，它们很可能将永远如此。<BR>

莫拉格堂暗杀技艺精湛的证据似乎无需多言。极少有人能从他们的谋杀企图中逃脱，每一次都令人瞩目且极为罕见，证明他们过去和现在都是耐心、能干、善用工具的杀手。在一著名护甲匠的遗物中发现的一封信件碎片，已在我们金库中封存了一段时间。这封信很可能是一位不知名的莫拉格堂刺客为其公会订购武器时所写，其中揭示了一些他们对刀刃的偏好，以及提到了沃努拉 -- 莫拉格堂将退役特工送往的岛屿 -- <BR>
<BR>
“祝贺你的工艺精湛，你的匕首平衡与重量俱佳。但刀刃薄如耳语，锻造得过于精巧，却不实用。它必须有更锋利的刃口，因为动脉被切开后有自我闭合的倾向，会导致失血不足。我将两周后离开沃努拉，前去检验你的新作品，希望它们能更令人满意。”<BR>
<BR>
莫拉格堂在第二纪元早期悄然遍布泰姆瑞尔，一如既往地用鲜血崇拜梅法拉和西帝斯。<BR>
<BR>
当莫拉格堂在第一纪元2920年刺杀了皇帝雷曼，并在第二纪元324年刺杀了其继任者、执政官维尔西杜-沙伊时，这些长期潜伏在阴影中的刺客突然被推到了台前。他们变得肆无忌惮，沉醉于杀戮，甚至用执政官的鲜血在墙上涂写了“莫拉格堂”的字样。<BR>
<BR>
莫拉格堂立即被泰姆瑞尔所有地区一致宣布为非法，只有其家乡行省晨风除外。在那里，他们继续在大家族的默许下运作，显然切断了与西部卫星兄弟的所有联系。在那里，他们继续着半合法的存在，接受黑色令状，肆无忌惮地进行谋杀。<BR>
<BR>
大多数学者认为，黑暗兄弟会 -- 那个世俗的、以谋杀牟利的刺客组织 -- 的诞生，源于莫拉格堂内部的一次宗教分裂。鉴于两个教派都极为隐秘，很难推断其确切性质，但可以做出一些合乎逻辑的假设。<BR>
<BR>
为了生存，莫拉格堂必定曾向晨风的最高权力 -- 在第二纪元，只能是阿玛莱西娅、索萨·希尔和维威克组成的审判席 -- 寻求过认可。梅法拉，莫拉格堂与西帝斯一同崇拜的对象，据说是维威克的“前身”。假设莫拉格堂以停止崇拜梅法拉、转而崇拜维威克，来换取对其继续存在的容忍，这难道不合逻辑吗？<BR>
<BR>
莫拉格堂继续崇拜西帝斯，这是我们所知的。大多数人并不认为黑暗兄弟会是一个宗教组织，而只是一个世俗组织，以黄金换取谋杀。然而，我见过一些寄往兄弟会的令状，那是明确的证据，表明西帝斯仍然被奉为至高无上。<BR>
<BR>
那么，读者会问，分裂的原因何在？当两个团体如此接近时，一场无声的战争如何能开始？毕竟，两个刺客公会都崇拜西帝斯。然而，历史中出现了一个人物，应该会让那些持有这种假设的人停下思考。<BR>
<BR>
夜母。<BR>
<BR>
夜母是谁，她来自何方，她的职能是什么，无人知晓。卡洛瓦克·汤威在其通常研究充分的历史小说《2920，第一纪元最后一年》中，试图将她塑造为莫拉格堂的领袖。但在历史上，她从未与莫拉格堂有过关联，只与黑暗兄弟会有关。<BR>
<BR>
夜母，我亲爱的朋友，就是梅法拉。西方的黑暗兄弟会，不受审判席教令的束缚，继续崇拜梅法拉。他们或许不直呼其名，但那位掌管谋杀、性与秘密的迪德拉仍然是他们的领袖。而且他们过去没有，至今也没有原谅他们的兄弟将梅法拉抛弃。<BR>
<BR>
那位在第二纪元丧生、认为兄弟会与莫拉格堂之间的战争永无止境的鞋匠是正确的。在帝国的阴影中，死亡兄弟会仍深陷战斗，它们很可能将永远如此。<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Flora of Skyrim, Volume I<BR>
by Arielle Jurard<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Alchemists, healers, and self-sufficient adventurers practising their arts in the province of Skyrim are advised to familiarise themselves with the ingredients of the region. To aid those of poor memory, I have recorded some alchemical formulae which use the native flora.<BR>
<BR>
Potions to restore fatigue are amongst the easiest to produce, if only because the required ingredients are so abundant across Tamriel. Many common foodstuffs possess the required effect; combining two or more of them in a set of quality alchemical apparatus results in a more potent -- and bottleable -- extract. Bread, apple, cheese, honey, leek and potato are all easy to obtain throughout the Holds. Bread in Skyrim is baked in the Colovian fashion, from native witherwheat flour. The grains and flour also restore fatigue, but are much less palatable. Apples can be found on their trees, and are often farmed, as are leeks and potatoes. Honey can be obtained from beehives, which are normally cultivated on farms and in some cities.<BR>
<BR>
To create a potion for the restoration of health, combine black spore cap and honey lily blossom. The black spore mushroom can be found in dark and damp places across Skyrim, though only its cap is of alchemical interest; the stalk tastes bitter and is good for little. Honey lily flowers grow in abundance across the Reach, and particularly in Midkarth. The plants are easy to find -- they have tall stalks, and their blossom is the distinctive honey color for which the plant is named.<BR>
<BR>
Various diseases spread by the secretion of the native Wormmouth can be cured by combined application of Vicar Herb leaves and Aspyr Tea. The Vicar Herb is a common plant throughout the Reach, resembling a tiny tree with flowers white as stars. The Aspyr Tea is cultivated by Reachmen farmers, but may be found growing wild in the Sundered Hills or the Druadach Highlands.<BR>
<BR>
Of particular interest to adventurers is a potion to lessen one's weight. This is simply prepared by adding equal parts Cloudy Corn to Shadowfly stalk. Cloudy Corn is a farmed staple food across the province, but the Shadowfly plant is quite rare, and only grows in the wilds of Skyrim. Anyone who spots its purple petals whilst travelling should take care to harvest the plant, as they are of value to practising alchemists. When combined with the flower of the Taragetis the Shadow Fly will render a potion for the replenishment of one's magicka.<BR>
<BR>
An extract to aid exploration in dark places can be distilled from crushed shadowfly stalk and the root of the forsythia tromja. The forsythia is a tough and dark shrub with sparse golden flowers, though its most useful part lies under the ground. The roots are surprisingly thin and wiry, though should never be eaten raw, as they contain a mild paralyzing poison. The use of an alembic is highly recommended.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
天际植物志 卷一<BR>
阿里尔·朱拉尔 著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
在天际行省从事炼金、治疗及自给自足冒险的从业者，建议熟悉该地区的原料。为帮助记忆不佳者，我记录了一些使用本地植物的炼金配方。<BR>
<BR>
恢复体力的药剂是最容易制作的，原因很简单，所需原料在整个泰姆瑞尔都非常丰富。许多常见食物都具有所需效果；在一套优质炼金设备中将两种或更多此类食物混合，即可产生更有效且可瓶装的提取物。面包、苹果、奶酪、蜂蜜、韭菜和土豆在整个领都很容易获得。天际的面包按照科洛维亚风格烘烤，使用本地枯萎小麦面粉。谷物和面粉也能恢复体力，但味道差得多。苹果可在树上找到，常被种植，韭菜和土豆亦然。蜂蜜可从蜂箱获得，蜂箱通常养在农场和一些城市中。<BR>
<BR>
要制作恢复生命的药剂，将黑色孢子盖和蜜百合花混合。黑色孢子蘑菇在天际各地阴暗潮湿处都可找到，但只有其菌盖具有炼金价值；菌柄味苦，用处不大。蜜百合花在边塞大量生长，尤其在米德卡斯特别丰富。这种植物很容易找到 -- 它们有高耸的花茎，花朵呈独特的蜂蜜色，植物也因此得名。<BR>
<BR>
由本地虫嘴分泌物传播的多种疾病，可通过联合使用维卡草叶和阿斯帕茶来治愈。维卡草是边塞常见的植物，形似小树，开有星般洁白的花朵。阿斯帕茶由边塞农民种植，但在破碎丘陵或德鲁阿达赫高地也可能发现野生植株。<BR>
<BR>
对冒险者特别有用的是减轻体重的药剂。只需将等量的浊玉米加入暗影蝇茎中即可简单制备。浊玉米是全省种植的主食，但暗影蝇植物相当稀有，只生长在天际的荒野中。任何人在旅行中发现其紫色花瓣时，都应小心采摘，因为这对执业炼金术士很有价值。当与塔拉格提斯花混合时，暗影蝇可制成恢复魔能的药剂。<BR>
<BR>
有助于探索黑暗场所的提取物，可通过蒸馏压碎的暗影蝇茎和连翘特罗姆亚根来制取。连翘是一种坚韧、深色的灌木，开有稀疏的金色花朵，但其最有用的部分在地下。根部出奇地细而坚韧，但绝不可生食，因为它们含有轻微的麻痹性毒素。强烈建议使用蒸馏器。<BR>

Concerning Priests and Nackles As related at length by two Priests of Akatosh to the Adventurer, who at the time was not having an adventure, and had nothing better to do. 匕首雨及其周边，第三纪元的萧条时期<BR><BR>

开场白：我们可怜的演员们将努力记住台词，并尽量不被我们简陋的布景绊倒。我恳求各位观众，不要喝倒彩、纠缠或投掷腐烂食物。你们只会让这出短剧拖得更长。剧作家、演员与戏剧家协会谨告，任何对冗长对话、呆板表演、晦涩解说或令人困惑且不满的结局感到敏感或过敏的观众，请立即离场。你们的金币，唉，概不退还。作为补救之策，本系列短剧包含大量与肉体欢愉相关的直白描写。各位或许会喜欢。啊，我们的英雄来了，那位名叫冒险者的暗精灵恶棍。是时候让开场白欢快退场了。<BR><BR>

科蒙：是的，确实有点奇怪......而且我们甚至还没碰过那些......<BR><BR>
（莱班踢科蒙）<BR><BR>
莱班：我们俩都看到了相同的幻象 -- 真的很奇怪。<BR><BR>
冒险者：说来听听，我不急着走。<BR><BR>
莱班：嗯，我们都听到了某种......词语......开始是这样的。比如‘尼克爵士’或‘纳克圣徒’......<BR><BR>
冒险者：你是说‘尼克’或‘纳克’？等一下......让我喝一口你的酒，兄弟......啊！好多了 -- 你们喝的可真是高档货！是的，我想起来了 -- 有个关于一个叫纳克尔的精灵的故事或古老传说，我想 -- 来自晨风？<BR><BR>
莱班：你知道，也许你说得有道理 -- 这一带有个古老传说，我想来自高岩深处......嗯......纳克尔斯，就是它！<BR><BR>
冒险者：纳克尔斯，嗯！似乎有几个暗精灵用这个名字......尤其是那些......更古怪的......<BR><BR>
科蒙：是的，我猜那些坏家伙都喜欢那些武器魔法之类的东西......非常讨厌的家伙......<BR><BR>
莱班：（对科蒙）科蒙！这位伙计尖耳朵红眼睛......<BR><BR>
科蒙：请原谅，朋友......这里有点暗，我没......呃......<BR><BR>
冒险者：哦，没关系。这是个奇怪的时代。你知道，各安天命 -- 或各得其所 -- 视情况而定。现在......不如你给我讲讲这个纳克尔斯神话？来，让我帮你处理一下那瓶酒......啊！谢谢。<BR><BR>
莱班：呃......当然，如果你想这么说的话......来，再喝一大口！当然，我们有时间，我现在记得很清楚。<BR><BR>
科蒙：是的，我们还有几个小时，直到那个金发小妞出现在她的灯下......<BR><BR>
（莱班踢科蒙）<BR><BR>
莱班：（对科蒙）安静！记住，我们不得不把她的地址告诉大祭司，所以她暂时不会出现了！<BR><BR>
（对大家）好吧，故事是这样的，尽我所忆。这是高岩的农民们用来吓唬孩子、让他们安分一段时间的故事，我想。他们会在......让我想想......故事与烛脂节，还是女巫节？ -- 就在孩子们被送到谷仓或猪圈睡觉之前讲。<BR><BR>
科蒙：可恶的农民！不过，我会把他们全送到垃圾堆去......<BR><BR>
莱班：说真的，科蒙！记住，那些可怜的灵魂需要我们的同情和祝福，我们是他们的救星！<BR><BR>
科蒙：现在谁在老高官的书房里？<BR><BR>
莱班：呃......总之。故事大概是这样。如果孩子们这一年真的很乖 -- 在市场上偷够了东西，每天清理马厩，不去跟哥布林玩，不骚扰羊群，等等。如果他们真的很乖，那就没什么好担心的。但如果他们不乖，就有这么一个叫纳克勒斯的邪恶、可怕的暗精灵灵体。他不像典型的暗精灵 -- 更瘦，更高。面色惨白如纸，脸长如手臂。走路时膝盖和手肘像是向反方向弯曲。他发出指甲划过石板般的窃笑。穿着一件紧身黑衣（不是卡吉特风格，更像带纽扣的正装），但太紧太小。他会去拜访那些坏女孩 -- <BR><BR>
科蒙：你为什么又在说老高官了，莱班？<BR><BR>
（科蒙打嗝）（莱班踢科蒙）<BR><BR>
莱班：你真的得原谅科蒙：工作过度，你知道的。太多治疗和皈依......总之，老坏蛋纳克勒斯据说游荡在我们泰姆瑞尔的地下，在肮脏黑暗的矮人隧道里。全泰姆瑞尔的地下都是，如果你能相信的话！他乘着一辆生锈、吱嘎作响的旧矿车，在旧矿轨上行驶......<BR><BR>
冒险者：很久很久以前，我在落锤的龙牙巢穴见过一些......<BR><BR>
科蒙：（对莱班）他在龙牙巢穴做什么！？<BR><BR>
莱班：（对科蒙）嘘！如果他是我想的那个人，你不会想知道他是谁！（对大家）嗯，是的。好吧，纳克勒斯被哥布林拉来拉去穿过这些深隧道 -- 不是你常见的那种脏兮兮的黄皮肤哥布林，而是讨厌的黑色家伙。总之，他们拉着纳克勒斯在这些黑暗隧道中穿行，然后，深夜时分，他会在每个坏孩子的小屋、房子或城堡下方停下 -- 无论贵贱。然后他滑上排水管......<BR><BR>
科蒙：爬上裂缝......爬过洞口......<BR><BR>
莱班：渗过秘密通道......<BR><BR>
科蒙：咯咯笑着爬上厕所......<BR><BR>
莱班：直接进了孩子的地方！然后，如果孩子只是有点坏，纳克勒斯就只是把事情搞糟，让孩子受责。到处留下油腻的脏痕（总之比平时更多），打碎些东西，偷些东西，诸如此类。也许拿走糖果，留下些愚者黑檀块代替......<BR><BR>
冒险者：愚者黑檀 -- 那是什么？我听到过提它，哦，几个小时前......几个法师......<BR><BR>
莱班：你现在听到了？有趣......非常......好吧，我们一会儿再谈那个......让我先把纳克勒斯讲完。我说到哪了 -- 哦对......现在，如果那小崽子真的坏透了 -- 那所有小玩具都会被拿走。铜匕首、木剑、小鞭子等等。所有孩子最喜欢的常用东西。<BR><BR>
科蒙：鞭子？我喜欢那些。<BR><BR>
（科蒙打嗝）（莱班踢科蒙）<BR><BR>
莱班：如果那小崽子已经非常、非常坏，纳克勒斯就会抓住那崽子。把他或她塞进他那脏兮兮的大麻袋里。拖着麻袋穿过洞口和裂缝，下到他生锈的旧矿车上！然后他们就走了！<BR><BR>
科蒙：希望他把一些坏小女孩留下。<BR><BR>
（莱班踢科蒙）<BR><BR>
莱班：呃......所以我们可以救她们，当然，朋友......嗯。有时，据我所知，那崽子一去不回。我想也没什么大损失，农民们再生一个就是了。<BR><BR>
科蒙：知道，我知道，我知道......<BR><BR>
（莱班捏科蒙的鼻子）<BR><BR>
莱班：但是，就像这里流传的故事那样，小崽子通常只是被送去干活，挖出愚者黑檀块，铲土，装袋。扩展纳克勒斯的隧道。过了一段时间，小崽子被推回他来的地方。那小崽子似乎觉得自己在地下待了一整年，但地上只过了一天......小崽子回来时非常瘦，很脏，满身黑乎乎的......你知道，想想看 -- 在女巫节之后的那天，我经常看到一些小崽子，骨瘦如柴，身上脏兮兮的，沾满黑色污物，还一脸惊恐。如果他们有金币，父母会把他们拖到神殿去接受祝福和治疗。以谢尔格拉斯的胡须起誓，那哭喊声和吵闹声！足以把祭司逼到......呃......嗯，算了......那是我们的问题......<BR><BR>
科蒙：不......我跟你说，那是我们供货商的问题......<BR><BR>
（莱班把科蒙扔过屏风）<BR><BR>
莱班：总之，这就是这里流传的纳克勒斯传说的概要。我现在想起来，这传说遍布整个泰姆瑞尔......而且了解这地方的人都知道，这故事里很可能不只是一丁点真相，而是非常多......<BR><BR>
冒险者：所以，我猜有些......呃，更阴暗的暗精灵某种程度上认同这个纳克勒斯。可以说是，扮演这个角色......<BR><BR>
莱班：是的，我想这基本上概括了......虽然我们没见过那类人拖着麻袋装着崽子，对吧？<BR><BR>
科蒙：不，那是我们干的，小女孩崽子，不是吗？<BR><BR>
（科蒙打嗝）（莱班在科蒙头上砸碎一个瓶子）<BR><BR>
（科蒙倒地昏迷）<BR><BR>
冒险者：这真是一个很有趣的故事，先生们。我说，让我用一瓶酒来报答你们 -- 你们喝的是什么？啊，我就知道 -- 店老板！再给这些圣人上些圣酒！<BR><BR>
莱班：愿祝福降临于你，为你这份善意，朋友。<BR><BR>
冒险者：谢谢你，我肯定能用上一两个......话说，这‘愚者黑檀’，我最近听到一些窃窃私语 -- 大多是偷听......抱歉......是听......法师们之类的谈话。这玩意儿是怎么回事？来，再喝一口......好！<BR><BR>
莱班：嗯，我们不应该告诉外人......不过，你似乎已经知道一些了。而且如果你一直在听法师们的闲话......那，也许我们可以做笔交易。大家都有利！嗯......当然是为了阿卡托什礼拜堂，以及你的酬劳，好先生。<BR><BR>
冒险者：越来越有趣了 -- 请继续说吧。<BR><BR>
（科蒙踉跄站起）（科蒙打嗝）<BR><BR>
科蒙：是时候去感化那个街灯下的小姑娘了......不，不，不 -- 不是昨晚那个，是那个金发妞......<BR><BR>
（科蒙下）（后台传来女性尖叫声）<BR><BR>
莱班：朋友，你得原谅科蒙。他有点......你知道的，奇怪......他有那些......<BR><BR>
冒险者：哦，没关系，我们都有自己的......<BR><BR>
（莱班和冒险者下）（尾声上）<BR><BR>
尾声：对于本剧至此的质量，我们深表歉意。如果仍在座的各位愿意等待几分钟，让我们的吟游诗人演奏《沉默即同意》，我们将为下一幕 -- 第二部 -- 更换布景。请不要忘记打赏你的侍女。你相信有愚者黑檀这种东西吗？也许我们会在第二部中找到答案。也许不会。<BR><BR>
（音乐花腔）（尾声下）<BR><BR>
第一部终，主要关于纳克勒斯的传说。<BR>"""

主要关于愚者黑檀与神殿<BR><BR>

开场白：到目前为止，我们的喜剧进展甚微。冒险者，我们的暗精灵恶棍，请两位阿卡托什祭司喝了酒。大家都喝了不少。一位祭司匆匆离去，去追他的街灯姑娘了。而且，除非我忘了什么，或者在我注意别的事时发生了什么，这就是第一部的完整概要。啊，又来两位祭司。卑微的开场白必须退场了。<BR><BR>
（雷克和斯特特上）<BR><BR>
雷克：晚上好，莱班！晚上好，陌生人。我这位祭司同僚叫斯特特，我是雷克。我们很荣幸侍奉尤利安诺斯。<BR><BR>
冒险者：这到底是怎么回事 -- 祭司们的夜游？而且......我以为你们的神殿 -- 阿卡托什、尤利安诺斯，还有其他......我以为它们都是势不两立的竞争对手。无论是在神学上还是在金钱上，请恕我直言。但你们看起来都像是最要好的朋友......？话说回来，我是不是早些时候跟斯特特说过话，你说你是斯腾达尔神殿的？<BR><BR>
雷克：常见的误解，朋友......<BR><BR>
莱班：......但也是我们所......鼓励的......<BR><BR>
雷克：真的，我们都紧密合作，根据需要在不同神殿之间调动......<BR><BR>
莱班：......交换信息......<BR><BR>
雷克：......共享资金......<BR><BR>
斯特特：......交换我们的姐妹......<BR><BR>
（莱班踢斯特特）（开场白上）<BR><BR>
开场白：抱歉打断这欢乐的闹剧，但我之前忘了提及，愚者黑檀传奇 -- 如果这个词合适的话 -- 包含大量直白提及的祭司不端行为和性放纵。我希望在座各位中那些性情乖戾、拘谨古板、阴郁不悦、衣着邋遢或脾气暴躁的观众不要感到被冒犯。好了，娱乐继续。<BR><BR>
（开场白下）<BR><BR>

莱班：要知道，有一两个，呃......宗教组织......嗯，算是吧......我们跟他们没有任何关系......<BR><BR>
雷克：完全没有关系，完全没有......野兽，只是野兽......<BR><BR>
冒险者：比如？<BR><BR>
莱班：嗯 -- 黑暗兄弟会算一个......一帮讨厌的暴徒......还有暗夜社......<BR><BR>

这家伙，看起来是个正派的人......似乎知道一些关于法师和愚者黑檀的事......<BR><BR>
雷克：（对莱班低语）真的吗......真有趣......<BR><BR>
（对大家）嘿伙计，再来一瓶 -- 这会保佑你的喉咙的。哎呀，哎呀，确实如此......<BR><BR>
冒险者：谢谢雷克，不介意......<BR><BR>
莱班：但让我继续 -- 我刚才在给你解释这愚者黑檀......<BR><BR>
雷克：是的，愚者黑檀......<BR><BR>

斯特特：那首流行歌怎么唱的？（唱）<BR><BR>
所有老矮人都去哪儿了，很久以前......<BR><BR>

莱班：我听说沃斯加里安山脉北边某处有一堆真正的黑檀。你知道那些暗淡的黑色黑檀是如何被法师、被一些技艺精湛的护甲匠加工成各种强力武器、护符、腰带等等的。只要能找到，都能卖大价钱。而且最好的那些是很久以前由那些老矮人制造的......<BR><BR>

冒险者：原矿，未成形的材料，只为那么少数人提供工作......和力量？显然充满了负魔能？<BR><BR>

冒险者：是的，那大概就是我......呃......从一些法师那里听说的。但我也听到了别的......<BR><BR>
莱班：那又是什么呢，朋友......当然，如果你愿意告诉我们的话......先生。<BR><BR>
冒险者：哦，当然！我想我们可以达成......呃......某种协议？<BR><BR>
莱班和雷克（齐声）：当然，哦是的！<BR><BR>
冒险者：所以，是的，那些法师 -- 舒布和舒布，他们总是叫舒布，对吧？ -- 总之，这些老家伙说这愚者黑檀可以燃烧。不是魔法燃烧，而是像普通的木头一样。但火焰持续得更久，产生更多热量，几乎没有烟，没有噪音......非常有趣......法师们说炼金术士想要它，用来加热曲颈瓶和烧瓶......法师公会想要它，用来制造和销售......呃......假护符之类的......真是卑鄙的把戏！尤其是护甲匠，他们很想要它，我想是为了他们的熔炉。还有炼金术士，为了他们的蒸馏器......<BR><BR>
莱班：正是我所知道的！现在......冬天这里很冷，不是吗？所有人都在砍伐那些树，制造攻城器械、船只，所有那些邪恶的战争机器！所有那些富有的王室和商人都要给他们的大宅子供暖。好让他们的女伯爵们几乎可以什么都不穿就跑来跑去，而不是裹着皮草......<BR><BR>
斯特特：......就像我妹妹一样......<BR><BR>

第二天。<BR><BR>

开场白：当扮演冒险者和商人内弗隆的演员们夸张地动着嘴巴、模仿对话时，可怜的开场白必须承担起向观众更新前三幕剧情的责任。冒险者，一个暗精灵恶棍，被两个不同的团体 -- 四个醉醺醺的祭司和两个贪婪的法师 -- 雇佣，去拖延对方，并找到隐藏在沃斯加里安山脉中的愚者黑檀矿藏。现在，请想象这个布置得滑稽可笑的场景是一间繁荣商人店铺的后室。在冒险者和内弗隆患上牙关紧闭症之前，开场白就此别过。<BR><BR>
冒险者：所以你明白了吧，内弗隆朋友，我们面前是怎样的一个机会。我们有这种新商品，你也同意会有巨大的需求。<BR><BR>
内弗隆：尤其来自王室 -- 一旦他们中有一个有了新东西，其他人当然都想要。<BR><BR>
冒险者：别忘了护甲匠需要它做熔炉燃料，炼金术士需要它加热曲颈瓶什么的......<BR><BR>
内弗隆：你似乎已经把法师们处理好了，得到了他们的地点，记住了通道地图等等 -- 你知道，我们商人怀疑那些老傻瓜有个我们感兴趣的深藏的秘密已经很久了......现在，祭司们 -- 我们和尤利安诺斯学派已经合作得很好，可以说是亲密无间。但当然我们会把他们从主要利润中剔除 -- 也许让他们分一些给他们的信徒？而他们的神殿也可以充当 -- 怎么说呢？ -- 仓库？但阿卡托什礼拜堂是个问题，他们总是不听指挥、自作主张，毫无合作精神，简直就是疯子......我们真的得对他们做点什么，来......呃......确保他们的合作......<BR><BR>
冒险者：我有个建议或许可行......你还记得老科蒙离开时似乎拽走了一个街灯下的金发小姑娘吧......试想一下，万一碰巧，在他......神志不清的状态下......他错抓了什么重要人物呢？如果消息传出去，那礼拜堂岂不是会有大麻烦？<BR><BR>
内弗隆：嗯。确实......有个愚蠢的金发小贵族，对镇上这一带的‘真实生活’充满热情。她伪装自己（至少她自以为如此），跑到这里来扮演穷人。真是个愚蠢的傻瓜......科蒙还和他的金发妞躲在一起，对吧？<BR><BR>
冒险者：是的，在祭司们那个‘静修处’，靠近水边。<BR><BR>
内弗隆：哦是的，我知道那个地方 -- 常卖给他们一些‘精神粉末’什么的......好......你看，想象一下如果科蒙不小心抓了这个体验生活的女伯爵会发生什么事......如果她出了什么事，阿卡托什礼拜堂会从王宫那边招惹来无穷的麻烦......然后我们就可以介入，在礼拜堂困难时期提出‘帮助’......嗯。好！交给我了，我会联系我的一些......呃......商业伙伴......做些安排。<BR><BR>
冒险者：我会继续和祭司们闲聊，让他们支持我们的小生意？<BR><BR>
内弗隆：对！而且我应该把你介绍给我们兄弟会......抱歉，公会的一些更资深成员。过几天等一切都安排好了我会联系你。你每晚都在这里？<BR><BR>
冒险者：是的，这些天入夜后外面不太安全。<BR><BR>
内弗隆：我明白了。我们得为你安排一些......保护。好的，那就过几天。<BR><BR>
（内弗隆悄然下）（五位护甲匠上）<BR><BR>
（护甲匠和冒险者打斗）（冒险者倒地）<BR><BR>
（护甲匠把冒险者绑起来然后弄醒他）<BR><BR>
护甲匠1：好了，伙计。别跟我们耍花招！我们知道愚者黑檀的事。也知道那些似乎发现了位置的法师。我们一直在看你跟祭司、法师、商人周旋。几乎跟所有两条腿的家伙都搅在一起！<BR><BR>
护甲匠2：还知道你真的在跟内弗隆合作。<BR><BR>
护甲匠3：还知道你如何欺骗祭司和法师......<BR><BR>
护甲匠2：你和内弗隆在对付阿卡托什礼拜堂上确实干得不错，我们得承认。<BR><BR>
护甲匠1：但现在，我们要得到那愚者黑檀的货源。我们需要它来提高产量、质量和价格。我们可以和内弗隆及其同伙合作，反正我们也需要仓库和分销渠道。<BR><BR>
护甲匠4：我们可以用酷刑从你嘴里撬出来......<BR><BR>
护甲匠3：我们可以把你的计划告诉祭司们 -- 他们会立刻把你扔给暗夜社！<BR><BR>
护甲匠5：我们可以让法师们知道 -- 他们会把你送到湮灭去待上很长、很长一段时间！<BR><BR>
护甲匠1：但我们更希望你‘加入’我们的公会。我们可没空离开匕首雨去什么毛茸茸的荒野旅行。最近对我们的服务需求太大了。<BR><BR>
护甲匠2：不过我们可以派一队学徒跟你一起去，给你作伴。<BR><BR>
护甲匠4：我们的学徒通常负责测试我们所有的产品......他们会迫不及待想去野外测试一下。<BR><BR>
冒险者：先生们，先生们！请听我说 -- 我本来真的打算在从其他人那里拿到金子后，把整个交易交给你们的。<BR><BR>
（护甲匠5用热烙铁打冒险者）<BR><BR>
哦哦......好吧，我考虑过......<BR><BR>
护甲匠5：当然！那我还是个宁芙呢！<BR><BR>
冒险者：是的，是的，是的，你们真是太有说服力了。我很欢迎......呃......像你们这样强壮的先生们充当护卫和保镖。在野外会很有用的。<BR><BR>
护甲匠1：好。就知道你会识相！我们的一些其他成员现在正在和内弗隆进行......亲切交谈。我们能搞定他。从现在起，我们的两个大个子学徒会一直跟在你身边。当然是保护 -- 这镇子晚上很危险的......<BR><BR>
护甲匠3：所以继续你的安排，跟内弗隆合作。你随时可以把出发日期留给任何武器店。有什么问题也可以......<BR><BR>
冒险者：当然，先生们。是的，你们确实很有说服力。我会随时向你们汇报进展。还有，呃......谢谢你们的保护。<BR><BR>
（奥索，那个大个子学徒上）（冒险者被解开绳子）（五位护甲匠下）<BR><BR>
冒险者：你好，你是谁？<BR><BR>
奥索：我是奥索！<BR><BR>
冒险者：我的......保镖？<BR><BR>
奥索：我是奥索！<BR><BR>
冒险者：不知为何你看起来很眼熟。你去过晨风吗？<BR><BR>
奥索：我是奥索！<BR><BR>
冒险者：好吧。（旁白）我家老爷子以前常说，一个人能遇到的最糟糕的事就是跟一个一本正经的政客共度一个晚上。我想，这大概能排第二。<BR><BR>
（冒险者和奥索下）（尾声上）<BR><BR>
尾声：我们的戏有六部分，我们刚演完第四部。我觉得有趣的是，那位好色女伯爵还没有出场。你们不会以为我们的剧作家忘了把她写进了剧中人物表吧？嗯，只有你们回来看《愚者黑檀》第五部才会知道。如果你们的邻居决定不回来，别告诉他发生了什么。我们演员也得谋生，你知道的。我们换景的时候别忘了打赏侍女们。<BR><BR>
（尾声下）<BR><BR>
第四部终<BR>"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>

回到祭司们身边，最终计划，以及一两起杀人的报告......<BR><BR>
霜落月中旬前后，粉色宁芙客栈。<BR><BR>
（开场白、冒险者、奥索、内弗隆、五位护甲匠和开场白上）<BR><BR>
开场白：我们的暗精灵恶棍冒险者，在我们惊愕的注视下，从阴谋蛛网的王者，跌落成一团可悲的、蠕动的阿尔贡尼亚粪便。在追寻愚者黑檀 -- 那种人人愿意为之杀戮的物质 -- 的过程中，冒险者试图在商人内弗隆的帮助下，让法师与祭司相互争斗。唉，即是说，呜呼哀哉，五位护甲匠已经困住了内弗隆和冒险者，并接管了他们的计划。壮硕的奥索现在监视着冒险者的一举一动。但我有种感觉 -- 老实说，你们难道没有吗？ -- 在冒险者那败北后颤抖的躯壳之下，潜伏着一只如此狡猾和足智多谋的丛林猫，会在时机成熟时粉碎他所有的敌人。当然，我也可能错了。啊，我看到了一位自认为是冒险者朋友的阿卡托什祭司。我，开场白，必须离开了。<BR><BR>

莱班：晚上好，不介意我加入吧？<BR><BR>
冒险者：嗯......既然你已经坐下了 -- 不介意。我们敬爱的科蒙兄弟在这个寒冷的夜晚去哪儿了？<BR><BR>
莱班：你是说你还不知道 -- 哦，我猜你一直忙于......准备工作？<BR><BR>
冒险者：对，对，非常忙......<BR><BR>
莱班：那我告诉你吧 -- 哦，多糟糕的事啊。多大的麻烦......天哪......嗯......你无疑还记得可怜的科蒙有那个......呃......问题 -- 当然是过度劳累！<BR><BR>
冒险者：哦是的 -- 在我看来，你们确实工作得异常辛苦。<BR><BR>
莱班：嗯......还记得科蒙如何离开的吗，可以说是有些失常，然后......呃......带着外面街灯下那个金发小妞跑了？嗯 -- 在他......呃......神志不清的状态下 -- 他抓错了金发小妞 -- 天哪，确实抓错了......<BR><BR>
冒险者：对我来说她们看起来都差不多，不过当然，我也不太仔细看！<BR><BR>
莱班：天哪！嗯，长话短说吧，老科蒙抓住了一位女伯爵，她本以为自己‘伪装’得很好。天哪！<BR><BR>
冒险者：那么 -- 她逃走了吗？他们抓到科蒙了吗？发生了什么事？<BR><BR>
莱班：嗯，老科蒙虽然醉醺醺的，但动作快得像狂风中的唾沫。他躲过了所有追捕，把那位女士带到了我们的一间......私人静修小屋。天哪！后来，三天后，城市守卫、宫殿守卫、六七个王室成员一起追上了科蒙。对可怜的女伯爵来说，晚了一天 -- 我听说他们花了好大功夫才找到所有的......呃......碎片和零件。科蒙在那里，昏迷不醒。还有另一具尸体，某个普通的金发街灯姑娘。而他现在已经凉透了 -- 永远地，很可能在海湾底部。<BR><BR>
冒险者：哦好吧。女伯爵活该，跑到这种地方来。但我想会有后果吧？<BR><BR>
（另外两位祭司，尤利安诺斯的雷克和斯特特，以及四位武装城市守卫上）<BR><BR>
雷克：晚上好，莱班。晚上好，冒险者。还有 -- <BR><BR>
奥索：我是奥索。<BR><BR>
雷克：是的。幸会。莱班，你确实得到了我的同情......如果我们能帮上什么忙 -- 我们的尤利安诺斯神殿，也就是说......？但说真的，你应该把科蒙拴得更紧些 -- 最好是套索！<BR><BR>
冒险者：你好雷克。你好，斯特特 -- 你妹妹怎么样？<BR><BR>
斯特特：哦，她好极了。<BR><BR>
（雷克点燃了斯特特，但火灭了）<BR><BR>
莱班：是的，我知道我知道。哦，这后果！你知道阿卡托什祭司们已被从匕首雨城堡、途歇宫殿以及其他几乎所有地方驱逐出去了吗？礼拜堂的王室免税待遇被取消了？阿卡托什礼拜堂刚收到一张‘欠税’账单？天哪！<BR><BR>
冒险者：嗯......我想我们或许能帮上点忙？也许从尤利安诺斯那里借笔小额贷款来付税单？比如说，用一座神殿作抵押？哦 -- 税金不是按阿卡托什祭司的人数来算的吗？所以，也许......尤利安诺斯学派可以......接管相当大一部分？减少你的税单？你要知道现在时机不太合适 -- 我们正需要大量资金来筹备我替你们安排的那次探险。<BR><BR>
莱班：哦，我真的很为科蒙难过！但是，是的，也许如果好兄弟雷克能 -- 我真不想这么说 -- 承担更多的经济负担......？当然，作为回报......呃......某些方面的考虑？<BR><BR>
雷克：嗯。比如说大量的‘永久’借调祭司？仔细查看你们的账本？你们的地窖？你们的名册？一座神殿作为我们贷款的抵押？当然，还有这次......探险收益的更大分成？你们的......呃......供应商的名字？<BR><BR>
莱班：哦。我预见到会这样，跟老高官谈过这事 -- 他当时暴跳如雷。但是，作为高级兄弟，他最后授权我‘处理这事’。请注意，那不是他的原话，原话要......长得多，也直白得多......但至少大意如此。<BR><BR>
冒险者：当然，莱班。如果 -- 注意我说的是‘如果’ -- 如果我们成功了，那你就能轻易重新赢得王宫的欢心。只要以优惠低价把货卖给他们！对你任何货件拥有优先购买权？反正一个女伯爵对他们来说算得了什么？<BR><BR>

冒险者：交给我，我能......接触某些人。是的，我大概能说服他们放过礼拜堂，作为交换......未来的好处......<BR><BR>
莱班：哦，哦，我怎么感谢你才好？<BR><BR>

莱班：嗯，是的，我想我们负担得起 -- 你现在有地图了，对吧？我知道我们能拿出8000金币。鉴于潜在的利润......<BR><BR>
冒险者：放心！ -- 都在我的斗篷里 -- 一会儿给你看。我还设法......雇了些强壮的好小伙子，比如这位奥索，来管理马车、挖掘装载、充当护卫等等......<BR><BR>
莱班：好，好 -- 我可以放松一点了。天哪，礼拜堂的兄弟们会松一大口气的。我们真欠你的，兄弟会 -- 哦，我是说阿卡托什礼拜堂，当然！<BR><BR>
斯特特：兄弟会......？那我们的姐妹会呢，嗯？<BR><BR>
（雷克抓住斯特特，让莱班用大木槌击打斯特特）<BR><BR>
冒险者：那么，雷克，你和学派呢？你们能出多少，额外的2000？也许再多些 -- 你知道，这种旅行总是有很多临时开支。<BR><BR>
雷克：嗯。既然我们似乎能得到一整派额外的祭司，还有......其他考虑......当然可以！<BR><BR>
冒险者：好的，先生们 -- 哦，还有斯特特 -- 就是这个！<BR><BR>
（冒险者掏出一张地图，递给雷克）<BR><BR>
哦，以泽尼萨尔的手臂起誓，为了这个我可费了好大劲！那些狡诈的法师！但说到底，不过是贪婪的老傻瓜！......哦，以防你或你的，呃，首席祭司，还没见过货 -- 这里有个样品。拿去玩吧。<BR><BR>
（冒险者递给雷克一个小皮袋）<BR><BR>
雷克：谢谢，谢谢。我得承认，我之前有些......嗯，有些疑虑。你知道 -- 跟陌生人打交道什么的......现在没有了。合伙人！<BR><BR>
冒险者：好，好！<BR><BR>
（斯特特打嗝）<BR><BR>
斯特特：喂，你们听说过这个笑话吗 -- 祭司袍子下面藏着什么？哈哈 -- 他妹妹！哈哈哈！<BR><BR>
（冒险者、莱班和雷克把斯特特打晕）<BR><BR>
雷克：你知道，我担心我们真得对年轻的斯特特采取点措施了......他那个妹妹的事......呃！<BR><BR>
冒险者：是的，他可能成为另一个科蒙 -- 我们最不需要的就是这个！<BR><BR>
莱班：嗯。他这个妹妹 -- 真的 -- 存在吗？<BR><BR>
雷克：哦是的。天哪。哦是的。我们很了解她 -- 我是说，我们经常见到她......<BR><BR>
莱班：我想，兄弟，应该让她明白自己行为的错误。这样她就不会再对斯特特有影响了......<BR><BR>
雷克：是的，毫无疑问......嗯......<BR><BR>

莱班：正是！不过要知道，我担心这是一项艰巨、辛苦、累人的工程。会耗尽我们所有的......意志和精力。<BR><BR>
雷克：嗯，说得对。但也很有挑战性，嗯？会占用我们所有时间 -- 不过没关系，我们的冒险者朋友出去搬运货物的时候，我们会有时间的。<BR><BR>

莱班：那就说定了。我们后天开始？<BR><BR>

冒险者：当然，留着吧，我有一份副本。你会在那尊丑雕像那里递给我一个小袋子？<BR><BR>
雷克：都给你准备好 -- 十点整？哦，莱班，关于年轻的斯特特我又有个想法。他确实需要一些......野外实践训练，可以这么说......？<BR><BR>
莱班：嗯。说得好......我知道！负责野外任务分派的祭司明天会来。我们可以为斯特特安排一个......教育性的......任务？<BR><BR>
雷克：很好！但是在哪里......嗯......冬天快到了。据我所知，独孤城有个空缺，在天际最北边。街角夜间收款，或者类似的。很好！走吧，莱班。我们有账目要处理。那么晚安了，冒险者。明早十点！（莱班、雷克起身离开，拖起斯特特）<BR><BR>
