Harald's War and the end of the Dragon Cult<BR>
<BR> 
At the same time as the Dragon Cult's apocalyptic preachings were taking hold amongst the lower classes, the brutal wars of the Nordic kingdoms -- both against the Falmer and amongst each other -- were reaching their own height. A cunning Nordic king and descendant of Ysgramor named Harald Hand-Free was uniting the fractured holds under his banner, through both conquest and iron-willed diplomacy, until he was able to properly take the war against Falmer and begin pushing them out of Skyrim. However, as his campaign gained momentum, a series of Cult-inspired rebellions broke out and he was forced to return home and put them down.<BR>
<BR>
From this point on, Harald was always fighting a war on two fronts: one against the remaining Falmer tribes, and one against his own people. The fighting devastated the still-incipient Nordic kingdoms, but the king was able to cling to power and with great brutality reclaimed Skyrim inch by bloody inch. A very plausible legend states that holdouts in a great temple of the Dragon Cult were the last resistance Harald faced, and it was upon their bloodied altar that he declared the first Empire of the Nords (before tearing the entire structure down, brick by brick).<BR>
<BR>
Although their original apocalyptic beliefs have experienced occasional resurgences through the millennia (most notably during the ominous portents of the Year of Winter in Summer in 1E668), the Dragon Cult were thoroughly crushed and reformed by King Harald. He recognised the important role the Cult played in the daily life of common Nords, and rather than ban it outright he brought the veneration of Alduin within the (admittedly loose) religious framework of Nordic kingdoms.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
History of the Fighter's Guild<BR>
First Edition<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
In the 283rd year of the 2nd Era, Potentate Versidue-Shaie was faced with a disintegrating empire. The vassal kingdoms throughout Tamriel had reached a new height of rebellion, openly challenging his rule. They refused his taxes and led sorties against the Imperial garrisons throughout the land. At the destruction of his fortress in Dawnstar, he gathered the Imperial Council in what would be called the Council of Bardmont, after the town south of Dawnstar where they met. There the Potentate declared catholic and universal martial law. The princes of Tamriel would dissolve their armies or face his wrath.<BR>
<BR>
The next thirty-seven years were perhaps the bloodiest in the violent history of Tamriel.<BR>
<BR>
In order to crush the last of the royal armies, Versidae-Shaie had to sacrifice many of his best legions, as well as spend nearly every last piece of gold in the Imperial treasury. But he accomplished the unthinkable. For the first time in history, there was but one army in the land, and it was his own.<BR>
<BR>
The problems that immediately surfaced were almost as staggering as the triumph itself. The Potentate had impoverished the land by his war, for the vanquished kingdoms had also spent the last of their gold in defense. Farmers and merchants alike had their livelihood ruined. Before the princes of Tamriel would not pay his taxes - now, they could not.<BR>
<BR>
The only persons who benefited from the war were criminals, who preyed upon the ruins of the lawless land, without fear of arrest now that all the local guards and militia were gone. It was a crisis the Akavir had seen coming long before he destroyed the last of his subjects' armies, but for which he had no solution. He could not allow his vassals their own armies again, but the land was deeper into the stew of anarchy that it had ever been before. His army sought to fight the rise of crime, but a central authority was no threat against the local underworld.<BR>
<BR>
In the dawn of the year 320, a kinsman of Versidae-Shaie, Dinieras-Ves "the Iron", presented himself with a host of companions before the Potentate. It was he who suggested an order of mercantile warriors-for-hire, who could be hired by nobility in lieu of a standing army. The employment would be temporary, and a percentage of the fee would go to the Potentate's government, thus putting salve on two of Versidae-Shaie's greatest pains.<BR>
<BR>
Though it was then called The Syffim, after the Tsaesci word for 'soldiers,' the organization that was to be known as the Fighters Guild had been born.<BR>
<BR>
Dinieras-Ves "the Iron" initially believed that the entirety of the order should be composed of Akaviri. This belief of his is not disputed by any historian, though his motivation is often debated. The traditional, simple explanation is that he knew his countrymen well, trusted them, and felt that their tradition of fighting for profit would be of use. Others believe, with reason, that he and the Potentate sought to use the order to effectively complete the conquest of Tamriel begun over five hundred years earlier. When Akavir attacked Tamriel in the 2703rd year of the 1st era, they had been beaten back by the Reman Dynasty. Now they had a Potentate on the throne, and with Dinieras-Ves's machinations, the local armies would also be Akaviri. What they had failed to do by combat, they would have successfully accomplished by patience. A traditional strategem, many scholars suggest, of the immortal snake men, the Tsaesci of Akavir, who always had time on their side.<BR>
<BR>
The point, however, is largely academic. Though the Syffim did establish themselves in some kingdoms neighboring Cyrodiil, it became quickly apparent that local warriors were needed. Part of the problem was simply that there were not enough Akaviri for the work that needed to be done. Another part was that the snake men did not understand the geography and politics of the regions they were assigned.<BR>
<BR>
It was evident that some non-Akaviri were needed in the Syffim, and by the mid point of the year, three Nords, a warrior-sorceress, a rogue, and a knight were admitted into the order.<BR>
<BR>
The knight, whose name has been lost in the sands of time, was also a great armorer, and probably did more to strengthen the organization than anyone but Dinieras-Ves himself. As has often been stated, the Akaviri, particularly the Tsaesci, understood weaponry better than armor. Even if they could not wear it themselves, the knight was able to explain to the other Syffim what the weaknesses were in their opponent's armor, explaining to them how many joints there were in a pauldon and a grieve, and the differences between Aketons and Armkachens, Gorgets and Gliedshrims, Palettes and Pasguards, Tabards and Tassettes.<BR>
<BR>
With this knowledge, they made long strides in defeating the brigands, doing far better than their meager numbers would suggest. It is a joke among historians that if Akavir had a Nord armorer in their employ in the first era, they would have won the invasion.<BR>
<BR>
The success of these first three outsiders to the Syffim opened the door for more local members. Before the year was through, Dinieras-Ves had spread his business throughout the Empire. Young men and women, for a variety of reasons - because of desperate poverty, for love of action and adventure, in order to aid their crime-stricken neighbors - joined his new order en masse. They received training, and were immediately put to work helping the aristocracy's problems, assuming the roles of guards and soldiers within their locality.<BR>
<BR>
The early success of the Syffim in combating crime and defeating local monsters so inspired Potentate Versidae-Shaie that he entertained representatives from other organizations interested in Imperial sanction. Though formed much earlier, the Mages Guild had always been viewed with suspicion by the government. In the 321st year of the 2nd Era, the Potentate gave his approval to the Guilds Act, officially sanctioning the Mages, together with the Guilds of Tinkers, Cobblers, Prostitutes, Scribes, Architects, Brewers, Vintners, Weavers, Ratcatchers, Furriers, Cooks, Astrologers, Healers, Tailors, Minstrals, Barristers, and the Syffim. In the charter, they were no longer called the Syffim, however: bowing to the name it had become known as by the people, they were to be called the Fighters Guild. All the Guilds, and those that followed by later sanctions throughout the second and third eras, would be protected and encouraged by the Empire of Cyrodiil, recognizing their value to the people of Tamriel. All would be required to pay to expand their influence throughout the land. The Empire was strengthened by their presence, and the Imperial coffers were filled once again.<BR>
<BR>
Shortly after Versidae-Shaie's death, only three years after the Guild Act, his heir Savirien-Chorak allowed the reforming of local armies. The Fighters Guild was no longer the principal arm of the local aristocracy, but their worth had already been established. Though there were certainly strong individuals who sought their own fortunes in the past, many historians have suggested that Dinieras-Ves was the ancestor in spirit of the modern phenomenon of the Adventurer, those men and women who dedicate their lives to questing for fame and fortune.<BR>
<BR>
Thus, all owe a debt of gratitude to the Fighters Guild -- not only its members, and the people who have been helped by its neutral policy of offering strong arms for a fee within the boundaries of the law. Without them, there would be no guilds of any kind, and it may be argued, no model for even the independent Adventurer.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
战士公会历史<BR>
第一版<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
第二纪元283年，摄政王维西杜-沙耶面临着一个分崩离析的帝国。整个泰姆瑞尔的附属王国将叛乱推向了新的高度，公然挑战他的统治。他们拒绝纳税，并出兵袭击帝国在全境的驻军。当他在晨星的堡垒被摧毁时，他召集了帝国议会，会议地点在晨星以南的巴德蒙特镇，因此这次会议被称为巴德蒙特议会。会上，摄政王宣布了普遍性的全面军事管制。泰姆瑞尔的各位亲王必须解散军队，否则将面临他的怒火。<BR>
<BR>
接下来的三十七年，或许是泰姆瑞尔暴力历史上最血腥的时期。<BR>
<BR>
为了粉碎最后的王室军队，维西杜-沙耶不得不牺牲许多他最精锐的军团，也几乎花光了帝国国库中的每一枚金币。但他完成了不可思议的壮举。历史上第一次，这片土地上只有一支军队，那就是他自己的军队。<BR>
<BR>
随之而来的问题几乎和胜利本身一样令人震惊。摄政王通过战争使这片土地变得贫瘠，因为被征服的王国也将最后的黄金用于防御。农民和商人的生计都被摧毁了。以前泰姆瑞尔的亲王们是不愿交税 -- 现在，他们是想交也交不出了。<BR>
<BR>
唯一从战争中获益的人是罪犯，他们在这片无法无天的废墟上趁火打劫，由于所有地方守卫和民兵都已不复存在，他们不再害怕被捕。这是一场阿卡维尔人早在摧毁其臣民最后一支军队之前就已预见到的危机，但他对此束手无策。他不能再允许他的附庸拥有自己的军队，但这片土地却陷入了前所未有的无政府状态。他的军队试图打击日益猖獗的犯罪活动，但中央政权对地方黑社会并不构成威胁。<BR>
<BR>
在320年之初，维西杜-沙耶的一位亲属，“铁者”迪涅拉斯-维斯带领一众同伴出现在摄政王面前。正是他提议建立一个商业性的雇佣战士组织，贵族可以雇佣他们来代替常备军。雇佣是临时性的，并且一部分雇佣金将上缴给摄政王政府，从而缓解了维西杜-沙耶的两大痛点。<BR>
<BR>
尽管当时它被称为“西菲姆”（源自赛埃锡语中“士兵”一词），这个日后被称为战士公会的组织就此诞生了。<BR>
<BR>
“铁者”迪涅拉斯-维斯最初认为，整个组织应该由阿卡维尔人组成。他的这一观点没有受到任何历史学家的质疑，尽管他的动机常被争论。传统上简单的解释是，他非常了解自己的同胞，信任他们，并认为他们为利润而战的传统会派上用场。其他人则有理由地认为，他和摄政王试图利用这个组织来有效地完成五百多年前开始的征服泰姆瑞尔的事业。当阿卡维尔在第一纪元2703年进攻泰姆瑞尔时，他们被雷曼王朝击退。现在他们有一位摄政王在皇位上，而通过迪涅拉斯-维斯的谋划，地方军队也将是阿卡维尔人。他们在战斗中未能做到的事，将通过耐心来完成。许多学者认为，这是一种古老的策略，出自阿卡维尔的不朽蛇人 -- 赛埃锡，时间总是在他们那一边。<BR>
<BR>
然而，这一点在很大程度上只是学术争论。尽管西菲姆确实在邻近西罗帝尔的一些王国立足，但很快便发现需要本地战士。部分问题仅仅是阿卡维尔人数量不足以完成所需的工作。另一部分原因是这些蛇人不了解他们所派驻地区的地理和政治。<BR>
<BR>
很明显，西菲姆中需要一些非阿卡维尔人，于是在该年中期，三名诺德人、一位战士女巫、一名游荡者和一位骑士被接纳入了该组织。<BR>
<BR>
这位骑士的名字已湮没在时间的长河中，他也是一位伟大的盔甲匠。或许除了迪涅拉斯-维斯本人之外，他为巩固这个组织所做的贡献比任何人都多。正如人们常说的，阿卡维尔人，尤其是赛埃锡人，对武器的了解比对盔甲更深。即使他们自己不能穿戴盔甲，这位骑士还是能够向西菲姆的其他成员解释对手盔甲的弱点，向他们讲解护肩和护胫有多少关节，以及武装衣与臂铠、护喉甲与护颈甲、肩甲与护侧甲、战袍与腿甲之间的区别。<BR>
<BR>
凭借这些知识，他们在击败匪徒方面取得了长足的进步，其表现远远超出了他们可怜的人数所给人的预期。历史学家中流传着一个笑话：如果阿卡维尔在第一纪元雇佣了一位诺德盔甲匠，他们早就赢得了入侵。<BR>
<BR>
首批进入西菲姆的三名外人的成功，为更多本地成员敞开了大门。在这一年结束之前，迪涅拉斯-维斯已将自己的业务扩展到了整个帝国。年轻的男女们，出于各种原因 -- 因极度贫困、热爱行动与冒险、为了帮助受犯罪困扰的邻里 -- 纷纷加入了他的新组织。他们接受训练，然后立刻被派去帮助解决贵族们的问题，在地方上承担起守卫和士兵的角色。<BR>
<BR>
西菲姆在打击犯罪和击败地方怪物方面的早期成功极大地激励了摄政王维西杜-沙耶，以至于他接见了其他有意获得帝国认可之组织的代表。尽管成立得更早，但法师公会一直受到政府的怀疑。在第二纪元321年，摄政王批准了《公会法案》，正式认可了法师公会，以及修补匠、鞋匠、娼妓、抄写员、建筑师、酿酒师、葡萄酒商、织工、捕鼠者、毛皮商、厨师、占星师、治疗师、裁缝、吟游诗人、律师等行业公会，还有西菲姆。然而，在特许状中，他们不再被称为西菲姆：顺应民间对其的称呼，他们被命名为战士公会。所有的公会，以及此后在第二和第三纪元获得认可的公会，都因西罗帝尔帝国认识到它们对泰姆瑞尔人民的价值而受到保护和鼓励。所有这些公会都被要求出资以将其影响力扩展到全境。帝国的统治因它们的存在而得到加强，帝国国库也再次丰盈。<BR>
<BR>
在《公会法案》颁布仅三年后，维西杜-沙耶去世不久，他的继承人萨维里恩-乔拉科便允许地方军队重组。战士公会不再是地方贵族的主要武装力量，但其价值早已确立。尽管过去固然有强者独自闯荡、追寻财富，但许多历史学家认为，迪涅拉斯-维斯是现代“冒险者”现象的精神先驱 -- 那些献身于追寻名望与财富的男女们。<BR>
<BR>
因此，所有人都应对战士公会心存感激 -- 不仅是其成员，以及那些受惠于其“在法律范围内有偿提供武力”这一中立政策的人们。没有他们，就不会有任何种类的公会，甚至可以说不存在独立冒险者的榜样。<BR>
<BR>"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
A Short History of Karthwasten<BR>
Nerus Lalrav, Steward of Kyne-blessed Jarl Jona of Dragonstar<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Travelling up the road to Karthwasten, the former capital of the Redguard Reach, you can see the layers upon layers of past battles display themselves before you.  <BR>
<BR>
Evidence of initial settlement in the area around Karthwasten seems to date back to the late Merethic as a farming settlement built by one of the early Aldmeri families of High Rock, whose name has been lost to the pages of history. During the expansion years of King Vrage, the town was absorbed into the newly established hold of the Reach. Dubbed Karthwasten, after the river Karth that it lays abreast to, the settlement grew as a flood of Nordic colonists intermingled with the original proto-Breton farmers. For centuries, Karthwasten would prove itself time and again as an important fortified town against the original Nedic tribes of Hammerfell, the Rourken Dwemer, and eventually the warrior wave of the Yokudans.  <BR>
<BR>
During the War of the Red Diamond, the King of the Reach (who at that time had his seat in the city of Karthwasten) entered a military alliance with the Queen Potema of Solitude. Weakened by the conflict, the county was overrun, sacked and annexed by Dragonstar forces in 3E 136. Despite requests and petitions by the King of the Reach, compensation was not granted as "punishment for the Hold's treason against the Ruby Throne was justified". Over the next few hundred years, the city would be rebuilt, taking on the cultural motifs from the many cultures of the Reach, though predominately Yokudan.  <BR>
<BR>
However, as any citizen of the empire knows, the people of the Old Kingdom do not take theft lightly. In the year 396 of the Third Era, the War of the Bend'r-Makh engulfed the Reach in fire. Despite early successes at the battles of Julfnar's Cowardice and Purewater Run, the Nordic vanguard of the combined forces of King Vyrnod of the Reach and King Eyrfin of Haafingar completely routed Breton-Redguard forces at the Second Battle of Dragonstar. As part of the Treaty of Chorrol, the city of Karthwasten was incorporated the Nordic Kingdom of the Reach. It would be governed by a hero of the battle, now Jarl Jona the Ansei-Ender, who would later move her seat of power to Dragonstar itself in 3E 424.<BR>
<BR>
With the return of the Nords, crime has decreased, quality of life has improved, and trade has flourished, with only minor unrest in the poor quarter, where most of the original Redguard inhabitants have been relocated. It is believed by many, including yours truly, that the best days of the city of Karthwasten are ahead of her.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
卡斯瓦斯滕简史<BR>
奈鲁斯·拉尔拉夫，受吉讷祝福的龙星领主约娜的管事<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
沿着通往卡斯瓦斯滕（红卫河峪的前首府）的道路上行，你能看到层层叠叠的过往战斗在你眼前铺陈开来。<BR>
<BR>
卡斯瓦斯滕地区最早的定居证据似乎可以追溯到精灵纪元晚期，它是一个由高岩早期奥德莫家族之一的成员建立的农耕定居点，该家族的名字已湮没于史册。在弗拉格国王的扩张年间，这个城镇被并入了新建立的河峪领地。该定居点因其毗邻卡斯河而得名“卡斯瓦斯滕”，随着大批诺德殖民者与当地的原布莱顿农民融合，这里逐渐发展壮大。数个世纪以来，卡斯瓦斯滕一再证明了自己是一座重镇，抵御了落锤的原尼德部落、鲁尔肯锻莫，以及最终的尤库达人战士浪潮。<BR>
<BR>
在红钻战争期间，河峪国王（当时他的都城设在卡斯瓦斯滕）与独孤城女王波特玛结成了军事同盟。因战争而衰弱，该郡在第三纪元136年被龙星军队侵占、洗劫并吞并。尽管河峪国王多次请求和申诉，但补偿并未被批准，理由是“领地因背叛红钻王座而受到惩罚是正当的”。在接下来的几百年里，这座城市得以重建，吸收了河峪多种文化的元素，但以尤库达文化为主。<BR>
<BR>
然而，正如帝国的每一个公民所知，旧王国的人民不会轻视偷窃。在第三纪元396年，本德'尔-马克之战使河峪陷入了战火。尽管在尤尔夫纳之怯和净水奔跑战役中取得了初步胜利，但由河峪国王维尔诺德和哈芬加国王艾尔芬联合指挥的诺德先锋部队，在第二次龙星战役中彻底击溃了布莱顿-红卫联军。根据科洛尔条约，卡斯瓦斯滕城被并入诺德的河峪王国。该城将由一位战斗英雄 -- 现在的“终结安塞者”领主约娜统治，她后来在第三纪元424年将权力中心迁至龙星城本身。<BR>
<BR>
随着诺德人的回归，犯罪率下降，生活质量提高，贸易繁荣，仅在贫民区（大多数原红卫居民被重新安置于此）有轻微的不满。包括笔者在内的许多人都相信，卡斯瓦斯滕城最美好的日子还在前方。<BR>
<BR>"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>Introduction to the Cult of the Ancestor Moth<BR>

<BR>

---<BR>

<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>

Promulgated under the Authority of the Imperial Geographical Society<BR>

<BR>

... For long the Cyro-Nordics had exported ancestor-silks to other regions, simple yet exotic shawls woven from the silks of an indigenous gypsy moth and inscribed with the requisite genealogy of its buyer. Under the Cult, however, ancestor and moth became synonymous: the singing and hymnal spirits of one's forebears are caught in a special silk-gathering ritual, the resource of which is used to create any manner of vestment or costume. The swishing of this material during normal movement reproduces the resplendent ancestral chorus contained therein-it quickly became a sacred custom among the early Nibenese, which has persisted to the present day. Monks of the higher orders of the Cult of the Ancestor-Moth are able to forego the magical ritual needed to enchant this fabric, and, indeed, prefer instead to wear the moths about the neck and face. They are able to attract the ancestor-moths through the application of finely ground bark-dust gathered from the gypsy moth's favorite tree, and through the sub-vocalization of certain mantras. They must chant the mantras constantly to maintain skin contact with the ancestor-moths, a discipline that they endure for the sake of some cosmic balance. When a monk interrupts these mantras, in conversation for example, the moths burst from him in glorious fashion every time he speaks, only to light back upon his skin when he resumes the inaudible chant.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>先祖蛾教团简介<BR>

<BR>

<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>

帝国地理学会授权发布<BR>

......长久以来，西罗-诺德人一直向其他地区出口祖先丝绸，这些丝绸是用一种本地舞毒蛾的丝织成的朴素却别致的披肩，上面绣着购买者所需的谱系。然而，在教团中，祖先和蛾子变成了同义词：祖先那歌唱般的精灵通过一种特殊的采丝仪式被捕捉，其产物用于制作各种服饰或服装。这种材料在正常活动中摆动时，会重现其中包含的辉煌的祖先合唱 -- 这很快成为了早期尼本奈人的神圣习俗，并延续至今。高阶的先祖蛾教团僧侣能够省去给这种布料附魔所需的魔法仪式，事实上，他们更愿意直接让蛾子停在自己的脖子和脸上。他们通过涂抹一种取自舞毒蛾最喜爱树木的精细树皮粉末，以及默诵特定的咒语，来吸引先祖蛾。他们必须持续默诵咒语以保持皮肤与先祖蛾的接触，为了某种宇宙平衡而忍受这种修行。当僧侣中断默诵（例如与人交谈）时，每当他开口说话，蛾子便会华丽地四散飞离，而当他恢复那无声的吟诵时，蛾子又会重新落回他的皮肤上。<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
History of Daggerfall<BR>
By Odiva Gallwood<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
There is sufficient archaeological evidence for the modern historian to believe that there has been some variety of human settlement in the city-state of Daggerfall starting at least a thousand years before recorded history. The first use of the name Daggerfall to refer to the area around the current capitol was most probably in the 246th year of the 1st Era. The north half of the Iliac Bay, in fact all of the current province of High Rock, was conquered by invading Nords who brought a rough sort of civilization with them. One of the first civilized acts the Nords performed was a census -- the so-called Book of Life. Listed on page 933 of the Book is this entry:<BR><BR>
"North of the Highest bluffs, south of the moors, west of the hills, and east of the sea is called DAGGERFALL. 110 men, 93 women, 13 children under 8 years of age, 58 cows, 7 bulls, 63 chickens, 11 cocks, 38 hogs live here."<BR><BR>
Nearly four thousand years after this census was taken, we can see that these two hundred and sixteen people have multiplied heartily. The last census, in the year 3E 401, lists the population at over 110,000. It is always difficult to find an exact number, but the capitol city of Daggerfall certainly outnumbers her rivals, Sentinel and Wayrest.<BR><BR>
It has been a consistent, if not actually helpful amusement of historians to find the origin of placenames. Daggerfall, by tradition, is said to refer to the knife the first chieftain threw to form the borders of his lands. But there are other legends that may have equal validity.<BR><BR>
The Daggerfall entry from the Book of Life actually supports one theory about the reason for Daggerfall's longevity. The people were coastal fishermen, but they also found the land itself sufficiently rich to support raising livestock. This inclination of the early citizenry toward reinforcing their principal products brought stability to a fickle land.<BR><BR>
Daggerfall thrived during the years of the Skyrim occupancy. When the Wild Hunt killed King Borgas of Winterhold in 1E 369, the northlands engaged in the War of Succession and Skyrim, greatly weakened, lost her holdings in High Rock and Morrowind. The Iliac Bay had become important strategically, and Daggerfall began to expand her military.<BR><BR>
There were multiple opportunities for her to exercise this army and navy during the Direnni conflicts with the force of the Alessian Reform. The Dirennis were native Bretons, and Bretons are hardly ever given to excessive religion. Daggerfall became a minor base of operations for the Dirennis and their allies. Raven Direnni, the enchantress whose magic helped secure the final victory over the Alessians in the Glenumbria Moors, was one of the earliest occupants of Castle Daggerfall.<BR><BR>
Over the centuries that followed, the Dirennis felt into obscurity, but Daggerfall continued her growth. In 1E 609, King Thagore of Daggerfall defeated the army of Glenpoint and became the preeminant economic, cultural, and military force in southern High Rock. A position the kingdom has precariously kept ever since.<BR><BR>
Ironically, it was another successful military exercise three hundred and seventy years later that ended Daggerfall's monopoly of Bay trade: the annihilation of the orcish capitol Orsinium by a joint effort of Daggerfall, the new kingdom of Sentinel, and the now extinct Order of Diagna. The scattering of the orcs from southeastern High Rock made the river route to the Bay more accessible. The tiny village of Wayrest grew like a flower that no longer feared the mow. In twenty years, Wayrest's trade profits equaled Daggerfall's. In forty years, Wayrest was the acknowledged master of Iliac Bay trade. In one hundred and twenty years, Wayrest became the Kingdom of Wayrest.<BR><BR>
The Kingdom of Sentinel did not exhibit Wayrest's aggrandizement during the First Era. The Redguards were warriors learning the ways of the merchants, and their land was enemy enough to keep their population checked. Indeed, the number of people in all areas of the Iliac Bay was halved once in the First Era by the Thrassian Plague, once again by the War of Righteousness, and a third time by the invading Akaviri. If Daggerfall had not spent its first thousand years preparing for the battles of the next thousand years, it is indeed conceivable that the Iliac Bay today might be Akavarian.<BR><BR>
The Second Era, like the latter part of the First Era, is a tapestry of wars, insurrections, and plagues. Daggerfall, Sentinel, and Wayrest continued to expand and improve their military and economic positions in the Bay. Daggerfall and Wayrest would transpose positions as major trading center of the Bay, and Daggerfall and Sentinel likewise bandied over which was the superior military power.<BR><BR>
The Iliac Bay has continued to hold an important position in the Imperial government of the Third Era. Rarely allies (though the combined armies in opposition to the Camoran Usurper in the 3rd century of the 3rd Era is a notable exception), but not always enemies, Daggerfall, Sentinel, and Wayrest have weathered the storms of contention, plague, famine, and pestilence. The recent War of Betony was typical of Iliac Bay warfare: sincere, frighteningly violent, and peaceably resolved.<BR>"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
匕落历史<BR>
奥迪瓦·高尔伍德 著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
现代历史学家有充分的考古证据相信，至少在信史开始前一千多年，匕落城邦地区就已经存在着某种人类定居点。用“匕落”这个名字来指代当前首都周边的地区，最早的记载很可能是在第一纪元246年。髂骨湾的北半部，事实上是整个现在的高岩行省，被入侵的诺德人征服，他们带来了一种粗犷的文明。诺德人最早进行的文明行为之一就是人口普查 -- 即所谓的《生命之书》。该书的第933页记载如下：<BR><BR>
“在最高峭壁以北、荒野以南、山丘以西、大海以东的地方称为匕落。此地居住着110名男人、93名女人、13名八岁以下儿童、58头母牛、7头公牛、63只母鸡、11只公鸡、38头猪。”<BR><BR>
在这次人口普查近四千年后，我们可以看到这二百一十六人已经繁衍壮大。最近一次人口普查在第三纪元401年，记载的人口超过十一万。虽然很难得出确切数字，但匕落首府的人口无疑超过了其竞争对手哨卫和途歇。<BR><BR>
探寻地名的起源一直是历史学家们持续的乐趣（尽管实际上并无太大帮助）。根据传统，匕落这个名字指的是第一位酋长为划定其领地边界而投出的匕首。但也有其他传说可能具有同等的可信度。<BR><BR>
《生命之书》中关于匕落的条目实际上支持了一种关于匕落长寿原因的理论。那些人是沿海渔民，但他们也发现这片土地本身足够肥沃，可以支持饲养牲畜。早期市民这种强化主要产品的倾向，为这片多变之地带来了稳定。<BR><BR>
匕落在天际占领时期蓬勃发展。当狂猎在第一纪元369年杀死冬堡国王博尔加斯后，北方诸地陷入了继承战争，天际元气大伤，失去了其在晨风和高岩的领地。髂骨湾在战略上变得重要起来，匕落开始扩充其军事力量。<BR><BR>
在迪伦尼人与阿莱西亚改革势力的冲突期间，匕落有多次机会运用其陆军和海军。迪伦尼人是本地的布莱顿人，而布莱顿人几乎从不沉溺于过度的宗教。匕落成为了迪伦尼人及其盟友的一个次要行动基地。女巫拉文·迪伦尼，其魔法帮助确保了在谷影沼泽对阿莱西亚人的最终胜利，她也是匕落城堡最早的居住者之一。<BR><BR>
在随后的几个世纪里，迪伦尼家族逐渐衰落，但匕落继续发展壮大。在第一纪元609年，匕落国王萨戈尔击败了格伦角的军队，成为高岩南部卓越的经济、文化和军事力量。此后的匕落王国一直艰难地维持着这一地位。<BR><BR>
具有讽刺意味的是，正是三百七十年后的又一次成功的军事行动终结了匕落对海湾贸易的垄断：匕落、新生的哨卫王国以及现已消失的迪亚戈纳骑士团联合行动，摧毁了兽人首都奥辛纽姆。兽人从高岩东南部四散逃离，使得通往海湾的河道更加通畅。途歇这个小村庄像一朵不再畏惧被割刈的花一样生长起来。二十年后，途歇的贸易利润与匕落相当。四十年后，途歇被公认为髂骨湾贸易的主宰。一百二十年后，途歇成为了途歇王国。<BR><BR>
哨卫王国在第一纪元并未表现出途歇那样的扩张野心。红卫人是正在学习经商之道的战士，而他们的土地本身就有足够的敌人来遏制人口增长。事实上，髂骨湾所有地区的人口在第一纪元因瑟拉斯瘟疫减少了一半，又因正义战争再次减半，第三次因阿卡维尔入侵者而减半。如果不是匕落在第一个千年里为下一个千年的战斗做准备，可以想象，今天的髂骨湾可能已经是阿卡维尔人的天下。<BR><BR>
第二纪元，如同第一纪元后期一样，是一幅由战争、叛乱和瘟疫编织而成的图卷。匕落、哨卫和途歇继续在海湾地区扩张并改善它们的军事和经济地位。匕落和途歇交替成为海湾的主要贸易中心，而匕落和哨卫也同样争论着谁的军事实力更强。<BR><BR>
髂骨湾在第三帝国的政府中继续占据重要地位。匕落、哨卫和途歇很少结盟（尽管第三纪元三世纪联合对抗篡位者卡莫兰的联军是一个显著的例外），但也并非总是敌人，它们经受住了纷争、瘟疫、饥荒和灾祸的考验。最近的贝托尼战争是典型的髂骨湾式战争：真刀真枪、恐怖暴力、并且最终和平解决。<BR>"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
History of Daggerfall<BR>
By Odiva Gallwood<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
There is sufficient archaeological evidence for the modern historian to believe that there has been some variety of human settlement in the city-state of Daggerfall starting at least a thousand years before recorded history. The first use of the name Daggerfall to refer to the area around the current capitol was most probably in the 246th year of the 1st Era. The north half of the Iliac Bay, in fact all of the current province of High Rock, was conquered by invading Nords who brought a rough sort of civilization with them. One of the first civilized acts the Nords performed was a census -- the so-called Book of Life. Listed on page 933 of the Book is this entry:<BR><BR>
"North of the Highest bluffs, south of the moors, west of the hills, and east of the sea is called DAGGERFALL. 110 men, 93 women, 13 children under 8 years of age, 58 cows, 7 bulls, 63 chickens, 11 cocks, 38 hogs live here."<BR><BR>
Nearly four thousand years after this census was taken, we can see that these two hundred and sixteen people have multiplied heartily. The last census, in the year 3E 401, lists the population at over 110,000. It is always difficult to find an exact number, but the capitol city of Daggerfall certainly outnumbers her rivals, Sentinel and Wayrest.<BR><BR>
It has been a consistent, if not actually helpful amusement of historians to find the origin of placenames. Daggerfall, by tradition, is said to refer to the knife the first chieftain threw to form the borders of his lands. But there are other legends that may have equal validity.<BR><BR>
The Daggerfall entry from the Book of Life actually supports one theory about the reason for Daggerfall's longevity. The people were coastal fishermen, but they also found the land itself sufficiently rich to support raising livestock. This inclination of the early citizenry toward reinforcing their principal products brought stability to a fickle land.<BR><BR>
Daggerfall thrived during the years of the Skyrim occupancy. When the Wild Hunt killed King Borgas of Winterhold in 1E 369, the northlands engaged in the War of Succession and Skyrim, greatly weakened, lost her holdings in High Rock and Morrowind. The Iliac Bay had become important strategically, and Daggerfall began to expand her military.<BR><BR>
There were multiple opportunities for her to exercise this army and navy during the Direnni conflicts with the force of the Alessian Reform. The Dirennis were native Bretons, and Bretons are hardly ever given to excessive religion. Daggerfall became a minor base of operations for the Dirennis and their allies. Raven Direnni, the enchantress whose magic helped secure the final victory over the Alessians in the Glenumbria Moors, was one of the earliest occupants of Castle Daggerfall.<BR><BR>
Over the centuries that followed, the Dirennis felt into obscurity, but Daggerfall continued her growth. In 1E 609, King Thagore of Daggerfall defeated the army of Glenpoint and became the preeminant economic, cultural, and military force in southern High Rock. A position the kingdom has precariously kept ever since.<BR><BR>
Ironically, it was another successful military exercise three hundred and seventy years later that ended Daggerfall's monopoly of Bay trade: the annihilation of the orcish capitol Orsinium by a joint effort of Daggerfall, the new kingdom of Sentinel, and the now extinct Order of Diagna. The scattering of the orcs from southeastern High Rock made the river route to the Bay more accessible. The tiny village of Wayrest grew like a flower that no longer feared the mow. In twenty years, Wayrest's trade profits equaled Daggerfall's. In forty years, Wayrest was the acknowledged master of Iliac Bay trade. In one hundred and twenty years, Wayrest became the Kingdom of Wayrest.<BR><BR>
The Kingdom of Sentinel did not exhibit Wayrest's aggrandizement during the First Era. The Redguards were warriors learning the ways of the merchants, and their land was enemy enough to keep their population checked. Indeed, the number of people in all areas of the Iliac Bay was halved once in the First Era by the Thrassian Plague, once again by the War of Righteousness, and a third time by the invading Akaviri. If Daggerfall had not spent its first thousand years preparing for the battles of the next thousand years, it is indeed conceivable that the Iliac Bay today might be Akavarian.<BR><BR>
The Second Era, like the latter part of the First Era, is a tapestry of wars, insurrections, and plagues. Daggerfall, Sentinel, and Wayrest continued to expand and improve their military and economic positions in the Bay. Daggerfall and Wayrest would transpose positions as major trading center of the Bay, and Daggerfall and Sentinel likewise bandied over which was the superior military power.<BR><BR>
The Iliac Bay has continued to hold an important position in the Imperial government of the Third Era. Rarely allies (though the combined armies in opposition to the Camoran Usurper in the 3rd century of the 3rd Era is a notable exception), but not always enemies, Daggerfall, Sentinel, and Wayrest have weathered the storms of contention, plague, famine, and pestilence. The recent War of Betony was typical of Iliac Bay warfare: sincere, frighteningly violent, and peaceably resolved.<BR>"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="640F0F" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>The Ebon Heart of Morrowind: A History<BR>
<FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>by Qualia Tarvix<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
Although its early history is murky, mired in myth and native superstition, Imperial palaeognosticators date the founding of Ebonheart to very early in the First Era. Atop its rocky outcrop, commanding views over the surrounding land, it would have offered a natural defensive position then just as it does today. <BR>
 <BR>
Of its early inhabitants we know little. The city is first recorded as Khalaan, literally "Heart of Ebony", a probable reference to the missing god Shezarr who, unusually, was widely worshipped by the elves of this region. The ancient Nordic sagas mention a great temple or monastery dedicated to Shezarr somewhere directly south of Red Mountain and north of Mournhold, which I conjecturally associate with Khalaan- on the basis of admittedly scant evidence. <BR>
 <BR>
The debate raged for many centuries over which city was founded first- Ebonheart or Mournhold. The geography of Veloth's pilgrimage suggests it is the former that deserves the honor, although significant geological upheaval has occurred since this time which further muddies the metaphorical waters. Either way the two cities were equal rivals for a considerable period, a state of affairs that only came to an end with the emergence of the Tribunal faith and the adoption of Mournhold as the seat of the goddess Almalexia. The conjectured temple of Shezarr may also have vanished around this time, as there are vague references to a "massacre of monks" and a "razing of egregious sanctuaries". Unfortunately any religious purge was accompanied by an equally thorough cleansing of the historical record- I have seen clear evidence of ancient vandalism in documents describing these events. <BR>
 <BR>
Following a period of Nordic rule the city fell into the hands of the House Raathim, a once-powerful Dark Elf aristocratic family. They ruled the city for generations, perhaps growing powerful enough to rival the mighty philosopher-princes of House Indoril and the muck-magnates of House Hlaalu. The city continued to vie with Almalexia for local dominance, and even petitioned Sotha Sil to make his home in the city in order that they might compete with their neighbor on equal terms. The annals record that the god-sorcerer's only response was to silence Ebonheart entirely for a generation, so that no sound could be heard or uttered within its administrative boundaries. The city's inhabitants learned to communicate with looks and secret hand signals, which ultimately aided them in their covert struggles against their neighbours. The silent language of Ebonheart is still used to this day by Dark Elf agents and con artists. <BR>
 <BR>
Despite these upsets the Raathim period was relatively stable, although it was disrupted by the campaign of Tiber Septim. Ebonheart surrendered to Imperial forces but was tragically burned to the ground by religious fanatics. With the signing of the armistice the ruling Raathim were released from captivity and restored to their position, and began a rebuilding program. History reports that the reigning lord of the time, Theranis Raathim, made such an impression on the Emperor with his prowess in friendly melee tournaments that Septim decided to make Ebonheart his new capital in the province. The city was rebuilt in the Colovian style and a great citadel was constructed, to control the route between Vivec and Almalexia's cities. <BR>
 <BR>
Thus was a new golden age ushered in. The city of Ebonheart became a model of Imperial civil government and town planning. Additional settlements including Firewatch and Helnim were constructed in imitation of Ebonheart's majesty. The Raathim line even gave rise to an Empress, the great Katariah who re-established trade links with far Yokuda. Although the city was never able to supplant Almalexia as was originally intended, it grew into one of the wealthiest and most peaceful settlements in all Morrowind. For a time its inhabitants proudly declared Ebonheart to be "The Empire's Second City". While those heady days are gone, and a "new" Ebonheart has been constructed on Vvardenfell, the city today still stands as a comforting beacon of civilization in a strange and sometimes hostile land. <BR>"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="640F0F" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>晨风的黑檀之心：一部历史<BR>
<FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>夸利亚·塔维克斯 著<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
尽管其早期历史模糊不清，深陷于神话和本土迷信之中，但帝国的古知学家将黑檀心的建立时间定在第一纪元早期。它坐落于岩石嶙峋的岬角之上，俯瞰着周围的土地，当时和现在一样，都是一个天然的防御要地。<BR>
<BR>
关于其早期居民，我们知之甚少。这座城市最初被记录为“卡拉安”，字面意思是“黑檀之心”，可能指的是失踪的神祇舍扎尔，不同寻常的是，他曾被该地区的精灵广泛崇拜。古老的诺德传说提到，在红山正南、哀伤之城以北的某处，有一座供奉舍扎尔的神庙或修道院，我推测那与“卡拉安”有关 -- 诚然，这一推断基于非常有限的证据。<BR>
<BR>
关于两座城市 -- 黑檀心和哀伤之城 -- 哪一个先建立，争论持续了许多个世纪。维洛斯朝圣的地理位置表明，前者更应获此殊荣，尽管此后发生了重大的地质变动，给本就模糊的问题增添了更多不确定性。无论如何，在相当长的一段时期内，这两座城市是势均力敌的对手，这种局面直到审判席信仰的出现以及哀伤之城被确立为女神阿玛莱西娅的所在地才告结束。推测中的舍扎尔神庙可能也在这一时期消失了，因为有一些模糊的记载提到“僧侣大屠杀”和“夷平亵渎圣所”。不幸的是，任何宗教清洗都伴随着同样彻底的历史记录清除 -- 我在描述这些事件的文件中看到了明显的古代破坏痕迹。<BR>
<BR>
在一段诺德人的统治之后，这座城市落入了拉西姆家族 -- 一个曾经强大的丹莫贵族家族 -- 的手中。他们世代统治这座城市，也许强大到足以与强大的因多瑞尔家族的哲人王子和哈拉鲁家族的商贾巨头抗衡。这座城市继续与哀伤之城争夺本地的主导权，甚至向索萨·希尔请愿，希望他能定居于此，以便他们能与邻城平等竞争。编年史记载，这位神法师的唯一回应是让黑檀心整整一代人陷入寂静，使其行政边界内听不到也说不出任何声音。该城的居民学会了用眼神和秘密的手势交流，这最终帮助他们在与邻居的秘密斗争中取得了优势。黑檀心的无声语言至今仍被丹莫的特工和骗子使用。<BR>
<BR>
尽管经历了这些动荡，拉西姆时期相对稳定，尽管泰伯·塞普汀的征战打断了这一局面。黑檀心向帝国部队投降，但不幸被宗教狂热分子纵火烧毁。随着停战协定的签署，统治家族拉西姆获释并复职，开始了重建计划。历史记载，当时的领主塞拉尼斯·拉西姆在友好的近战比武中以其精湛的技艺给皇帝留下了深刻印象，以至于塞普汀决定将黑檀心作为该行省的新首都。这座城市以科洛维亚风格重建，并修建了一座宏伟的要塞，以控制维威克城与阿玛莱西娅诸城之间的路线。<BR>
<BR>
于是，一个新的黄金时代开启了。黑檀心城成为了帝国文官政府和城市规划的典范。包括火望和赫尔尼姆在内的其他定居点也都是模仿黑檀心的宏伟而建。拉西姆家族甚至出了一位女皇 -- 伟大的卡塔瑞亚，她与遥远的尤库达重建了贸易联系。尽管这座城市从未能像最初设想的那样取代阿玛莱西娅的位置，但它已发展成为整个晨风最富有、最和平的定居点之一。曾经有一段时间，其居民自豪地宣称黑檀心是“帝国的第二城市”。虽然那些令人振奋的日子已经过去，而且在瓦登费尔岛上还建起了一个“新”黑檀心，但这座城市至今仍是这片陌生有时充满敌意的土地上一座令人安心的文明灯塔。<BR>"""

Firewatch: A History<BR>
by Savri Hlervu<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">
With the signing of the Treaty of the Armistice at the close of the Second Era, the new Morrowind Province was divided into administrative districts, to be ruled by nobles of ducal rank in the Imperial peerage. Initially, the Empire intended for  the new Telvannis District to be headquartered in a native city, as was done in Narsis and Mournhold. This plan quickly proved impractical. It was thus decided that Telvannis District would have a new capital, one built in the Imperial style to accommodate all the offices and infrastructure of empire. For the next two centuries, the dukes and duchesses of Firewatch rarely visited their seat, preferring instead the high halls and softer living of Ebonheart and Mournhold.<BR>
<BR>
Firewatch remained a meager fortress town until the 270s, when the war-Emperor Uriel V began to assemble his mighty Far East Fleet. Mercenaries, adventurers, traders, and camp followers alike swept into the city, eager for the chance to accompany the enormous force on its invasion of the Uttermost East. <BR>
The failure of the Akavir invasion itself, however, was felt nowhere more keenly than in Firewatch. The ships that limped home were a pale shadow of the once-mighty Fleet, and more despairing spouses found themselves new widows or widowers as each vessel made port. The jubilant atmosphere that had driven Firewatch's first bout of growth gave way to a sullen paranoia; it was commonly thought, in those days, that the Akaviri were sure to strike back at Tamriel as soon as they were able. The city's walls were strengthened and fortified to prepare Firewatch for just such an attack, and the mighty Chapel of the East Empire Everlasting was constructed in a fit of piety. The city's residents hoped that the grand temple, completed in 293, might appeal to the surety and rigid law of Akatosh in the face of this ubiquitous sense of doom.<BR>
<BR>

It was during this period of unease that Firewatch faced its first military test; not from Akavir, but from within Telvannis. A local lord of some renown named Turimal made war on the Empire's holdings in the northeast, armed with strange and terrible magics wielding Dwarven metal weapons. Though the soldiers of the Dustmoth Legion defeated the rebel lord again and again in the dust wastes and ashen mountains, the crafty Telvanni repeatedly escaped Imperial justice. Only when Turimal audaciously besieged Firewatch itself, in spring 306, was his insurrection quashed. The Dark Elf mage was executed, his constructs dismantled, and his prized staff - dubbed "Oathrung" by the victorious Legionnaires - seized to become Firewatch's crown jewel. The occasion came just before the three hundredth anniversary of the city's founding, an event celebrated with the dedication of the new knightly Order of Firewatch.<BR>
<BR>
By the reign of Empress Morihatha, it seemed that the long-feared counter-invasion from the east would never come. Akatosh, it seems, had seen fit to protect his faithful. Through the early decades of the fourth century, Firewatch once more became a destination; not for soldiers and sailors, but for archaeologists and academics. Turimal's defeat and the successive peaceful reigns of Morihatha and Pelagius IV brought new material prosperity, and with nearby roads once more safe to travel, the many forgotten ruins of the northeast became accessible for the first time to scholars. Recognizing the unique opportunity of her city's location, Duchess Bredami Vaynth chartered the College of Firewatch, an institution dedicated to the study of Morrowind's history, in 379. Over time, the College has expanded into more disciplines, and today attracts scholars of history, magic, and the philosophies from around Tamriel.<BR>
<BR>
The Imperial Simulacrum put a bloody end to these glad years. Attacked by forces of the traitor general Casik by sea, Firewatch only barely avoided a sack. Duchess Vaynth herself was slain in 397 defending the northern outpost of Nivalis, and while the Order briefly held power in the vacuum, the city's mercantile and academic institutions fell into decline. It was not until the restoration of the true Emperor and the appointment of Perulia Jandacia as Duchess in 400 that these dark clouds began to disperse.<BR>
<BR>
Firewatch has yet to fully emerge from the shadow of the Simulacrum. Duchess Jandacia rules wisely and well, but the old paranoia that gripped the city in ages past has settled once more. Perhaps many years of peace and good order will restore the city's cheer. Despite its hardships, Firewatch remains ironclad, a stout outpost of the Empire at the edge of the world. The Watch-of-Fire, it is said, shall ever continue.<BR>"""

<BR>

<BR>

正是在这段不安的时期，火望迎来了它的第一次军事考验；并非来自阿卡维尔，而是来自泰瓦尼内部。一位名叫图里马尔的地方领主，装备着奇怪而可怕的魔法并挥舞着锻莫金属武器，对帝国在东北部的领地发动了战争。尽管灰蛾军团的士兵在尘土荒地和灰烬山脉中一次又一次地击败了这位叛逆领主，但狡猾的泰瓦尼人多次逃脱了帝国的审判。直到图里马尔在306年春天胆大妄为地围攻火望城本身，他的叛乱才被平息。这位丹莫法师被处决，他的构造体被拆解，他珍贵的法杖 -- 被胜利的军团士兵称为“誓约之杖” -- 被没收，成为火望的瑰宝。这一事件恰好发生在该城建城三百周年前夕，为了庆祝，新建的火望骑士团举行了奉献仪式。<BR>

History of Lock Picking

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
History of Lock Picking<BR><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
The modern lock has a fascinating history in Cyrodiil. The need to restrict access to one's home has been a problem since homes were first built. The very first security system was a simple bar across the door. This has the obvious shortcoming of only being functional when the owner is at home.<BR>
<BR>
The first recorded instance of a lock is the ingenious armbreaker of Castle Anvil. The count of the day put five slide bars on the side of the door. A hole in the door just above them allowed him to reach in and manipulate any of these bars. Only one of the bars truly locked or unlocked the door. The other four released the clasp on a hammer that fell down on the person's arm. Only by knowing which sliding bar was the true lock could one safely open the door.<BR>
<BR>
For over a hundred years, the state of the art in locks was defined by sliding bars and punished traps. Then the famous dwarf Mzunchend invented the pin lock. The first example had three pins. The key was turned in the lock four times, each turn depending on a different pin being in position. Obviously a pin could be used more than once.<BR>
<BR>
It was sixty-five years before anyone devised a method to open a pin-based lock without the key and without damaging the lock. It wasn't that the problem was so difficult. It was that nobody other than royalty could afford Mzunchend's locks. An enterprising blacksmith named Orenthal decided to mass-produce a common form of the lock at a reasonable price. Suddenly every shop had a lock. Now there was a reason to subvert the locks. It wasn't long before lockpicks and lockpicking appeared. Orenthal became quite wealthy inventing more and more sophisticated locks.<BR>
<BR>
Today's locks are sophisticated mechanisms with spring-loaded pins. Each metal pin must be pushed up by the key precisely to open the lock. Any imprecision in the key, any poorly made copy, or any clumsy attempt at lockpicking releases the spring tension, causing the pin to clamp down upon or even break the key or lockpick.<BR>
<BR>
Locks are made more secure by using multiple pins in the lock. Multiple-pin locks are more delicate and difficult to make, and more expensive, but provide a greater reliability against tampering. Multiple-pin locks have the further virtue of resetting all pins when any single pin is tampered with. A single mistake with the fifth pin of a five-pin lock requires a thief to reset all five pins again. Most affordable locks are one-pin or two-pin locks. The five-pin lock is the highest achievement of the lockmaker's craft, and the greatest challenge to a would-be intruder.<BR>
<BR>
Picking the modern lock is an art form. A lockpick is a thin metal bar with a small tooth on the end. The tooth is used to press the pin up into the lock mechanism. The thief uses skill and experience to manipulate each pin in turn to determine the exact tension necessary to set the spring-loaded pin at its catchpoint. With a subtle pressing and lofting of the pin, the master thief determines the exact motion required to set it.<BR>
<BR>
A novice thief breaks many picks while learning his trade. Only with time and practice will he get better at guessing the tension and timing necessary to set a pin. As a result, novice thieves tend to carry a great many lockpicks, while the masters only need to carry a few.<BR>
<BR>"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
开锁术历史<BR><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
现代锁具在西罗帝尔有着引人入胜的历史。自从人类开始建造房屋起，如何限制他人进入自己的住所就成了一个难题。最早的安全系统只是门上一根简单的门闩。这有一个明显的缺点：只有在主人自己在家时才能发挥作用。<BR>
<BR>
历史上记载的第一个锁具是安维尔城堡巧妙的“断臂器”。当时的伯爵在门的一侧安装了五根滑动门闩。门闩正上方的门上一个洞，让他能伸手进去操作这些门闩。只有一根门闩是真正用来锁门或开门的。其他四根门闩则会释放一个锤子的卡扣，锤子会砸向开门者的手臂。只有知道哪根滑动门闩是真正的锁，才能安全地打开门。<BR>
<BR>
在长达一百多年的时间里，锁具的技术水平就是由滑动门闩和惩罚性陷阱来定义的。后来，著名的矮人姆尊臣德发明了弹子锁。最早的弹子锁有三个弹子。钥匙需要在锁中转动四次，每次转动依赖于不同的弹子就位。显然，同一个弹子可以使用多次。<BR>
<BR>
六十五年后，才有人发明了一种无需钥匙、不损坏锁具就能打开弹子锁的方法。并非这个问题有多么困难。而是除了王室，没人买得起姆尊臣德的锁。一位名叫奥伦萨尔的进取铁匠决定以合理的价格批量生产一种常见的锁形制。突然间，每家店铺都有了锁。于是，破坏锁具的理由就出现了。不久之后，开锁器和开锁术就出现了。奥伦萨尔通过发明越来越复杂的锁具变得相当富有。<BR>
<BR>
今天的锁具是带有弹簧弹子的精密机械装置。钥匙必须精确地将每个金属弹子推到位才能打开锁。钥匙的任何不精确、任何粗劣的复制品、或者任何笨拙的开锁尝试，都会释放弹簧的张力，导致弹子卡住甚至折断钥匙或开锁器。<BR>
<BR>
通过在锁中使用多个弹子来增加安全性。多弹子锁更精密、更难制造，也更昂贵，但具有更高的防撬可靠性。多弹子锁还有一个优点：当任何一个弹子被触动时，所有弹子都会复位。在五弹子锁上，如果第五个弹子出错一次，盗贼就必须将全部五个弹子重新复位。大多数价格可承受的锁是一弹子或两弹子锁。五弹子锁是制锁工艺的最高成就，也是潜在闯入者面临的最大挑战。<BR>
<BR>
开启现代锁是一门艺术。开锁器是一根细金属棒，末端有一个小小的齿。这个齿用于将弹子向上压入锁的机构。盗贼运用技巧和经验，依次拨动每个弹子，以确定将弹簧弹子设置在其卡点的精确张力。通过对弹子进行微妙的按压和抬升，神偷就能确定设置它所需的精确动作。<BR>
<BR>
新手盗贼在学习技艺时会折断许多开锁器。只有经过时间和练习，他才能更擅长判断设置弹子所需的张力和时机。因此，新手盗贼往往会携带大量开锁器，而大师则只需要带几个。<BR>

A History of Saturalia<BR>
By Eadwyn Arkidge<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
In the High Rock kingdom of Wayrest, few holidays are so beloved as the wintertide festival of Saturalia. Originally a regional festivity, Saturalia's undeniable appeals have broadened its popularity across much of the empire. Traditionally, Saturalia is a time for feasting, drinking, and exchanging gifts - a celebration of warmth in the deep of winter.<BR>
<BR>
Saturalia began its long history as a midwinter festival among the Bjoulsae and sedentary Wayrest Nedics, dedicated to the god Sadhuill. A now-forgotten god of merriment, debauchery, and love, Sadhuill has in modern times been identified with Sanguine and even Dibella. For the ancient Wayrestians, Sadhuill's feast was a time for great indulgence in food, drink, and sex, a tradition that has filtered down to a degree into modern Saturalia traditions.<BR>
<BR>
However, it was not until the early Third Era that the Saturalia we know came into being. When Tiber Septim brought Wayrest and High Rock into his empire, it was his lieutenant, Saturio, who was made interim governor of Wayrest. Aside from many advances in infrastructure and governance, Governor Saturio was noted for his great piety, and considerable effort in spreading the Imperial faith to the heathen Bretons, who then worshipped an ecclectic assortment of elven, nordic, and pagan-Nedic deities, resembling imprecisely the "modern" gods of the Bretons.<BR>
<BR>
In early Third Era Wayrest, Sadhuill was one of these, highly popular during his midwinter festival. Saturio, noting this popularity, hoped to turn the religious dedication to Sadhuill's faith to the Imperial Cult, and was remarkably successful. So dedicated was he in his pursuit and emulation of Sadhuilli practices - distributing gifts to families across the city and drinking barrels of wine in company - Saturio could not but be welcomed into the Wayrestian tradition. But he had not, as some rivqls suggested, "gone native". As his position in the Wayrestians' estimations rose, his gods Dibella, Mara and Arkay seemed more and more to represent the spirit of wintertide merriment to the Bretons.<BR>
<BR>
Within three years, Sadhuill's name had become to vanish from midwinter celebrations, and a great many Wayrestians began to follow Saturio's new cult, and after his death, the memory of Saturio had begun to replace the heathen festival deity.<BR>
<BR>
For his role in bringing Wayrest into the Imperial fold, Saturio was declared a saint of the Imperial Cult, and Saint Saturio's Day a recognised holy day. But the memory of Sadhuilli traditions survives through Saturio's legacy, and Saint Saturio is today a jovial winter spirit, to whom the generous giving of gifts is attributed - good little children who keep the Nine and obey their parents will be given gifts by old Saint Saturio, or "Saturalisman", while their parents enjoy a hearty drink in his honor.<BR>

<BR>

<BR>
由于他在将途歇归入帝国版图中的作用，萨图里奥被宣布为帝国教团的圣徒，圣萨图里奥日成为公认的圣日。但萨德希尔传统的记忆通过萨图里奥的遗产得以保存，而圣萨图里奥今天是一个欢乐的冬日精灵，慷慨馈赠礼物被归于他的名下 -- 遵守九圣灵戒律、服从父母的好孩子们会得到老圣萨图里奥（或称为“萨图里奥人”）的礼物，而他们的父母则会痛快地畅饮一杯向他致敬。<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>Cyrodiilic History and Customs - The Second Empire<BR>

<BR>

---<BR>

<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>

Promulgated under the Authority of the Imperial Geographical Society<BR>

<BR>

The Second Empire is divided into two stages: the Reman Dynasty and the Akaviri Potentate. After the Akaviri raiders had been defeated, Reman recruited many of them into his service. Later Cyrodiils traditionally kept a House Guard of Akaviri, and the Emperor's chief advisor, the Potentate, was usually of Akaviri descent. Other Akaviri slaves played a significant part in establishing the administrative structures of the Second Empire, as well as in the training of its military. The restructured Imperial legions, which learned an unparalleled measure of coherence, logistics, and discipline from the Akaviri, began to easily overwhelm the other regional armies; soon every region in Tamriel belonged to Cyrodiil except for Morrowind. After the assassination of Reman's last heir by the Dark Elven Morag Tong during the disastrous Four Score War, control of the Empire reverted to the Akaviri Potentate. They have left a visible mark on the Empire of today. The high crafts of daikatanas and dragonscale armor came from Akavir, as did the banners and military dress of Septim's shock troops, the Blades. The Red Dragons that have come to represent the Empire and the Imperial City were originally Akaviri war mounts. Akaviri surnames are rare and prized possessions among the Cyrodilic citizenry of today, and there are trace facial features of the Akaviri in many distinguished Cyrodilic families. Some colonies of "true Akaviri" still exist in both the Empire and its border regions, but they are named so only for their practices and customs than for the purity of their blood.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>西罗帝尔历史与习俗 - 第二帝国<BR>

<BR>

---<BR>

<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>

帝国地理学会授权发布<BR>

<BR>

第二帝国分为两个阶段：雷曼王朝和阿卡维尔摄政。阿卡维尔入侵者被击败后，雷曼招募了许多人为他服务。后来的西罗帝尔人传统上保留了一支由阿卡维尔人组成的王室卫队，而皇帝的首席顾问 -- 摄政王，通常也具有阿卡维尔血统。其他阿卡维尔奴隶在建立第二帝国的行政结构和军事训练方面发挥了重要作用。重组后的帝国军团从阿卡维尔人那里学到了无与伦比的凝聚力、后勤能力和纪律，开始轻松压倒其他地方的军队；很快，泰姆瑞尔除了晨风之外的每个地区都归西罗帝尔所有。在灾难性的“八次十年战争”期间，雷曼最后的继承人被丹莫的莫拉格·堂刺杀后，帝国的控制权回到了阿卡维尔摄政王手中。他们在今天的帝国留下了明显的印记。大太刀和龙鳞甲的高级工艺来自阿卡维尔，塞普汀的精锐部队“刀锋”的旗帜和军装也是如此。已经成为帝国和帝都象征的红龙，最初是阿卡维尔的战骑。阿卡维尔姓氏在今天的西罗帝尔公民中很罕见，是珍贵的财产，许多显赫的西罗帝尔家族中都有阿卡维尔人的面貌特征。在帝国及其边境地区仍然存在一些“纯正阿卡维尔人”的聚居区，但他们之所以如此称呼，更多是基于他们的习俗和传统，而非血脉的纯粹性。<BR>

However, should a stronghold be built at Odai Plateau, the populace there could use the eggs, and any extras could be easily taken to Hla Oad and shipped out of Province. """<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Holidays of the Iliac Bay<BR>
By Theth-i<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
The region of the Iliac Bay has a rich history, and not surprisingly, a number of holidays unique to it because of this history. The Breton and the Redguard cultures have many similarities, but just as many distinctions. An analysis of the holidays is one way to study the people.<BR><BR>
As any schoolchild could tell you, the Redguards are a relatively new culture to Tamriel. Their arrival from their homeland is actually well recorded, though it occurred several thousand years ago, in the 808th year of the 1st Era. Hammerfell was a great desert encompassed by almost impassable mountains -- unclaimed and unwanted. Many of the holidays extant in modern Hammerfell seem to be direct translations of older Redguard festivals before their migration to Tamriel.<BR><BR>
The orgiastic seasonal celebrations seem unusual in a province with few changes in the weather from month to month. Yet on the 28th of Suns Dawn, the Redguards of the Banthan jungle celebrate Aduros Nau to relieve the wintertide lethargy; on the 1st of Mid Year, the people of Abibon-Gora celebrate Drigh R'Zimb in honor of the sun, which no normal Redguard worships in this day; similarly, on the 29th of Suns Height, the festival in the Desert called Fiery Night, seems almost perverse in such an environment; the Koomu Alezer'i on the 11th of Last Seed in Sentinel has been translated as a harvest thanksgiving, though many scholars have suggested that it was once a springtide holiday; similarly, the Feast of the Tiger in the Bantha on the 14th of Last Seed was probably once a religious holiday to a Tiger God, instead of a thanksgiving.<BR><BR>
Other old Redguard holidays have either been acknowledged as part of the old culture or adjusted to fit with the climate of Hammerfell. The Serpent's Dance, for example, of Satakalaam is patently an old festival honoring a Serpent God of the homeland who evidently did not survive the journey to Hammerfell. The significance of the date, the 3rd of Suns Dusk, has been lost with the Serpent Priests. Baranth Do, on the 18th of Evening Star, and Chil'a, on the 24th of the same month, are both New Years festivals. Most likely, they have been moved from their original dates to correspond with the notion of the year defined in Tamriel.<BR><BR>
The Bretons have been in Tamriel since before recorded history. Their holidays have remained almost unchanged since primitive times, though new holidays have been created to replace those which have lost popularity.<BR><BR>
The oldest holidays still observed in High Rock must include Waking Day, on the 18th of Morning Star, when the people of the Yeorth Burrowland wake the spirits of nature after the winter, very nearly in the tradition of their more reverential ancestors. Flower Day, held on the 25th of First Seed in the smaller villages of High Rock is most likely just as older or older. The old cult of the flower is also remembered as Gardtide in Tamarilyn Point on the 1st of Rains Hand. Daggerfall's Day of the Dead, on the 13th of Rains Hand, suggests the ancestor worship that marked the Breton religion of antiquity. Finally, the ancient goddess of the moons, Secunda, is remembered in the Moon Festival in Glenumbra Moors on the 8th of Suns Dusk, just as the nights begin to grow longer.<BR><BR>
The more recently created holidays of High Rock are those like Tibedetha, "Tibers Day," celebrated every 24th of Mid Year in honor of Alcaire's most famous, son, Tiber Septim. Likewise, Othroktide on the 5th of Suns Dawn is held in honor of the first and most illustrious Baron of Dwynnen. In quite extreme contrast, Marukh's Day on the 9th of Second Seed, is a solemn holiday, immortalizing the lessons of the equally solemn 1st Era prophet Marukh. My favorite of the modern Breton festivals has to be Mad Pelagius, held in mock honor of the most eccentric of the Septim Emperors. Pelagius was, after all, a prince of Wayrest before he became King of Solitude, and then Emperor of Tamriel. The Bretons like to boast that it was his time in High Rock that drove him mad.<BR>"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
髂骨湾节日<BR>
塞西 著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
髂骨湾地区历史悠久，因此产生了一些该地区特有的节日，这并不奇怪。布莱顿文化和红卫文化有许多相似之处，但同样也有许多差异。分析节日是研究其人民的一种方式。<BR><BR>
任何学童都能告诉你，红卫人对于泰姆瑞尔来说是一个相对较新的文化。他们从故乡到来的时间实际上有很好的记载，尽管那发生在几千年前的第一纪元808年。落锤是一片被几乎无法通行的山脉环绕的大沙漠 -- 无人宣称拥有，也无人想要。现代落锤存在的许多节日似乎直接源自红卫人迁徙到泰姆瑞尔之前的古老节日。<BR><BR>
在这样一个月份之间天气变化不大的行省，这种狂欢式的季节性庆祝活动似乎有些不同寻常。然而，在日晓月28日，班坦丛林的紅衛人庆祝“阿杜罗斯·瑙”以缓解冬日的倦怠感；在年中月1日，阿比邦·戈拉的人民庆祝“德里格·利'津布”以纪念太阳，而如今普通的红卫人并不崇拜太阳；同样，在日高月29日，沙漠中名为“炽热夜”的节日，在这样的环境中显得几乎反常；哨卫在末种月11日的“库乌穆·阿勒泽'里”被解释为丰收感恩节，尽管许多学者认为它曾经是一个春季节日；同样，班塔在末种月14日的“虎之盛宴”可能曾经是献给虎神的宗教节日，而不是感恩节。<BR><BR>
其他古老的红卫节日，要么被承认为旧文化的一部分，要么被调整以适应落锤的气候。例如，萨塔卡拉姆的“毒蛇之舞”，显然是一个古老的节日，用来纪念故乡的蛇神，而这位蛇神显然没能活到抵达落锤。日期（日暮月3日）的意义已随着蛇神祭司们一同失落。夜星月18日的“巴兰斯·多”和同月24日的“奇尔'阿”都是新年节日。它们很可能被从原来的日期移至现在的时间，以对应泰姆瑞尔规定的年份概念。<BR><BR>
布莱顿人早在信史开始前就已在泰姆瑞尔生活。他们的节日自远古时代以来几乎未变，尽管也创造了新的节日来取代那些不再流行的。<BR><BR>
高岩仍在庆祝的最古老节日必定包括复苏日（晨星月18日），这一天纽尔斯·伯罗兰的人们在冬天之后唤醒自然之灵，这与他们更为虔诚的祖先的传统非常接近。鲜花日（初种月25日）在高岩较小的村庄举行，很可能同样古老或更古老。古老的鲜花崇拜也在雨手月1日的塔玛利林角的“伽德节”中被纪念。匕落的死者之日（雨手月13日）暗示了标志着布莱顿古老宗教的祖先崇拜。最后，在日暮月8日，正当黑夜开始变长之际，谷影沼泽的月亮节纪念着古老的月亮女神瑟昆达。<BR><BR>
高岩较近代创造的节日则包括“提贝德塔”（“泰伯日”），在每年年中月24日庆祝，以纪念阿尔凯尔最著名的儿子泰伯·塞普汀。同样，日晓月5日的“奥瑟罗克节”是为了纪念德温宁的第一位也是最杰出的男爵。形成鲜明对比的是，次种月9日的马鲁克日是一个庄严的节日，旨在铭记同样庄严的第一纪元先知马鲁克的教诲。在现代布莱顿节日中，我最喜欢的当属“疯狂佩拉基乌斯”，它以嘲弄的方式纪念最古怪的塞普汀皇帝。毕竟，佩拉基乌斯在成为独孤城国王、继而成为泰姆瑞尔皇帝之前，曾是途歇的一位王子。布莱顿人喜欢吹嘘说，正是他在高岩的那段时间让他发了疯。<BR>"""

高岩仍在庆祝的最古老节日必定包括复苏日（晨星月18日），这一天纽尔斯·伯罗兰的人们在冬天之后唤醒自然之灵，这与他们更为虔诚的祖先的传统非常接近。鲜花日（初种月25日）在高岩较小的村庄举行，很可能同样古老或更古老。古老的鲜花崇拜也在雨手月1日的塔玛利林角的“伽德节”中被纪念。匕落的死者之日（雨手月13日）暗示了标志着布莱顿古老宗教的祖先崇拜。最后，在日暮月8日，正当黑夜开始变长之际，谷影沼泽的月亮节纪念着古老的月亮女神瑟昆达。<BR><BR>
高岩较近代创造的节日则包括“提贝德塔”（“泰伯日”），在每年年中月24日庆祝，以纪念阿尔凯尔最著名的儿子泰伯·塞普汀。同样，日晓月5日的“奥瑟罗克节”是为了纪念德温宁的第一位也是最杰出的男爵。形成鲜明对比的是，次种月9日的马鲁克日是一个庄严的节日，旨在铭记同样庄严的第一纪元先知马鲁克的教诲。在现代布莱顿节日中，我最喜欢的当属“疯狂佩拉基乌斯”，它以嘲弄的方式纪念最古怪的塞普汀皇帝。毕竟，佩拉基乌斯在成为独孤城国王、继而成为泰姆瑞尔皇帝之前，曾是途歇的一位王子。布莱顿人喜欢吹嘘说，正是他在高岩的那段时间让他发了疯。<BR>"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
The Hoom, Habitat and Habits<BR>
Menulus Flavis<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
A little over 50 years ago a cargo vessel  arrived at the Bravil docks. It had set sail for Morrowind three years before that, its hold filled with luxury goods. In its stead now it carried a set of strange items, hitherto unseen by our academics.<BR>
<BR>
A set of painted, inlayed and lacquered shells took up most of the room in the hold, stacked on top of each other like a collection of nested dolls. The smallest perhaps twice the size of an adult Mudcrab, the largest as big as a small room.<BR>
<BR>
Females seem to be dominant sex. Males will bring gifts of food in exchange for mating advantage. Males sometimes attacked.<BR>
<BR>
All these shells were said to come from one single, individual animal, collected over decades. As it grew it molted, left behind the old shell and grew a new one, each larger than the last. The Dunmer had collected each shell as it was discarded by the animal and decorated it.<BR>
<BR>
The captain had gambled that the novelty he traded his cargo for would turn him a profit and his gamble was correct beyond his greediest dreams. Nobles from many houses fell over each other to bid for this new and exciting curiosity. He had made his fortune.<BR>
<BR>
That captain was my father and his windfall guaranteed me a life of luxury and the best education money could buy. Now, more than half a century later, I went on a journey to learn more about the creature which had become the mascot of my family.<BR>
<BR>
Over land I traveled to Dawnstar, over sea to Blacklight. in search of the Hoom. I will spare my reader the difficulties I encountered on the way and the unseemly amount of bribery required to make the reticent Dunmer farmers reveal their knowledge and simply present my results here.<BR>
<BR><BR>
The crustaceans called Hoom are native to the Velothi mountains which separate Morrowind from Skyrim. Attempts to transplant them to other regions have failed, likely due to a combination of the ever-present ashfalls from Red Mountain and a specific but unidentified quality of the waters where they spend their larval stage.<BR>
<BR>
The Hoom life cycle can be divided into four distinct and separate stages.<BR>
<BR>
First, in Spring, herds of Hoom make a trek towards the same ancestral spawning grounds where they themselves hatched. They feel at home in both salt and brackish water and the pregnant females lay clusters of hundreds of sticky eggs, which they attach to rocks. No parental care is given at this stage and shortly after laying the herd makes the journey back towards the mountains where they live as adults. Hoom farmers travel with their tamed herd at this time, but wild Hoom make the trek alone.<BR>
<BR>
Between two and three weeks after spawning season the eggs hatch and the second stage of Hoom life reveals itself, the aquatic Hoom larvae, locally known as Grulbs. Grulbs are carnivorous, feed on insects, shellfish and small fish and their diet allows them to grow quickly. They are coated in a mildly toxic slime that is used by the Dunmer as an ingredient in some of their drogas and medicine. The sting of the Grulb delivers an unpleasant burning sensation that can last for a few days. Grulbs in turn are predated on enthusiatically by Slaughterfish and Cliff Racers. In form they resemble sea slugs.<BR>
<BR>
Roughly two months after hatching they develop a hard shell and become immobile until from that casing emerges the third stage, Hoomcrabs.<BR>
<BR>
The amphibious Hoomcrabs are easily mistaken for Mudcrabs. Looking remarkably similar, they fill the same ecological niche of scavenger as the Mudcrab itself, but are not aggressive. Hoomcrabs stay away from Mudcrabs, as Mudcrabs will not hesitate to attack them. Several moltings occur at this stage, each time the Hoomcrab emerges larger until at the end of Summer there is no mistaking them for Mudcrabs any longer. They will be roughly twice as large. Even though the Dunmer harvest Hoomcrabs for their meat, there is now little danger to them from the native wildlife. They can easily fend off Mudcrabs and no other animal takes a special interest in them.  The largest thinning of the numbers occurs in late Summer, when they trek inland. Into the Velothi Mountains, in search of the specific herd of Hoom that parented them.<BR>
<BR>
Maybe one in twenty of the Hoomcrabs actually survive to find their herd. The rest fall by the wayside because of the difficulty of the journey. Once they are re-united the Hoomcrabs will seek out adult males and attach themselves to their carapace like whelks to a rock. Dormant, the final  changes occur to their physiology until at last emerges the fourth stage: Juvenile Hoom.<BR>
<BR>
From this point onward no major alterations to their form occur. Once a year they molt, leaving behind their old shell as it becomes too small for them to comfortably reside in. At this final stage Hoom are herbivorous. A tame, well cared for Hoom can live for roughly 50 to 60 years. Stories of ancient Hoom older than a century exist, often detailing a wise, wild Hoom saving a foolish Dunmer hunter or traveller. But I have found no verified cases of a Hoom that old outside of folk tales.<BR>
<BR><BR>
Elsewhere is detailed how the Hoom shells are tuned to facilitate and beautify the sounds they can produce. I will refer my kind reader to this work by the scholar Adrys to satisfy his curiosity about this remarkable phenomenon. But I would be remiss not to mention the beauty of a tuned, tame Hoom herd, singing in the dusk light. The piccolos of the juveniles, the altos the females produce and the deep, rich bass tones of the adult males surely create a concerto without equal in nature.<BR>
<BR><BR>
Hoom products perform many functions in Dunmer society. Their saliva contains modest restorative properties. When fed Scrib jelly their dung becomes a type of cement that dries when exposed to air.<BR>
<BR>
Hoom wool on its own is an irritant that has an adverse effect on the lungs, but when treated with Shalk resin it's a flame retardant and keeps out heat and cold. Treated Hoom wool is used for making winter coats, however its most important function is in construction. Traditional Dunmer homes as well as Ashlander yurts utilise a layer of Hoom wool to keep out the Winter cold as well as the Summer heat.<BR>
<BR>
But the most important Hoom product is the shell, discarded by the animal during molting. The smaller shells are used to make musical instruments. Medium-sized shells are used to create parts of traditional Dunmer bonemold armor and tools. The largest shells are exceptionally prized and can function as a shelter by itself, or joined together with others. The shells are decorated using various techniques. Inlays of pearl, jade, glass and ebony. Lacquer, paints and metalwork all function to increase their value and also to display elaborate religious iconography for those shells which are not for trade.<BR>
<BR>
The Hoom and its various products are so intertwined in Dunmer culture, arts and construction that it is difficult to imagine what Morrowind would be without these docile creatures that lead such remarkably complex lives.<BR>
<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
荷姆：栖息地与习性<BR>
梅努鲁斯·弗拉维斯 著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
五十多年前，一艘货船抵达了布拉维尔的码头。三年前，它满载着奢侈品起航前往晨风。如今，它运载的是一批奇怪的物品，这些物品在此之前我们的学者从未见过。<BR>
<BR>
一套彩绘、镶嵌并上漆的贝壳占据了货舱的大部分空间，它们像套娃一样一个摞一个地堆放着。最小的可能有一只成年泥沼蟹的两倍大，最大的有一间小房间那么大。<BR>
<BR>
雌性似乎是主导性别。雄性会带来食物作为礼物，以换取交配优势。雄性有时也会发起攻击。<BR>
<BR>
所有这些贝壳据说都来自一只单独的动物，是数十年间收集起来的。随着它的生长，它会蜕壳，留下旧壳，长出更大的新壳。丹莫们将这只动物丢弃的每一个壳都收集起来，并加以装饰。<BR>
<BR>
船长赌了一把，认为他用货物换来的新奇物品能为他带来利润，结果他的赌注正确得超出了他最贪婪的梦想。来自多个家族的贵族们争相竞标这件新奇有趣的珍品。他发了大财。<BR>
<BR>
那位船长就是我的父亲，他的这笔意外之财保证了我能过上奢侈的生活，并接受金钱能买到的最好教育。如今，半个多世纪后，我踏上了旅程，去了解更多关于这种已成为我家吉祥物的生物。<BR>
<BR>
我陆路行至晨星，海路抵达黑光，寻找荷姆。我不会让读者为我在路上遇到的困难，以及为了让沉默寡言的丹莫农民透露他们的知识所需支付的大量贿赂而烦恼，我就在这里直接呈现我的研究结果。<BR>
<BR><BR>
被称为荷姆的甲壳类动物原产于分隔晨风和天际的维洛提山脉。将它们移植到其他地区的尝试都失败了，这可能是由于红山持续不断的火山灰沉降，以及它们幼虫期所生活水域中某种特定但未知的特质共同作用的结果。<BR>
<BR>
荷姆的生命周期可分为四个截然不同且独立的阶段。<BR>
<BR>
首先，在春天，成群的荷姆会跋涉回到它们自己孵化的同一片祖先产卵地。它们在咸水和半咸水中都能舒适地生活，怀孕的雌性会产下数百枚粘性卵，并将它们附着在岩石上。在这个阶段没有亲代照料，产卵后不久，群体就会返回它们成年后生活的山脉。此时，驯养荷姆的农民会随同他们的驯化群体一起旅行，但野生的荷姆会独自完成这次跋涉。<BR>
<BR>
产卵季节后两到三周，卵孵化，荷姆生命的第二个阶段显现出来 -- 水生荷姆幼虫，当地称为“格拉布”。格拉布是肉食性的，以昆虫、贝类和小鱼为食，它们的饮食使其能快速生长。它们覆盖着一层微毒的粘液，丹莫将其用作一些药品和药物的成分。被格拉布蜇到会产生一种令人不快的灼烧感，可持续数天。反过来，格拉布也是食人鱼和峭壁鸟热衷捕食的对象。它们的外形类似于海蛞蝓。<BR>
<BR>
孵化后大约两个月，它们会发育出硬壳并变得无法移动，直到从那个壳中浮现出第三阶段 -- 荷姆蟹。<BR>
<BR>
两栖的荷姆蟹很容易被误认为是泥沼蟹。它们看起来非常相似，与泥沼蟹一样扮演着食腐动物的生态位，但没有攻击性。荷姆蟹会远离泥沼蟹，因为泥沼蟹会毫不犹豫地攻击它们。这个阶段会发生几次蜕壳，每次蜕壳后荷姆蟹都会变得更大，直到夏末，人们就再也无法将它们误认为是泥沼蟹了。它们将大约有两倍大。尽管丹莫会捕捞荷姆蟹作为肉食，但此时它们面临的本地野生动物威胁已经很小。它们可以轻易击退泥沼蟹，也没有其他动物对它们特别感兴趣。数量减少最显著的是在夏末，那时它们会向内陆跋涉，进入维洛提山脉，寻找抚育它们的那群特定的荷姆群体。<BR>
<BR>
可能只有二十分之一的荷姆蟹能实际存活下来并找到它们的群体。其余的因旅程艰难而半途而废。一旦重逢，荷姆蟹会寻找成年雄性，像螺附着在岩石上一样附着在它们的甲壳上。在休眠状态下，它们的生理会发生最终的变化，直到最后浮现出第四阶段：青年荷姆。<BR>
<BR>
从此刻起，它们的外形不再发生重大变化。每年蜕壳一次，当旧壳变得太小无法舒适居住时，它们就会将其丢弃。在最后的这个阶段，荷姆是食草动物。驯养的、照料良好的荷姆大约能活50到60年。存在关于活过一世纪的古老荷姆的故事，常常详细描述一只聪明、野生的荷姆拯救愚蠢的丹莫猎人或旅行者。但除了民间传说，我没有发现任何经过验证的、如此长寿的荷姆案例。<BR>
<BR><BR>
关于如何调校荷姆壳以促进和美化物種能发出的声音，在其他地方有详细记载。我将请好心的读者参考学者阿德里斯关于这一非凡现象的著作，以满足他们的好奇心。但如果不提及一只调校过的驯养荷姆群在暮色中歌唱的美景，那将是我的失职。幼崽的短笛声、雌性发出的女低音和成年雄性深沉、丰富的男低音，无疑创造了一首自然中无与伦比的协奏曲。<BR>
<BR><BR>
荷姆制品在丹莫社会中发挥着许多功能。它们的唾液含有温和的恢复性特质。当喂食夸蚂幼体凝胶时，它们的粪便会变成一种在空气中干燥的水泥。<BR>
<BR>
荷姆毛本身是一种刺激物，对肺有不良影响，但经沙尔克树脂处理后，它就变成了阻燃剂，并能抵御冷热。处理过的荷姆毛用于制作冬衣，但其最重要的功能是在建筑方面。传统的丹莫住宅以及灰烬之民的帐篷都会使用一层荷姆毛来抵御冬寒和夏热。<BR>
<BR>
但最重要的荷姆制品是壳，它们在蜕皮时丢弃的壳。较小的壳用于制作乐器。中等大小的壳用于制作传统丹莫骨模盔甲和工具的一部分。最大的壳极其珍贵，可以单独作为庇护所，也可以与其他壳连接在一起。这些壳使用各种技术进行装饰。镶嵌珍珠、玉石、玻璃和黑檀木。漆器、油漆和金属工艺都是为了增加其价值，同时对于那些非交易的壳，还展示了精美的宗教图像。<BR>
<BR>
荷姆及其各种制品在丹莫的文化、艺术和建筑中如此紧密地交织在一起，以至于很难想象没有这种性情温顺、却过着极其复杂生活的生物，晨风会是什么样子。<BR>
<BR>

However, the truest way for Kyne's folk to find fortune is upon the battlefield, and the greatest wealth of our kingdom was borne home on the shields of our warriors.<BR>

<FONT COLOR="500F0F">十二、觐见行为规范<BR>
<FONT COLOR="000000">儿子：亲爱的父亲，我应该期望那些觐见我的人表现如何？<BR>
父亲：儿子，你是国王，你必须要求所有来到你面前的人表示顺从。缺少傲慢是王国的死亡，因为畏惧性的尊重是良好统治的约束力。所有人都将在你面前鞠躬；你土地上的人类将鞠躬一次，外来领地的人类将鞠躬两次，而那些来自精灵之地的人，唯有在冒犯你的情况下，才会将脸庞从粗糙的土地上抬起。务必做到这一点，否则你的王权台座将变得脆弱。<BR>
<BR>
<FONT COLOR="500F0F">十三、惩罚与处决权<BR>
<FONT COLOR="000000">儿子：那么，作为国王，我该如何处理违法者和那些贪婪自负的人？<BR>
父亲：作为国王，处死的权力在你手中；所有人的生命都依赖于你的宽容。但也要记住，繁荣和服从来自于对秩序的认可；期望孕育默许，这就是我们所说的正义。尽管你拥有处决权，但更好的做法是通过没收财富、没收土地和剥夺自由来解决争端。通过这些方式，你变得更强大，同时让那些违抗你法律的人成为一个范例，所有人都可以用它来衡量自己的服从。<BR>
<BR>
<FONT COLOR="500F0F">十四、打破誓言的方法<BR>
<FONT COLOR="000000">儿子：既然我矗立在伟大的誓言支柱之上，我又该如何确保我意志的自由呢？<BR>
父亲：誓言在众神面前最为神圣，因此打破这种契约是最危险的仪式。首先，你可以杀死你对他许下诺言的人，如果这本身没有违背你对他们的承诺。其次，你可以用你自己的誓言加重他们的负担，使他们为了自己的解脱而放弃你的债务。第三，也是最严重的，你可以要求他们通过公开战斗来捍卫他们对你的忠诚的权利，不过这会使你同时冒生命和王位的风险，因为任何在此类挑战中击败你的人，都可以从你这里额外榨取一个没有范围限定的誓言。<BR>
<BR>
<FONT COLOR="500F0F">十五、结语<BR>
<FONT COLOR="000000">于是儿子学到了为君之道，并将这些知识记录下来，以便所有的继承者也能通过他们不羁的克制来塑造智慧王国。<BR>

However, the truest way for Kyne's folk to find fortune is upon the battlefield, and the greatest wealth of our kingdom was borne home on the shields of our warriors.<BR>

<FONT COLOR="000000">Son: And what, dear father, should I expect of those in my royal presence?<BR>

First, you may kill they to which you owe your word, if this does not itself break your word to them. Second, you may burden them with oaths of your own, such that they forswear your debt in hope of their own relief. Third, and most grievous, you may call on them to defend their right to your fidelity in open combat, though through this you risk both your life and your rule, since any who best you in such a challenge may extract from you one additional oath of no set breadth.<BR>

<FONT COLOR="000000">儿子：父亲，在伟大的誓言支柱上，我的位置在哪里？<BR>
父亲：那些向你宣誓效忠的人类领袖，无论是领主、君王还是众多氏族的首领，都是你的封臣。他们被约束于你和你的王国，正如在过去时代你的誓言会将你约束于至高王一样。但宣誓是双向的，你绝不能忘记你对你的封臣所应承担的安全、繁荣和正义的义务。众神不会对一个反复无常的君主微笑。<BR>

父亲：众神首先是炉灶的统治者，而你的家将永远是与他们最接近的地方。南方人为他们的神建造巨大而空洞的建筑，因此始终与他们疏离。相反，你将在火边静默祈祷，不加仪式地尊崇你的先祖。寻求那些为众神代言的女眷、老妇或女巫的恩惠，你的统治将长久而繁荣。<BR>

<FONT COLOR="500F0F">十二、觐见行为规范<BR>
<FONT COLOR="000000">儿子：亲爱的父亲，我应该期望那些觐见我的人表现如何？<BR>

<FONT COLOR="500F0F">十三、惩罚与处决权<BR>
<FONT COLOR="000000">儿子：那么，作为国王，我该如何处理违法者和那些贪婪自负的人？<BR>
父亲：作为国王，处死的权力在你手中；所有人的生命都依赖于你的宽容。但也要记住，繁荣和服从来自于对秩序的认可；期望孕育默许，这就是我们所说的正义。尽管你拥有处决权，但更好的做法是通过没收财富、没收土地和剥夺自由来解决争端。通过这些方式，你变得更强大，同时让那些违抗你法律的人成为一个范例，所有人都可以用它来衡量自己的服从。<BR>
<BR>
<FONT COLOR="500F0F">十四、打破誓言的方法<BR>
<FONT COLOR="000000">儿子：既然我矗立在伟大的誓言支柱之上，我又该如何确保我意志的自由呢？<BR>
父亲：誓言在众神面前最为神圣，因此打破这种契约是最危险的仪式。首先，你可以杀死你对他许下诺言的人，如果这本身没有违背你对他们的承诺。其次，你可以用你自己的誓言加重他们的负担，使他们为了自己的解脱而放弃你的债务。第三，也是最严重的，你可以要求他们通过公开战斗来捍卫他们对你的忠诚的权利，不过这会使你同时冒生命和王位的风险，因为任何在此类挑战中击败你的人，都可以从你这里额外榨取一个没有范围限定的誓言。<BR>
<BR>
<FONT COLOR="500F0F">十五、结语<BR>
<FONT COLOR="000000">于是儿子学到了为君之道，并将这些知识记录下来，以便所有的继承者也能通过他们不羁的克制来塑造智慧王国。<BR>

I was born Matinus Byrne of the Cyrodilic Empire, noble son and heir, before I took to the woods and the plains to find my calling. I felt that my destiny lay with that of my ancestors, the fierce Nords, and spent many months in the wilderness of Skyrim. A lesser man might have fallen under the ice and snow, and the ferocious beasts that still stalk those lands, but I persevered. Yet I felt that my life had no true purpose, and so, at a loss, I crossed the border to Morrowind. The ashen land of the Dark Elves was poor and its creatures attacked travelers frequently. No one knows how many pilgrims and merchants have never reached their destination because of a chance encounter with a flock of Cliff Racers, or a particularly aggressive Kagouti. Unimpressed with the natives, I joined a merchant train as a hired sword, defending well-fed Hlaalu Noble's goods with my life.<BR>

My main service to my employer was guarding his caravans as they journeyed through dangerous territory, though such journeys were often uneventful, probably due to the number of guards he chose to keep. Their prey, a great number of Guars, had stood no chance against such a ferocious host.<BR>

The next morning, the pack continued to follow the Foyada, many more than I had seen last night. Two men now led them, young Nords with slightly more decorous clothing than that of their fellows, while several older men continued behind the pack. They had eaten well that morning, the remainder of the meat yielded to them by the Guar herd, and I had seen many giving thanks to the Hunter. When I felt a spear at my throat I knew that fighting was useless now. Before I could speak, I felt something hard crack across my skull, and the sunlight faded.<BR>

The Hounds, being the followers of Hircine, revere the Lycanthropes, its form and its manner, and even imitate them their rituals and daily lifestyle. Nothing brings more joy to a Hound's heart than to hear the call of a werewolf, perhaps even see one in the moonlight. They are not reckless, though, and protect themselves against Lycanthropes as competently as they can, with charms and false scents. Many of the Hounds I have known, over my years of service to them, have yearned to contract Lycanthropy, though none were so foolish as to attempt it. Save one. While the werewolf is a perfect example of a true hunter, it is, at best, a mindless, savage creature.<BR>

I had been an acolyte of Hircine for just a few years when I heard of the Chamber of the Wolf. A dungeon deep below the ruins of a Dwemer outpost. I heard they kept a werewolf there, as a test of worth for the higher-ranking Hounds. My pack father confirmed it to me, a test of skill and speed to "hunt" the wolf, and return alive, was demanded by the Hunter as proof of a Pack Father's loyalty. The greatest of the hunters regularly passed through the Chamber of the Wolf to keep their skills high and wits sharp. On the 1st of Mid Year, scant days from the invocation of the Hunter, I entered the Chamber.<BR>

I can feel the slippery gore beneath my feet, could smell fresh blood. Evidently I had not been the only creature to visit this place recently, though I had, at least, survived this long. Torch in one hand, the other against the handle of my axe; that it was silver held no comfort to me, for I would have to be stronger, quicker and smarter than the Lycanthrope long enough for me to remove its head, or escape through the hatch at the center of the ruin. I continue to pull the rest of my body away from the hole, and hear the moans and movements of the animal as I kick at it again, before pulling my legs away from the trapdoor. Of the many Hounds who had ventured into that ruin, few had left alive, and less sane.<BR>
<BR>
I walk away from the Chamber of the Wolf, shirt tied around my bloody ankle, towards the nearest town, I have no money, but the ruin was littered with valuable armour and weaponry, I pay no heed to the armour I left behind. The Hounds have no claim upon me now. I pause as I hear a familiar call, a signal of the end of the hunt - The call of the wolf.<BR>"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
狼之召唤<BR>
马蒂努斯·伯恩 著<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[出版者注：本书作者马蒂努斯·伯恩，是我年轻时的一位朋友。这份夸张故事的手稿经由信使送到我在帝都的办公室，随附马蒂努斯本人一张便条，我已十年未见。马蒂努斯据传已死于天际荒野，收到此稿令我颇感意外。我无法担保这个故事内容的事实性或准确性，但出于对老友的相助，我出版此书。]<BR>

滴！滴！滴！咚！咚！咚！没有光，除了滴水声和我自己的脚步声外没有任何声音，连心跳声都没有。墙壁摸起来又冷又湿，我能闻到沾在墙壁和我手上的血腥味。身后传来一阵短暂的脚步声，以及一个坚硬锋利的东西敲击地板的声音，随后又是一片寂静......<BR>

我，马蒂努斯·伯恩，生于西罗帝尔帝国，贵族之子，是继承家业之人，之后才投身荒野平原寻找自己的使命。我感觉自己的命运与我的祖先 -- 凶悍的诺德人 -- 血脉相连，于是在天际的荒野中度过了数月。一个意志薄弱的人或许会葬身于冰雪和那些仍在那些土地上徘徊的凶猛野兽之口，但我坚持了下来。然而，我觉得自己的生活没有真正的目标，于是，彷徨无措之下，我越过边境进入了晨风。丹莫这片灰烬之地贫瘠不堪，其生物频繁袭击旅人。没有人知道有多少朝圣者和商人因为偶然遭遇一群峭壁鸟或一只特别具有攻击性的盾角蜥而永远无法到达目的地。对当地人并无好感，我加入了一支商队，成为雇佣剑士，用生命保卫着一位养尊处优的哈拉鲁贵族的货物。<BR>
<BR>

<BR>
猎犬们并不以他们的魔法天赋著称，事实上，他们中除了最强者外很少有人会魔法。他们是淳朴的民族，靠双手双脚谋生。我只见一位猎犬用过一次魔法，那就是我自己的群父，在年中月5日施展了一个召唤法术，出于某种我无法理解的原因召唤了猎神......<BR>

How Orsinium Passed to the Orcs
奥辛纽姆如何归于兽人之手
