<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>Inside Almalexia's Tongs<BR>$0A<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>by Galasa Sarvu<BR>$0A<BR>$0A<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>If Vivec City is the heart of Morrowind, Almalexia is its face. Much of what outlanders know, or think they know, of the Great House culture of the Dunmer comes from the capital itself. This can be misleading, as Almalexia is unique and stands apart from the province it rules in many ways. One of these is the role of the Tongs, or honorable societies. Tong culture is not exclusively a feature of the great city, but it is here that it has reached its most diverse and curious expression. Most native residents of the city belong to one of these societies, even if their ties to it are loose and informal. Some groups hold significant power, for good or for ill.<BR>$0A<BR>$0AMost of the more common Tongs resemble the cults of the Imperial Province. In a land like Morrowind, where heresy is not tolerated by the authorities, fraternities form that emphasize one element or another of the Tribunal faith without challenging the overarching Temple doctrine. So we have the Galaan (Mathematicians') Tong, which reveres Sotha Sil as the Divine Logician and whose members devise puzzles in his honor, with which they challenge one another. The Sorys (Unseeing) Tong, in contrast, honors the art of water breathing as practiced by Vivec and devotes itself to the study of the skill. The most widely known of these associations is the Morag (Foresters') Tong, which venerates Mephala and carries out bloody murder on the behalf of the Houses. Occasionally one of these groups will stray too far beyond Temple orthodoxy, and must conduct their rituals in secret or risk the heavy hand of the Ordinators.<BR>$0A<BR>$0ASome of these fraternities are restricted to a particular trade, and in modern times these tend to be indistinguishable from the tradesmen's guilds of the West. The Guild of Chandlers and Clerks and the Guild of Furnishers and Caravaners are two examples to be found in the city. Even these secular-sounding brotherhoods have roots in the veneration of Morrowind's saints.<BR>$0A<BR>$0ARather more sinister are the underground Tongs, which are criminal fraternities and dangerous heretical cults. The Camonna (Thankless) Tong strikes dread into the hearts of outlanders at its merest mention, while the Vel-Osryn (Impertinent) Tong are renowned for their acts of vandalism, both petty and daring. Some of these darker groups may be nothing more than rumor, like the gruesome Issani (Gourmet's) Tong which is often quietly blamed for unexplained disappearances but for whose existence no evidence is known to this author. These are the most secret of secret societies, and even discussing them is a taboo among polite society.<BR>$0A<BR>$0AYou might be wondering whether an outlander may join any of these ancient Dunmer brotherhoods. The answer may disappoint. As bulwarks of tradition most Tongs scorn foreign membership, and one is usually invited to join via family connections. One or two exceptions exist however, and many Tongs run hostels and flin houses that welcome outlander coin. But remember, when you are under the roof of a Tong, be it a bar, a private house or a dedicated building, you are subject to their rules and their laws. Tong halls are everywhere in Almalexia, and often unmarked as such, but ignorance may prove no excuse for disrespect.<BR>$0A
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>阿玛莱西娅的公会内部<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>加拉萨·萨尔武 著<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>如果说维威克城是晨风的心脏，那么阿玛莱西娅就是它的脸面。外乡人对丹莫豪族文化所了解或自以为了解的大部分内容，都源于首都本身。这可能会产生误导，因为阿玛莱西娅独树一帜，在许多方面都独立于其所统治的行省。其中之一便是“公会”或称荣誉社团的角色。公会文化并非这座伟大城市独有，但正是在这里，它发展出了最多样、最奇特的表达方式。城市中的大多数本地居民都属于这些社团之一，即使他们与社团的联系松散且非正式。一些团体拥有相当大的权力，无论这种权力是好是坏。<BR>
<BR>
大多数较为常见的公会类似于帝国行省的教派。在像晨风这样当局不容忍异端的土地上，兄弟会组织会强调审判席信仰中的某一个或另一个元素，但又不挑战总体的神殿教义。因此，我们有“加拉安”（数学家）公会，它尊崇索萨·希尔为神圣的逻辑学家，其成员为他设计谜题，并以此来挑战彼此。相比之下，“索里斯”（盲视）公会尊崇维威克所实践的深海探索与水下呼吸艺术，并致力于这一技能的研究。这些协会中最广为人知的是“莫拉格”（林居者）公会，它尊崇梅法拉，并代表各大家族实施血腥谋杀。偶尔，这些团体中的某一个会偏离神殿正统太远，必须秘密举行仪式，否则将面临神殿卫兵的严厉打击。<BR>
<BR>
这些兄弟会中的一些仅限于特定的行业，在现代，它们往往与西方的行业公会难以区分。烛台与文书公会以及家具与商队公会就是该市中存在的两个例子。即便是这些听起来世俗的兄弟会，其根源也在于对晨风圣徒的崇敬。<BR>
<BR>
更为险恶的是地下公会，它们是犯罪兄弟会和危险的异端教派。“卡莫纳”（不知感恩）公会光提到名字就让外乡人胆战心惊，而“维尔-奥斯林”（无礼）公会则以其或轻或重的破坏行为而闻名。其中一些较为黑暗的团体可能只是谣言，例如可怕的“伊萨尼”（美食家）公会，它常常被私下指责为无法解释的失踪事件的元凶，但笔者并未发现其存在的证据。这些都是最秘密的秘密社团，即使在文明社会中谈论它们也是一种禁忌。<BR>
<BR>
你可能想知道外乡人是否可以加入这些古老的丹莫兄弟会。答案可能会让你失望。作为传统的堡垒，大多数公会轻视外族成员，通常会通过家族关系邀请加入。然而，存在一两个例外，并且许多公会经营着旅店和弗林酒馆，欢迎外乡人的钱币。但请记住，当你置身于公会的屋檐下时，无论是酒吧、私宅还是专用建筑，你都要受他们规则和法律的约束。公会在阿玛莱西娅随处可见，常常没有标记，但无知不能作为无礼的借口。<BR>

我凝视地平线，
看着大海以其暗色威严闪闪发光，
盐米在轻拂的微风中轻轻摇曳，

我看到峭壁鸟迅速飞过，
比湮灭的产物更大胆，
它们栖息在我年少时熟知的树木间，
它们的叫声尖锐而响亮，
汇入这些花园的壮丽之中。<BR>
<BR>
当玛格努斯低垂在土地之上，
在月亮尚未升起之前，
天空中可见余烬，
金煌明亮的太阳隐没于黄昏，
我们的感官变得敏锐，
随着麝香被吹散，
与我们的心灵一起，形成了一曲记忆的合奏。
我们的心灵编织出宁静安魂曲的形状，
这一切为我们，当喜悦流过我们的猩红眼眸，
当夜空的光辉牵引着我们的心灵
并满足我们的欲望。<BR>
<BR>
心与魂的面容<BR>
<BR>
我的心脏承受着这样迸发的压力，
当我置身于这令人惊叹的面容之中，
一个盛满奢华佳酿的圣杯在我面前满溢，
我向自己倾诉着过去的冲突，
讲述我如何亲眼目睹山峦崩塌，
化为尘土和奇异的黑暗阴影，
巨大的树木在炽烈怒火的暴虐中倾倒
我的心充满了咸涩，
因为我的眼泪流进了心里。<BR>
<BR>
当天穹敞开大门
并将其宇宙财富抛洒而出，
我双手伸出，去收集这些珍宝
在我的脑海中，我沉思着煽动与不忠，
正是通过这些思绪，
我揣想着毒药斟满我的酒杯。
我感到需要寻求救赎，
以及寻求忏悔的冲动。<BR>
<BR>
当爱充满我心，
伴随着他们诱人的欲望和欢乐，
以及众神对欢愉的许诺，<BR>
<BR>
启迪的思绪充盈我的脑海，
然而我忆起并感受到自身的伤疤，
当我醒来时，梦见了过去的愚蠢，
以及昔日的罪过
然而我在内心深处感到恐惧，
召唤我去寻求拯救，
为过去的错误而赎罪。
这些花园是感知、照明的面容，
也是一种无法被刻意掌握的壮丽。<BR>
<BR>
病态宁静<BR>
对抗我们的主人是痛苦的根源，
如同草叶被撕裂，
当它们矗立在狂风路径上，
我们被吹得四散，屈服了，
由于我们对他们的阴谋。
我们如同见了猎人而畏缩的瓜尔
他们的诡计如同毒药注射，
是每一张嘴都会拒绝的。
何其讽刺。<BR>
<BR>
当瑟昆达升起，
众神呼唤你，寻找
天空染上深红，因疯狂而赤红
时间处于黄昏与黎明，
死亡很快将找到你，
你可能将死于血腥，
我们祈求神圣，与我们同在，
当我们在坚实的土地中找到救赎。
我们被赋予如此悲惨的命运，必须主动寻死。<BR>"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
<BR>
Interrogating Dunmer<BR>
<BR>
The prideful and pompous Dunmer are harder nuts to crack than some races, but as with all others they yield when reasonable pressure is applied. The true test is discovering what constitutes "reasonable pressure" for a given mer. For the best and quickest results, one must attack the Dunmer where the foolish mer reckons his race strong.<BR>
<BR>
The Dark Elves certainly seem to act as though pride is one of their strengths. Turning their arrogance against them can work wonders. For example, Dunmer think themselves the most enlightened of races, with a firm grounding in a false superstition. The Ashlanders - those who do not indulge in the popular superstition - find themselves at odds with Dunmer society. The interrogator working these facts to their advantage might threaten to give a traditional Ashlander tattoo to a boastful House Dunmer.<BR>
<BR>
Continuing along that vein, House Dunmer are especially proud of themselves and their particular House. Each of the Houses hold a reasonable contempt for the others, to rather ridiculous extremes. When interrogating a stubborn House Dunmer, one might procure armor of a different House, and threaten to force the Dunmer to wear it just before releasing him into the welcome arms of his very understanding brothers.<BR>
<BR>
If the above methods fail, or the interrogator finds himself dealing with an Ashlander, other means might be employed. One must understand that direct, physical action should not be the first course, but when other options have exhausted themselves, one must do what one must do.<BR>
<BR>
The Dunmer are highly resilient to the touch of flame, and as a result, they do not properly fear it as other races do. Therefore, exposing them to the full agony that burns can produce would be an almost wholly new sort of pain for a Dunmer. Unexpectedly intense, unexpectedly hurtful, it would be a new sensation. Subjects are much more resistant to familiar forms to interrogation than new and unusual methods. By casting a powerful weakness on them, and holding a torch to the soles of their feet, most Dunmer will not hesitate to volunteer information that would incriminate their own mothers.<BR>
<BR>
Of course, the examples outlined here are just examples, and an interrogator of any skill will invent his own methods, or use old ones in new ways. This manuscript should merely be considered a starting point, rather than a guide book. <BR>
"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
<BR>
审讯丹莫<BR>
<BR>
骄傲自负的丹莫比某些种族更难对付，但和其他人一样，当施加合理的压力时，他们也会屈服。真正的考验在于找出对某个特定精灵来说，什么才算是“合理的压力”。为了取得最佳和最快的结果，必须在这个愚蠢的精灵自以为种族强大的地方攻击他。<BR>
<BR>
丹莫的言行举止显然让人感觉傲慢是他们的优势之一。利用他们的傲慢对付他们可以产生奇效。例如，丹莫认为自己是开化的种族，对于错误的迷信有着坚实的基础。灰烬之民 -- 那些不沉溺于流行迷信的人们 -- 发现自己与丹莫社会格格不入。审讯者利用这些事实为自己谋利，可能会威胁要给一个自夸的家族丹莫纹上传统的灰烬之民纹身。<BR>
<BR>
顺着这个思路，家族丹莫尤其对自己和自己的特定家族感到自豪。各家族之间互相抱以相当的蔑视，甚至到了荒谬的地步。当审讯一个顽固的家族丹莫时，可以弄到另一个家族的盔甲，并威胁要强迫这个丹莫穿上它，然后将他释放到他那非常“善解人意”的兄弟们热情欢迎的怀抱中。<BR>
<BR>
如果上述方法失败，或者审讯者发现自己面对的是一个灰烬之民，则可以采用其他手段。必须明白，直接的物理行动不应该是首选，但当其他选择都已穷尽时，就必须采取必要手段。<BR>
<BR>
丹莫对火焰的伤害具有很高的抵抗力，因此，他们不像其他种族那样真正害怕火焰。所以，让他们充分体验燃烧所能产生的全部痛苦，对丹莫来说将是一种全新的痛苦体验。意想不到地强烈，意想不到地伤人，这将是一种全新的感觉。相比于新奇的方法，受审者对熟悉的审讯方式更具抵抗力。通过对他们施加强大的虚弱术，然后用火炬烤他们的脚底，大多数丹莫会毫不犹豫地主动提供甚至会牵连自己母亲的罪证。<BR>
<BR>
当然，此处列举的只是例子，任何有经验的审讯者都会发明自己的方法，或以新的方式使用旧的方法。这份手稿应仅被视为一个起点，而非一本指南书。<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Ius, Animal God<BR>
By Buljursoma<BR><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
The statues one sees throughout Valenwood and parts of Hammerfell and Elsweyr that seem to be of a misshapen humanoid carrying a rod are of Ius, The God of Animals.<BR><BR>
The rod He carries has its origin in the tale of The Ox and The Evil Farmer. It seems that one day an evil farmer decided to kill all of his animals and have a big party. As The story unfolds, animal after animal is killed and prepared for a big meal. Lastly the farmer comes to the ox and prepares to slit its throat. The ox, not wishing to be anybody's dinner, prayed very vocally to Ius. This came out as a loud Moo, of course.<BR><BR>
At that very instant Ius appeared carrying a rather large set of balance weights. Without explanation, Ius ate the farmer and vanished. Ever since that day Ius The Extremely Agitated, has always been portrayed as carrying a large set of scales with him. The local Ius worshippers have no idea why and do not seem to care. Although this story has been called fanciful at best, I personally know a racoon who had actually talked to The Ox. That is, before the Ox became filler for the local inn's larder. 
I do not have any information one way or the other about the validity of this second myth. It is, however, quite traditional.<BR><BR>
It seems that many, many years ago, before the reign of Uriel Septim VII, before the reign of Cephorus Septim II, yes, even before the age of Pelagius Septim III (long may his name be praised!), there lived a wombat who was the pet of Lady Greelina, daughter of the Lord Prufrock of Rockcreek. Lady Greelina loved her wombat so, and it loved her too with all the passionate intensity a marsupial can muster.<BR><BR>
Unfortunately, it was a time of great sorrow in Rockcreek. A pestilence had come through the town, destroying all their cash crops (which consisted of raspberries and a few scraggly odd weeds that caused Argonian women to look very attractive to those who partook); Then a plague had come, inflicting nearly every cobbler with chronic hiccoughs; finally a witch had cursed the townspeople so the only words any could utter were "Hmmm. Precisely." All the businesses, stores, and guilds fled from the town faster than an extremely fast thing.<BR><BR>
Lady Greelina saw her father despairing the loss the town was suffering, so she brought her wombat in and told him, "Father, my wombat can save us all, for it is sacred to the god Ius, God of Animals. The only reason I didn't tell you earlier is because I am an early adolescent going through that period when I don't like to communicate. But please, ask a wish of my wombat, and Ius will fulfill it, for my wombat loves me."<BR><BR>
The king thought this was fairly flakey, but he had nothing to lose so he uttered a modest wish to the wombat, "All I want is for one business to come to Rockcreek that will never leave no matter the calamity."<BR><BR>
I probably should have mentioned before that the king had always been cruel to the wombat (he used to lick it and try to make it stick to walls), so the wombat had Ius create an equipment store in front of the palace gate that would never go away. The royal family ended up going mad and eating one another (and ironically, the wombat was one of the first to go). But that is why there is to this day an equipment store blocking the palace gate in Rockcreek. If you don't believe me, go there and see.<BR>"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
伊乌斯，动物之神<BR>
布尔朱尔索玛 著<BR><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
在瓦伦伍德、落锤和艾斯维尔的某些地区，人们看到的那种似乎是畸形的人形生物手持棍棒的雕像，便是伊乌斯，动物之神。<BR><BR>
他手持的棍棒源于《牛与邪恶农夫》的故事。似乎有一天，一个邪恶的农夫决定杀光他所有的动物，然后开个盛大的派对。故事展开，一只又一只动物被宰杀，用做一顿大餐的食材。最后，农夫来到公牛面前，准备割断它的喉咙。公牛不想成为任何人的盘中餐，于是大声地向伊乌斯祈祷。当然，发出的声音是一声响亮的“哞”。<BR><BR>
就在那一刻，伊乌斯出现，手里拿着一大套平衡砝码。伊乌斯二话没说，吃掉了农夫，然后消失了。从那天起，“极度激动的伊乌斯”总是被描绘成随身带着一大套天平的形象。当地的伊乌斯崇拜者不知道为什么，似乎也不在乎。尽管这个故事最多只能算是想象力的产物，但我个人认识一只浣熊，它实际上和那头公牛交谈过。当然，那是在公牛成为当地旅馆储藏室的填充物之前。
对于第二个神话的真实性，我没有任何信息证明或反驳它。然而，它确实相当传统。<BR><BR>
似乎在很久很久以前，在尤利尔·塞普汀七世统治之前，在塞弗鲁斯·塞普汀二世统治之前，是的，甚至在佩拉吉乌斯·塞普汀三世（愿他的名被长久称颂！）的时代之前，有一只袋熊，它是岩溪镇普鲁弗洛克勋爵的女儿格瑞琳娜夫人的宠物。格瑞琳娜夫人非常爱她的袋熊，而袋熊也以一只有袋动物所能积聚的全部热情爱着她。<BR><BR>
不幸的是，那段时期岩溪镇充满了悲伤。一场瘟疫席卷了小镇，摧毁了他们所有的经济作物（包括覆盆子和一些稀奇古怪的杂草，这些杂草会让食用者觉得阿尔贡女性看起来非常有吸引力）；接着又来了一场瘟疫，几乎让每一个补鞋匠都患上了慢性打嗝；最后，一个女巫诅咒了镇民，让他们只能说出“嗯。正是如此。”所有企业、商店和公会都以比极快之物更快的速度逃离了小镇。<BR><BR>
格瑞琳娜夫人看到她的父亲为小镇遭受的损失而绝望，于是她把她的袋熊带进来，告诉他：“父亲，我的袋熊可以拯救我们所有人，因为它对动物之神伊乌斯来说是神圣的。我之前没告诉您的唯一原因是我正处于不喜欢交流的青春期早期。但是求求您，向我的袋熊许个愿吧，伊乌斯会实现它的，因为我的袋熊爱我。”<BR><BR>
国王觉得这相当奇怪，但他也没什么可失去的，于是对着袋熊许了一个小小的愿望：“我只希望有一家企业能来到岩溪镇，并且无论发生什么灾难都不会离开。”<BR><BR>
我可能之前应该提到，国王一直对那只袋熊很残忍（他过去常常舔它，并试图把它粘在墙上），所以袋熊让伊乌斯在宫门前造了一家永远不会消失的装备店。王室成员最终发疯并互相残食（具有讽刺意味的是，袋熊是最先遭殃的之一）。但这就是为什么直到今天，岩溪镇的宫殿大门前还有一家装备店挡着路。如果你不相信我，就亲自去看看。<BR>"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
<BR>
A Just Punishment<BR>
By Eraturiel<BR>
<BR>
Londenrume studied the tavern from his usual seat, casually filtering out the conversations of the other regulars. He did not come for food or drink, or to overhear their petty trifles. What concerned him was news from afar that travelers - the unusual lot - brought in. Information was always useful, even if that use was not immediately apparent.<BR>
<BR>
As luck would have it, two unfamiliar Nords stalked in. Luck, however, was not kind enough to make them carelessly start conversing their business to all within earshot. That made them doubly curious: Besides being strangers, the Nords broke the seemingly unwritten Nordic rule of bragging loudly of their brave and foolish exploits. Most especially the foolish ones. But these two sat in silence, staring sullenly at the other patrons. They opened their mouths only to order more liquor or foodstuffs, and did even that with an air of hushed importance.<BR>
<BR>
As Londenrume watched them without seeming to watch them, he knew their eyes were surveying the room in just the same way. They were looking for something. With typical Nords, he would have suspected a fight. But these fellows made no motions toward their weapons, and he did not sense the usual pre-battle tension in them. A waitress serving the patron on Londenrume's left distracted him for a moment, and when he quickly looked without looking back at the Nords, they were gone.<BR>
<BR>
Shaking his head in stifled curiosity, Londenrume suddenly stiffened. He felt hand on his shoulder as one of the Nords took the seat to his right and his fellow stood behind and between them. The bearded Nord at the seat, the elder of the two, studied Londenrume's face, his dark, hard eyes betraying nothing.<BR>
<BR>
"High Elf," he began "we have need of your services." Saying no more, he waited for some response.<BR>
<BR>
After beat, Londenrume asked "And how would two unfamiliar men such as yourselves know what sort of services I might offer?"<BR>
<BR>
The grey bearded Nord turned on the stool to face the bar while he talked. "You are an Altmer. You wear robes without the creak of armor below. Your hands fit around a plate as if it were a book. You might look around shifty like a thief, but you are a wizard." It wasn't a question, but the Nord let it hang in the air as if it were.<BR>
<BR>
"Congratulations," Londenrume stated flatly "you have figured out that an Altmer uses magic."<BR>
<BR>
"Let's not waste each other's time. You know we were looking for someone like you. As I said, we have need of your services."<BR>
<BR>
Londenrume answered flippantly, "Indeed, I do not intend to waste any time. I'm not interested."<BR>
<BR>
At that, Londenrume felt a dagger poke lightly into his back as the other Nord stepped close in to cover the blade from prying eyes. All around them, regular tavern chatter continued unabated. The Nord with the dagger hissed "You are a sharp mer. My blade is sharper still, but you are a sharp mer. I know you do not recall us asking for your services, because we did not."<BR>
<BR>
The older Nord chimed in, "As he says. This is not a matter of requesting. This is not a negotiation. I said we were looking for someone like you. I said we had need of your services. I say now, you will come with us, travel with us, and cast spells for us. When you are no longer needed, you are free to do what you will."<BR>
<BR>
The second Nord continued, "If you give us trouble now, you will die. We might be caught, and we might not. But you will be dead. I know you understand me."<BR>
<BR>
After an uncomfortable silence, the bearded Nord clapped Londenrume on the shoulder. "It's settled then," he said loudly. "Come then, friend. Much road lies before us. Much work to be done."<BR>
<BR>
As the group passed through the tavern door, Londenrume cast one last glance back. None of the other patrons had noticed.<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
Travel was a nightmare for Londenrume. The Nords set a murderous pace, and the frozen lands of northern High Rock seemed to conspire against him. The one saving grace was that Haeflig, the younger Nord, stalked out ahead and killed anything that troubled him. Considering the relative ease with which he dispatched the odd malevolent beast, Londenrume would not have been surprised had the powerful youth claimed nothing troubled him at all. That they could cover so much harsh ground so quickly, and that Haeflig could swing his axe so tirelessly along the way did much to banish from Londenrume's mind the notion of fleeing his captors.<BR>
<BR>
At the end of the fourth day's marching, when they prepared a rudimentary camp, Traskig, the elder Nord, decided it was time to share some information with Londenrume. As was his habit, the bearded Nord gave up little.<BR>
<BR>
"Elf. A ship was wrecked off the western Skyrim coast. That's where we're going." When Londenrume pried for more, all Traskig would say was "A day after we pass Jehanna, you go your way, we go ours. Keep asking questions, your way will be in the ground."<BR>
<BR>
After another four wretched days, the small party looked out over the bitterly frigid coastline of Skyrim. The Nords called for halt at what looked like just another stretch of water to Londenrume. Talking among themselves, they each nodded, convinced that this was the spot they'd been seeking. Shivering against the wind, the Altmer walked cautiously over to his kidnappers.<BR>
<BR>
"You said before I was a sharp mer." he said through chattering teeth, "Since I've been dragged uselessly along while the two of you cleared the way, I take it this is what you needed me for?"<BR>
<BR>
"Yes, elf." Haeflig answered, "The ship has sunk far below where we can reach it. We would have gotten a spell caster closer to home, but only we know of the ship, and telling one local means fifty would know. Don't need the competition. Just need someone competent to cast a spell of water breathing."<BR>
<BR>
"Don't you worry about the water?" Londenrume asked.<BR>
<BR>
Traskig had looked annoyed with Haeflig for having volunteered so much information, but at that both could not help but laugh openly. "We are Nords, elf. We bathe ourselves in snow. These waters? Tepid." Haeflig continued chuckling, with typical Nord bravado.<BR>
<BR>
Londenrume quickly silenced them by asking if he would get a cut of the loot from the sunken ship. Traskig turned his cold, hard eyes on the Altmer and with equal warmth told him "Of course. We will spread everything out on the ground, appraise it, and split the take in half. My half, Haeflig's half, and your half."<BR>
<BR>
Quietly, Londenrume stated "Three halves aren't a whole."<BR>
<BR>
"Oh yes they are, elf." Traskig stared a hole through Londenrume, "All halves have the same value. Our halves tell us how much gold will line our pockets. Yours tells you how much your life is worth, how much it takes for us not to kill you."<BR>
<BR>
Londenrume wanted to laugh back in their faces, and call them for the fools they were, but somehow held his contempt in. When the Nords demanded he cast the water breathing spell, he cast it. Of course, it didn't last as long as they'd hoped. A pity, thought Londenrume as they struggled vainly to the surface. Whatever treasures they sought, they would indeed get to spend eternity with. Unless the slaughterfish tore their corpses apart. A just punishment for being foolish enough to threaten one upon whom your life depended. <BR>

公正的惩罚<BR>

The young boy lay drowsing in the palace orchard, high on a breezy hill overlooking the deep blue bay of Daggerfall. The constant autumn fog of Daggerfall had blown away for the nonce and the sky was a deep endless blue. Moments like this were rare for young Prince Edward; this afternoon was the result of days of scheming, for he craved solitude as the other nobles he knew craved companionship. Now his tutor believed him engaged in extra arms practice, the master of arms believed him to be chasing deer with the huntmaster, who thought he was studying Elvish. His father had no idea where he was and didn't care, being occupied with his young wife and their sons and other pleasures of noble life.<BR><BR>
At the plop of an apple barely missing his head, he opened his pale grey eyes; there was a sweet rotten smell in his nostrils. He sighed and stared up into the blue. Why should things fall down instead of up? If you stared at the sky long enough you could feel as if you were falling into it his eyes glazed and the pupils grew huge as the dark-ringed irises dilated. Edward's gaze shifted rapidly over the four beings in front of him, unable to find a comfortable resting place. He hoped briefly, fervently, that he was dreaming. "I am. I did. Will he? Shall we call him and find out?" The dark elf straightened and his eyes glowed deeper. A tiny puff of steam escaped the dragon's nostrils. A glowing aura appeared around his companion. Edward knew he wasn't going to call the guard. Why should they be slaughtered? These two looked capable of anything. Quite suddenly he was no longer afraid. If they were here to hurt him, they'd have done it by now. But a feeling of impotent rage remained. They'd taken his mother. And now.<BR><BR>
"Why are you here?" he demanded.<BR><BR>
"Edward, will you come with us?" The high elf spoke. Hearing him was like hearing a harp, cool as a breeze, warm as a fireside.<BR><BR>
The boy stood very still. He wanted very much to say yes, to his own amazement. He wanted to ask if he would see his mother, but instead: "My father..." he croaked.<BR><BR>
"Will miss you no doubt." The irony was back in Moraelyn's voice, a voice that made Edward think of icicles sparkling and dripping in winter sun. But there was a sort of hunger in his glowing eyes, a longing?<BR><BR>
His father wouldn't miss him and he knew it. Shame ran through the boy, but he looked up at the broad-shouldered elf defiantly. "Are you my father?" Edward had meant the question to match the elf's sarcasm, but his hand crept to his ear as if of itself. "Does my mother have other sons?" Suddenly Edward knew she did not and that the question would hurt the dark elf. And was glad.<BR><BR>
"Your mother might be dead, for all you know. Or care, it seems." The dark elf's narrow nostrils twitched as if Edward stank, and the lines around his mouth deepened. She was not dead. Edward would have known. The bitter injustice of Moraelyn's contempt stung. "Did she send you to me?"<BR><BR>
"Do you take me for an errand boy!" he snapped, and spoke to his companion: "Let us take him now and be gone; we may discuss it at leisure."<BR><BR>
The golden elf held up his hand, "Patience, my cousin." and, to Edward, "Well, youngling, will you come?"<BR><BR>
Dark tales were told of human children kidnapped by elves, who hungered for young humans<BR><BR>

The dragon spat a bit of flame, but the unicorn did not move; its golden eyes regarded Edward steadily. "Unicorns do not abide any sort of falsity." The words floated through his mind in his mother's voice.<BR><BR>
"I'ric Harad Egun the ArchMagister, I will come with you."<BR><BR>

Edward screamed down, noting the upturned faces of his stepmother and her red-haired sons. Roane had a fur-trimmed robe clutched round her, but her long hair floated wildly. Four pairs of eyes fastened on him, not Moraelyn, glittering with fury and hatred. Edward stopped waving and clutched Shag tightly with both hands. Moraelyn's mail clad arm was securely about his waist. Edward slumped against him, feeling quite safe for the first time in a very long while. The bowmen had stopped shooting; most of them were looking at the royal family. The king danced with rage. The great dragon's wings beat harder now and they headed due south out over the water.<BR><BR>

"Why did you wait so long to fetch me?"<BR><BR>
"Querulous child, do you think dragons and unicorns do the bidding of elves or men? Your mother came to me full willing, but she could not bring you; you were too closely guarded by your father's men. Would you have had us lay waste your land to take you by force? She thought you would be safe and cared for and she was desperate. No, this was the dragon's plan."<BR><BR>
Of all the astonishing events of the afternoon, this was the most surprising: the notion that a dragon should take an interest in him, when not even his own family did. But, willing, the elf said, full willing!<BR><BR>
"You are the focus of large events, youngling. Your task is to prepare yourself to be a king; a king such as your people have never known. Our task is to aid you. Sleep now."<BR><BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
爱德华国王，第一部<BR>

第一章：离开匕落<BR><BR><BR>
很久很久以前，正值世界之春，在红卫人到来和辉煌的塞普汀帝国形成之前，但在哥布林将矮人赶出落锤之后，匕落国王科尔西尔一世与他的王后、途歇的阿莱拉生了一个儿子，取名爱德华。<BR><BR>
男孩躺在宫殿的果园里打盹，果园坐落于一座微风轻拂的高丘上，俯瞰着匕落的深蓝海湾。匕落那常年不断的秋雾暂时散去，天空是深邃无垠的蓝色。对于年轻的爱德华王子来说，这样的时刻很少见；这个下午是他几天策划的结果，因为他渴望独处，就如同他所认识的其他贵族渴望陪伴一样。此刻，他的导师以为他在进行额外的武器训练，武器大师以为他在和猎场看守追鹿，而猎场看守则以为他在学习精灵语。他的父亲不知道他在哪里，也不在乎，他正忙于和年轻妻子以及他们的儿子们，还有其他贵族生活的乐趣。<BR><BR>
一个苹果“噗”的一声落下，差点砸中他的头，他睁开了淡灰色的眼睛；鼻孔里闻到一股甜腻的腐烂气味。他叹了口气，凝视着蓝色的天空。为什么东西会向下落而不是向上？如果你盯着天空足够久，你会感觉自己仿佛在坠入其中......他的眼神变得呆滞，随着深色眼圈的眼瞳扩大，瞳孔也变得巨大。他感觉身体失重，漂浮着......另一个苹果落下，擦过他的耳朵，他重重地摔在地上，先是臀部着地，然后是头，他疼得叫出了声。一声银铃般的笑声响起。爱德华猛地坐起来，下巴松开，目瞪口呆地环顾四周。<BR><BR>
两个骑马的人站在十英尺外，一动不动，如同石雕，专注地注视着他。王子们不容易被吓倒，即使是天性温和的那种，但爱德华从未见过或想象过这样的一对。一人有着金色的皮肤和眼睛，身着镶金边的白色长袍，骑着一匹（爱德华眨了眨眼。它还在）独角兽！独角兽旁边是一头金色的龙，翅膀整齐地折叠着。龙背上是一个穿着深色链甲的男人，腰间挂着一把长剑。他光着头；深色脸庞上的眼睛闪着红光，尖尖的耳朵......“你们是精灵！什么！”<BR><BR>
“他是个聪明的孩子。”黑暗精灵的声音带着讽刺。爱德华注意到，他说的是完美的布莱顿语，他的大脑仍在运转，虽然他的身体其他部分好像出了问题。<BR><BR>
“看来如此。他多半是靠自己做到的。对于一个未经训练的孩子来说，这很了不起。我只是帮他集中了注意力。”高精灵也说了布莱顿语，但有些犹豫，带着轻微的歌唱口音。爱德华的导师曾说，精灵是无法说人类语言的。<BR><BR>
爱德华的目光在他面前的四个生物身上快速扫过，找不到一个舒适的落点。他短暂、热切地希望自己是在做梦。他的思绪充满了疑问和要求，然后突然间，他的舌头恢复了功能。“但我根本没在集中注意力！我的导师们都说我做不到。”爱德华紧紧咬住下巴，突然意识到和这样的存在争论可能不明智。<BR><BR>
但是金色精灵咧开嘴笑了，露出完美洁白的牙齿，“正是如此。”他散发出如此温暖的赞许，爱德华感到自己的皮肤愉悦地刺痛起来。这种感觉，他只在已故的母亲身上感受过。但另一个精灵的面孔毫无表情；那双红色的眼睛仿佛要刺穿爱德华的灵魂一般盯着他。<BR><BR>
“莫拉林！你是莫拉林！巫术之王！”他一跃而起，面对着黑暗精灵。“你偷走了我的母亲！我父亲会杀了你。”<BR><BR>
“是我。我偷的。他会吗？我们要不要把他叫来问问？”黑暗精灵挺直身体，眼睛的光芒更深了。一小股蒸汽从龙的鼻孔喷出。他的同伴周围出现了一道发光的灵气。爱德华知道他不会叫守卫了。为什么要让他们被屠杀呢？这两个人看起来无所不能。突然间，他不再害怕了。如果他们是要伤害他，他们早就动手了。但一种徒劳的愤怒感依然存在。他们带走了他的母亲。而现在......<BR><BR>
“你们为什么在这里？”他质问道。<BR><BR>
“爱德华，你愿意跟我们走吗？”高精灵说话。听他的声音如同听竖琴，清凉如微风，温暖如炉边。<BR><BR>
男孩一动不动地站着。令他自己惊讶的是，他非常想说“愿意”。他本想问是否能看到母亲，但却问出口：“我父亲......”他声音沙哑。<BR><BR>
“无疑会想念你的。”莫拉林的声音里又带上了讽刺，这种声音让爱德华想起冬日阳光下闪闪发光、滴着水的冰柱。但他发光的眼睛里带着某种渴望，一种向往？<BR><BR>
他父亲不会想他的，他知道。羞愧在男孩心中蔓延，但他挑衅地抬头看着那个宽肩膀的精灵。“你是我父亲吗？”爱德华本想用这个问题回应精灵的讽刺，但他的手下意识地摸向了自己的耳朵。他和他那个脾气暴躁、性格豪爽、红发的父亲一点也不像，而罗恩常说他看起来有股精灵相。<BR><BR>
一阵沉重的沉默，爱德华察觉到莫拉林表面上是认真对待这个问题，但真相与他接下来要说的话无关。他会给出一个方便的回答。尽管如此。<BR><BR>
“不。”回答得有些不情愿。当然，他可能在撒谎，但爱德华感到一阵深深的解脱。<BR><BR>
“我母亲还有其他儿子吗？”爱德华突然知道她没有，而且这个问题会伤到那个黑暗精灵。他为此感到高兴。<BR><BR>
“你母亲可能已经死了，就你所知。或者在乎，看起来是这样。”黑暗精灵窄窄的鼻孔抽动着，好像爱德华身上有臭味，嘴角的皱纹加深了。她没有死。爱德华本该知道的。莫拉林的轻蔑所带来的痛苦和不公刺痛了他。“是她派你来找我的吗？”<BR><BR>
“你把我当成跑腿的了吗！”他厉声说，然后对他的同伴说：“我们现在就带走他，走吧；我们可以之后再慢慢讨论。”<BR><BR>
金色的精灵举起手，“耐心点，我的表亲。”然后对爱德华说，“那么，小家伙，你愿意来吗？”<BR><BR>
曾有黑暗的传说讲精灵会绑架人类小孩，他们渴望年幼的人类......<BR><BR>
“我不知道你的名字，”爱德华拖延道。<BR><BR>

“啊。而且你将回到这里统治它，爱德华王子。我，大导师伊瑞克·哈拉德·伊冈，向你发誓。”莫拉林转过身来，用精灵语尖锐地抗议。龙喷出了一点火焰，但独角兽没有动；它金色的眼睛稳稳地看着爱德华。“独角兽不容忍任何形式的虚假。”这句话以他母亲的声音在他脑海中回荡。<BR><BR>
“大导师伊瑞克·哈拉德·伊冈，我愿意跟你们走。”<BR><BR>

“你会，”莫拉林打断了他；他抓住爱德华的腰带，把他扔到了龙背上。爱德华在龙的脖子和翅膀之间安顿下来，睡着的夏格软塌塌地搭在他身前。“没有地方给......”爱德华开口，然后吃惊地抽搐了一下，因为他身下的龙挪动着，变大了。变得非常、非常、非常大。莫拉林以一个身着盔甲者难以置信的跳跃翻身上来。独角兽跳过了九英尺高的墙，干净利落地越过。龙的巨大翅膀展开；它蹲伏下来，然后跃入空中。它背上的骑手们剧烈摇晃。黑暗精灵用爱德华听不懂的精灵语嘀咕了一句，他们便稳住了。翅膀有力地拍打着，龙绕着堡垒低飞，缓缓升高。人们四下奔跑，喊叫着，指指点点。爱德华看到了他的老保姆，挥手喊道：“再见！再见！总有一天我会回来的......”弓箭手射箭，箭支嗖嗖飞过，保姆尖叫着，紧紧抓住最近的人的手臂。科尔西尔国王赤裸着跑上城垛，尖叫着挥舞拳头。“恶魔的孩子，回来，我要把你打成半死。莫拉林，下来像个男人一样战斗，虽然你不是男人。”<BR><BR>

在当天下午所有令人惊异的事件中，这是最令人惊讶的：一条龙竟然对他感兴趣，而连他自己的家人都没有。但是，精灵说，心甘情愿！心甘情愿地来到他身边！<BR><BR>
“你是重大事件的焦点，小家伙。你的任务是为成为国王做准备；一个你们的人民从未见过的国王。我们的任务是帮助你。现在睡吧。”<BR><BR>
一阵阵睡意向爱德华的脑海袭来。“但是......”他想问莫拉林关于母亲的事，但最后一阵睡意太强了；它直接盖过了他，他陷入了黑暗而充满火光梦境的深渊。<BR>"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
King Edward, Part II<BR>

Chapter 2: Reunion at Firsthold<BR><BR><BR>
Edward woke to a red sky. The sun was just peeking over the western mountains. They were nearing a glittering tower, fire flashing from every facet. The dragon veered to fly nearer and shot a long blast of flame. A light flashed several times from the tower's top as they dropped suddenly. Edward's stomach felt very peculiar. He sighed and stirred and felt Moraelyn shift so that his right arm now held Edward. He stretched and yawned.<BR><BR>
"Not much longer now. It's several days by horse from the Crystal Tower to Firsthold but I judge that Akatosh will have us there within the hour."<BR><BR>
"We're not stopping at the Tower? I'ric..."<BR><BR>
"Do not use that name so lightly, not even to me. The ArchMagister will not return for days yet. Unicorns are brothers to the wind and travel as fast, even burdened, but not as fast as dragons fly. You see the Elven homeland at dawn from the back of a dragon. Count yourself fortunate among men."<BR><BR>
Edward's gaze roamed the deep green woods and rugged hills. There was no sign of habitation. "It's lovely," he said politely, "but not so beautiful as High Rock," he added out of loyalty and truth. "Are there no towns or villages or farms?"<BR><BR>
"The Firstborn live nestled deep in the trees. And they do not tear up the earth and plant anew, but take gladly what Auriel offers, and make return. Ahhh, the green smell of growing things."<BR><BR>
Indeed, the air was as heady as the wine Edward used to sip from his father's cup, before... "I'm hungry."<BR><BR>
"I expect so." A bit of shifting and Moraelyn's left hand produced a small leaf-wrapped package. The dusky hand was large and strong and looked neither human nor animal. Edward stared at it with revulsion, then took the package gingerly so as not to touch the hand. He felt Moraelyn stiffen and the hand that held Edward relaxed its grasp a bit. Edward felt ashamed of his reaction. It was neither kind nor wise to give offense in the circumstances. Moraelyn could quite easily drop him overboard. "I need to bathe, but so do you," he said stiffly. Moraelyn was deliberately misinterpreting the reaction, Edward knew. "Yes, I'm very dirty," Edward bit into the cake which proved much better than it looked. "My lady mother's used to seeing me like this, at least she used to be. But perhaps I should bathe first?"<BR><BR>
"I think you will not be offered that choice. Ah, at last!" The dragon spread his wings, sent a huge gout of flame soaring skyward and dropped to earth in a large clearing. The landing was abrupt and jarring. Elves appeared quite suddenly and arms reached up to take him and Shag, who woke at last, ran frantically in circles, and then sat panting at Edward's feet.<BR><BR>
A tall elf with fiery hair like copper greeted them formally. "Greetings, my lord King. Your lady wife awaits you. Prince Edward, I welcome you to the land of the Firstborn on behalf of all its people. May your stay here prove pleasant and productive."<BR><BR>
Moraelyn nodded deferentially. "Thank you, my host. My Queen has waited long enough; we will go to her now." Moraelyn's hand on his shoulder steered Edward toward the largest tree he'd ever seen. The trunk was hollow; steps inside led up; openings gave out onto more steps and bridges along and among the mighty branches. They proceeded along these until they reached a large canopied platform, furnished with seats and chests as if it were a room. A golden skinned woman smiled at them and waved them in, then left. A tall slender, pale-skinned, dark-haired human woman paced toward them, her eyes on Edward. Only Edward.<BR><BR>
"Why did you leave us!" The cry came from deep inside, ringing through him. It stopped her several paces from him. Now her eyes lifted to Moraelyn, who said in a harsher tone than Edward had yet heard from him. "Thou wilt address thy Mother with respect, cub!" A glancing blow made his eyes water.<BR><BR>
Aliera crossed quickly to Moraelyn and placed her hands on his chest. "Greeting, my husband. All praise to Notorgo for bringing you and my son safely to me."<BR><BR>
"Thank also the Lord of the Dragons and the Bandit, who could not have lifted the boy more neatly himself. The ArchMagister had somewhat to do with it as well." Moraelyn's dusky hands came up to hold her bare arms lightly and tenderly. He laughed, looking relaxed and happy. But the hands against his chest formed a barrier as much as a caress.<BR><BR>
"I am blessed indeed. But it has been long since my son and I have spoken. We may find words more easily if we seek them alone together."<BR><BR>
Moraelyn's smile vanished instantly. "Are words then a thing which two can find more easily than three? Well. Perhaps. At times. Wife." He turned on his heel and left. The bridge swung and creaked, but his feet made no sound at all.<BR><BR>
Aliera watched after him, but he did not look back. Edward felt again the curious mix of satisfaction and regret that came with giving pain to his enemy. "Edward, my son, come and sit by me."<BR><BR>

"What have you been told?"<BR><BR>

"Would you hear why I left your father or why I did not take you with me, having chosen to go."<BR><BR>
Edward paused, thinking, "Madam, I would hear the truth, therefore I must give the truth. I would hear why you left me behind. The other, I think I know, as much as I can or would know, unless you wish to tell me more or other."<BR><BR>

Corcyr had no use for the land and he wanted the weapons very much indeed -- there are none better -- so he favored the proposal. There were many details to be discussed and arranged and it fell to me to conduct these negotiations. Corcyr despises Dark Elves and he was jealous of Moraelyn, who was already famed as the finest fighter in all Tamriel.<BR><BR>

I had long since retired with the other ladies so I know not what it was, but I'd heard enough in private to know that Corcyr had a store of such to choose from. Moraelyn gave the challenge and gave Corcyr until noon, that he might recover such wits as he had.<BR><BR>

I can live without your love, but I would not have your enmity. Come with me now, as wife or honored guest, as you choose. And you shall serve as blood price in stead of your kith or kin.'<BR><BR>

Or possibly that of the man I loved, though I counted that most unlikely. Moraelyn's fighting skills alone were supreme, and in an affair of this sort he would be entitled to call on magic aid as well. 'We could take him with us.' But Moraelyn shook his head sadly, 'That I will not do. It would go against my honor to part father and son.'"<BR><BR>
"Leaving love alone, I am trained to duty", Aliera said proudly. "Should I have robbed you of your father or your loving uncle? And I thought it likely that Corcyr, should he survive, would somehow blame me for the affair and use it as an excuse to put me away. I thought that Corcyr would be pleased to have me gone. I knew he wanted the weapons very much. I could trade them for time with you, I thought." All this passed through my mind while Moraelyn stood waiting, not looking at me.<BR><BR>
"Lady Mara, help me to choose wisely, I prayed. 'You truly want me as wife? I could bring you nothing but trouble.'"<BR><BR>
"'Aliera, I would have you to wife. And I want nothing but yourself.' He shed his cloak and wrapped it round my body, pulling the bedclothes away."<BR><BR>
"'Moraelyn, wait is this right, what I do?'"<BR><BR>
"'Milady, if I thought this wrong, I should not be standing here! Of the choices you are given, this one seems to me most right.' He swung me up in his arms and carried me to his horse. And so I left your father's house, clad only in his cloak and riding before him. And wild joy mixed with my sorrow, so that I scarce knew how I felt. That is my truth."<BR><BR>

Very strange, since he was small for his age. Instead she said, "You're just as I thought you'd be," with deep maternal satisfaction.<BR><BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
爱德华国王，第二部<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
第二章：首堡重逢<BR><BR><BR>
爱德华醒来时，天空泛着红色。太阳刚刚从西边的山脉露出头来。他们正接近一座闪闪发光的高塔，火光从每一个面上闪烁。龙转向靠近高塔，并喷出一长串火焰。随着他们突然下降，塔顶多次闪烁出光芒。爱德华的胃感觉非常奇怪。他叹了口气，动了动，感觉到莫拉林挪动了一下，他的右臂现在搂着爱德华。他伸了个懒腰，打了个哈欠。<BR><BR>
“现在不会太久了。从水晶塔骑马来首堡需要好几天，但我估计阿卡托什会在一小时内把我们送到那里。”<BR><BR>
“我们不在塔那里停吗？伊瑞克......”<BR><BR>

莫拉林恭敬地点点头。“谢谢你，我的主人。我的王后已经等得够久了；我们现在就去见她。”莫拉林的手搭在爱德华的肩膀上，引着他走向他见过的最大的树。树干是空心的；里面的台阶向上延伸；开口通向更多的台阶和沿着（以及位于）巨大树枝间的桥梁。他们沿着这些往前走，直到到达一个带有华盖的大平台，平台上布置着座椅和箱子，如同一个房间。一个金色皮肤的女人向他们微笑，招手让他们进去，然后离开了。一个高挑苗条、皮肤白皙、深色头发的人类女子向他们走来，她的目光落在爱德华身上。只落在爱德华身上。<BR><BR>

The golden days passed swiftly. Edward spent most of his time in the company of his parents. He saw few other children. None at all lived in 'their' tree, only their wood elf host and Moraelyn's six Companions, an oddly assorted, cheerful lot. Disrespectful, Edward thought. None of the Daggerfall court or servants would dared have addressed his father as these did Moraelyn and Aliera with their constant raillery. But these weren't servants or courtiers. Just Companions. Only one was a Dark Elf. Moraelyn only really liked being alone when he was composing a ballad.<BR><BR>

金色的日子飞快流逝。爱德华大部分时间都和父母在一起。他很少见到其他孩子。他们的“树”里完全没有其他孩子居住，只有他们的木精灵主人和莫拉林的六个同伴，他们是群奇特的、快乐的家伙。爱德华觉得他们很无礼。匕落宫廷或仆人中，没有人敢像这些家伙对莫拉林和阿莱拉那样不断地嘲笑。但他们不是仆人或朝臣。只是同伴。其中只有一个丹莫。还有一个卡吉特女人，两个木精灵（兄妹），一个诺德男人（甚至比莫拉林还高大），还有一个长相奇怪的、像蜥蜴一样的男人，说着一口嘶嘶作响的口音，爱德华几乎听不懂他在说什么。那个诺德男人被称为“莫拉林的奴隶”或简称“奴隶”，尽管莫拉林通常叫他“马茨”或“我的奴隶”。马茨负责打理大家的武器，并为晚上的篝火收集木柴。但其他人带木柴回来也并不罕见；莫拉林自己常常借马茨的斧头，如果需要，或者他愿意的话，也会去砍柴和劈柴。<BR><BR>

莫拉林笔直地站着，似乎在考虑这件事。“我不能吗？”他嘲弄道。<BR><BR>
“爱德华，求你了......”阿莱拉向他恳求道。<BR><BR>
“告诉我，王子殿下，如果不能背，那肉是怎么到餐桌上的？如果王子不能背肉，那么国王和王后当然也不能，或者王子们是在成为国王后就改掉了这种无能吗？”<BR><BR>
“他们有仆人！”<BR><BR>
“侍候蚂蚁？多聪明的想法。只有人类才能想出这个！我注意到蚂蚁非常擅长搬运，尽管我没有指挥它们的诀窍。也许你可以教我。”<BR><BR>
“仆人！就像这里的马茨，”爱德华喊道。他讨厌被戏弄。马茨和其他同伴听到了他们为猎物争吵的叫喊声，走了过来。<BR><BR>
“马茨？你以为我不能让你背鹿肉，却能让马茨背？”莫拉林仰头盯着金发巨人。“好吧，不试试怎么知道。马茨，背鹿。”<BR><BR>
金发巨人若有所思地挠了挠头和下巴。“陛下，没有什么比这更让我高兴的了，但这头鹿太大了，而且我的旧伤后背有些疼，也许您杀一头小点儿的。”<BR><BR>
“好了，王子，现在怎么办？”<BR><BR>
“你揍他。”<BR><BR>
“凭什么？我能跑过他。马茨，如果我比你先到那棵橡树，你背鹿吗？”马茨慢慢地摇了摇头。<BR><BR>
“你用棍子打他！”爱德华喊道。<BR><BR>
“作为治疗师，你展现出了多大的潜质啊，我的王子。请原谅我，在你接受进一步训练之前，我不会向你咨询。据我判断，用棍子打并不能改善马茨的背。当然，我可能错了。”<BR><BR>
“希尔克，你背鹿。”<BR><BR>
“我，大人？很抱歉，但我刚想起来，我是天堂女王蒂贝拉第五家族的第四代表亲。我的尊严不允许我背任何东西。”<BR><BR>
威洛和比奇声称，一位法师禁止他们在乔恩月亮升起时携带动物的任何部分。<BR><BR>
“王子，你确定这个规矩是真的吗？它似乎让生活变得极为不便。我们可以把木柴运到鹿这儿，但这需要好几个小时，会让我们在这过夜。我们也可以当场生吃，但我自己觉得肚子还没空到觉得这个选择有吸引力。阿莱拉，你能帮我们吗？高岩人是怎样把肉端上餐桌的？”<BR><BR>
“陛下，我住在那儿的时候，坚信肉是魔法变来的。有仆人，但他们是一群令人恼火、懒惰的家伙，带来的麻烦比他们本身的价值还多。爱德华，我的儿子，这规矩有没有可能只适用于高岩？”<BR><BR>
“我想是吧......”<BR><BR>
爱德华背了一份压弯他腰的肉，但他没有抱怨。于是就这么定了，那晚的晚餐充满了欢乐。但在接下来的几天里，每当同伴们看到他背着什么，就会焦急地问，高岩的王子是否可以这样做。<BR><BR>
“如果马茨不是仆人，那他们为什么叫他‘莫拉林的奴隶’？”一个昏昏欲睡的下午，爱德华问道。<BR><BR>
“嗯，他是我的奴隶。我花金子买来的，花光了米斯和我所有的积蓄。我们在帝国帕斯要塞附近遇到一个人正在打他。他看起来奄奄一息；当我和米斯试图阻止殴打时，那人说马茨是个逃跑的奴隶，他想怎么处置就怎么处置。于是我扔下金子，告诉他可以拿着金子离开，否则我就亲手杀了他。他选择了后者，所以我告诉马茨，让他作为他主人的继承者拿走金子，想去哪就去哪。他选择和我们一起走，于是我们把金子和他的主人一起埋了，从那以后马茨就一直和我们在一起。”<BR><BR>
“如果他愿意，他能离开吗？”<BR><BR>
“当然可以。”<BR><BR>
“我能去那边摘些浆果吗？”爱德华问道，莫拉林点了点头。<BR><BR>
阿莱拉蜷着身子睡着了。莫拉林坐在她旁边，靠在一棵树上，手玩弄着她长长的黑色卷发。他的眼睛和皮肤对明亮的阳光过敏。夏格在旁边的阳光下伸着懒腰睡着，深色的皮毛在光线下闪烁着银光。爱德华走到灌木丛边，采摘着明亮的发光浆果 -- 之所以这么叫是因为它们会在夜晚发光，尽管现在它们呈现出一种相当暗淡的灰色。但它们味道很好。他想，如果他吃得够多，晚上会不会也发光？或者他把浆果捣碎收集汁液......灌木丛勾住了他，然后他发现了一条穿过灌木丛的隧道，便沿着它小跑，想知道它通向哪里。<BR><BR>
隧道尽头是一小片空地，前面是一堆岩石。有一个洞，洞里有什么东西。爱德华后退了一步，喉咙里发出了细小的声响。那东西动了一下，露出一张长着獠牙的、咆哮的脸和刨着地的蹄子。<BR><BR>
男孩慢慢后退。野兽的头低下来，肩膀耸起，庞大的身躯笨重地冲了过来。爱德华试图扑进灌木丛 -- 但没有空间 -- 然后，不可思议地，莫拉林出现在他面前，在他和野兽之间。一道闪光和一声撞击，精灵似乎向后跃了几英尺，落在爱德华的脸正前方蹲着。空气中呼啸声响起，他的剑似乎自行从鞘中跳出。他周围的空气中闪烁了一下，还有一股烧焦的气味。寂静。<BR><BR>
“离开这里，孩子！现在！”<BR><BR>
爱德华逃跑了，大声喊着母亲，她正朝着灌木丛跑来，呼唤着他。她把他紧紧抱住，然后开始转而呼喊莫拉林。没有回答，然后，不知怎的，精灵出现在那里，毫发无损，他的剑已经重新入鞘。但他喘着粗气。<BR><BR>
“你杀了它吗？你受伤了吗？”<BR><BR>
“没有，也没有。我用了护盾。勉强挡住。你打扰了一只带着幼崽的母猪。幸运的是，她在第一次撞击后就觉得够了。我敢说她不太习惯事后发现她的敌人还站着。”<BR><BR>
“你为什么不杀了她？”爱德华追问道，惊吓之后觉得非常渴望血腥。<BR><BR>
“太刀，即使是黑檀之刃，也不是我用来对付母野猪的选择。也许矛更好。越长越好。再说，不管它，明年这里会有六头小猪，如果运气好的话。”<BR><BR>
“你制造了一个魔法护盾，”爱德华瞪大眼睛说。<BR><BR>
“是的，如果没有护盾，即使是硬朗的老丹莫，她也会留下几道痕迹。”<BR><BR>
“爱德华，感谢你的救命恩人是有教养的表现。”他母亲提醒道。<BR><BR>
“谢谢，”爱德华机械地说，脑子里忙着想更多的问题。精灵是怎么知道他有危险的？他怎么会那么快赶到那里？<BR><BR>
“救我儿子的命，几乎不需要谢我。谢谢夏格吧，”莫拉林说。“是这只猫告诉我出事了。”<BR><BR>
爱德华跪下，抱住了那只得意洋洋、咕噜咕噜叫的猫。“老夏格真好。我总能靠得住他。”<BR><BR>
“我的儿子”。“我们的儿子”。这两个词在没有任何借口的情况下骄傲地回荡着。爱德华琢磨了一会儿；这需要一个解释。他倾向于相信，莫拉林只是还不够了解他，倾向于对陌生人抱有疑点利益归于被告（先假定他好）。最终会了解的，但与此同时，他不妨享受这种感觉。这种感觉很好。有一个为你骄傲、喜欢和你在一起、带你去各种地方、和你说话、听你诉说的父亲。最不寻常的是，在你需要独处的时候，他会让你独自待着。莫拉林只有在创作民谣时才真正喜欢独处。<BR><BR>
爱德华告诉比奇和威洛关于母野猪的事。“他让我跑我就跑了。你们会吗？因为是他让我跑的。我想不出任何能帮上忙的办法，但是......”威洛和比奇仔细听着，交换了眼神，说他们会考虑这个问题。<BR><BR>
傍晚篝火晚餐后，威洛拿起她的小竖琴，开始歌唱秋日下午和浆果的乐趣......除了莫拉林派男孩去摘浆果这一点。他们搞错了那部分。莫拉林猛地坐起来，环顾四周，但其他人已溜进了黑暗中，威洛也没有在看他。<BR><BR>
米斯踱步走进了火光中，迈着矫揉造作的步子，做着采摘浆果的哑剧动作，大声地吃着。莫拉林低下头，呻吟了一声。米斯做哑剧表演发现了什么东西，然后欢快地蹦跳着。马茨的头和肩膀晃进了火光中。米斯伸手去拍他，然后随着马茨试图用獠牙撕裂他，米斯尖叫着向后跳开。巨大的獠牙和一个猪鼻子装饰着他的脸。米斯蹲下身子，双手捂着脸，做出夸张的恐惧表情。穿着黑衣的希尔克，在一阵火花中跳到米斯和马茨之间，背心朝后，紧身裤滑落到膝盖，光着脚。它伸手去拿剑，但马茨冲过来把它撞飞了；它旋转着飞出视线。马茨四肢着地乱爬，没碰到米斯，却撕破了他的紧身裤。米斯绕着篝火跑，马茨在后面追。希尔克一只手拿着剑，另一只手提着紧身裤，追着马茨，用剑打他。<BR><BR>
另一个人影出现了，穿着阿莱拉的蓝色长袍，比奇的头从上面伸出来，戴着长长的深色假发。米斯畏缩在她的裙子后面。她瞪着马茨，马茨僵住了。希尔克绊倒了，趴在他身后。比奇把头发往后一甩，安慰地拍了拍米斯的头，湿了一根手指，捋了捋眉毛，然后悠闲地拿起弓，瞄准，弦声一响。<BR><BR>
马茨向后一跳，摔倒在希尔克身上，发出一声非常逼真的死亡喉鸣。比奇和米斯拥抱在一起，无视了还被压在马茨身下平躺着的希尔克。<BR><BR>
莫拉林在希尔克第一次跳出来时就开始笑了。阿莱拉一直等到比奇出现。现在泪水顺着她的脸颊流下。莫拉林弯着腰，用拳头捶着树。银铃般的笑声波浪般响起，阵阵金币雨落入圈中。同伴们聚拢在一起，像人类一样鞠躬。<BR><BR>
“再来一次，再来一次！”<BR><BR>
“不不不不！”莫拉林喘着气，仍在笑。“啊，你们差点把我给逗死了比那只母猪还狠！我求饶了！”<BR><BR>
“改天晚上吧，诸位好心人......我们的国王今天经历了漫长的一天。我们感谢你们大家。”<BR><BR>
“天哪，全镇的人都看见了吗？”爱德华盯着身后，但他们已全都消失在黑暗中。“不是那样的，”他喊道。“你是一个英雄。他们是在取笑你。”<BR><BR>
“对，对，都对。尤其是最后一点。以杰夫瑞本人起誓，那太有趣了！”<BR><BR>
“他们都看到了！你还打算让他们再来一次？”爱德华感到愤慨。他们看起来都很荒唐。<BR><BR>
“让他们？毫无疑问，在未来的几个世纪里，整个泰姆瑞尔都会传唱这个故事。但绝不会有第二次演得这么好的了。”<BR><BR>
“但事情根本不是那样发生的。”<BR><BR>
“如果马茨......我是说那只母猪再次冲锋，事情就会那样发展。阿莱拉的弓会比我的破剑有效得多。而且她会看到莫拉林像卡吉特一样跳跃！”他手指捋了捋眉毛，这是阿莱拉的典型动作，然后他又一次大笑起来。“没错，如果她找不到箭，她一个眼神就能杀死那野兽。马茨，你演得比母猪还像母猪。个头也更大，我发誓！米斯，你这个老流氓，只有你能装得那么无辜。”<BR><BR>
“但，但这不是真的！”爱德华抗议道。<BR><BR>
“孩子，你认为真理只有一个吗？你今天看到的是真理吗？你看到了全部真理吗？即使是关于真正发生的事情？你今晚在这里看到的，如果你允许的话，将照亮看不见的真理，你可以花一生时间反思它，却仍无法看清它的全貌，因为它会越来越远、越来越深，像池水中的涟漪一样扩散，超越我们所有人，进入永恒的深邃宁静。发生的事情只是真理的一小部分......也许是最小的一部分。而你所看到的更小。”<BR><BR>
爱德华仍然认为一个国王真的应该更有尊严。但他没有说出来。<BR>"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
King Edward, Part IV<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
Chapter 4: Stories<BR><BR><BR>
Edward faced his mother defiantly. "I'm not sick and I'm not a baby. I can stay here by myself. I don't need Mith." There was a dangerous glint in Moraelyn's eyes. Aliera's lips thinned. "You will mind him, Edward."<BR><BR>
"Yes, madam," Edward said sulkily.<BR><BR>
"Come on, wife. Mith knows how to deal with princes who don't want his company." The three adults laughed a bit in their irritating way at a joke he didn't understand.<BR><BR>
The weather was drizzly and Edward had the sniffles. His mother had decided that he shouldn't go out, even though they were only going visiting. Moraelyn had taken his side, but threw out his hands and raised his brows at Edward in a helpless gesture when Aliera insisted that he stay behind. Mith, whom Edward liked the least of the Companions, had volunteered to stay with him. Even Ssa'ass would have been better. Mith was scruffy looking. Like a stableboy. And cheeky, even for a Companion. Edward sulked silently for awhile longer. Mith had fetched a broom and was sweeping the house out, brushing dirt from the room above into the room Edward was in. What on earth was the use of staying in when there wasn't really any 'in' to stay in? Edward got tired of sulking, fetched a broom and went up to help sweep.<BR><BR>
"Mith", Edward said. "have you ever been to the Crystal Tower?"<BR><BR>
"I have. It's an unchancy place at first, but you'll grow used to it." Mith was applying his broom with energy and whistling. "Sweeping was kind of fun here. There weren't any sides to the platforms so all you had to do was brush the dirt and leaves over the side. You started at the top and worked your way down."<BR><BR>
"You're quick with the broom, Mith. I haven't half finished my side yet. Will there be others there like me?"<BR><BR>
"Oh, some children, I'd think. Most'll be somewhat older. I should be quick with a broom. My father had me sweeping out the king's stables when I was your age. I used to dream and talk too much like you; he beat me for it. So I learned to be quick."<BR><BR>
Edward swept faster, stirring up dust. "Not like that, boy. Watch me. Anyway, there's no hurry; it's just habit with me. Moraelyn'd serve me my head on a platter if I touched you. My father, heh, he was always...well, he was a hard man to please. He was a Nord."<BR><BR>
"Your father?" Edward stared at Mith, but Mith looked much like the other Dark Elves he'd seen. Not many. Dark elves didn't come to Daggerfall; Gerald had banned them. But he'd seen some on his rare trips to other courts. And there were some in Firsthold besides Moraelyn and Mith. "Did he have red hair?" Mith's hair was a dark red. Gerald had red hair. "He tended the stables for Moraelyn?" No wonder Mith looked like a stableboy. But Edward kept his tone polite. Mith had a sharp tongue...and Edward knew that neither of his parents would be sympathetic if he complained that Mith had been impertinent.<BR><BR>
"He did have red hair. Maybe I got mine from him...but mostly mixed elf and human children come out dark elf. No, Moraelyn wasn't a king then or expecting to be...'sides this was in Blacklight, where I was born. Moraelyn's brother was king in Ebonheart in those days. He came up to visit our King and brought Moraelyn along. To keep him out of trouble, he said." Mith grinned. "I grinned when I heard him say that, and I saw the boy looking at me out of the tail of his eye, but he wouldn't take notice. Like I was the dirt or something worse. His brother tossed him a pouch and told him to go into town and get his knife mended. Jerked his thumb at me and told me to show him the way."<BR><BR>
"Moraelyn said he didn't need an escort to find a store and stalked off like princes do." Mith grinned knowingly at Edward. But the grin wasn't unfriendly. Edward smiled back a bit, and Mith went on. "Our king eyeballed me, so I took off after him. Moraelyn didn't spare me so much as a glance. Went four blocks out of his way, down by the wharfs, and when I tried to tell him where the store was he shoved me right off the pier. I could Levitate, of course, but he caught me by surprise and I went in with a big splash, and everyone laughing like jackasses. I got myself out and went straight to the store and waited for him - but not so he could see me - and when he finally showed up, I lifted the pouch right off him. He didn't even know it was gone. So in he goes and tosses the knife on the counter and tells the smith to fix it right off. Which he does. Only then Moraelyn can't pay him, tells the smith he's the King of Ebonheart's brother, the smith just laughs and says, 'And I'm the Archmagister.' Then the smith calls the guard and three of them show up. Well, Moraelyn wasn't what he is now - three guards wouldn't even warm him up nowadays - but he was even faster then. He was out of there so fast he nearly knocked me over at the door. He lost the guards pretty quick; all that armor slows 'em down. I found him crouching in one of those hedge mazes in the park. He was doubled over out of breath but still I stood a good ways off while I asked him real nasty if he needed an escort back to the Palace. Not that I was planning to go back! I was gonna take the money and run and never look back, I tell you! But I had to have the last word. I wasn't born high but I was born proud."<BR><BR>
"He glared at me for a minute or so, catching his breath, then he just rolled over and started to laugh that laugh of his. Prince or no, I started to like him then. When we'd finished laughing, more or less, we started talking. I told him I didn't want to go back. Nor dared to. 'Princes don't get blamed, Prince,' I said, 'Stableboys do.' He said that wasn't entirely the case, but he saw my point. Then he said that as I was his escort then he must obey his brother and come with me. And that his name was Moraelyn, not Prince. We've been together ever since....more or less."<BR><BR>
Edward smiled politely. He could see why Mith had run away, but not why Moraelyn had gone with him. Unless he was afraid to face his brother about the stolen money. Edward tried to imagine Moraelyn being afraid to face anyone and failed. "I wish I was brave. Like you and Moraelyn."<BR><BR>
"Why, you are brave. And your courage will grow with the rest of you."<BR><BR>
"Are there only High Elf boys at the Tower?"<BR><BR>
"There'll be other sorts, too, most likely. A few Dark Elves, for sure. D'ye miss your own kind?"<BR><BR>
Edward shook his head. "Human boys don't like me much anyway. Nor High Elf boys..." His eyes filled suddenly and he turned his head away. But Mith's voice was unexpectedly gentle. "I thought you wanted to go to the Tower."<BR><BR>
"I do. But..."<BR><BR>
"You'll be lonely."<BR><BR>
Edward nodded.<BR><BR>
"That's a hard thing to face."<BR><BR>
"Did you go there alone, Mith?"<BR><BR>
"No. Moraelyn did, but he was older than you, by a good bit. A grown man, in fact. They didn't take any but High Elf students in those days, you know. But Moraelyn heard of them and said he wanted to go there. We were together already, the seven of us, save for Aliera, and a handy bunch in a fight. Moraelyn had already gotten that Dragon's Blade he wears, and the Dragon's Tooth to go with it - remind me to tell you about that sometime - and he was a famous fighter already. And the rest of us aren't slackers. But he thought we could be better at the spellcasting and the Tower was the place to learn that. Well, no one goes near the Tower without an invitation. No one! No one would even tell you where it was. But they'd tell you where NOT to go. So he went there. Alone. One morning he was gone and there a note saying for us to wait for him. So we did, here in Firsthold. He was gone two weeks, then he came back one night, rowing across with the tide. He just said they'd accepted him, but he couldn't say anything more about it. But he asked me to come back with him."<BR><BR>
"'They want me?' 'Well, they've accepted one Dark Elf,' he said. 'One more shouldn't bother them too much.' """<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
爱德华国王，第四部<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
第四章：故事<BR><BR><BR>
爱德华倔强地面对着他母亲。“我没生病，也不是小孩子了。我可以自己待在这里。我不需要米斯。”莫拉林的眼中闪过一丝危险的光芒。阿莱拉的嘴唇抿紧了。“你得听他的，爱德华。”<BR><BR>
“是的，夫人，”爱德华闷闷不乐地说。<BR><BR>
“走吧，老婆。米斯知道怎么对付不想要他陪伴的王子。”三个大人以一种令爱德华恼火的方式，因为他不理解的笑话而笑了起来。<BR><BR>
天气阴沉，细雨蒙蒙，爱德华有点伤风。尽管他们只是出门做客，但他母亲还是决定他不该出去。莫拉林原本站在他这边，但当阿莱拉坚持要他留下时，莫拉林却摊开双手，朝爱德华无奈地挑了挑眉。米斯，爱德华在同伴中最不喜欢的一个，主动提出留下来陪他。即使是萨阿斯也会比他强。米斯看起来邋里邋遢的，像个马夫。而且即使作为同伴，他也显得相当放肆。爱德华又默默地生了一会儿气。米斯拿了一把扫帚，正在打扫屋子，把上面房间的灰尘扫到了爱德华所在的房间里。既然根本没有什么‘里面’可待，待在里面到底有什么用呢？爱德华生够了气，也拿了一把扫帚，上楼去帮忙打扫。<BR><BR>
“米斯，”爱德华说。“你去过水晶塔吗？”<BR><BR>
“去过。刚开始是个不太吉祥的地方，但你会习惯的。”米斯用力地挥舞着扫帚，吹着口哨。“在这儿扫地还挺有趣的。平台上没有围栏，所以你只需要把灰尘和树叶扫到边上去就行。从顶部开始，一路往下扫。”<BR><BR>
“你用扫帚真快，米斯。我这边还没扫完一半呢。那里会有其他和我一样的人吗？”<BR><BR>
“哦，我想会有一些孩子的。大多数会大一些。我用扫帚倒是很快。我像你这么大时，我父亲让我打扫国王的马厩。我以前跟你一样，想得太多，话也太多；他为此打过我。所以我学会了快点。”<BR><BR>
爱德华扫得更快，扬起了灰尘。“不是那样，孩子。看我的。反正也不用急；这只是我的习-惯。要是我碰了你，莫拉林会把我的脑袋装在盘子里端上来。我的父亲，嘿，他总是......嗯，他是个难以取悦的人。他是个诺德人。”<BR><BR>
“你的父亲？”爱德华盯着米斯看，但米斯看起来和他见过的其他丹莫很像。他见过的丹莫不多。丹莫不去匕落；杰拉德严禁他们入境。但在他难得去其他宫廷的几次机会中，他见过一些。而且除了莫拉林和米斯之外，首堡也有几个。“他有红头发吗？”米斯的头发是暗红色的。杰拉德有红头发。“他为莫拉林打理马厩？”难怪米斯看起来像个马夫。但爱德华保持着礼貌的语气。米斯嘴很厉害......而且爱德华知道，如果他抱怨米斯无礼，他的父母双方都不会同情他。<BR><BR>
“他确实有红头发。也许我是从他那儿遗传的......但精灵和人类的混血儿多数是丹莫。不，那时莫拉林还不是国王，也没打算成为国王......而且这事发生在黑光，我的出生地。那时莫拉林的哥哥是黑檀心的国王。他来拜访我们的国王，把莫拉林也带来了。他说，是为了让莫拉林不惹麻烦。”米斯咧嘴笑了。“我听到他那么说时也咧嘴笑了，我看见那个男孩用眼角瞟了我一下，但他装作没注意到我。好像我是尘土或更糟糕的东西似的。他哥哥扔给他一个钱袋，让他去镇上把匕首修好。然后朝我竖起拇指，让我给他带路。”<BR><BR>
“莫拉林说他不需要向导陪他去找店铺，然后像王子们那样气冲冲地走了。”米斯心照不宣地朝爱德华咧嘴一笑。但那笑容并无恶意。爱德华也回以一个微笑，米斯继续说。“我们的国王瞪了我一眼，所以我跟了上去。莫拉林连看都没看我一眼。他绕了四个街区，走到了码头边，当我试图告诉他店铺在哪里时，他一把把我推下了码头。我本来可以漂浮的，但他趁我不备，我‘扑通’一声掉进水里，大家都像驴子一样哈哈大笑。我自己爬了出来，直接去了店铺，在那里等他 -- 但没让他看见我 -- 等他终于出现时，我直接把他的钱袋偷了过来。他甚至不知道钱袋丢了。然后他走进店里，把匕首往柜台上一扔，让铁匠立刻修好。铁匠照做了。只是到了付钱的时候，莫拉林却拿不出钱，他告诉铁匠自己是黑檀心国王的弟弟，铁匠只是笑了笑说，‘那我还是大导师呢。’然后铁匠叫来了守卫，来了三个。嗯，莫拉林那时还不是现在的样子 -- 现在的他三个守卫根本不在话下 -- 但他当时动作更快。他飞快地冲出店铺，在门口差点把我撞倒。他很快甩掉了守卫；那些盔甲拖慢了他们的速度。我在公园的树篱迷宫里找到了他，他正蜷缩着身子，上气不接下气，但我还是站得远远的，用非常难听的语气问他，是否需要向导送他回宫殿。我可没打算回去！我告诉你们，我本想拿了钱就跑，再也不回头！但我必须逞口舌之快。我出身不高，但生来骄傲。”<BR><BR>
“他瞪了我大约一分钟，喘着气，然后他翻了个身，开始发出他那特有的笑声。不管他是不是王子，从那时起我开始喜欢他了。等我们差不多笑完后，开始聊了起来。我告诉他我不想回去。也不敢回去。‘王子不会被责备，王子，’我说，‘马夫才会。’他说并非完全如此，但他明白我的意思。然后他说，既然我是他的向导，他必须听从哥哥的命令，跟我回去。还说他叫莫拉林，不是王子。从那以后，我们几乎就一直在一起了。”<BR><BR>
爱德华礼貌地笑了笑。他能理解米斯为什么逃跑，但不明白莫拉林为什么跟他走。除非他因为偷钱的事不敢面对他哥哥。爱德华试图想象莫拉林害怕面对任何人，但失败了。“我希望我像你和莫拉林一样勇敢。”<BR><BR>
“哎呀，你很勇敢。而且你的勇气会随着你的成长而增长。”<BR><BR>
“塔里只有高精灵男孩吗？”<BR><BR>
“很可能也会有其他种族的。肯定会有几个丹莫。你想念你的同类吗？”<BR><BR>
爱德华摇了摇头。“反正人类的男孩们也不太喜欢我。高精灵男孩们也是......”他的眼睛突然湿润了，他转过头去。但米斯的声音出乎意料地温和。“我以为你想去塔里呢。”<BR><BR>
“我想去。但是......”<BR><BR>
“你会孤独的。”<BR><BR>

“那是一件难以面对的事。”<BR><BR>

“但是大导师非常感兴趣。你看，他们不穿盔甲，除了法杖和匕首外不带任何东西。他们认为所有那些金属会干扰施法。但莫拉林即使穿着链甲，使用任何单手武器，都能施法得很好。而我能穿着皮甲，带着军刀施法，尽管那是种笨重的武器；我更喜欢我的短剑。说实话，他们并不太看重我，但莫拉林......他之前在门外扎了营。当他们试图赶他走时，他就坐在那里一动不动！他们把所有的法术、巨魔守卫、所有招数都用上了，都没用。他把巨魔守卫打倒在地，让它们自己再生。如果他们试图用法杖打他，他会用剑格挡，而那些法术根本伤不了他分毫。”<BR><BR>

显然，尖牙也需要时间。他尽力尝试，却始终无法用刀接近精灵，尽管莫拉林只是双脚站立，身体躲闪、低头弯腰......还一边笑。沮丧之下，爱德华收起尖牙，捡起法杖，双手抡起，朝他砸去。这并没有造成伤害，但当法杖敲击在魔法护盾上时，发出了令人满意的声响。莫拉林任由他打，但一旦护盾法术的能量用尽，便轻松地挡住了法杖。爱德华把它扔在地上，转身要走；精灵伸手想安慰他。爱德华从鞘中拔出尖牙，径直刺向精灵的心脏。刀被格挡开，从他手中飞了出去。爱德华本准备刺入并停住，甚至通过护盾都感受到了冲击。然后莫拉林跪在他面前，左手搭在右膝上，脸上是因震惊和难以置信而变得灰白。鲜血像泉水一样从他的手腕喷出。“把你的腰带给我！”<BR><BR>
“我......我没有......”爱德华的牙齿在脑袋里格格作响。他感到恶心和头晕。胆汁涌上了他的喉咙。“不 -- 不是 -- 故 -- 故意的。”这么多血。<BR><BR>
“孩子，现在别晕倒。我需要你的帮助。腰带。快，爱德华！把它塞进伤口里。天啊，真是一团糟！”那只手在手腕处几乎被完全切断。爱德华猛地坐下，浑身颤抖着，但他的双手还是把腰带塞进了敞开的伤口里，然后把剩下的部分缠在手上和手腕上。<BR><BR>
“拿我的腰带做个吊腕带。”莫拉林小心翼翼地把受伤的手臂放进吊带里，然后松开了另一只手。他从腰间取下水瓶，一口气喝完了。“我需要更多的水。你的法杖呢？往回两英里处有口井。尖牙呢？去找回来，别割到自己。”<BR><BR>
“我不想要它。”<BR><BR>
“很少有刀剑沐浴过莫拉林的鲜血。那会给你带来好运。照我说的做。”<BR><BR>
“涨潮了。”<BR><BR>
“是啊，首堡就算在乔恩上，对我们也没用。我一只手没法划船。”<BR><BR>
“我可以......”<BR><BR>
“不，你不行。你没那个力气。这里的水流很急。我宁愿死在陆地上。爱德华，我们不能待在这里。血腥味会引来野兽。如果我晕倒了，你就赶紧逃开，爬到树上去。然后祈祷。”他站起身，靠在法杖上，喘着粗气。“跟紧我，但无论发生什么，都不要抓着我。”他迈出一小步，又一步。<BR><BR>
“对不起。”<BR><BR>
“无疑。你选错了时间和地点当刺客。一个好的刺客总会计划好退路。”<BR><BR>
“是的，先生。”爱德华吸了吸鼻子，忍住眼泪。“先生，我治不好你，但我可以恢复一些活力。”<BR><BR>
“你能吗？那会大有帮助。”爱德华施的法术让精灵一震；他倒吸一口气，但冲击过后，他站得更直、更稳了。“我可以再来一次，”爱德华急切地主动提出。<BR><BR>
“不。你力量足够，但缺乏技巧。不过现在好多了。”<BR><BR>
莫拉林走得更好些了；他说话的声音也好多了。爱德华努力想把受伤的画面从脑海中抹去。他们缓慢地移动着，莫拉林时不时靠在树上休息。没有任何东西打扰他们。经过一段漫长的、寂静的跋涉，他们到达了那口老井。莫拉林喝干了第一壶水，爱德华重新灌满，自己喝了一些，然后又再次灌满。<BR><BR>
“我们今晚就待在那里。”“那里”是一栋破旧的大建筑，显然已被遗弃。精灵踢开了锁着的门。里面一片漆黑。“要光吗？”爱德华问。<BR><BR>
“不。我能看见。省着你的法力，待在我身边。”传来一阵窸窸窣窣的声音。老鼠！爱德华想都没想，就给两人都施了护盾，拔出尖牙，背靠着精灵。一只老鼠跳起来，直直撞在刀上。莫拉林挥舞法杖，又打倒了两个。其他的四散逃窜。<BR><BR>
“干得好，小子！”他们找到一个小而无窗的房间，随手关上了门。周围<BR><BR>
似乎有些木头；这大概是厨房旁边的一个储物间。莫拉林靠着墙坐了下来。<BR><BR>
“这么说。你会用刀。刚才那些都是装的？为了让我放下戒备？”<BR><BR>
爱德华惊骇万分。他放声大哭，抗议说自己绝不愿伤害莫拉林。“我只是想开个玩笑；我以为这会让你笑......一开始我很生气，但气的是自己，气自己的笨拙，不是气你......这是一个突然的念头......我爱你，亲爱的！”<BR><BR>
精灵伸出他好的那只胳膊，把爱德华拉向自己。“那值得一只手，任何时候都值得。”<BR><BR>
爱德华靠在他肩头抽泣，莫拉林轻拍着他安慰道。“你是我真正的父亲。”<BR><BR>
“爱德华，我不是......”<BR><BR>
“不，你是。你把我的福祉置于你自己的之上，在我最不值得的时候爱我。你一直善良、慷慨，除了对我自己有好处的事，从没要求过我什么。你愿意为我付出生命。这才是真正的父亲该做的。而我除了痛苦什么也没给过你。那个生我的人鄙视我和母亲，因为我们不像他。我们也不像你，然而你却深爱着我们。我会对你更好的，亲爱的父亲。”<BR><BR>
“我给了你足够的理由生气。我把你母亲从你身边带走了。”<BR><BR>
“你冒着失去她的风险，因为你不愿把我和父亲分开。你并不了解我，而我父亲是你不共戴天的仇敌。然而你依然为我们着想。你不可能知道他有多悖逆常情。你没有那种天性。”<BR><BR>
“不错。但冒犯以及你的愤怒依然存在。”<BR><BR>
“我爱你！”爱德华抗议道。但他听出自己声音里带着怒意。<BR><BR>
“也恨我。”莫拉林的声音如此平静，仿佛他们在讨论天气。<BR><BR>
“我不能同时做两件事......可以吗？”<BR><BR>
“你能吗？”<BR><BR>
“我不是故意要伤害你的。”<BR><BR>
“我相信你。”<BR><BR>
“我是......我，是恶的吗？我很抱歉；如果没发生那事，我愿付出一切，但是......我......”<BR><BR>
“从中获得了一定程度的满足。”<BR><BR>
爱德华的喉咙被哭声噎住，说不出话，只是把头埋在莫拉林的肩上点了点头。精灵的手轻柔地抚摸着他。<BR><BR>
“伊瑞克给你讲过迪德拉吗？”<BR><BR>
“恶魔？没有。是恶魔让我做这些事吗？那我就是恶的了。”<BR><BR>
“不，你不是。但迪德拉以那样的行为为食。他们鼓励那些行为。你的愤怒吸引了他们。但他们不能强迫你做任何事。而且他们（或它）不在你体内。但它与你相连。”<BR><BR>
“我不想要它。我想让它消失。我怎样才能让它消失？”<BR><BR>
“你为什么不想要它？你从中汲取力量。那就是当老鼠攻击时，你能为我们俩施护盾的原因。”<BR><BR>
“法力？那可不是来自恶魔。”<BR><BR>
“不，但使用它的能力可以。听着，你的一些行为滋养了迪德拉。但同时你也从中汲取力量。然后那力量就是你的了，你可以随意使用。”<BR><BR>
“你有一个迪德拉吗？”<BR><BR>
“我有，而且还不小，但我认为每个人都有（一个或多个）。有的强些，有的弱些，仅此而已。但别到处打听别人的迪德拉。这不礼貌。”<BR><BR>
“我想让我的离开！”爱德华哭喊道。<BR><BR>
“你是这么说。但假装它不存在并不能让它消失。拥有一个迪德拉有点像骑马。你必须保持控制。迪德拉并不关心你。它同样乐意以你的痛苦、伤害或死亡为食，然后找个新宿主。它们不能像我们一样思考或计划，而且我认为它们对时间的体验也和我们不同。所以，滋养迪德拉的行为发生在当下，当你沉浸其中时，过去和未来对你来说也不复存在了。这是一种极为愉悦的体验，但也可能非常危险，而且极易成瘾，以至于你会开始只想着滋养你的迪德拉。你会停止思考众神、你爱的人，甚至你自己。当你在这条路上走得太远时，你就会失去选择另一条路的意志。”<BR><BR>
“太可怕了！那我该怎么办？”<BR><BR>
“这很可怕，是可能降临在一个人身上的最坏的事。记住今晚。记住你的感受。学会认清迪德拉的饥饿本质，并且思考你的所作所为。你还年轻，这对你来说很沉重，但你身处危险之中。啊！”精灵的身体僵硬了，他屏住了呼吸。爱德华猜是伤口在疼。<BR><BR>
莫拉林说他必须睡一会儿，问爱德华能不能放哨，一小时后叫醒他。然后他就可以在门上设个锁，他们俩都能休息了。<BR><BR>
“是的，先生......也许我还能做点别的。我不能设锁，但是......”这门没法拴上，也无法保持敞开，会差不多自己关上。爱德华在门后的墙壁附近摸索，找到了一个楔子。他关上门，用一块木头把楔子敲紧。“我就知道。双手抱满木头通过这样的门很不方便。我们在......在杰拉德的王宫也有这样的门。现在，任何试图进来的东西都会把你吵醒；你就可以用你的力量施放治疗而不是上的锁。”<BR><BR>
“哎呀，真是想得周到。”他拔出剑，放在身边的地板上。“那我们不妨都睡吧。”<BR><BR>
他们睡得断断续续。门和墙壁上经常有抓挠声，但没有任何东西进入他们的小储藏间。夜间，莫拉林施放了几次治疗法术。到早晨，他自称自己“像个独臂人一样”还行。他解开用作绷带的腰带，检查伤口。血已经止住了；手摸起来还是温的；不再疼痛，也没有肿胀 or 变色。但伤口仍然敞开，那只手无法使用。神经和肌肉被切断，一些小骨头也断了。这样的修复超出了他的能力。爱德华感到迪德拉正以这景象为食，赶紧转过头去。<BR><BR>
莫拉林咧嘴一笑。“你不如让它吃吧；这是一种无害的喂食。伤害已经造成了。”<BR><BR>
“我打算饿死它，”爱德华坚定地说。<BR><BR>

“是的，他们能在那里治好你，不是吗？”<BR><BR>

“她杀了你之后就会来杀我，”爱德华叹了口气。“至少回塔里能推迟那一刻。”他们来到了明亮的庭院。清晨的阳光已高悬在西方的天空。<BR><BR>

Beech, Ssa'ass, Mats and the Khajiit woman, Silk, had also gone off together, laughing. They'd invited Mith to come along, but Mith had declined.<BR><BR>

爱德华国王，第七部<BR>

第七章：龙<BR><BR><BR>
“那么你看到了一个恶魔？还用尖牙杀死了一只老鼠？尖牙是把上好的黑檀木匕首。它们很稀有，所以你要好好保管它，”米斯说。“关于这把刀，除了它来自莫拉林的父亲，我没什么可告诉你的。就是我们逃跑前他哥哥让他去修的那把。你想听听他们是怎么弄到马茨用来雕刻刀柄的那颗龙牙的吗？”<BR><BR>

“‘他们不太聪明。我得替他们着想。没有我他们会迷路的。好好打猎，伙计们！呃，如果他们找不到鹿，你还想要别的什么吗？猪，也许？几只兔子？坚果？浆果？快点，好吗？’但我们有手势，他的手势告诉我们离开那里，别再回来！我本来很高兴离开的；我的意思是，我喜欢莫拉林，但我没觉得我死在他旁边会给他带来任何安慰。如果被当作菜单上菜品的是我，我很乐意看到他安全离开，而且我猜他也是这么想的。但那个榆木脑袋的诺德人不听我的！他说如果我们所能做的只是死在他旁边，那我们就那么做。诺德的歪理。不过唱成歌倒是很好听。”<BR><BR>
“于是我们花了几个小时弄到一头鹿，带着它回去了。我想莫拉林这时候怕是已经在龙的肚子里了，而龙会很乐意加上一头鹿、另一个丹莫和一个诺德人来凑齐它一天的口粮。但莫拉林还坐在那里，和龙聊着天。他看到我们时看起来也不太高兴。他让我们留下鹿就走，说等我们离开后他就切开脓肿。但马茨说他一直在思考。哦，天哪，我想。马茨不常思考，而且这倒是好事，真的。他决定他可以用一条链子套住那颗坏牙，把链子的另一端固定在地板上，然后让龙自己用力拔出来。”<BR><BR>
“龙喜欢这个主意，于是莫拉林切开了脓肿，让肿胀消退到龙可以比较舒服地吞下那头鹿的程度。然后他们用链子把那颗牙拔了出来。搞得一团糟，真的是。到处都是血和脓。莫拉林还让我们对这条龙施放治疗法术来止血和封闭伤口。”<BR><BR>
“‘啊，嗯，好，非常好。好吧，莫拉林，你证明了自己。拿着剑走吧。’”<BR><BR>
“莫拉林看着他。‘你的意思是这是一种考验？’他说。‘你那牙疼多久了？’”<BR><BR>
“‘以你们凡人的时间计量，确实很久，但对龙来说其实不算长。那么听我说：一个邋遢的年轻法师来了，想偷我的金子。我当场抓住了他；我们之间言辞越来越激烈，然后他对我施了一个法术。他那可怜的法术对我影响不大，我便杀了他。但是嗯......’龙短暂地移开了视线，然后继续讲述。‘那个小矮子显然在自己身上施了一个自制的诅咒法术，当我咬碎他时......’龙回想起此事，狠狠地皱起了眉头，然后继续说，‘不管怎样，每当有人来试图拿那把剑时，牙疼就会发作。最剧烈的疼痛会在被我吃掉入侵者后消失......但我通常不会那么做，尽管我曾出于自卫烧焦过几个；嘿，只要喷一点火，他们大多数人就逃跑了。鹿很充足；吃过和你聊过天的人总是有些......呃，啊，令人不愉快。那个油腻的法师让我消化不良了好几天。即使对一条龙来说，抽筋、拉肚子和胀气也太过了。所以那牙疼从来没有完全好过。后来的那些来客也不太愉快......总之那是我生命中最不愉快的时期之一。当然，我不能长时间离开那把剑的附近。这是诅咒的一部分。’”<BR><BR>
“‘如果你愿意，我们可以待上一阵子。我们是好伙伴。我是莫拉林；我那位红头发的朋友是米斯，那个大个子是马茨。我还是想在下面找找秘银，而且我以前从来没有过龙朋友。’”<BR><BR>
“‘我可能会喜欢这样。你有一些好朋友，尽管你说你必须替他们思考。但我认为他们可以自己思考，而且看起来他们已认定你是个值得结交的家伙，’龙犹豫了一下，竟设法露出了害羞的表情！‘你可以叫我阿卡托什。’”<BR><BR>
“于是我们待了几个星期。和龙一起打猎；那真是种体验！搜索了矿井......下面没找到多少东西。但龙给了我们它宝藏中的宝石。说它只需要金属；它们躺在上面时能将金属吸收到鳞片里。所以我们终究还是收获不错。莫拉林想把剑给马茨。声称如果我们没回来，他肯定会试图杀死那条龙，然后就会被烤熟。但马茨不肯要。说龙把剑给了莫拉林，所以显然他才是应得之人。马茨拿走了那颗牙，但他制作了你现在拿着的这个刀柄，也送给了莫拉林。他告诉我，他以前从未有过什么值得送人的东西，这让他感觉很好。莫拉林选择把它送给你，他非常高兴。”<BR><BR>
“我觉得马茨才应该得到那把剑，”爱德华说。“他并没有试图偷任何东西。他回来真的很勇敢，即使他认为这没什么用。莫拉林试图偷窃，被抓住了，然后只是试图用言语脱身。你们都可能因为他而丧命。”<BR><BR>
“这正是莫拉林说的。啊，好吧，反正马茨比起剑来更喜欢他那把大斧头。”<BR><BR>
爱德华叹了口气。“我希望我能像马茨一样勇敢。我猜我更像你。”<BR><BR>
“是啊，”莫拉林的声音在他身后响起，吓了男孩一跳。“嘴巴不饶人，就像米斯。没关系。如果你能像米斯一样勇敢，我就会非常满意。如果有一天我走了，他们只说我‘做了他该做的事’，我的灵魂就会安息。”<BR>"""
