Their immortality has been disrupted and so the pattern collapses. The Lich simply dies, no better than a mortal.<BR>
<BR>
The same thing happens if this kind of Lich tries to change its pattern, perhaps because it has found the problem with its state. The pattern collapses and the Lich dies. Immortality cannot sustain immortality.<BR>
<BR>
This is the trap. If you have already walked down this path, you have my sympathies.<BR>
<BR>
The True Lich<BR>
<BR>
By caution, chance, longing, or luck, these practitioners have found that simply becoming immortal is not good enough.<BR>
<BR>
The patterns they carve are tied to a focus, be it a concept, object, or even a more esoteric thing. It could be as mundane as a needle or as outlandish as a song or sickness. Their immortality is merely the result of their focus, however, and not the focus itself. And this is the crucial difference.<BR>
<BR>
If this kind of Lich is killed by force of arms, the pattern is not disrupted as such, and they will rise again. For some, only under certain conditions, but they will rise without error.<BR>
<BR>
But, like a metaphysical bank account, if the pattern is removed, this changes. If the needle is broken, the song no longer sung, or the sickness cured, this Lich is about as immortal as the Common variety - but there is yet another crucial difference: they can carve a new pattern with their soul, secure themselves again and learn and grow as they have before.<BR>
<BR>
It would be difficult, ascending a second time. Maybe they could try to go back on the path of the original intention of the rituals. Maybe they can try for godhood. They will probably fail.<BR>
<BR>
But at least they can try.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Life and the Animate: the Key to Bretonnic Golemworking<BR>
<BR>
by Saer Vacerit<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Though the making of magical statues and other such animated servitors has been part and parcel for the magically inclined societies of Tamriel, the fashioning and bringing to life of golems is an art-form unique to the Bretons, and has found little ingress elsewhere on the continent. Visitors to High Rock oft mistake these lumbering shapes for Atronachi - indeed, this misapprehension is common among the Breton mages themselves, as the properly fashioned Golem does indeed share some characteristics with Outsider Elementals.<BR>
<BR>
The making of a simple golem is by no means a complicated magic, and has been practiced by the various Breton peoples since time immemorial. The practitioner is to acquire a low-level conscious entity (a beast animus, or one of the more simple Daedricules), and binds it through incantation to a construct, in the same way as one would enchant a sword or a tool. The trick is to enhance the construct, through a patchwork of incantations, amulets, scrolls and alchemicals, in such a way for the various magical essences to allow and promote the transference of living energies. In this way, a simple being is produced that is, by all conventional definitions, alive.<BR>
<BR>
Of course, an effective golem will require much more care and resources than this simple manikin. Most creatures will need a set of sensory receptors, eyes and ears (never mouths!) to receive orders. Directives of vigor and aggression are necessary for a creature of hard labor or guarding, while a personal assistant may need a mind to think, and a will to act on your behalf. Directives of loyalty and devotions are essential in any golem, as creations that lack these are dangerous and untrustworthy. Last but not least, a golem will need a spark or flame of life to give it ambulatory qualities.<BR>
<BR>
The materials from which a given golem is constructed are a clear indication of the caster's skill. First among these is the well-known "chilled" golem, usually made from frozen mud. Its supernatural ice is not so much a sign of its maker's aptitude as an easy way of sapping excess cold buildup in the creatia condensers. The very oldest golems were of this type: the creations of Bjoulsae shamans, who, according to folklore, fashioned miniature servants from horse dung and sent out to enemy encampments. These small interlopers would spoil food and poison water supplies, only to melt away in the morning heat.<BR>
<BR>
While well-crafted chilled golems most certainly exist, most show the signs of cracking and weight shifts that indicate that they were at one point partially heated and then frozen again, when helping their master at the alchemy stand for example. Cold golems are also liable to break and lose limbs, and are functionally useless in the warm climates south of the Iliac Bay. <BR>
<BR>
A superior kind of golem is the one made from clay or stone parts, as first employed during skirmishes with the Redguard invaders. While these servitors still employ a "soft" core of mud in which their directives can be embedded, their outer shell is composed of cleverly interlocking stone or clay parts, giving them more protection and efficiency in warm climates. Indeed, the polarity of these machines is completely reversed as opposed to the cold golems, meaning that they radiate heat. This also makes them more durable, as any cracks in the outer shell are quickly filled by hardening seepage from the soft interior. <BR>
<BR>
The most recent type of golem are those made of iron or other kinds of metal. The first iron golems were fashioned by Anton Demerax, scholar at Gwylim University, who was inspired by the workings of the Dwemer Animunculi whom he observed during his sojourns in the south. While he did not succeed in replicating these automatons, Demerax' research did lead to the creation of a new kind of golem. At first little more than an animated suit of armor, these servitors showed their use in the Fourteenth Battle of Northmoor.<BR>
<BR>
A special note on the servitor known as the Haemonculus, which is of a different nature. Pioneered by the witch covens of the southern coast, these rag-tag creatures show all the signs of their hedgery-magic and unseen purpose. They function more or less the same as other golems, with the addition of select Daedric matter to the design, such as hearts, skin, limbs, and any other aspect that can be harvested from a dissipating summons. This imbues these creatures with a much more focused and malicious will, which often escapes its creator's control and turns against them. Homonculi have been used as guardians since time immemorial, often praised for their tireless vigilance, their self-sufficiency, and their single-minded aggression. It goes without saying that the making and employing of such artifacts falls outside of the purview of any self-respecting practitioner of the magical arts.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
生命与活化物质：布莱顿魔像制作的关键<BR>
<BR>
塞尔·瓦塞里特 著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
尽管制作魔法雕像和其他此类活化仆从一直是泰姆瑞尔魔法倾向社会的常见组成部分，但魔像的塑造和赋予生命却是布莱顿人独有的艺术形式，在大陆其他地方鲜有涉足。高岩的访客常将这些笨拙的形体误认为是侍灵 -- 事实上，这种误解在布莱顿法师自身中也颇为常见，因为制作得当的魔像确实与异界元素生物共享一些特征。<BR>
<BR>
制作一个简单的魔像绝非复杂的魔法，自远古以来就被各个布莱顿民族所实践。修行者需获取一个低阶的有意识实体（一只野兽的灵性，或一个较简单的迪德拉灵体），并通过咒语将其束缚到一个构造体上，就像给剑或工具附魔一样。诀窍在于，通过咒语、护符、卷轴和炼金物品的拼凑组合来强化构造体，使得各种魔法精华能够允许并促进生命能量的转移。如此，一个按所有常规定义都算“活着”的简单生物便被创造出来。<BR>
<BR>
当然，一个有效的魔像需要比这个简单人偶多得多的照料和资源。大多数生物需要一套感觉接收器，眼睛和耳朵（永远不要嘴巴！）来接收命令。对于从事繁重劳动或守卫的生物来说，活力与攻击性的指令是必需的；而个人助理则可能需要思考的头脑和代表你行事的意志。忠诚与奉献的指令对任何魔像都至关重要，因为缺乏这些的造物是危险且不可信的。最后但同样重要的是，魔像需要生命的火花或火焰来赋予它移动的特性。<BR>
<BR>
构造魔像的材料是施法者技能的明确体现。其中首先是众所周知的“寒冰”魔像，通常由冻泥制成。它那超自然的寒冰与其说是制造者技艺的标志，不如说是消耗创质冷凝器中多余寒冷积聚的简便方法。最古老的魔像就是这种类型：彼欧塞萨满的造物，根据民间传说，他们用马粪制作微型仆从，派往敌军营地。这些小小的入侵者会破坏食物、毒化水源，然后在早晨的暑热中融化消失。<BR>
<BR>
虽然精心制作的寒冰魔像确实存在，但大多数都显示出开裂和重量转移的迹象，表明它们曾在某个时刻（例如在炼金台前帮助主人时）部分受热，然后又重新冻结。寒冰魔像也容易断裂和失去肢体，并且在髂骨湾以南的温暖气候中基本无用。<BR>
<BR>
更高级的魔像是由黏土或石材部件制成的，最早在与红卫入侵者的冲突中使用。这些仆从虽然仍采用可嵌入指令的“软”泥核心，但其外壳由巧妙互锁的石材或黏土部件组成，使它们在温暖气候中具有更强的防护力和效率。实际上，这些机器的极性相对于寒冰魔像完全反转，意味着它们会散热。这也使它们更耐用，因为外壳的任何裂缝都会被柔软内芯渗出的硬化物质迅速填补。<BR>
<BR>
最新型的魔像是用铁或其他金属制成的。第一批铁魔像是由格维林大学的学者安东·德梅拉克斯创造的，他受到在南下旅居期间观察到的锻莫机关构体的启发。虽然他未能成功复制那些自动机器，但德梅拉克斯的研究确实导致了一种新型魔像的诞生。起初不过是一套活化盔甲，这些仆从在北沼第十四次战役中展现了其用途。<BR>
<BR>
特别需要提及一种性质不同的仆从，称为血肉魔像。由南海岸的女巫集会首创，这些拼凑而成的生物显露出其粗陋魔法和不可告人目的的所有迹象。它们的功能与其他魔像大体相同，只是在设计中加入了精选的迪德拉物质，如心脏、皮肤、肢体，以及任何可以从消散的召唤物中收获的部件。这赋予了这些生物更加专注和恶毒的意志，这种意志常常脱离其创造者的控制，转而攻击他们。血肉魔像自古以来就被用作守卫，常因其不知疲倦的警惕、自给自足和一心一意的攻击性而受到称赞。不言而喻，此类神器的制造和使用超出了任何有自尊心的魔法技艺实践者的范畴。<BR>

与关于这一低等物种起源的本地传说相反，蟹灵从阿碧希安海迁徙到注入髂骨湾的湖泊和水湾。除了从人类躯干大小的骨架框架上伸出的众多爪状肢体、钳子和疾行脚外，蟹灵还披着装甲般的皮，并分泌在某些圈子里备受珍视的壳蜡。它们是水生清道夫，大部分时间生活在深海水域。当地渔民讲述了与此物种发生冲突的故事（例如蟹灵割破渔网偷鱼），但蟹灵大多性情温和，除了在它们的蜕变期 -- 卡维纳西姆期间。<BR>
<BR>
在卡维纳西姆期间，蟹灵在陆地上行走，偏爱海岸沼泽和靠近开阔水域的河流。幼崽受到严密保护，育母极具领地意识，对入侵者反应迅速且充满敌意。这让人相信卡维纳西姆增强了蟹灵的战斗本能：事实上，在目睹了我们的首席地理学家普尔凯里乌斯·庞普提努斯被开膛破肚之后，我们的突袭队在捕获和挑选更多标本之前都三思而后行。<BR>
<BR>
在陆地上行走一年后，蟹灵返回水中。当它们潜入水中时，会经历一次被称为“梅夫”的最终蜕变，在此过程中它们吞噬自己的陆生皮肤和呼吸器官 -- 那些它们不再需要的身体部位 -- 然后将凝固的残留物呕吐成直径约一英尺的小纤维球。这些令人作呕、气味难闻的球体被称为“格罗姆”，在湖泊周围成簇被发现。迄今为止，我们的药剂师尚未发现格罗姆有何益处，除了能让这支队伍中一些肠胃较弱的成员感到恶心之外。<BR><BR>"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Light Armor Repair<BR><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
There are two classes of light armor, metallic and non-metallic. Chainmail, Elven, Mithril and Glass are all examples of metallic light armor. You may be surprised to think that Glass can be thought of as metallic, but appearances are deceiving. What we call Glass is nothing like the windows panes you see in houses. The greenish material is far stronger and has a much higher melting point.<BR>
<BR>
Non-metallic armors are Fur and Leather. For these armor types, the hammer is less useful than the sewing kit. A sharp awl is necessary to restitch the thick material. Holes frequently have to be patched with spare material. The rule of thumb is once you have to patch a patch, it's time to throw out the armor and get a new set.<BR>
<BR>
Metallic armor will occasionally need a patch. Usually it can be repaired by hammering the torn pieces back together. Elven and Mithril will repair better when heated. Chainmail is usually malleable enough to work on cold.<BR>
<BR>
The trickiest of all is Glass. Hammer blows struck across the grain run the risk of shattering the armor. Whenever possible, allign the hammer blows with the grain. In extreme cases, place the armor in tub of oil. Place the anvil so that the affected piece is on the anvil, but just under the oil. Vibrations from the hammer blows are absorbed by the oil and less likely to shatter the Glass.<BR>
<BR>"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
轻甲修理<BR><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
轻甲分为两类：金属类和非金属类。锁子甲、精灵甲、秘银甲和玻璃甲都属于金属类轻甲。你可能会惊讶于玻璃甲被认为是金属类，但外表具有欺骗性。我们所说的玻璃与你在房屋中看到的窗玻璃完全不同。这种带绿色的材料坚固得多，熔点也高得多。<BR>
<BR>
非金属类护甲是毛皮甲和皮革甲。对于这些类型的护甲，锤子的用处不如缝纫工具包。需要用锋利的锥子重新缝合厚实的材料。破洞常常需要用备用材料打补丁。经验法则是，一旦你需要在补丁上再打补丁，就该扔掉这件护甲，换一套新的了。<BR>
<BR>
金属类护甲偶尔需要补缀。通常可以通过将撕裂的碎片锤打在一起进行修复。精灵甲和秘银甲在加热时修复效果更好。锁子甲通常具有足够的延展性，可以在冷态下操作。<BR>
<BR>
最棘手的是玻璃甲。垂直于纹理方向的锤击有使护甲碎裂的风险。只要可能，就让锤击方向与纹理对齐。在极端情况下，将护甲放入一桶油中。放置铁砧，使受损部位位于铁砧上，但刚好在油面之下。锤击产生的振动被油吸收，从而降低玻璃碎裂的可能性。<BR>

Like in the Deal<BR>
By Orgol gro-Muk<BR>
<BR>
The first few days with my new friends was a time to great enjoyment. Every day, I would spend a few hours begging Kievier Sounien to teach me a new spell. I knew he dreaded my stupidity, but he could not ask for a more enthused student. Besides tolerating my attempts to be educated, there was little to do. <BR>
Ma'Dar, Kievier Sounien, and Celewen, I have already mentioned. Besides them, the ruin also housed Reeya and Hjestvild. Reeya was an Argonian mage, and wasn't as receptive as Kievier about teaching his craft. I didn't learn much more about him, because I have a policy against bothering creatures with that many sharp teeth. Hjestvild was a boastful Nordic thief, and was very ill-suited for his profession. The majority of his tales of theft ended with something like "And then I smote the guard with a mighty fist" or "But jail's not so bad, you know?" I would have taken the opportunity to let Hjestvild teach me about his trade as well, but even unfortified, I knew better.<BR>
<BR>
As Sundas turned into Morndas, marking the passing of my first week here, we began to worry that Celewen had been captured. Usually, she would be gone only half a day at a time, but none among had laid eyes upon her for four. I'm sure none of the others enjoyed the irony that she returned on The Day of Waiting, as I doubt those outside of the Dragontail Mountains know of it (the day, for those outside that range, was the 9th First Seed).<BR>
<BR>
Celewen brought news of a shipment of moon sugar that needed distributing, as well as some other cargo she was more secretive about. Mostly, it would involve hauling crates from the boat at the port to our hideout. Considering the build of our fellows, I suspected the duty would fall chiefly on Hjestvild and myself. Time to earn my keep, I suppose. At least my armor had been destroyed, so I could do the work without that Igma on my back.<BR>
<BR>
While the rest of us prepared to leave, Kievier sprawled himself out on a hammock. As the only one who could exercise a measure of control over our undead security system, he was the safest choice to stay. Reeya finished his preparations early, and dashed out of the ruin. Curious, I followed the Argonian (besides, having very little to my name, I required very little preparation). I found him bent over talking to the shoreline not too far from the ruin. My approach must have been unwelcome, for he gestured for me to stay back.<BR>
<BR>
When he finished whatever he had been hissing in his own language, a muted purple haze floated over the water, and he turned to me. "It's the Slaughterfish, warmblood. We trained the ones here to carry messages for us. No man, or mer, or even Argonian can match their grace under the surface." He began walking back toward the ruin's hidden entrance, to await the others. "Swift swim will hasten their journey even more. We will follow the shoreline to the port, and keep our eyes to the water. For when we see again those Slaughterfish, we will know whether or not the law will be there to dissuade our work. The deal with our fellow smugglers did not include fighting well armed guards, after all." <BR>

<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
蒂贝拉之百合<BR>

[以下是蒂贝拉的诺德追随者中流传的一个流行故事，大约创作于人类第一帝国后期（第一纪元200年-400年）。以下现代泰姆瑞尔语翻译由冬堡文化厅成员完成，第三纪元289年]<BR>

<BR>
“真有趣在这儿找到你，朔尔的娼妇，”精灵冷笑道，“你丈夫这么快就厌倦你了，让你出来玩泥巴，而他去和公猪交配？”<BR>
蒂贝拉面对这邋遢生物的嘲讽毫不动摇，挺直身体，抚平了裙子上的褶皱。“下午好，精灵，”女神说道，“你看起来相当暴躁，即使对雪精灵而言也是如此。我打扰你安眠了吗？如果你愿意，我可以帮你重新铺床。事实上，我相信我刚才就在路边看到了一些[猛犸粪]。”<BR>
精灵见没能激怒蒂贝拉，气得直跺脚，并用手指着她指责道：“别假装我的话伤不到你，因为那是事实！事实上，我很确定，即使是朔尔本人，也会更青睐我而不是你！”<BR>
一向相当庄重的蒂贝拉发出了一连串咯咯的笑声，从中诞生了十二种新的山花。那雪精灵只是越来越生气，脸涨得通红，徒劳地抓着新生的花朵。<BR>
“我向你挑战，蒂贝拉，人类的邋遢女人，来一场美貌竞赛！不需要裁判，因为即使是你也不得不承认我的胜利！除非你害怕被拉下马......”伐莫用一种极其恶心的、能使瓦拉格奶凝固的笑容斜眼看着我们的女神。作为回应，蒂贝拉长久而坚定地看着这个[可怜的]生物。精灵的威胁终究没有任何真实依据。朔尔深爱着他的妻子们，他绝不会选择一个精灵作为他的新娘。然而，也许这件事也能带来一些好处......<BR>
<BR>
“我接受你的挑战，精灵，”我们的女神说道。<BR>
“好！好！一周后在这山脚下见我，我们来看看谁是整个梦达斯最美丽的！”<BR>
<BR>
竞赛的细节敲定后，雪精灵一路咯咯笑着爬回了她的山间要塞。蒂贝拉叹了口气，目送她离去。“我想并非一切事物都天生具有美感，”蒂贝拉想，“但我相信我可以给她上一堂关于谦逊的课。”<BR>
<BR>
蒂贝拉仰望天空喊道：“鹰姐妹！我需要你的帮助来完成一项最崇高的举动！这关乎羞辱一个精灵！”云层变暗、旋转。帷幕拉开，我们的神祇注视着一张既美丽又[令人不安]的面孔。蒂贝拉笑了。她的呼唤得到了回应。<BR>
<BR>
一周过去了，精灵回到山脚下与蒂贝拉会面。她的眼圈用炭涂黑，头发用一种最好别问是什么的物质染成了深红色，裙子只被窝里的碎屑稍稍弄脏。伐莫带着一种傲慢的神气，就像剑齿虎在受伤的猎物周围踱步一样。“那个所谓的女神绝对不可能赢我！”精灵自言自语道。她瞥见蒂贝拉就在路的拐弯处，穿着完全相同的蓝色长袍，只是更脏了些。<BR>
<BR>
“愚蠢的人类女神，你甚至懒得准备吗？看看我！”伐莫吹嘘道，摆出一个她想必认为很诱人的姿势。<BR>
<BR>
“是的，你很可爱，但请告诉我，亲爱的精灵，你觉得我的这朵花怎么样？”蒂贝拉回答道。<BR>
<BR>
“你的......花？！”精灵惊叫道。<BR>
<BR>
“是的，一朵花。”蒂贝拉指向一朵梦达斯上从未见过的百合花。花瓣呈粉红色，渐渐融入天蓝色，反射着玛格努斯的光芒。它细长的茎上点缀着宽阔的叶子，有着[羔羊毛般的质感]。这真是一株宏伟的植物，值得一百首民谣来赞颂。“过去这一周，我一直在同一个地方辛勤劳作，浇水、除草、培育这片土地。它很美丽，不是吗？”<BR>
<BR>
“我简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。连诺德的神都很蠢！这是美貌竞赛，不是农艺竞赛！”精灵欢呼道。“我赢了！我赢了！我赢了！”<BR>
<BR>
伐莫的话被一声巨响打断，紧接着是一阵缓慢柔和的隆隆声，越来越响。天空变暗了，当蒂贝拉和精灵抬头看时，前者笑了，后者做出了一个极其滑稽的鬼脸（嗯，至少对我们来说是这样）。一大群难以计数的淡绿色飞蛾，排列成精巧且不断变化的队形，已经到达并在她们头顶形成了一个雷鸣般的漩涡。<BR>
<BR>
“这是某种诺德人的诡计吗？以奥瑞埃尔之名，那怪物是什么？！”雪精灵哭喊道。<BR>
“一堂关于什么是真正美丽的课，你这可怜的东西。”女神回答道。<BR>
<BR>
飞蛾们仿佛接到了信号，猛地冲向那朵淡蓝色的百合花，整个空地都被一个由飞蛾构成的混乱漏斗云所笼罩。精灵逃到附近一块巨石后面躲避，简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。<BR>
<BR>
的确，飞蛾们非常迷恋蒂贝拉上周辛勤培育的那朵百合花，但这并不是它们聚集如此之多的唯一原因。飞蛾们在享用了百合花蜜之后，产下了堆堆如雪堆般大小的卵，然后飞走了。<BR>
<BR>
然而，事情并没有就此结束！那些卵，得到了吉讷本人的祝福，在飞蛾离开后几秒钟内就迅速孵化，并开始向蒂贝拉爬去。女神只是看着惊恐的精灵，带着腼腆的笑容，向后仰起头和双臂。蠕虫覆盖了女神的每一寸肌肤，在雪精灵看来，它们扭动翻腾了似乎永远那么久。然后，蠕虫卷成茧，掉到了地上。<BR>
<BR>
伐莫简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。仅仅几分钟前还是沾满泥渍的长袍，现在变成了一件美丽的淡绿色连衣裙。仔细一看，这件连衣裙并非单色，而是由不断变化的、彩虹般的不同绿色色调组成。哎呀，她身上的丝线之多，足以让一个尼本奈贵族狂喜到晕倒！她的头发用许多互连的小丝带束起。深开的领口，周围环绕着白色褶边，腹部紧裹着丝带，衬托出她的胸部和臀部。裙摆拖在地上，但没有一块泥土敢玷污它，因为那样做将违背蒂贝拉亲爱姐妹的意愿。一些茧已经开始孵化，变成了小小的侍女，托起了她的裙摆。诚然，世界从未见过如此景象，此后也未曾再见。<BR>
<BR>
“我相信我赢了，精灵。”蒂贝拉宣称。<BR>
<BR>
“骗子！江湖术士！人类的猛犸骑手！”伐莫以一种极其不悦的狂怒吼道。她沉浸在愤怒中，没有注意到那只不守规矩的蚕，在她跺脚时被踩碎在脚下。<BR>
<BR>
蒂贝拉的脸色阴沉下来，堆堆的茧嗡嗡作响，破茧而出，愤怒的飞蛾再次聚集形成一个漏斗，然后爆发成一股愤怒的潮水，直扑杀害它们同胞的凶手。精灵发出一声尖叫，被飞蛾群一路驱赶着逃回了她的山间要塞，从此再未骚扰过人类或神灵。<BR>
<BR>
蒂贝拉教会了我们关于真正诺德之美的一个非常重要的道理。它不是你可以涂抹在脸上或挂在脖子上的东西，因为那些是骗子和其他精灵族类的工具。美是通过辛勤工作和劳作赢得的，它将幸福、艺术和爱注入朔尔和吉讷赐予所有诺德人的礼物之中。<BR>
<BR>"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Liminal Bridges<BR>
By Camilonwe of Alinor<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
A Discourse On The Theory and Praxis of Travelling Between Mundus and Oblivion<BR> 
<BR>
Transliminal passage of quickened objects or entities without the persistent agency of hyperagonal media is not possible, and even if possible, would result in instantaneous retromission of the transported referents. Only a transpontine circumpenetra- tion of the limen will result in transits of greater than infinitessimal duration.<BR>
<BR>
Though other hyperagonal media may exist in theory, the only known transliminal artifact capable of sustained transpontine circumpenetra- tion is the sigil stone. A sigil stone is a specimen of pre-Mythic quasi-crystalline morpholith that has been transformed into an extra-dimensional artifact through the arcane inscription of a daedric sigil. Though some common morpholiths like soul gems may be found in nature, the exotic morpoliths used to make sigil stones occur only in pocket voids of Oblivion, and cannot be prospected or harvested without daedric assistance.<BR>
<BR>
Therefore, since both the morpholiths and the daedric sigils required for hyperagonal media cannot be obtained without traffic and commerce with Daedra Lords, it is necessary that a transliminal mechanic cultivate a working knowledge of conjuration -- though purpose-built enchantments may be substituted if the mechanic has sufficient invocatory skill. Traffic and commerce with Daedra Lords is an esoteric but well-established practice, and lies outside the compass of this treatise. [1]<BR>
<BR>
Presuming a sigil stone has been acquired, the transliminal mechanic must first prepare the morpholith to receive the daedric sigil.<BR>
<BR>
Let the mechanic prepare a chamber, sealed against all daylight and disturbances of the outer air, roofed and walled with white stone and floored with black tiles. All surfaces of this chamber must be ritually purified with a solution of void salts in ether solvent.<BR>
<BR>
A foursquare table shall be placed in the center of the room, with a dish to receive the morpholith. Four censers shall be prepared with incense compounded from gorvix and harrada. On the equinox, the mechanic shall then place the morpolith in the dish and intone the rites of the Book of Law, beginning at dawn and continuing without cease until the sunset of the same day.<BR>
<BR>
The mechanic may then present the purified morpholith to the Daedra Lord for his inscription. Once inscribed with the Daedra Lord's sigil, the morpholith becomes a true sigil stone, a powerful artifact that collects and stores arcane power -- similar in many respects to a charged soul gem, but of a much greater magnitude. And it is this sigil stone that is required to provide the tremendous arcane power necessary to sustain the enchantment that supports the transpontine circumpenetration of the limen.<BR>
<BR>
To open a gate to Oblivion, the mechanic must communicate directly, by spell or enchantment, with the Daedra Lord who inscribed the sigil stone in question. The Daedra Lord and the mechanic jointly invoke the conjurational charter [2], and the mechanic activates the charged sigil stone, which is immediately transported through the liminal barrier to the spot where its sigil was inscribed, thus opening a temporary portal between Mundus and Oblivion. This portal may only remain open for a brief period of time, depending on the strength of the liminal barrier at the chosen spots, several minutes being the longest ever reported, so the usefulness of such a gate is quite limited.<BR>
<BR>
[1] Interested students are invited to consult the works of Albrecht Theophannes Bombidius and Galerion The Mystic for the fundaments of this discipline.
[2] Recommended examples of the conjurational charter may be found in Therion's Book of Most Arcane Covenants or Ralliballah's Eleven Ritual Forms.<BR>
<BR>"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
阈限之桥<BR>
阿里诺尔的卡米隆维 著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
论梦达斯与湮灭之间旅行的理论与实践<BR>
<BR>
没有超对角介质持续作用的情况下，活化物体或实体进行跨阈限通道通行是不可能的，即使可能，也会导致被传送的指涉物瞬间返回。只有通过阈限的桥接环绕渗透，才能实现持续时间大于无穷小的穿越。<BR>
<BR>
尽管理论上可能存在其他超对角介质，但已知唯一能够持续进行桥接环绕渗透的跨阈限神器是印记石。印记石是一种前神话时期的准晶体形态石样本，通过迪德拉符文的秘法铭刻，被转化为跨维度的神器。虽然像灵魂石这样的普通形态石可能在自然界中找到，但用于制造印记石的奇异形态石只存在于湮灭的 pocket voids 中，没有迪德拉的帮助无法勘探或采集。<BR>
<BR>
因此，既然没有与迪德拉君主的交易和往来就无法获得超对角介质所需的形态石和迪德拉符文，跨阈限技师就必须培养召唤术的实用知识 -- 尽管如果技师有足够的咒文技能，也可以用特制的附魔来代替。与迪德拉君主的交易和往来是一种深奥但已被确立的实践，不属于本篇论文的范畴。[1]<BR>
<BR>
假设已经获得了一块印记石，跨阈限技师必须首先准备形态石，使其能够接收迪德拉符文。<BR>
<BR>
技师应准备一个房间，密封以防止所有日光和外界空气的干扰，以白石为顶为墙，黑砖铺地。该房间的所有表面必须用虚空盐溶于乙醚溶剂的溶液进行仪式性净化。<BR>
<BR>
在房间中央放置一张四方桌，桌上放一个碟子以承接形态石。准备四个香炉，使用由戈维克斯和哈拉达配制的香料。在春分或秋分日，技师将形态石放入碟中，从黎明开始持续吟诵《法律之书》的仪式，直至当日日落，不可中断。<BR>
<BR>
然后，技师可将净化后的形态石呈递给迪德拉君主，由其进行铭刻。一旦刻上迪德拉君主的符文，形态石就成为真正的印记石，一种能够收集和储存奥术能量的强大神器 -- 在许多方面类似于已充能的灵魂石，但能量规模要大得多。正是需要这种印记石来提供维持支撑阈限桥接环绕渗透的附魔所需的巨大奥术能量。<BR>
<BR>
要开启通往湮灭之门，技师必须通过法术或附魔，与铭刻了该印记石的迪德拉君主直接沟通。迪德拉君主和技师共同援引召唤契约 [2]，然后技师激活已充能的印记石，印记石会立即穿过阈限屏障被传送到其符文被铭刻的地点，从而在梦达斯和湮灭之间打开一个临时传送门。这个传送门只能短暂开启，具体时间取决于所选地点阈限屏障的强度，有记录的最长时间为几分钟，因此这种门扉的用途相当有限。<BR>
<BR>
[1] 有兴趣的学生请参阅阿尔布雷希特·特奥芬尼斯·邦比迪乌斯和“神秘者”伽勒良的著作，以了解这门学科的基础。
[2] 召唤契约的推荐范例可在塞里昂的《最秘约之书》或拉利巴拉赫的《十一种仪式形式》中找到。<BR>
<BR>"""

技师应准备一个房间，密封以防止所有日光和外界空气的干扰，以白石为顶为墙，黑砖铺地。该房间的所有表面必须用虚空盐溶于乙醚溶剂的溶液进行仪式性净化。<BR>

在房间中央放置一张四方桌，桌上放一个碟子以承接形态石。准备四个香炉，使用由戈维克斯和哈拉达配制的香料。在春分或秋分日，技师将形态石放入碟中，从黎明开始持续吟诵《法律之书》的仪式，直至当日日落，不可中断。<BR>
<BR>
然后，技师可将净化后的形态石呈递给迪德拉君主，由其进行铭刻。一旦刻上迪德拉君主的符文，形态石就成为真正的印记石，一种能够收集和储存奥术能量的强大神器 -- 在许多方面类似于已充能的灵魂石，但能量规模要大得多。正是需要这种印记石来提供维持支撑阈限桥接环绕渗透的附魔所需的巨大奥术能量。<BR>
<BR>
要开启通往湮灭之门，技师必须通过法术或附魔，与铭刻了该印记石的迪德拉君主直接沟通。迪德拉君主和技师共同援引召唤契约 [2]，然后技师激活已充能的印记石，印记石会立即穿过阈限屏障被传送到其符文被铭刻的地点，从而在梦达斯和湮灭之间打开一个临时传送门。这个传送门只能短暂开启，具体时间取决于所选地点阈限屏障的强度，有记录的最长时间为几分钟，因此这种门扉的用途相当有限。<BR>
<BR>
[1] 有兴趣的学生请参阅阿尔布雷希特·特奥芬尼斯·邦比迪乌斯和“神秘者”伽勒良的著作，以了解这门学科的基础。
[2] 召唤契约的推荐范例可在塞里昂的《最秘约之书》或拉利巴拉赫的《十一种仪式形式》中找到。<BR>

The Line of Emperors I

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>THE LINE of EMPERORS VOLUME I: from ALESSIA to AMI-EL<BR>

<BR>

A COMPREHENSIVE INQUIRY<BR>

into the<BR>

LINE of SUCCESSION<BR>

of the<BR>

EMPERORS of CYRODIIL<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

by Jaume Abtacil<BR>

<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>

<BR>

By the virtue and patronage of Emperor Pelagius IV, I, Jaume Abtacil, have been granted the scholarly task of presenting to the discerning public a full and unbiased account of the Line of Emperors, beginning with the first, Blessed Alessia, who did found the First Empire, and her many descendants, to the rule of the Remanites, whose iron hand did maintain the Second Empire, to the ascendancy of Tiber Septim, anon Talos, from whom the line of Septim does continue to this day and forever. Herewith I will chronicle their lives and deeds, tally their virtues, expound on their blessed example, so that the people of Tamriel may know the Emperors in their glory.<BR>

<BR>

I. ALESSIA or AL-ESH, ALESHUT, PERRIF, PARAVANIA<BR>

What little we know of the early Emperors came to us through hearsay and myth, and is as such an unworthy basis for fair scholarly enterprise. The true and unvarnished record as was written by the scribes of ages past has sadly felt the tooth of Akatosh, and, more insidiously, the blind zealotry of the Marukhati, whose dogmatic refusal of time's arrow led them to the ritual destruction of many an archive and library. What little they left was once again victim to man's thirst for destruction, and fell to fire and ruin in the War of Righteousness.<BR>

<BR>

As such, when we speak of the Emperors of the First Empire, we must guard for the contrivances of the bard, who seeks to lead us astray on the byways of legend and folklore. Still, where of history naught remains but story, it is the scholar's duty to record, and extract from the song of the past the essence of verity.<BR>

<BR>

The ancestry of the First Empress of Man is forever shrouded in mystery. Empress Alessia first rose to prominence in the Ayleid fiefdom known as Sard or Sard Avar Leed, where many tribes of Man were held in service, and the old clan-bonds and lines of patrimony had fallen into obscurity. Of course, many a fanciful invention tries to fill this lacuna. Some claim Alessia a princess of the wetland tribes, the Al-Gemha or Men-of-Ket, and as such of Nedic royalty. Others make her a descendant of the Men-of-'kreath, either a pure Nord or of mixed blood. Some fables even portray her as the love-child of a Nedic slave and an Ayleid city-king. The underlying purpose of these stories is, obviously, to affirm the first Empress as a legitimate ruler by descent, with a substantiated claim to the White-Gold Throne. Regardless of the verisimilitude of these accounts, in today's age of meritorious aristocracy it is clear that Alessia's claim came about not through inheritance, but through her own actions, and through Divine favor.<BR>

<BR>

The exact moment of Alessia's ascendancy is much debated. Some point to the Insurrection at Sard, where Morihaus did come to her aid, others to the Emancipation at Vahtacen, where for the first time was uttered the name Al-Esh. The Annunciation at Sancre Tor is an obvious candidate, were it not that this likely apocryphal event does not fit in the known chronologies of the Rebellion. The Bestowing of the Imperial Ruby by the Divine Akatosh is another obvious candidate for the moment of ascendancy, but suffers much the same problem: there are about a thousand different accounts of the Bestowing, all in contradiction with each other in time and in place. Most scholars have come to agree that the Taking of the Citadel marks the true beginning of Alessia's reign.<BR>

<BR>

Be it as it may, Empress Alessia's reign is remembered as a time of splendor and provenance. In but several decades, Alessia succeeded in shaping a rabble of ex-slaves and mercenaries into an efficient, powerful and sophisticated culture. This was, in part, due to the tutelage of the remnant Ayleid kings who had sworn fealty to the new Empire, and also due to the Nordic mercenary forces who had brought with the accomplishments of Atmoran civilization. Some Nordic scribes take pleasure in claiming Alessia's Empire as a client-kingdom to the then prominent Empire of Vrage the Gifted, which stretched from Bretony to the holds of Morrowind. Of course, the political relationships between both mannish Empires were much more complicated, based as they were on a foundation of the mutual respect and obligations that two mannish kingdoms would naturally feel for each other. Sadly, such subtleties are oft lacking in northern history writing.<BR>

<BR>

The crux of the matter lies in Alessia's Nordic allies, who had joined the rebellion at Sancre Tor in return for the promise of land and riches. Alessia, in her wisdom, granted the Nordic chieftains expansive estates in the undeveloped west, later known as Colovia, to keep their divergent Nordic customs and religion from dissension with the Nedic Elven-inspired views (a situation happily resolved by later Divine Revelation). These Nordic chieftains, now Colovian gentry, still swore fealty to the Nordic High King, even as their Nedic and Ayleid subjects belonged solely to the White-Gold Throne. This feudal complication would haunt the relations with the Colovian Estates in years to come.<BR>

<BR>

II. BELHARZA or THE MAN-BULL<BR>

Little is known of the second Emperor of Man, save, of course, his half-bullish aspect. Belharza's father was Morihaus, god of legend, who in turn was the favored son of the Divine Kynareth. Thus, his lineage is peerless, even if the maternal line is understandably marred by our ignorance of Alessia's true ancestry. The ascension of Belharza was said to suffer from a crisis, caused by the Nedes' insistence on a maternal succession. Emperor Belharza spent some of his youth in voluntary exile amongst the Nords before claiming his throne, and as such his rule was saturated in a Nordic ideal of life and governance.<BR>

<BR>

Belharza's reign was sober and soldierly, in sharp contrast to his developing Nibenese cort$E8ge, but necessary for the defense of his fledgling empire. Belharza fixed the borders of Cyrodiil with great stones, and pressured the southern Blackwood tribes and Colovian estates into the giving of tribute to the White-Gold Throne. Of his personal life we know little. Memories of his marital status are muddled and unsure, though the record states with great surety that Belharza did never marry a consort, if ever he had any.<BR>

<BR>

III. AMI-EL<BR>

Possibly the most obscure Emperor of the early line, as almost nothing is known of Ami-El save his (or her) name and involvement in a Nord-Direnni conflict in the Western Reach. Fraudulent myth surrounds this Emperor, and makes any definitive statement little more than supposition. Speculation on Belharza's matrimonial arrangements have led some to believe that Ami-El was an illegitimate child of one of Belharza's odalisques, or even a common pauper elected as figurehead after a coup by one of Belharza's cousins. While it is true that the Marukhati reveled in the electing of random commoners to vaunted symbolical status, it is a matter of historical truth that they did not at any time have the requisite power to install an Emperor. Iconographical depictions, at least, agree on the signs of Ami-El's ancestry, depicting him with a single vestigial bullhorn.<BR>

<BR>

Of Ami-El's reign little is known, save that he furthered the cause of the Marukhati and decreed the Alessian Doctrines as the law of the land. Many dietary and occupational restrictions associated with Marukhatism were instated in this time, furthering the divergence between Nibenay and Colovia. Other than that, Ami-El is said to have strengthened the bonds with the Nordic Empire, and expanded the rule of the Alessians south along the Niben, subjugating the semi-independent Nedic tribes and Ayleid kings, and displacing the Khajiiti occupation of the left bank. Legends speak of a "marriage with the sea," hinting at an alliance with one of the great mercantile powers of the Topal Bay.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>帝王世系 卷一：从阿莱西亚到阿米-埃尔<BR>

<BR>

全面探究<BR>

关于<BR>

继承世系<BR>

之<BR>

西罗帝尔皇帝<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

豪梅·阿布塔西尔 著<BR>

<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>

<BR>

承蒙皇帝佩拉吉乌斯四世的恩典与赞助，我，豪梅·阿布塔西尔，被赋予了一项学术任务：向有见地的公众呈现一份关于帝王世系的完整、不偏不倚的记述，从第一位皇帝、蒙福的阿莱西亚（她建立了第一帝国）及其众多后裔，到雷曼家族的统治（其铁腕维持了第二帝国），再到泰伯·塞普汀（即塔洛斯）的崛起，塞普汀世系从他延续至今，并将永远延续。我将在此记录他们的生平与事迹，列举他们的美德，阐述他们蒙福的榜样，以使泰姆瑞尔的人民了解皇帝们的荣光。<BR>

<BR>

一、阿莱西亚 或称 阿莱西亚、阿莱舒特、佩里夫、帕拉瓦尼亚<BR>

我们对早期皇帝所知甚少，多来自传闻和神话，因此不能作为公正学术研究的可靠基础。不幸的是，过去时代的抄写员所书写的真实、未加修饰的记录，已遭受阿卡托什之齿的啃噬，以及更阴险的 -- 马鲁哈特教派的盲目狂热，他们对时间箭头的教条式拒绝导致他们仪式性地摧毁了许多档案馆和图书馆。他们留下的那点东西，又再次成为人类毁灭欲望的牺牲品，在正义战争中毁于火海和废墟。<BR>

<BR>

因此，当我们谈论第一帝国的皇帝时，我们必须警惕吟游诗人的杜撰，他们试图在传说和民俗的歧路上误导我们。尽管如此，在历史只剩故事可寻之处，学者的职责便是记录，并从往昔的歌谣中提取真实的精髓。<BR>

<BR>

人类第一位女皇的祖先永远笼罩在神秘之中。女皇阿莱西亚最初崛起于名为萨德或萨达瓦·里德的亚历德封地，那里有许多人类部落被奴役，古老的氏族纽带和祖传世系已湮没无闻。当然，许多异想天开的杜撰试图填补这一空白。有人声称阿莱西亚是湿地部落阿尔-格姆哈或克特之民的公主，因此是尼德王室后裔。另一些人则说她是克瑞斯部落的后裔，要么是纯血诺德人，要么是混血。有些寓言甚至把她描绘成一个尼德奴隶与一个亚历德城邦国王的私生子。这些故事的潜在目的显然是肯定第一位女皇作为合法统治者的血统，确立她对白金塔王座的宣称权。无论这些叙述的真实性如何，在当今功绩贵族的时代，阿莱西亚的宣称权显然并非来自继承，而是来自她自身的行动，以及神圣的恩宠。<BR>

<BR>

阿莱西亚崛起的确切时刻争议颇多。有人认为是萨德起义，当时莫里豪斯前来援助她；也有人认为是瓦塔肯解放，那里首次喊出了阿莱西亚之名。桑克雷·托的宣告是一个明显的候选，但这一可能杜撰的事件与已知的起义年表不符。神圣阿卡托什赐予帝国红钻是另一个明显的崛起时刻，但存在同样的问题：关于赐予的记载有上千种，在时间和地点上相互矛盾。大多数学者已达成共识，认为攻克都堡标志着阿莱西亚统治的真正开始。<BR>

<BR>

无论如何，阿莱西亚女皇的统治被铭记为一个辉煌与兴盛的时期。短短几十年内，阿莱西亚成功地将一群前奴隶和雇佣兵塑造为一个高效、强大且精密的文明。这在一定程度上归功于宣誓效忠新帝国的残存亚历德国王的指导，也归功于带来了阿特莫拉文明成就的诺德雇佣军。一些诺德抄写员乐于声称阿莱西亚帝国是当时著名的天赋者弗拉格帝国的附属王国，后者的疆域从布莱托尼一直延伸到晨风的各据点。当然，这两个人类帝国之间的政治关系要复杂得多，其基础是两个人类王国彼此自然会感受到的相互尊重与义务。可悲的是，北方的历史写作常常缺乏这种微妙之处。<BR>

<BR>

问题的关键在于阿莱西亚的诺德盟友，他们加入了桑克雷·托的起义，以换取土地和财富的承诺。阿莱西亚以其智慧，在未开发的西部（后来被称为科洛维亚）授予诺德酋长们广阔的庄园，以保持他们迥异的诺德习俗和宗教不与受精灵启发的尼德观念产生冲突（后来通过神圣启示，这一情况得到了令人满意的解决）。这些诺德酋长，即后来的科洛维亚贵族，仍然效忠于诺德至高王，即使他们的尼德和亚历德臣民只属于白金塔王座。这种封建复杂性将在未来困扰与科洛维亚各领地的关系。<BR>

<BR>

二、贝尔哈扎 或称 人牛<BR>

对人类的第二位皇帝知之甚少，当然，除了他的半牛形象之外。贝尔哈扎的父亲是传说之神莫里豪斯，而莫里豪斯又是神圣吉娜瑞斯的爱子。因此，他的血统无与伦比，即使母系因我们对阿莱西亚真实血统的无知而存在缺陷（这是可以理解的）。据说贝尔哈扎的登基经历了一场危机，由尼德人坚持母系继承所引发。贝尔哈扎皇帝在登基前，曾自愿流亡诺德人中度过了部分青年时光，因此他的统治浸透了诺德人的生活与治理理念。<BR>

<BR>

贝尔哈扎的统治是严肃且军人化的，与他逐渐形成的尼本奈随从形成鲜明对比，但这对于保卫他初生的帝国是必要的。贝尔哈扎用巨石固定了西罗帝尔的边界，并迫使南部的黑木部落和科洛维亚领地向白金塔王座进贡。关于他的个人生活，我们知之甚少。关于他婚姻状况的记载模糊不清，但记录非常肯定地指出，贝尔哈扎从未娶过配偶（如果他有的话）。<BR>

<BR>

三、阿米-埃尔<BR>

可能是早期世系中最默默无闻的皇帝，因为除了他的名字（或她的名字）以及参与了西部河峪的一场诺德-迪伦尼冲突外，几乎对阿米-埃尔一无所知。围绕这位皇帝的是虚假的神话，使得任何确定的陈述都近乎猜测。对贝尔哈扎婚姻安排的猜测导致一些人认为阿米-埃尔是贝尔哈扎某个侍妾的私生子，甚至是贝尔哈扎某个堂兄弟政变后选为傀儡的普通乞丐。虽然马鲁哈特派确实热衷于随机选举平民担任受人尊崇的象征性地位，但历史事实是，他们从未拥有过拥立皇帝的必要权力。至少，图像学描述在阿米-埃尔血统的标志上是一致的，将他描绘成带着一个残留的牛角。<BR>

<BR>

关于阿米-埃尔的统治，我们知之甚少，只知道他推动了马鲁哈特派的事业，并颁布法令，宣布阿莱西亚教义为这片土地的法律。许多与马鲁哈特主义相关的饮食和职业限制在这一时期确立，进一步加深了尼本奈与科洛维亚之间的分歧。除此之外，据说阿米-埃尔加强了与诺德帝国的联系，并沿着尼本河向南扩展了阿莱西亚人的统治，征服了半独立的尼德部落和亚历德国王，并取代了卡吉特对左岸的占领。传说中提到了“与大海的婚姻”，暗示与托帕尔湾的一个强大商业势力结盟。<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>THE LINE of EMPERORS VOLUME II: from GORIEUS to HERDA<BR>

<BR>

A COMPREHENSIVE INQUIRY<BR>

into the<BR>

LINE of SUCCESSION<BR>

of the<BR>

EMPERORS of CYRODIIL<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

by Jaume Abtacil<BR>

<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>

<BR>
<BR>

IV. GORIEUS<BR>

Emperor Gorieus assumed the throne in 1E 478. Memory of this Emperor is pointedly divided: Colovians speak of him as the tyrannical usurper defied in the legend of Rislav the Righteous, while the Nibenese portray him as the wizened, immortal ruler from the extravagant fables of the Woven City. The longevity of Gorieus is no mere myth, though: all sources indicate that he ruled the Heartland for an uninterrupted five hundred years, before ceding the throne to Hestra.<BR>

<BR>

Folk tales claim Gorieus was a great sorcerer who hid his soul in a marvelous silk tapestry, thus tricking Arkay into searching its convoluted geometric patterns for hundreds of years -- or even for all eternity, if the folktales of the Wandering Emperor are to be taken serious. More sober heads have theorized that there were not one, but several emperors in this period, the so-called Goriathite dynasty, and that current confusion is the result of destruction of primary sources, deliberate misdirection by Marukhati iconoclasts, and the homogenizing tendencies of myth. Most likely, he was merely an accomplished mage, who mastered the Ayleid arts even as his priests rained down death on that hapless people.<BR>

<BR>

Be as it may, Gorieus' reign was an eventful era. After the crushing defeat at Glenumbra Moors, Alessian political influence beyond the Nibenay was for all practical purposes at an end, and the rule of the Cyrodiils limited. The Niben's commercial culture, however, flourished, and riches from all over Tamriel flooded the valley. An age of decadence followed, wherein the Niben's indulgent society and totemic cults were further shaped into their current form. The trade of silk was paramount, and came near to a religious sacrament in some ways. For a while, the Imperial City was decked out in layer upon layer of the most splendid silks, truly earning the title of the Woven City. Excesses in this regard caused the city to burn down no less than five times during Gorieus' reign, eventually necessitating a complete rebuilding in many quarters.<BR>

<BR>

Gorieus eventually abdicated in favor of daughter, Hestra (or, in the alternate record, his great-great-granddaughter Hestra), and left the palace, never to be seen again. His tomb lies empty.<BR>

<BR>

V. HESTRA or HESTRA, THE BUILDER<BR>

Empress Hestra is remembered as the Builder, for she finished the renovation and expansion of the Imperial City that started under her father's reign. Furthermore, she was responsible for the many great highways that were built in this time, still remembered as Hestra-Ways. Only Reman I and Potentate Sidri-Ashak did more to improve the Empire's road network. Hestra sought to rejoin the Colovian Estates with the Empire, and with their military support, she waged war across the Empire, reconquering the Reach, and making inroads into both Argonia and Valenwood. Hestra thus demonstrates the true strength of Cyrodiil, that, when East and West are united, the Rule of Law across Tamriel is assured.<BR>

<BR>

Hestra was faithful to the example of Alessia, both as a wise ruler and a great warrior. She often shared the hardships of war with her soldiers on the Reachman front, thus earning their undying loyalty. Indeed, her great military campaigns were equated by many with the triumphs of the Alessian Rebellion, until they were regarded as pilgrimages and crusades in the honor of the first of Emperors.<BR>

<BR>

It should be noted that Hestra was not only mighty in battle, but also a perceptive diplomat, being among the first to establish friendly relations with the newly arrived Yokudan exiles. A great and enduring affection grew between Cyrodiil and Hammerfell, and many wondrous Redguard customs and practices were introduced to the Imperial people. The greatest of these is no doubt the sophisticated tradition of duels and arena fighting, which is still being practiced in the Imperial City and the city of Kvatch to this day. Hestra herself invited the great blademaster Gaiden Shinji to found the Imperial Arena, for she took great pleasure in these contests of skill, as did her people.<BR>

<BR>

Sadly, for all her great works, Hestra could not prevent the critical discontinuation of all written record which the ignorant and the Numidianists refer to as the "Dragon Break" or the "Middle Dawn." In this period, the Marukhati aversion to record-keeping germinates to such fearsome heights that all written sources of this time must be discounted as fundamentally unreliable. Hestra's later life is the subject of pure conjecture. It may be assumed she continued her policy of conquest and infrastructure, eventually holding a substantial territory (though the exact nature of these lands is obscured to us). Some sources indicate that Hestra was the first Emperor to hold extramundial colonies, possibly having one or more tribute-kingdoms in Oblivion. The matter of succession is veiled in mystery.<BR>

<BR>

VI. SHOR-EL<BR>

A most obscure and possibly apocryphal Emperor. Shor-El's reign is victim to the negligence of his scribes, as it falls squarely into this period of abhorrent anti-scholarship. His relation to Hestra is unknown. Some believe Shor-El to be not of the true line, but a Nordic usurper who held the Imperial City for but a scant few years. The poets' words state that Cyrodiil in this time became "like an egg," signifying that its political might was once again limited to the Belharzarian borders. Whatever the cause, the seat of Emperors lost much of its splendor, and in later years was overshadowed by the growing might of the Oloman Confederacy in Colovia -- a curious reversal, indeed.<BR>

<BR>

VII. HERDA<BR>

Emperor Herda is the last Empress of the Alessian line known to us by name. She ruled somewhere shortly after the devastating War of Righteousness, with both her predecessors and successors unknown. The records speak of her as a mediator, who restored friendly relations between Colovia and Nibenay after many years fraught with dissension. Let it be understood that those of the early Emperors who brought unity and strength to Cyrodiil were remembered, while other languish in obscurity: A fitting lesson, I believe, for both ruler and servant.<BR>

<BR>

No mention of Herda is made after 1E 2260, and later records fail to elucidate us on the subject of the Alessian rulers. Most likely the line of Alessia had died out by then, being replaced by the traitor priest-kings and insipid potentates who would come to epitomize the First Interregnum. A sad end for this most mythical of lineages.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>帝王世系 卷二：从戈里乌斯到赫尔达<BR>

<BR>

全面探究<BR>

关于<BR>

继承世系<BR>

之<BR>

西罗帝尔皇帝<BR>

豪梅·阿布塔西尔 著<BR>

四、戈里乌斯<BR>

戈里乌斯皇帝于第一纪元478年即位。关于这位皇帝的记忆存在明显分歧：科洛维亚人视他为暴虐的篡位者，被“正义者”里斯拉夫的传说所反抗；而尼本奈人则将他描绘成《编织之城》奢华寓言中那位老成、不朽的统治者。然而，戈里乌斯的长寿并非仅仅是神话：所有资料都表明，他在将王位让给海斯特拉之前，不间断地统治了心脏地五百年。<BR>

<BR>

民间故事称戈里乌斯是一位伟大的巫师，他将自己的灵魂藏在一幅奇妙的丝绸挂毯中，从而欺骗阿尔凯在其错综复杂的几何图案中寻找了数百年 -- 如果关于“流浪皇帝”的民间传说可信的话，甚至可能是永恒。更清醒的头脑推测，这一时期并非只有一位，而是有几位皇帝，即所谓的戈里乌斯王朝，而当前的混乱是原始资料被毁、马鲁哈特派破坏圣像者的蓄意误导以及神话的同质化趋势共同作用的结果。最有可能的是，他仅仅是一位成就卓著的法师，即使在他的祭司们向那个不幸的民族倾泻死亡之时，他也掌握了亚历德技艺。<BR>

<BR>

无论如何，戈里乌斯的统治是一个多事之秋。在谷影沼泽惨败之后，阿莱西亚人在尼本奈之外的政治影响力实际上已经终结，西罗帝尔人的统治范围受限。然而，尼本的商业文化却蓬勃发展，来自泰姆瑞尔各地的财富涌入河谷。随后是一个颓废的时代，尼本纵情享乐的社会和图腾崇拜进一步演变成今天的形式。丝绸贸易至高无上，在某些方面近乎宗教圣礼。有一段时间，帝都披上了一层又一层最华丽的丝绸，真正赢得了“编织之城”的称号。这方面的过度导致了在戈里乌斯统治期间，城市被烧毁不下五次，最终许多区域被迫完全重建。<BR>

<BR>

戈里乌斯最终退位，让位给他的女儿海斯特拉（或者在另一种记载中，是他的曾曾孙女海斯特拉），然后离开了宫殿，再未出现。他的陵墓是空的。<BR>

<BR>

五、海斯特拉 或称 建设者海斯特拉<BR>

海斯特拉女皇被誉为“建设者”，因为她完成了在其父亲统治时期开始的帝都翻新和扩建工程。此外，她还负责修建了这一时期建成的许多大道，这些道路至今仍被称为“海斯特拉之路”。只有雷曼一世和摄政王西德里-阿沙克在改善帝国道路网络方面做得更多。海斯特拉试图将科洛维亚各领地重新纳入帝国，并在他们的军事支持下，在整个帝国发动战争，重新征服了河峪，并打入了阿尔贡尼亚和瓦伦伍德。海斯特拉因此证明了西罗帝尔的真正力量：当东方与西方联合起来时，整个泰姆瑞尔的法治便得以保障。<BR>

<BR>

海斯特拉效仿阿莱西亚的榜样，既是一位明智的统治者，也是一位伟大的战士。她经常在河峪前线与士兵们同甘共苦，从而赢得了他们永久的忠诚。事实上，她伟大的军事行动被许多人比作阿莱西亚起义的胜利，最终被视为纪念第一任皇帝的朝圣和圣战。<BR>

<BR>

值得注意的是，海斯特拉不仅勇猛善战，而且还是一位敏锐的外交家，是最早与新抵达的尤库达流亡者建立友好关系的人之一。西罗帝尔和落锤之间发展出深厚持久的友谊，许多奇妙红卫习俗和做法被引入帝国人民之中。其中最伟大的无疑是决斗和竞技场格斗的成熟传统，这种传统至今仍在帝都和科瓦奇城延续。海斯特拉亲自邀请了伟大的剑术大师盖登·真司创建帝国竞技场，因为她和她的人民一样，对这些技巧的较量感到非常愉悦。<BR>

<BR>

可悲的是，尽管海斯特拉功勋卓著，但她未能阻止所有书面记录的严重中断，即无知者和努米迪安主义者所称的“龙破”或“中之黎明”。在这一时期，马鲁哈特派对记录保存的厌恶发展到了可怕的程度，以至于这一时期的任何书面资料都必须被视为根本不可靠而予以摒弃。海斯特拉的晚年生活纯属猜测。可以推测她继续推行她的征服和基础设施建设政策，最终拥有了相当可观的领土（尽管这些领土的具体性质对我们来说是模糊的）。一些资料表明，海斯特拉是第一位拥有境外殖民地的皇帝，可能在湮灭中拥有一个或多个朝贡王国。继承问题则笼罩在神秘之中。<BR>

<BR>

六、舒-埃尔<BR>

一位最不为人知、可能杜撰的皇帝。舒-埃尔的统治是其抄写员疏忽的牺牲品，因为它正好落在这个令人憎恶的反学术时期。他与海斯特拉的关系未知。一些人认为舒-埃尔并非真正的世系成员，而是一个诺德篡位者，只占据了帝都短短几年。诗人的文字称，此时的西罗帝尔变得“像一个蛋”，意味着其政治力量再次局限于贝尔哈扎的边界之内。无论原因如何，皇帝的宝座失去了许多光彩，并在后来被科洛维亚日益强大的奥洛曼联盟所遮蔽 -- 这确实是一个奇异的逆转。<BR>

<BR>

七、赫尔达<BR>

赫尔达皇帝是我们所知阿莱西亚世系中最后一位有名有姓的女皇。她在毁灭性的正义战争结束后不久统治了某个时期，其前任和继任者均未知。记载称她是一位调解者，在经历了多年纷争之后，恢复了科洛维亚与尼本奈之间的友好关系。要知道，早期皇帝中那些为西罗帝尔带来统一和力量的人被铭记，而其他人则默默无闻：我相信，这对统治者和臣民都是一个恰当的教训。<BR>

<BR>

第一纪元2260年之后再无赫尔达的记载，后来的记录也未能阐明阿莱西亚统治者的情况。最有可能的是，阿莱西亚的血脉那时已经断绝，被叛徒祭司王和乏味的权贵所取代，他们将成为第一次大空位的缩影。这是这个最具神话色彩的世系的悲惨结局。<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>THE LINE of EMPERORS VOLUME III: from REMAN I to KASTAV<BR>

<BR>

A COMPREHENSIVE INQUIRY<BR>

into the<BR>

LINE of SUCCESSION<BR>

of the<BR>

<BR>
<BR>

VIII. REMAN I or THE CYRODIIL<BR>

After the War of Righteousness, the Alessian throne was crouched in the tattered remnants of misrule. Colovia and Nibenay were without true rulers, carved into city-states and negligible kingdoms, and ruled by corrupt local magnates. Save a few unlucky fools, none came forth to claim the title of Emperor, and for four hundred years the White-Gold Throne gathered dust in the shadowed halls of the Emperor's palace.<BR>

<BR>

So it would have continued, were it not for the rise of Reman Cyrodiil. Born on the sacred heights of Sancre Tor, he was the child of King Hrol of the upper provinces and the maiden Shoni-Et, a distant relative of the true Alessian line. By the age of thirteen, Reman I had united the Colovian kingdoms through his piety, leadership and sacrosanct example. By joining his army with the Battlemage forces of the Nibenay he defeated the dreaded Tsaeci horde at Pale Pass, and elicited from that serpent people the promise of eternal servitude to the Emperors of Cyrodiil. Reman thus reunited Colovia and Nibenay under his rule, and entered the Imperial City as a conqueror and peacemaker.<BR>

<BR>

Inspired by the loyalty and strength that manifested in his people united, Reman felt called to the holy purpose of uniting all of Tamriel under his Divine rule. His hand forced by the growing aggression of Alinor, Reman united the mannish races of Tamriel and waged a war as had until then never been seen on Nirn, conquering all of the north, the southern lands of Anequina, Pelletine, and Camoria, and much of Argonia. He secured heavy tribute from the kingdom of Alinor in return for accommodation. Only the dusky people of Morrowind resisted this rule, an act of willful sedition for which they were to suffer greatly in times to come.<BR>

<BR>

Reman I was among the most wise and just rulers Cyrodiil ever knew, bringing peace and Imperial Law to the ignorant provinces, instigating great works of infrastructure and fortifications, and reuniting the Imperial people in their common cause and culture. On his deathbed he was thus called upon by the Divines to serve as a guiding star and example to man, and ever since he has been worshiped as the Worldly God, who did come to the aid of man in their hour of need, and returned to them the fires of purpose and identity.<BR>

<BR>

IX. BRAZOLLUS DOR<BR>

While the name and deeds of Emperor Brazollus Dor are sure to ring out in beauty in the hallowed halls of Aetherius, his time of life was clearly overshadowed by the reign of his vaunted predecessor, Reman I. As such, we know precious little of Brazollus Dor, though it can be deduced that he continued the good works of his father, namely the building of Empire, through the construction of Remanite highways, bridges, and fortresses. Brazollus Dor was crowned in 1E 2762, and assumed his name in recognition of Emperor Belharza, also the second ruler in a line, whom Brazollus sought to emulate in all aspects. As such, Brazollus rejuvenated the cult of Morihaus in the Imperial City and instated many rituals in honor of that deity. From the forges of the Zenitharites he ordered a crown of golden bull-horns made, signifying the resurgence of Cyrodiil's Divine bloodline.<BR>

<BR>

Brazollus Dor's date of death goes unrecorded. Let this be a warning to the scribe and the record-keeper, that they must be truthful and exacting in their work, so that further generations may come to know of the great works of their betters.<BR>

<BR>

X. KASTAV or THE WARDEN<BR>

Through the byways of myth we are told the story of Emperor Brazollus Dor's succession. Upon his deathbed, Brazollus surveyed his progeny and found them a bitter disappointment: his many sons and daughters were to the last one drunks, halfwits, cowards and traitors. The Emperor thus denounced and disinherited them all, save for his latest grandson who had been born but three days before. Brazollus then called to his side his trusted advisor and close friend, Kastav of the Crossing Vale, and adopted him as his son and heir, tasked to keep the Empire safe until a son of the line of the Remanites came of age. And Brazollus instructed Kastav to lock away each and every one of his negligent sons and daughters in the holds of the Imperial Prison, so that they could never plot and conspire to overthrow him. By virtue of his adoption into the true line Emperor Kastav is counted among the true Emperors, and for his policy of detaining and imprisoning all his unworthy rivals he is to be known as Kastav the Warden.<BR>

<BR>

Like Brazollus Dor, Emperor Kastav felt the negligence of the scribe's hand. Kastav was known to quell unrests in the lands of Skyrim, that eminent province whose people were normally first to join and advance the cause of the Empire, but under his rule did quarrel and chafe. Kastav had no patience for such reticence, and engineered the downfall of these upstart rebels, intending to entrench the Empire far into the north, so that its righteous rule would never again be doubted by the people of that land. Sadly, Kastav died before he could see his plans come to fruition, and it fell to his successor to lay the keystone on his great political work.<BR>

八、雷曼一世 或称 西罗帝尔人<BR>

正义战争之后，阿莱西亚王座蜷缩在暴政的破烂残骸之中。科洛维亚和尼本奈没有真正的统治者，分裂成城邦和无足轻重的王国，由腐败的本地权贵统治。除了少数几个不幸的傻瓜外，无人前来宣称皇帝的称号，白金塔王座在皇帝宫殿昏暗的大厅里积尘四百年之久。<BR>

<BR>

雷曼受到其统一人民所展现的忠诚和力量的鼓舞，感到自己被召唤去实现将整个泰姆瑞尔置于其神圣统治之下的神圣目标。由于阿里诺尔日益增长的侵略性，雷曼被迫联合泰姆瑞尔的人类种族，发动了一场奈恩前所未见的战争，征服了整个北方、安奎那、佩里廷和卡莫利亚的南部土地，以及阿尔贡尼亚的大部分地区。他从阿里诺尔王国获得了巨额贡品，以换取和解。只有晨风的昏暗种族抵抗了他的统治，这种蓄意的叛乱行为使他们将在未来的岁月中遭受巨大苦难。<BR>

<BR>

雷曼一世是西罗帝尔有史以来最明智、最公正的统治者之一，为无知的行省带来了和平与帝国法律，推动了基础设施和防御工事的伟大工程，并让帝国人民在共同事业和文化中重新团结起来。临终前，他被圣灵召唤，成为人类的指路明灯和榜样，自那以后，他被尊奉为凡世之神，在人类需要时伸出援手，并将目标与身份认同的火焰归还给他们。<BR>

<BR>

九、布拉佐卢斯·多尔<BR>

尽管布拉佐卢斯·多尔皇帝的名字和事迹定会在光界神圣的大厅中优美地回响，但他的一生显然被他那备受赞誉的前任雷曼一世的统治所掩盖。因此，我们对布拉佐卢斯·多尔知之甚少，尽管可以推断他延续了其父亲的善政，即通过修建雷曼式的大道、桥梁和堡垒来建设帝国。布拉佐卢斯·多尔于第一纪元2762年加冕，并以其名号来纪念贝尔哈扎皇帝（也是世系中的第二位统治者），布拉佐卢斯试图在所有方面效仿他。因此，他在帝都复兴了莫里豪斯的崇拜，并设立了许多尊崇该神祇的仪式。他向泽尼萨尔信徒的熔炉订购了一顶黄金牛角王冠，象征着西罗帝尔神圣血统的复兴。<BR>

<BR>

布拉佐卢斯·多尔的死亡日期未有记载。愿这成为对抄写员和记录保管者的一个警示：他们必须在工作中保持真实和严谨，以便后世能够了解他们前辈的伟大功绩。<BR>

<BR>

十、卡斯塔夫 或称 典狱官<BR>

通过神话的旁支，我们得知了布拉佐卢斯·多尔皇帝继位的故事。临终前，布拉佐卢斯审视了他的后代，发现他们令他极其失望：他的众多儿子和女儿，无一例外都是酒鬼、弱智、懦夫和叛徒。因此，皇帝谴责并剥夺了他们的继承权，除了他那个三天前刚出生的孙辈。布拉佐卢斯随后将他信赖的顾问和密友，岔口谷的卡斯塔夫召到身边，收为养子，指定他为继承人，其任务是在雷曼血统的儿子成年之前保护帝国的安全。布拉佐卢斯还指示卡斯塔夫将他那些玩忽职守的儿子女儿全部关进帝国监狱的牢房，以使他们永远无法密谋推翻他。凭借被收养进入真正世系，卡斯塔夫皇帝被视为真正的皇帝之一，并且由于他拘留和监禁所有不配竞争者的政策，他被称为“典狱官”卡斯塔夫。<BR>

<BR>

与布拉佐卢斯·多尔一样，卡斯塔夫皇帝也感受到了抄写员之手的疏忽。众所周知，卡斯塔夫平息了天际省内的动荡，这个显赫行省的人民通常是第一个加入并推进帝国事业的人，但在他的统治下却发生了争吵和摩擦。卡斯塔夫对此种不合作毫无耐心，他策划了这些暴发户叛军的倒台，意图将帝国深深扎根于北方，以使那片土地的人民再也不会怀疑其正义统治。可悲的是，卡斯塔夫未能看到他的计划实现便去世了，而完成其伟大政治工作的重任则落到了他的继任者身上。<BR>

<BR>

XI.REMAN II<BR>

Emperor Reman II assumed the throne in the early twenty-ninth century, receiving the mandate of power from the dying hand of Emperor Kastav, his caretaker and foster-father, in a time when the Empire was beset by Nordic and Argonian insurgents. Reman II wasted no time in putting an end to these uprisings, making clever use of his Tsaeci servants as he did so, sending these brave and loyal warriors first to the north, where they brought down the Nordic rebels, and then south, where they fought the great Battle of Argonia, establishing Imperial Law and the Rule of the Emperors in that stygian land.<BR>

<BR>

Remembering the ideals of his predecessor, Reman I, who did intend to join all of Tamriel under his rule, and seeing what good his regime did in the newly joined province of Black Marsh, Reman II decided to honor this great ambition, and to that purpose declared war on the lands of Morrowind, for the Dunmer who lived there were in thrall to dark powers, and their resuscitation was a noble goal indeed. For Four-Score years the war against the Dunmer raged, as they were abetted by a dark three-headed spirit, who went by the name of Ephen. With his great endeavor unfinished, Reman II was slain in battle in the year of 1E 2851, and his people did weep over the fall of so mighty a man.<BR>

<BR>

XII. THE EXPUNGED REMAN<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

XIII. REMAN III<BR>

In the year 1E 2877 Reman III did take the throne, fated to be the last of the line of Reman. Brave as his predecessors, Emperor Reman III fought the Dunmer of Morrowind to a standstill, though he was undermined at every turn by treachery and deceit. Even his own consort, the Empress Tavia, conspired against him with revolutionaries and tribesmen of the Blackwood borderlands, who were moved by perverse instincts to struggle against legitimate authority. So it came to be that the Emperor was forced to confine Tavia in the dread prisons of Black Marsh.<BR>

<BR>

Though these actions may seem harsh, Reman III was a more gentle ruler than his predecessors, and was known far and wide for his mercy and kindness. As such, he is remembered by the people of Cyrodiil as a martyr of kindness and good governance, for his enemies did wound him, and killed his only son, and assassinated him as well, on the eve of his triumphant victory over the Dunmer. So the Second Era began, which was an Era of chaos, in which no true Emperor would appear.<BR>

<BR>

With his last breath, Reman III entrusted the administration of his Empire to his Tsaeci servant, Versidue-Shaie, who safeguarded the Empire as Potentate for many years, as did his son, Savirien-Chorak. But the lands of Cyrodiil did not prosper under an alien hand, and the Potentates were never a good substitute for the true rule of the Emperors. In time, they too fell to the hands of murderers, and the Empire was left in the delinquent care of the Interregnum Pretenders, a ceaseless flow of hapless warriors and champions who sought the legitimacy that only the White-Gold Throne could ensure. Without a true Emperor, the land was soaked in blood, and the people of Tamriel knew despair.<BR>

十一、雷曼二世<BR>

雷曼二世皇帝于二十九世纪初登基，当时帝国正遭受诺德和阿尔贡叛乱分子的困扰。他从其监护人和养父卡斯塔夫皇帝垂死的手中接过权力之托。雷曼二世毫不拖延地结束了这些起义，巧妙利用他的赛埃锡仆从，先将这些勇敢忠诚的战士派往北方，镇压了诺德叛军，然后派往南方，在那里他们进行了伟大的阿尔贡尼亚战役，在那片黑暗的土地上建立了帝国法律和皇帝的统治。<BR>

<BR>

铭记其前任雷曼一世（他意图将整个泰姆瑞尔纳入其统治）的理想，并看到他的政权在新加入的黑沼泽行省所取得的成就，雷曼二世决定实现这一宏大抱负，并为此向晨风的土地宣战，因为居住在那里的丹莫受制于黑暗力量，而拯救他们确实是一个崇高的目标。与丹莫的战争持续了八十年，期间丹莫得到了一个名为埃芬的黑暗三头精魂的援助。在其伟大事业未竟之际，雷曼二世于第一纪元2851年在战斗中阵亡，他的人民为如此伟大人物的陨落而悲泣。<BR>

<BR>

十二、被除名的雷曼<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

十三、雷曼三世<BR>

在第一纪元2877年，雷曼三世登基，注定成为雷曼世系的最后一位皇帝。与他勇敢的先辈一样，雷曼三世皇帝与晨风的丹莫战斗到相持不下的地步，尽管他在每个环节都受到背叛和欺骗的削弱。甚至他自己的配偶塔维亚女皇也与黑木边境地区的革命者和部落成员合谋反对他，这些人被反常的本能驱使，与合法权威作斗争。因此，皇帝被迫将塔维亚囚禁在黑沼泽可怕的监狱中。<BR>

<BR>

尽管这些行动可能显得严苛，但雷曼三世比他之前的统治者更为温和，并以其仁慈和善良而广为人知。因此，他被西罗帝尔人民铭记为仁慈与善政的殉道者，因为他的敌人重伤了他，杀死了他唯一的儿子，并在即将战胜丹莫的前夕也将他刺杀。第二纪元由此开始，这是一个混乱的纪元，在此期间再无真正的皇帝出现。<BR>

<BR>

雷曼三世在生命的最后一刻，将他的帝国托付给他的赛埃锡仆人维西杜-沙伊，维西杜-沙伊以摄政王的身份守护帝国多年，他的儿子萨维里恩-乔拉克也是如此。但西罗帝尔的土地在异族之手并未繁荣，摄政王们永远无法替代皇帝们的真正统治。最终，他们也死于谋杀者之手，帝国被遗弃在大空位僭主们的失职照看之下，那是一连串不幸的战士和冠军，他们寻求只有白金塔王座才能确保的合法性。没有真正的皇帝，这片土地浸透了鲜血，泰姆瑞尔的人民陷入了绝望。<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>THE LINE of EMPERORS VOLUME V: from CUHLECAIN to KINTYRA I<BR>

<BR>

A COMPREHENSIVE INQUIRY<BR>

into the<BR>

LINE of SUCCESSION<BR>

of the<BR>

EMPERORS of CYRODIIL<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

by Jaume Abtacil<BR>

<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>

<BR>
<BR>

XIIV. CUHLECAIN or EMPEROR ZERO<BR>

While never fully inaugurated, the warlord Cuhlecain did rule the Imperial City for more than a day and is numbered among the Emperors of the Septim line as Emperor Zero, on the express request of Emperor Tiber Septim himself, for the latter did love and respect the former as a father, and did not wish to see his name vanish into obscurity along with the Interregnum Pretenders.<BR>

<BR>

Cuhlecain, king of Falkreath, saw the chaos and misrule of his age and set out to return the world to righteous rule. He was an intelligent ruler, quickly perceiving that, to restore the Empire, it was necessary to unite the Colovian Estates, and to do that, he would need safety and security on his northern border. In the north, the Reachmen and the Nords had been at war for many a year. In acknowledgment of the ancient Nordic blood that flows through all true Colovian houses, Cuhlecain sided with the Nords against the Reachmen agitators.<BR>

<BR>

In his service there was then raised a mighty warrior, a general-prince hailing from the high north, from Atmora -- this was general Talos, anon Tiber Septim. Cuhlecain recognized in him the great power of the heroes of old and gave Talos the command of his armies, saying: "You who has come on the royal breath of the north, I call you son, and as no child I have before you, the Empire I have wrought will be yours in times to come," thus anointing general Talos as his rightful heir.<BR>

<BR>

With the aid of Tiber, Cuhlecain united the Colovian Estates and raised a mighty army of the sons of Colovia. From the west they marched, and the men of Nibenay rejoiced and laid down their weapons, recognizing the true ruler of Empire. Still, treason, in those days, was ever present. On the day of his coronation, Cuhlecain fell victim to a conspiracy of his enemies, and was struck down. There exists a legend among the people of the Imperial City, that claims Cuhlecain's lifeless body sunk into the ground after his defeat, and that now he rules beneath the city as the King Underground. Such fancies as the populace invent have, of course, no basis in anything of history, but may serve to lighten the mood of such heady tomes as the wise and powerful take to hand.<BR>

<BR>

XV. TIBER SEPTIM or TALOS, YSMIR, DRAGON OF THE NORTH, STORM-CROWN, HJALTI EARLY-BEARD, DRAGONBORN<BR>

The greatest of all Emperors, and progenitor of the greatest line of Emperors, which does continue to this day and will continue forever-more, Akatosh willing, Emperor Tiber Septim, who did ascend to join the ranks of the Divines in Aetherius. He was born in 2E 828 in distant Atmora under the name Talos, which means Stormcrown in the tongue of the Ancient North. There, on the March of Giants, he did learn the arts of combat and governance under the benevolent eye of the High King of Atmora, and when he came of age, he departed for the south, knowing the path of his destiny. For the tales of discord in the Empire of Man had reached even the far shores of the Uttermost North, and the rulers of that boreal place were mindful of their brothers, saying: "Once, we sent our greatest and most virtuous warriors to Tamriel, knowing then of the pain that the land endured under the harsh reign of the Elves. Now that the spirit of misrule and slavery stalks the land again, let once more the fruit of our frozen arbors set sail, and do right in the Southland, though it pains us to lose one so great."<BR>

<BR>

Thus Talos came to Skyrim, where he learned much from the great kings of that land, and learned the secrets of the Tongues, by which the world can be made to shake and submit. He led the Nords in the taking of Old Hrol'dan from the Witchmen, an act which spread his fame far and wide, causing Cuhlecain to anoint him as the leader of his forces, and the ancient monastic order of the Grey-Beards to vouch for him, proclaiming his Divine right to rule.<BR>

<BR>

But not all men were in favor of the return of righteous rule. In Skyrim and High Rock there were then usurpers who dreaded the return of the Empire, knowing that their crimes and misdeeds would surely be brought to bear on them were a true Emperor to claim the White-Gold Throne. An alliance of Nords and Bretons was raised against the forces of Cuhlecain, and while the latter had proceeded to the Imperial City in preparation of his coronation, Talos stood alone to break the coming invasion at the fortress of Sancre Tor. There, a great battle of the age was fought, and by the power of Talos' voice the Nords recognized the true leader of Men and fell upon their erstwhile Breton allies. In the catacombs of Sancre Tor, Talos then found the sacred Amulet of Kings, signifier of the Will of Akatosh.<BR>

<BR>

From Sancre Tor, Talos returned victorious to the palaces and lofty towers of the Imperial City, where he was feted by Cuhlecain on the eve of his ascension. Then, the poison of betrayal struck, as the dagger found Cuchlecain's heart, and found the throat of Talos, too, a wound which would surely have killed him were it not for his Divine nature. Talos carried the lifeless corpse of Cuhlecain from the flames of the burning palace, and, lifting the Amulet of Kings high above his head, he spoke in a whisper, reminding the gathered nobility of Colovia and Nibenay of their oaths, their loyalty, and their place in the order of things. And Talos anointed himself Emperor of Man, ruling king of all the nations of the world, and he took the name of Tiber Septim, that all his subjects may know him as such.<BR>

<BR>

And the Emperor was much dismayed by the deeds of the Nordic and Breton traitors, who had conspired to assault him, and fought against the natural order. So he set about to break these wayward sons of Man, and even before the seasonal rains came to blanket the Imperial City, the first kings of Skyrim and High Rock came to kneel before the White-Gold throne. In but a few years time Tiber had Septim conquered the north, bringing peace and order where before there was only misrule.<BR>

<BR>

But the great and the good will forever be opposed from all corners. The Aldmeri Dominion grew fearful of the rising star of the North, and they plotted to engineer the new Empire's downfall. Under their tutelage, the beastmen of Elsweyr and Argonia grew restless, attacking the borders of Cyrodiil without cause or provocation. The Emperor replied in kind, cutting deep into the wild domain of these baseless peoples. He skirmished with the Altmeri forces on the high seas, too, but that people's mastery over the waves proved ever obstructive.<BR>

<BR>

Instead, his attention was drawn to Hammerfell. Ever did the people of that place quarrel with one another over an ancient and forgotten matter, so that the blood and tears of men were spilled in vain. Tiber Septim offered his wise and impartial counsel to end this matter, and, with sound judgment, brought the Redguard into the fold of Empire, to prosper under his guidance. In 2E 864 then was signed the First Treaty of Stros M'Kai, where after all the races of Man were united under the Rule of Empire. The might of Men was then a spearhead, and thrust into the heart of the unruly natives of the south, it brought them too to the foot of the White-Gold Throne.<BR>

<BR>

Then only the empires of the Elves stood strong. Tiber Septim first looked east, to Morrowind, and found that the bane of the Remanites was weak and divided. His numberless legions poured into the lands of ash, and took from the Dunmer the capital of the Mourning Hold, which is where they worship their strange and wrong-headed god, Ephen. The Dunmer were forced into the signing of the Armistice, which promised their complete surrender, and in return, Tiber Septim graciously allowed them to hold onto some of their quaint traditions. The legions of men returned to the Imperial City victorious, and laden with tribute and great golden statues.<BR>

<BR>

Then, Tiber Septim looked to the west, to the Aldmeri Hegemony. The Altmer were strong, stronger than any enemy Man had ever faced, but the Emperor was flushed from his victory over the Dunmer, and knew himself a being of a higher order. Then first did manifest the Divine power for which he was to be elected to sit among the gods in high Aetherius, and lead them, and Tiber Septim, anon Talos, called upon a gestalt of gold and great power, that was followed by his numberless legions, and in but a year they crushed all opposition, and all of Tamriel was united under the banner of the Cyrodiils. Ninefold blessings on the Emperor Tiber Septim, anon Talos, who cleared the way for Man's dominion!<BR>

<BR>

XVI. PELAGIUS I SEPTIM<BR>

After the victories of Tiber Septim, it was declared that the Second Era was over, and now was the beginning of the Third Era, which was to be the Era of the Emperors Septim. Tiber Septim led a long and prosperous life, further unifying his great Empire, and in the latter years of his life the Divine Arkay was always by his side, to give counsel and prepare the way ot Divinity. Then in the year 3E 38 Tiber Septim ascended to high Aetherius as Talos, to forever-more sit amongst the Divines, to lead and protect us, as he did in life.<BR>

<BR>

Tiber Septim was succeeded by his grandson, Pelagius Septim I. Though Emperor Pelagius was young when first he donned the Amulet of Kings, he was wise, and assisted by the many spirits and guides his grandfather had groomed for him. His reign was glorious and free of strife, as he furthered the cause of Empire, connecting the provinces with bonds of blood and commerce, and striking down rebellion with an even hand.<BR>

<BR>

Emperor Pelagius was pious, too, and instated the worship of Talos in the entirety of Tamriel, and he summoned the Octadic Council from their distant dioceses, and caused them to reflect upon the Divine nature of Talos, until they declared him one of the Divines, henceforth to be known as the Nine Divines. And Pelagius founded the Citizen's Cult of Talos, Tiber Imperator in the northernly city of Bruma, which Talos had once saved from disaster by his actions as Sancre Tor, and for which he had held a strong affection in mortal life.<BR>

<BR>

The piety of Pelagius was to be his downfall, for he was assassinated in the Temple of the One by foul interlopers of the Dark Brotherhood, on the behest of malcontent provincials. As he had no living children, Pelagius was succeeded by his first cousin Kintyra, daughter of Tiber Septim's brother Agnorith, who had been made king of Silvenar.<BR>

<BR>

XVII. KINTYRA I SEPTIM<BR>

Empress Kintyra Septim ascended the throne in 3E 41, and though her reign only lasted a short seven years, it is remembered as a period of prosperity, in which the harvests were bountiful, the people content, and agitators laid down their weapons and submitted to Empire. Kintyra was known as a great patron of the arts, and under her guidance many great public works were made, such as the great Imperial Opera, or the Library of the People in the Imperial City. She was known as a great actress and dancer herself, and an delighted in the noble Nibenese art of skin-painting and tattooing, as she made many intricate designs that were admired by all.<BR>

<BR>

In the life of Empress Kintyra we see once again the shadow of the empresses of old, of Alessia and Hestra, and it would be fitting to remember here the old Nibenese adage: "Blessed are they who live under the law of River and the Bull, they will know joy their whole life, and the land rejoices."<BR>

<BR>

全面探究<BR>

<BR>
<BR>

十四、库莱凯恩 或称 零号皇帝<BR>

尽管从未正式登基，但军阀库莱凯恩确实统治了帝都超过一天，并被列为塞普汀世系的皇帝之一，称为零号皇帝，这是应泰伯·塞普汀皇帝本人的明确要求，因为泰伯爱戴并尊敬库莱凯恩如父，不愿看到他的名字与大空位僭主们一同湮没无闻。<BR>

<BR>

佛克瑞斯国王库莱凯恩目睹了他那个时代的混乱与暴政，立志让世界回归正义的统治。他是一位明智的统治者，很快意识到要恢复帝国，必须统一科洛维亚各领地，而要做到这一点，他需要确保北方边境的安全。在北方，河峪人和诺德人已交战多年。鉴于流淌在所有真正科洛维亚家族中的古老诺德血统，库莱凯恩站在诺德人一边，对抗河峪的煽动者。<BR>

<BR>

在他麾下，后来崛起了一位强大的战士，一位来自遥远北方阿特莫拉的将军王子 -- 这就是塔洛斯将军，后来的泰伯·塞普汀。库莱凯恩在他身上认出了古代英雄的伟大力量，并将军队的指挥权交给塔洛斯，说道：“你带着北方的王者气息而来，我称你为子，在我没有比你更早的孩子，我所缔造的帝国将在未来属于你。”于是，他任命塔洛斯将军为他的合法继承人。<BR>

<BR>

在泰伯的协助下，库莱凯恩统一了科洛维亚各领地，并组建了一支由科洛维亚之子组成的强大军队。他们从西边进军，尼本奈的人民欢欣鼓舞，放下武器，承认了帝国的真正统治者。然而，在那个时代，背叛无处不在。在他加冕之日，库莱凯恩成为敌人阴谋的牺牲品，被击倒。帝都人民中流传着一个传说，声称库莱凯恩死后他的尸体沉入了地下，现在他作为地下之王统治着城市下方。当然，民众编造的这种幻想没有任何历史依据，但或许有助于让睿智和当权者捧起的这些深奥典籍增添些许轻松气氛。<BR>

<BR>

十五、泰伯·塞普汀 或称 塔洛斯、伊斯米尔、北方之龙、风暴王冠、早须雅尔提、龙裔<BR>

所有皇帝中最伟大的一位，也是最伟大皇帝世系的始祖，阿卡托什保佑，这一世系延续至今并将永远延续 -- 泰伯·塞普汀皇帝，他登上了光界，加入了圣灵的行列。他于第二纪元828年出生在遥远的阿特莫拉，名为塔洛斯，在古北方语中意为“风暴王冠”。在那里，在巨人之行省，他在阿特莫拉至高王的仁慈关注下学习了战斗与治理之术，成年后，他知晓了自己的命运之路，便启程南下。因为人类帝国不和的传闻甚至传到了极北之地的遥远海岸，那片北方之地的统治者们心系同胞，说道：“曾经，我们将最伟大、最有德行的战士送往泰姆瑞尔，当时我们知道这片土地在精灵的严酷统治下承受着痛苦。如今，暴政与奴役的阴魂再次笼罩大地，让我们冰冻果园的果实再次扬帆起航，去南方匡扶正义吧，尽管失去如此伟大的人物令我们痛心。”<BR>

<BR>

塔洛斯就这样来到了天际，从那里的伟大国王身上学到了很多，并学会了“吼声之道”的秘密，凭借此道可以让世界震动并屈服。他率领诺德人从巫术师手中夺回了旧赫罗尔丹，此举使他的名声广为传播，导致库莱凯恩任命他为军队的领袖，而古老的修道会灰胡子也为他担保，宣告他拥有神圣的统治权。<BR>

<BR>

但并非所有人都赞成正义统治的回归。在天际和高岩，当时存在着篡位者，他们惧怕帝国的回归，知道如果一位真正的皇帝入主白金塔王座，他们的罪行和恶行必将受到清算。诺德人和布莱顿人组成联盟，对抗库莱凯恩的军队，而就在库莱凯恩前往帝都准备加冕之际，塔洛斯独自一人坚守在桑克雷·托要塞，以击退即将到来的入侵。在那里，一场那个时代的伟大战役打响了，凭借塔洛斯声音的力量，诺德人认出了人类的真正领袖，转而攻击他们昔日的布莱顿盟友。在桑克雷·托的地下墓穴中，塔洛斯随后发现了神圣的众王护符，这是阿卡托什意志的象征。<BR>

<BR>

从桑克雷·托胜利归来，塔洛斯回到帝都的宫殿和高塔，在他即将登基的前夜，库莱凯恩设宴款待了他。然后，背叛的毒药袭来，匕首刺入了库莱凯恩的心脏，也刺入了塔洛斯的喉咙，若非其神圣本性，这道伤口定会致命。塔洛斯将库莱凯恩的尸体从燃烧的宫殿火焰中抱出，并将众王护符高高举过头顶，低声说道，提醒聚集在此的科洛维亚和尼本奈的贵族们记住他们的誓言、忠诚以及在万物秩序中的位置。随后，塔洛斯自封为人类皇帝，统治世界所有国家的国王，并采用了泰伯·塞普汀这个名字，以便所有臣民都能以此称呼他。<BR>

<BR>

皇帝对诺德和布莱顿叛徒的行径深感愤慨，他们密谋袭击他，违抗自然秩序。于是他着手摧毁这些任性的人类之子，甚至在季节性的雨水覆盖帝都之前，天际和高岩的首批国王就已来到白金塔王座前屈膝臣服。短短几年时间，泰伯·塞普汀就征服了北方，在曾经只有暴政的地方带来了和平与秩序。<BR>

<BR>

然而，伟大与善良之人永远会受到来自四面八方的反对。先祖神洲对北方崛起的新星日益感到恐惧，他们密谋策划新帝国的覆灭。在他们的教唆下，艾斯维尔和阿尔贡尼亚的兽人变得躁动不安，无故挑衅，袭击西罗帝尔的边境。皇帝以牙还牙，深入这些无耻之徒的荒野领地。他也在公海上与傲特莫军队发生小规模冲突，但那个民族对海浪的掌控始终是难以逾越的障碍。<BR>

<BR>

于是，他的注意力转向了落锤。那里的人民总是为了一个古老而被遗忘的事情彼此争吵，人类的血泪被白白浪费。泰伯·塞普汀以其明智公正的劝告来解决此事，并以合理的判断将红卫人纳入帝国的怀抱，让他们在他的指引下繁荣发展。在第二纪元864年，签订了第一份斯特罗斯·姆'凯条约，此后所有人类种族在帝国统治下团结一致。人类的力量成为矛头，刺入南方桀骜不驯的土著的心脏，也将他们带到了白金塔王座的脚下。<BR>

<BR>

那时，只剩下精灵的帝国依然强大。泰伯·塞普汀首先向东看，望向晨风，发现雷曼家族的祸根已经虚弱且分裂。他无数的军团涌入灰烬之地，从丹莫手中夺取了哀伤之城，那是他们崇拜其奇怪而执迷不悟的神灵埃芬的地方。丹莫被迫签署了停战协议，承诺完全投降，作为回报，泰伯·塞普汀仁慈地允许他们保留一些古怪的传统。人类军团满载贡品和巨大的黄金雕像，胜利返回帝都。<BR>

<BR>

然后，泰伯·塞普汀向西看，望向亚历德霸权。傲特莫很强大，比人类曾经面对的任何敌人都要强大，但皇帝因战胜丹莫而踌躇满志，并且深知自己是一个更高层次的存在。那时，他的神圣力量首次显现，这使他得以被选入光界的高天，与众神同坐，并领导他们，泰伯·塞普汀（即塔洛斯）召唤了一个由黄金与巨大力量构成的格式塔，他的无数军团紧随其后，仅仅一年时间，他们就粉碎了所有抵抗，整个泰姆瑞尔都统一在西罗帝尔的旗帜之下。九重祝福归于泰伯·塞普汀皇帝，即塔洛斯，他为人类的统治开辟了道路！<BR>

<BR>

十六、佩拉吉乌斯一世·塞普汀<BR>

在泰伯·塞普汀的胜利之后，第二纪元宣告结束，第三纪元开始，这将是塞普汀皇帝的纪元。泰伯·塞普汀度过了漫长而繁荣的一生，进一步统一了他伟大的帝国，在晚年，神圣的阿尔凯一直陪伴在他身边，给予忠告，为他通往神性铺平道路。随后，在第三纪元38年，泰伯·塞普汀作为塔洛斯升入光界高处，永远地坐在圣灵之中，像他在世时一样，领导并保护我们。<BR>

<BR>

泰伯·塞普汀的继任者是他的孙子佩拉吉乌斯·塞普汀一世。尽管佩拉吉乌斯皇帝初次戴上众王护符时还很年轻，但他很明智，并得到了他祖父为他培养的众多精灵和向导的协助。他的统治辉煌而无纷争，他推进了帝国的事业，以血缘和商业的纽带连接各行省，并公正地镇压了叛乱。<BR>

<BR>

佩拉吉乌斯皇帝也很虔诚，他在整个泰姆瑞尔确立了塔洛斯的崇拜，并召集了八圣灵议会，让他们思考塔洛斯的神圣本质，直到他们宣布他为圣灵之一，从此被称为九圣灵。佩拉吉乌斯还在北方的布鲁玛城建立了公民塔洛斯教团，那里是塔洛斯曾作为桑克雷·托的英雄行动而拯救于灾难的地方，也是他在凡世生活中怀有深厚感情的地方。<BR>

<BR>

佩拉吉乌斯的虔诚最终导致了他的垮台，因为他在至一神殿被黑暗兄弟会的卑鄙刺客暗杀，这些刺客受不满的行省人指使。由于他没有在世的子女，佩拉吉乌斯的继任者是他的堂妹金泰拉，泰伯·塞普汀的弟弟阿格诺里斯的女儿，阿格诺里斯曾被任命为希尔维纳国王。<BR>

<BR>

十七、金泰拉一世·塞普汀<BR>

金泰拉·塞普汀女皇于第三纪元41年登基，尽管她的统治只持续了短短的七年，但被铭记为一个繁荣的时期，期间丰收连连，人民满足，煽动者放下武器，臣服于帝国。金泰拉以伟大的艺术赞助人而闻名，在她的指导下，许多伟大的公共工程得以建成，如伟大的帝国歌剧院，以及帝都的人民图书馆。她本人也被誉为伟大的演员和舞蹈家，并喜爱高贵的尼本奈彩绘和纹身艺术，她创作了许多复杂的图案，受到所有人的赞赏。<BR>

<BR>

在金泰拉女皇的一生中，我们再次看到了古代女皇阿莱西亚和海斯特拉的影子，这里适合铭记古老的尼本奈格言：“在河流与公牛的法律下生活的人有福了，他们将终生知晓欢乐，大地也将为之欢欣。”<BR>

<BR>

XVIII. URIEL I SEPTIM or THE GENTLE<BR>

After his mother's untimely death, emperor Uriel Septim assumed the throne, being the first Emperor to carry that illustrious name. Emperor Uriel continued the good work of his predecessors, furthering the unity of the Tamrielic provinces, and his reign is now remembered as a golden age of peace and harmony. Uriel was also a great lawmaker, who long studied the old codices of Nordic, Elven, and Monkey-law, synthesizing them into the shape of Law we know today. Blessed above all others are the Lawmakers, for the Law is Empire, and Empire is Sacred. In his own way, Uriel conquered and wrought an Empire as Tiber Septim had done, and made the will of Emperors clear to the land. Uriel Septim saw new wisdom in some of the old Marukhati edicts, and set about to rationalize the system of punishment and incarceration he had inherited -- under his rule, the great prisons of Black Marsh were once again full of industry, and many malfeasants found a fitting end there. For this, he is remembered as Uriel the Gentle.<BR>

<BR>

XIX. URIEL II SEPTIM or THE MISFORTUNATE<BR>

Emperor Uriel Septim I died in 3E 64, to be succeeded by his son, Emperor Uriel Septim II. He was similar in kindness as his father, though his reign was plagued by insurrection. Uriel II attempted to counter this mindless violence with forgiveness, only for his goodwill to me betrayed and mistaken for weakness. Under his reign, the judicial legacy of his father was squandered, and enemies of the Empire roamed free, terrorizing the populace.<BR>

<BR>

Plague and blight, too, stalked the land, and Uriel II expended much of what his predecessors built up to aid his people in their suffering. Uriel II died in 3E 82, bent by worries and strife. Though many have laid the blame of these times of hardship at his feet, we must at all times remember that the Empire prospers not for the sake of simple prosperity, but for the sake of Empire, meaning law and purpose. Here, in the hour of need, Uriel II did not hesitate to use the whole of the Empire's means in order to fight what ailed his realm, and this steadfast attitude is to be admired.<BR>

<BR>

XX. PELAGIUS II SEPTIM<BR>

When Pelagius II ascended the throne, the Empire was in disorder: his father's policies had expended the treasury and set the provinces on the rebellious path of independence. The Elder Council, ever a trustworthy tool in the hands of his forefathers, was now filled with vipers and traitors. Pelagius II did well to disband that institution, and assembled a new Council of loyal and trustworthy vassals, reforging the Elder Council as one would reforge a broken sword. He encouraged the princes and kings of Tamriel to do likewise, and by the end of his reign the Empire was a prosperous place once more.<BR>

<BR>

Though Pelagius II was beloved by his servants and his people, he was conspired against by those he had slighted through his forceful policies -- indeed, there were even vicious tongues who falsely claimed the Emperor had committed heresy by disbanding the Elder Counil! After seventeen years of his blessed reign, Pelagius II was poisoned by a former councilman, leaving the throne to his son, Antiochus Septim. Let this be a lesson to the wise and powerful, that a righteous ruler is never without enemies, as righteous rule will always find malice at its door.<BR>

<BR>

XXI. ANTIOCHUS SEPTIM or THE DEBAUCHED<BR>

Much has been written of Antiochus Septim's supposed depravity and moral laxity by those too unwise to see an Emperor's true virtue beyond superficial deeds. True, Antiochus was much seduced by the simple pleasures that is realm brought, but is that not the right of any Emperor, to enjoy the fruit of his labor? Indeed, Antiochus did many great and goodly thing, bringing about peace and stability in the inner provinces, and furthering the systems of Imperial justice and taxation. If there were rebellions and uprisings in his time, then it was surely these measures of order and wise rule that unsettled the corrupt provincial kings, rather than Antiochus' Dibellan demeanor. Indeed, in the hour of his greatest need, the 3E 110 Pyandonean invasion of Summerset, the Emperor was assisted by a great and sudden storm which utterly destroyed the dreaded Maormeri armada -- a clear sign of Divine favor.<BR>

<BR>

Despite his lust for pleasure, Emperor Antiochus was to find no joy in the governance of his Empire: the remaining years of his reign were marked by the continuing rebellion of the outer provinces. Still, he remained ever a jovial man, quick with a word and a smile, and genuinely fond of even the least among his people. He was greatly mourned when, in 3E 119, he died of a mysterious suffocation -- later rumored to be the work of his rapacious stepsister, Potema Septim of Solitude -- the dread Wolf Queen.<BR>

十八、尤利尔一世·塞普汀 或称 温和者<BR>

在他母亲英年早逝后，尤利尔·塞普汀皇帝登基，成为第一位拥有这个光辉名字的皇帝。尤利尔皇帝继续了前任的善政，进一步促进了泰姆瑞尔各行省的统一，他的统治如今被铭记为一个和平与和谐的金色时代。尤利尔也是一位伟大的立法者，他长期研究诺德、精灵和猴人法律的各种古老法典，并将它们综合成我们今天所知的法律形式。立法者是最有福的，因为法律即帝国，帝国即神圣。尤利尔以自己的方式，像泰伯·塞普汀一样征服并塑造了一个帝国，并向这片土地传达了皇帝的意志。尤利尔·塞普汀从一些古老的马鲁哈特教令中看到了新的智慧，并着手合理化他所继承的惩罚和监禁制度 -- 在他的统治下，黑沼泽的大监狱再次充满了劳役，许多罪犯在那里找到了应有的结局。为此，他被铭记为“温和者”尤利尔。<BR>

<BR>

瘟疫与枯萎病也肆虐着这片土地，尤利尔二世耗费了其前任积累的许多财富来帮助他的人民度过苦难。尤利尔二世于第三纪元82年驾崩，因忧虑和纷争而佝偻。尽管许多人将这些艰难时期的责任归咎于他，但我们必须时刻牢记，帝国繁荣并非为了单纯的财富，而是为了帝国本身，意味着法律和目标。在此危难时刻，尤利尔二世毫不犹豫地动用帝国的全部力量来对抗困扰其王国的疾病，这种坚定的态度值得钦佩。<BR>

二十、佩拉吉乌斯二世·塞普汀<BR>

当佩拉吉乌斯二世登基时，帝国处于混乱之中：他父亲的政策耗尽了国库，并使各行省走上了独立的叛乱道路。元老院，曾是其先辈手中可靠的工具，如今却充满了毒蛇和叛徒。佩拉吉乌斯二世明智地解散了该机构，并组建了一个由忠诚可靠附庸组成的新议会，如同重铸一把断剑般重塑了元老院。他鼓励泰姆瑞尔的亲王和国王们效仿此举，到他统治结束时，帝国再次成为一个繁荣的地方。<BR>

<BR>

二十一、安条库斯·塞普汀 或称 放荡者<BR>

关于安条库斯·塞普汀所谓的堕落和道德松懈，那些不智之人写了很多，他们无法看透表象之下皇帝真正的美德。诚然，安条库斯深受其王国带来的简单快乐的诱惑，但这难道不是任何皇帝享受其劳动成果的权利吗？事实上，安条库斯做了许多伟大而善良的事情，为内省带来了和平与稳定，并推进了帝国司法和税收制度。如果说他的时代有叛乱和起义，那一定是这些秩序与明智统治的措施动摇了腐败的行省国王，而非安条库斯的蒂贝拉式举止。确实，在他最需要帮助的时刻，第三纪元110年派安多尼亚入侵夏暮岛，皇帝得到了一场巨大的、突如其来的风暴的协助，彻底摧毁了可怕的锚莫舰队 -- 这是神圣恩宠的明确标志。<BR>

XXII. KINTYRA II SEPTIM or THE CAPTIVE<BR>

Sad and woeful, the tale of Kintyra II! From youth, she was much sinned against, thrust onto the throne at the tender age of fifteen, while her aunt, Potema Septim, spread the blackest slander in the hallowed chambers of Empire. Queen Potema questioned, in terms that no worthy historian could bear to repeat, the legitimacy of Kintyra's claim, referring to the somewhat loose morals of her father's reign. In turn she proposed her own son, the weak-willed Uriel Mantiarco, as heir of the Septim Empire. Despite the support of the Elder Council and the willingness of Stone, Hedge and Flame towards Kintyra II, Potema's words succeeded in riling up the ever-treasonous rulers of the outer provinces.<BR>

<BR>

Kintyra II ruled but shortly, though her rule carried the seed of squandered greatness. By her command, the court returned to the austerity that is ever the hallmark of the Septim line. Similarly, many provincial insurgents laid down their arms when confronted with her gentle authority, and many voluntarily offered reparations to the White-Gold Throne. Kintyra was an accomplished sorceress, despite her youthful age, and would doubtlessly have become the foremost of her line to practice that cerebral discipline, and a patron saint to its adherents everywhere, were her life not so tragically cut short. For the lesser kinglets of Skyrim and High Rock were ever ready to undermine the authority of a true Emperor. During a festive visit to the Iliac Bay, Kintyra's escort was attacked, and the Empress herself imprisoned in the keep of Glenpoint, where she was murdered by the faithless lords of that place. For this reason, no Emperor will ever again set foot in the duchy of Glenpoint, nor will its name be spoken in the presence of an Emperor, nor will Imperial administration refer to it as anything other than the Hold of Traitors, much reviled.<BR>
