Guide to Narsis
纳西斯指南

> BOOK.TEXT T_Sc_GuideToNarsisTR
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Guide to Narsis<BR><BR>
<IMG SRC="tr\narsis_city_map_00.dds" WIDTH="377" HEIGHT="377"><IMG SRC="tr\narsis_city_map_01.dds" WIDTH="377" HEIGHT="189"><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">
Narsis is the largest city on Morrowind's mainland after Almalexia, and is the capital city of House Hlaalu. It is the province's financial capital, with many outlander residents and visitors who come to conduct business with House Hlaalu. Hundreds of tourists are seen passing through the Grand Bazaar every day to purchase exotic Dunmeri wares, and locals often visit to purchase international merchandise. Most outlander business is conducted in the Foreign Quarter, with most native commoners living in the skyscrapers of St. Veloth Quarter. The Waterfront processes shipments going to and from the city, and the Market Quarter is where the majority of the city's shops are located. The Old Quarter and Council Quarter house the wealthiest citizens of Narsis and contain the main residences of Clan Hlaalu, as well as the Grand Council Hall and other official House locations. Surrounding the city are various manors and plantations, as well as the Narsis District Duke's residence in Riverkeep.<BR>
<BR>
Narsis' six districts are centered on the Council Quarter mesa, with the Market Quarter below to the northwest, St. Veloth Quarter to the north, the Waterfront to the east, and the Old and Foreign Quarters to the south. Across the river, Riverkeep is south, Old Dren Plantation is southeast, and Vedas Plantation is east.<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
Market Quarter<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">The Market Quarter, Narsis' newest district, is located on the Purple Road to the northwest. Originally it was simply an informal day-market for caravaners and local farmers to gather; the Market Quarter grew into a full district post-Armistice as traders and travelers, who couldn't find room in the Foreign Quarter, built inns and houses to accommodate themselves. The population is a mix of Dunmer natives and outlanders. Among the important locations are the Mesa Exchange, the province's newest and only stock exchange, the multi-level Grand Bazaar, the Farmers and Laborers Hall, and the lavish manor of the Sixth Family of Clan Hlaalu. <BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
St. Veloth Quarter<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">Located directly north of the Council Quarter, St. Veloth Quarter (sometimes called St. Veloth's Square or simply St. Veloth's) is home to Narsis' working class population. In the First Era, the residents of Narsis' third-oldest district farmed the land of what is now the Market Quarter and Foreign Quarter or worked as boatmen plying the river. As House Hlaalu moved its people out into the former Waters March over the course of the Second Era, the population of St. Veloth's Square became poorer, a trend that continues into the current era. Important locations in this Quarter include the two giant apartment towers named the Velothi Tower and Brevur Heights. There is also the Morag Tong Hall and the guildhalls of the Miners and Tanners, the Tailors and Dyers, and the Cat Catchers. <BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
Waterfront<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">The Waterfront is Narsis' eastern district, built against the Council Quarter's cliffs at great expense by House Hlaalu. The Waterfront houses several local merchant companies, including the East Empire Company. The famous "Merchant-Prince of Narsis", Dravos Turil, owns a large shop in the Waterfront, and the Fortuna casino functions as the center of the city's red-light district. Other important locations include the Sailors and Shipbuilders Hall and the large manor of the Seventh Family of Clan Hlaalu.<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
Old Quarter<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">The Old Quarter is, as the name suggests, the oldest continuously inhabited part of the city and is the smallest district in area. It is essentially a road located between the Council and Foreign Quarters. Much of the old nobility lives here, as well as some of the middle-class Dunmer who work directly for House Hlaalu. The First Family of House Hlaalu live in the oldest building in the city, a manor facing the entrance to the Council Quarter.<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
Council Quarter<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">The Council Quarter is the center of governance for House Hlaalu, and contains the luxurious palace of the Second Family of Clan Hlaalu. This palace is the home of the Grandmaster of House Hlaalu, High Hlaalu Athires. Among other important locations are the Measurehall, which is the center of House business in the province, as well as the Imperial Consulate, the Eight-Bones Temple and the Arena.<BR>

<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
Foreign Quarter<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">The Foreign Quarter is the southernmost district of Narsis. Before the Armistice, outlander merchants were only permitted to trade on the south flat, which was farmland tended by slaves that regularly flooded when the river swelled. Merchants profited so much from doing business directly in Narsis that a shack town was formed on the flat, becoming the original Foreign Quarter. Over the millenia it was gradually built into a part of the city proper. This district houses the Mages Guild, Fighters Guild, the Chapel of Zenithar, and the Narsis District's headquarters for the Imperial Legion, Heron Hall. The Foreign Quarter also holds the entrance to the expansive Narsis Catacombs.<BR>

<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><IMG SRC="tr\narsis_region_map.dds" WIDTH="377" HEIGHT="189"><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">Foot bridges connect the main peninsula to the Purple Road in the southwest and to the Market Quarter in the northwest. The Purple Road itself leads west through Shipal-Sharai and Septim's Gate Pass to reach Cyrodiil. Silt strider service is available at the south edge of the Foreign Quarter, traveling from Narsis to Hlerynhul, Andrethis and Ald Horak. A guar cart near the Canyon Keep in the Market Quarter travels to Shipal-Sharai and Stormgate Pass. Ships from the docks at the Foreign Quarter travel to Hlerynhul, Sadrathim, and Othmura, and low-fare gondolas shuttle passengers around the city and outskirts via the Thirr river.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
纳西斯指南<BR><BR>

<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">
纳西斯是晨风大陆上仅次于阿玛莱西娅的第二大城市，是哈拉鲁家族的首府。它是该省的金融中心，拥有众多外乡人居民和前来与哈拉鲁家族做生意的访客。每天可见数百名游客穿过大集市购买异国情调的丹莫商品，而当地人则常去购买国际商品。大部分外乡人业务在外邦区进行，大多数本地平民居住在圣维洛斯区的摩天大楼中。滨水区处理进出城市的货物，市场区是城市大部分商店的所在地。老区和议会区居住着纳西斯最富有的公民，包含哈拉鲁氏族的宅邸，以及大议会厅和其他家族官方场所。城市周围散布着各种庄园和种植园，以及位于河堡的纳西斯区公爵府邸。<BR>

纳西斯的六个区以议会区所在的平顶山为中心，市场区在其西北下方，圣维洛斯区在北面，滨水区在东面，老区和外邦区在南面。河对岸，河堡在南面，旧德伦种植园在东南面，维达斯种植园在东面。<BR>

<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
老区<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">老区，顾名思义，是城市中持续有人居住的最古老部分，也是面积最小的区。它基本上是一条位于议会区和外邦区之间的道路。许多旧贵族居住于此，以及一些直接为哈拉鲁家族工作的中产阶级丹莫。哈拉鲁家族的第一氏族住在城市最古老的建筑中，一座面向议会区入口的庄园。<BR>

议会区<BR>

<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
交通<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><IMG SRC="tr\narsis_region_map.dds" WIDTH="377" HEIGHT="189"><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">人行桥将主半岛与西南方的紫道和西北方的市场区连接起来。从紫道分支出的好路向北通往科罗纳提盆地，向南绕过西罗帝尔河通往纳西斯郊区，包括河堡的公爵府邸、旧德伦种植园和维达斯种植园。紫道本身向西穿过希帕尔-沙莱和塞普汀门隘，通往西罗帝尔。外邦区南边有阔步沙蚤服务，从纳西斯前往赫莱林胡尔、安德雷西斯和奥德·霍拉克。在市场区峡谷堡附近有瓜尔车前往希帕尔-沙莱和风暴关隘。外邦区码头的船只前往赫莱林胡尔、萨德拉西姆和奥斯穆拉，低价贡多拉则通过西罗帝尔河穿梭于城市和郊区之间。<BR>

Necrom is the Holy City of the Dead located on the easternmost part of mainland Morrowind in the Sacred Lands region. Both the city above and the catacombs are guarded by the Ordinators in Mourning, an elite cadre of their order, who will protect the silence of Necrom against anyone who would dare to disturb it. Weapons, spells, or any disrespectful behavior are forbidden in the Holy City under the penalty of death. <br> <br>
The Waterfront <br> <br>
The Waterfront is where the docks are located and it's through here where most outlanders who visit Necrom enter the city. A trader and a hostel provide their services to travellers who are just passing by, while the city proper is accessed through the large docks administration building.
<br> <br>
The Charnelworks <br> <br>
The Charnelworks is the lower quarter of the city above Necrom and a place of great mourning. The dead are brought here in through the Pilgrim's Gate for preparation before they're taken to the catacombs. The district is the home of the priests and workers who help prepare and cremate the bodies, and it is also where the Temple bone-smiths create the holy guardians known as bonewalkers in their smithies. The catacombs can be entered from the eastern side of the district. 
<br> <br>
The Upper District <br> <br>
In the Upper District a myriad of shrines and memorials of bygone days can be found as well as various services for pilgrims. A great number of Temple relics are kept here. Prominent pilgrimage sites include the Shrine of the First Citizens where the ancestors of today's Dunmer laid the foundations of the city and the Memorial to the War of the First Council. Outlanders should be reminded that these sites are not museums but places of worship and mourning. The Sinner's Gate, known thusly for being used by pilgrims who try to keep their distance from their dead ancestors, is located in the southeastern corner of the district.
<br> <br>
The Temple District <br> <br>
The Temple district is dominated by the mighty Fane of the Ancestors which stands atop the large Temple complex. Inside the Fane are shrines devoted to the Tribunal gods Almalexia, Vivec and Sotha Sil and their Anticipations the Daedra Princes Boethiah, Mephala and Azura. Strong ancestral magics flow through the Fane powering the Ghostfence on Vvardenfell. Underneath the Fane are the forbidden Temple vaults of Necrom.
<br> <br>
The Catacombs <br> <br>
Mourners and pilgrims can access the Catacombs from the Charnelworks district. It is here where the true City of the Dead lies. The lower reaches of the catacombs date back to the arrival of the Velothi in Morrowind. The catacombs are far too large and complex to map, and they are ever expanded to make room for new generations of dead. The ancient spirits guard their resting place with great passion, but they will also whisper their secrets to pilgrims if they have the ears to listen.
<br> <br>
Notable figures <br> <br>
Her eminence the Archmatron, Alvu Sareleth, can be found in the High Offices in the Temple district. Marshal Verendas Hlervan and Canon Simine Turethi, who are in command of the Ordinators in Mourning, can be found in the Watch Barracks in the Upper District and the Hall of Contemplation in the Temple district, respectively. Bradys Hlaalo, in the Chamber of Parting, is the priest in charge of the mourning rituals and corpse preparation in the Charnelworks. Ethaso Athones is in charge of the docks administration in the Waterfront.
<br> <br>
Transportation <br> <br>
Ship transport to and from Necrom can be found in the settlements of Enamor Dayn and Alt Bosara. The Silt Strider takes passengers to Sailen and Akamora. <br>"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Guide to Old Ebonheart<BR> <BR>
<IMG SRC="TR\oldebonheart_city_map.dds" WIDTH="377" HEIGHT="377"><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">
Old Ebonheart is the beating heart of the Empire in Morrowind and the largest Imperial city in all the East. Seated at the very mouth of the mighty Thirr River, the city is a mighty symbol of Imperial culture and military power, and a friendly haven for travelers in the often-hostile lands of the Dark Elves.

Despite its mainland location, Old Ebonheart is part of Vvardenfell District, and the legal seat of its Duke, the noble Vedam Dren. Duke Dren, having relocated his administration to the new Ebonheart-upon-Vvardenfell in the Ascadian Isles, has left governance of the city in the hands of Burgrave Caros Cocceius, Castellan of the Ebon Tower.

Travelers entering Old Ebonheart will pass beneath a striking statue of Talos, watching over his great eastern city just as he did in life. Newcomers are required to declare any proscribed or taxable goods at the Census Office found here. The main road north continues further into Old Ebonheart, dividing the city proper into two halves. Off this main thoroughfare, a civilian visitor can find the Moth and Tiger Inn and the Guild of Mages, while weary Legionnaires may rest their heads at the Legion Boarding House.

Old Ebonheart is a city of astonishing delights, but none are more beautiful than the Grand Chapel of Talos, known across the Empire for its fine glasswork and stolid, yet beautiful architecture. Old Ebonheart's west side, where the Grand Chapel can be found, is built around the historic Fountain Plaza, where many of the city's oldest and most prominent institutions are located. The grand guild hall of the Guild of Fighters is on the Plaza, as are the Morrowind headquarters of the Briricca Private Bank and the East Empire Company. The esteemed Imperial Archaeological Society also has its Morrowind headquarters here; its museum - open to visitors - is the finest public collection of Dark Elven and Dwarven antiquities anywhere in Tamriel.

The eastern city is the dense core of Old Ebonheart's economic might. In its tight alleyways and busy shops, an enterprising buyer can find goods and services of a thousand varieties, while the docks service traders from across the Empire. Two inns in the eastern city provide lodgings - the Empress Katariah and the Salty Futtocks - though the editors of the Guide recommend that visitors avoid the latter, a tavern of low repute. The Hostel of Stendarr's Mercy may also provide for travelers seeking charitable accommodations.

<BR> <BR>
<IMG SRC="TR\oldebonheart_ebontower_city_map.dds" WIDTH="377" HEIGHT="377"><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">

Across the bridge from the Fountain Plaza, the Ebon Tower complex is an immense testament to Imperial architecture and fortification design. Eight towers, each named for a Divine, guard the spiraling double walls of the fortress, crowned by Talos' Tower - the tallest structure in the Eastern Provinces. Besides the Ebon Tower itself, the fortress courtyard hosts the headquarters of the Imperial Legion in Morrowind, as well as the Hall of Justice, seat of the Imperial Curia in Morrowind. Citizens wishing to arrange for permanent residence in Morrowind may inquire at the Resettlement Office, while those seeking the resources of a Provincial Mission may find them here. Travelers from Skyrim and Black Marsh should note, however, that those Provinces' Missions have been relocated to Ebonheart-on-Vvardenfell.

<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="2" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Region Information
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">
Old Ebonheart is in the Aanthirin region, the fertile hills that surround the lower Thirr River. Vvardenfell District ends at the city's walls; the rest of the region is a part of Mournhold District. To the south, the villages of Dondril and Felms Ithul are only a short trek from Old Ebonheart's gates, while the Dark Elf Temple outpost of Serynthul can be found to the east. Further south, the larger town of Vhul is one of the more notable sources of the closely-guarded native drink called punavit.

All three of the aforementioned Dark Elf settlements are ruled by the enigmatic lord of Roa Dyr, a chapel-fortress of the local Great House Indoril. Roa Dyr does not exclude visitors, but travelers are urged to take care not to offend the often-prickly Indoril. There are few services in Roa Dyr available to travelers, and no inn.

Across the river, on the western banks, a smattering of rich plantations form the eastern border of House Hlaalu territory. While members of the Hlaalu are friendlier to western travelers than their Indoril counterparts, visitors - particularly natives of Black Marsh and Elsweyr - are advised to remain alert, as it is on these plantations that the most savage customs of the Dark Elves are maintained. Should travelers find themselves embroiled in a dispute, the Guild of Barristers chapter in Old Ebonheart often handles complex issues of local and Imperial law.

The road south from Old Ebonheart terminates at its confluence with the great Veloth's Path. a well-maintained road sacred to the Dark Elves. From here, a traveler may proceed east to Mournhold, or west across the bridge-city of Almas Thirr towards the Narsis and Velothis Districts.

There are several ruined Daedric, Dwarven, and Dark Elf complexes in and around the Aanthirin. Despite the docile and civilized nature of the Aanthirin, many of these ruins are extremely dangerous. Travelers should take care to avoid the Dwarf ruins of Bthung (east of Old Ebonheart) and Bthungtch (southwest of Almas Thirr), as well as the very prominent Daedric temple of Hadrumnibibi on an island directly south of Old Ebonheart. Most dangerous of all is the abandoned Indoril citadel of Tur Julan, found on the cliffs above the Hlaalu plantations on the western bank of the Thirr. It is said that these ruins are inhabited permanently by powerful Daedric guardians, who do not hesitate to slaughter unwary visitors.

If the reader has business on Vvardenfell, the modest new fortress of Ebonheart on the island is a recommended port of entry. Though services are much more limited than its mainland counterpart, the Six Fishes Inn provides beds, and there is easy access to Vivec City. Before traveling around Vvardenfell, however, those who have not already registered with the Census and Excise Office in Old Ebonheart, should first detour to the small village of Seyda Neen, where the only Census office on the Black Isle can be found.

<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
旧黑檀心指南<BR><BR>
<IMG SRC="TR\oldebonheart_city_map.dds" WIDTH="377" HEIGHT="377"><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">
旧黑檀心是帝国在晨风跳动的心脏，也是整个东方最大的帝国城市。雄踞于大河西罗帝尔河河口，这座城市是帝国文化和军事力量的宏伟象征，也是旅行者在常常充满敌意的丹莫土地上的友好避风港。

尽管位于大陆，旧黑檀心却是瓦登费尔区的一部分，是其公爵 -- 高贵的维达姆·德伦 -- 的法定驻地。德伦公爵已将其行政机构迁至阿斯卡迪亚峭壁地区新建的瓦登费尔上的黑檀心，将城市治理权留给了黑檀塔的城主卡罗斯·科奇乌斯。

进入旧黑檀心的旅行者将从一座醒目的塔洛斯雕像下经过，这座雕像如同他生前一样守护着他伟大的东方城市。新来者需在此处的人口办公室申报任何违禁或应税货物。向北的主干道继续深入旧黑檀心，将城市本身分为两半。离开这条主干道，平民访客可以找到“蛾与虎客栈”和法师公会，而疲惫的军团士兵则可在“军团宿舍”休息。

旧黑檀心是一座充满惊人愉悦的城市，但没有什么比塔洛斯大神殿更美，它以其精美的玻璃制品和朴实而美丽的建筑闻名于整个帝国。旧黑檀心的西侧，即大神殿所在地，围绕着历史悠久的喷泉广场而建，城市许多最古老和最著名的机构都坐落于此。战士公会宏伟的大厅位于广场上，布里里卡私人银行和东帝国公司的晨风总部也在此处。受人尊敬的帝国考古学会也将其晨风总部设在这里；其博物馆 -- 向游客开放 -- 是泰姆瑞尔任何地方都无法比拟的丹莫和矮人古物的最佳公共收藏。

东区是旧黑檀心经济力量的核心。在狭窄的巷弄和繁忙的商店中，有进取心的买家可以找到上千种商品和服务，而码头则为来自帝国各地的商人服务。东区有两家客栈提供住宿 -- “卡塔瑞亚女皇号”和“咸味肥臀” -- 不过本指南的编辑建议访客避开后者，那是一家声誉不佳的酒馆。“斯滕达尔慈悲旅舍”也可能为寻求慈善住宿的旅行者提供帮助。

<BR><BR>
<IMG SRC="TR\oldebonheart_ebontower_city_map.dds" WIDTH="377" HEIGHT="377"><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">

从喷泉广场过桥，黑檀塔建筑群是帝国建筑和防御工事设计的宏伟证明。八座塔楼，每座以一位圣灵命名，守卫着堡垒盘旋的双层城墙，其顶端是塔洛斯之塔 -- 东部诸行省最高的建筑。除了黑檀塔本身，堡垒庭院还设有帝国军团在晨风的总部，以及帝国库里亚在晨风的所在地 -- 正义厅堂。希望安排在晨风永久居住的公民可向重新安置办公室咨询，而寻求行省使团资源的人可在此找到。但来自天际和黑沼泽的旅行者应注意，那些行省的使团已迁至瓦登费尔上的黑檀心。

<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="2" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
地区信息
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT">
旧黑檀心位于安西林地区，即环绕西罗帝尔河下游的肥沃山丘。瓦登费尔区止于该城墙外；该地区其余部分属于哀伤之城区。向南，从旧黑檀心城门出发只需短途跋涉即可到达东德里尔和费尔姆斯·伊苏尔村庄，而东边则可以找到丹莫神殿的前哨塞林苏尔。再往南，较大的城镇伍尔是名为普纳维特这种严密保护的本地酒类的主要产地之一。

上述三个丹莫定居点均由神秘的罗阿·迪尔领主统治，罗阿·迪尔是本地因多瑞尔大家族的礼拜堂堡垒。罗阿·迪尔不排斥访客，但敦促旅行者小心，不要冒犯常常敏感的因多瑞尔人。罗阿·迪尔提供给旅行者的服务很少，也没有客栈。

河对岸，西岸上，零星分布的富裕种植园构成了哈拉鲁家族领土的东部边界。虽然哈拉鲁成员比他们的因多瑞尔同行对西方旅行者更友好，但仍建议访客 -- 尤其是黑沼泽和艾斯维尔的本地人 -- 保持警惕，因为正是在这些种植园里，丹莫最野蛮的习俗得以保留。如果旅行者发现自己卷入纠纷，旧黑檀心的律师公会分会经常处理本地和帝国法律的复杂问题。

从旧黑檀心向南的道路终点与伟大的维洛斯之路交汇。这是一条维护良好、对丹莫神圣的道路。从这里，旅行者可以向东前往哀伤之城，或向西穿过桥梁城市阿玛斯·西罗帝尔，前往纳西斯区和维洛提斯区。

安西林及其周边有几处被毁的迪德拉、矮人和丹莫建筑群。尽管安西林地区温顺文明，但这些废墟中的许多都极其危险。旅行者应注意避开布通（旧黑檀心以东）和布通奇（阿玛斯·西罗帝尔西南）的矮人废墟，以及位于旧黑檀心正南岛上非常突出的迪德拉神庙哈德鲁姆尼比比。最危险的是被遗弃的因多瑞尔都堡图尔·尤兰，位于西罗帝尔河西岸哈拉鲁种植园上方的悬崖上。据说这些废墟永久居住着强大的迪德拉守护者，它们会毫不犹豫地屠杀粗心的访客。

如果读者在瓦登费尔有事，岛上那座朴素的新堡垒黑檀心是推荐入境点。尽管服务比其大陆对应物少得多，但“六条鲜鱼客栈”提供床位，且前往维威克城很方便。然而，在前往瓦登费尔各处旅行之前，那些尚未在旧黑檀心的人口与税务办公室登记的人，应首先绕道前往赛达·尼恩小村，那里是黑岛上唯一的人口办公室所在地。

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Peakstar<BR><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000"><BR><BR>
The waves washed lightly against the shore, bringing in shells, bottles, wood, and bodies. Nothing on the shore could remember where it came from. This was either because the objects were incapable of memory, or because the bodies had no more use for their memories.<BR><BR>
A body stirred on the shore. The waves moved it up a few inches further, then brought it back down a few more inches then it had been before. The body stirred again. The waves carry it up the shore again; this time leaving it entrenched upon the sand. The fingers move, the toes begin to wiggle. The head sways from side to side. The eyes open. The waves brought another message to Vvardenfell. But this time the message was not in a bottle. It was the bottle itself. It did not know what its message was. That's what it had to discover.<BR><BR>
"Look, Sul-Matuul, there at the peak. The star has risen." <br>
"Yes" replied the Ashkhan. "And once again, the prophecies have failed us."<br>
"No, they have not. They do not say when the incarnate will arrive, nor where. Most of what we believe is what we wanted to believe. The prophecies have been lost, and through the generations, what we remembered has changed. We must look where we would not expect." <br><BR>
"Nibani, look! There at Peakstar!" The Ashkhan pointed towards the great mound. The star had disappeared, as well as those around it. There was a dark shape outlined by the lighter colored sky. The shape was that of a Dunmer. <br>
Do you think The Wise-woman started. <br><br>
The Urshilaku Ashlanders took the lost Dunmer in as their own. They trained her in the arts of war, medicine, and leadership. The Wise Woman and the Ashkhan, the two tribal leaders, looked to her for hope of their continuation. They named her Peakstar. She would continue on with the prophecies, and not fail where the others had before. She would succeed. She must succeed.<br>
The fall brought many blight storms. The winter brought many blight storms, but it also dropped something else: poisoned rain. The blight was getting worse, infecting the very air with its symptoms. <br>
Nibani, Wise Woman of the Urshilaku, walked to the mound of the prophecies, to Peakstar. Once again, the star had risen to its point. And once again, there was something else on the hill. Nibani walked closer. It was a flower, a fire fern. And it was in full blossom. Nibani smiled and looked back towards Peakstar, the Nerevarine Reincarnate, talking with the Ashkhan.<br><br>
The blue sky was getting darker. Clouds were moving in from the south, from Red Mountain. The poisoned rain began to fall from the sky. It lasted for nearly an hour. Chores could not be completed, food and livestock was ruined. The sky was turning red, and the rain had finally stopped. Peakstar watched the sky in silence. She knew this storm was going to be a bad one. The clouds had thickened, and they were blood red. The winds began to blow now. Strong winds, dangerous winds, winds that cried through the valleys with the cries of the ash vampires. Nibani and the Ashkhan were sitting in silence as well, though they were not watching the growing storm. They were thinking about the future of the ashlanders, of Vvardenfell. They were hoping that Peakstar would not end up like the others. The winds had grown strong, and the tents began to bend under the force of the winds. The cries grew louder and louder until it seemed that they did not come from the wind any longer. The Ashkhan heard this, too, and he grew terrified.<br><br>
"Protect the camp! Don't let them through!" Peakstar began to give the warriors their orders for the battle. The ash vampires had used the cover of the blight storms to approach on the camp. They attacked first by raining spears and arrows down upon them unexpectedly. The Urshilaku replied with a volley of their own, along with a few spells. Then they sent out their bravest warriors. The Urshilaku did not have many. Most had died fighting the intangible blight. What they had then might not have been enough. Peakstar joined the battle as soon as possible. She ran into the middle of the fighting swinging her staff around with pure skill. She knew where to hit, and when to block. She knew when to cast a spell on her enemies, and when to heal her friends. She knew where to lead her warriors and the tactics they would need in order to defeat their enemies. She had been trained to lead Morrowind, and that duty started with the Ashlanders. Peakstar looked promising. <br><br>
The battle ended with the retreat of the ash vampires, though the battle had come at a heavy price to the Urshilaku. Many were forced to leave the camp to look for trade in the more civilized areas of Vvardenfell. The size of the camp decreased considerably, and the danger to those remaining had increased.<br>
The time had come for Peakstar. She had led the Ashlanders through many dangers, protected them from numerous enemies. The Ashkhan and the Wise-woman had come to their decision. Peakstar would be tested. She was given the directions to the Cavern of the Incarnate, where she would put on the ring of Moon-and-Star, and Morrowind would know the Nerevarine once again! Peakstar made it to the cavern safely, and entered through the doors of twilight.<br><br>
The message had been discovered. Peakstar was not the Nerevarine, but one piece of its whole. She was a promise that the puzzle would someday be complete, and the hopes and prophecies of the ashlanders would come true. The Old Ways would be restored. The waves brought in another message: a freed prisoner with an emperor's decree.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
<BR>
Ralen Rothadas' Memoir Page<BR>
<BR>
[It appears to be a page from a journal, though presumably the rest of the document has been lost to age]<BR>
<BR>
'Twas round about the time of the holiday Hogithum on the 12th day of First Seed that we set out on the pilgrimage to the Shrine of Pride. A lovely day, all agreed, and the favorable weather was what prompted us, as a group, to make the difficult journey. Though the Ashlands, as always, met only the barest imagining of hospitality, they seemed marginally less foreboding with the sun high in the heavens and no cloud in sight. Quite confident, we were, until Harrison, the brave Redguard leading our group called for us to halt.<BR>
<BR>
"Kagouti up ahead, five of them" he warned, "We should give a moment, and allow them to move from the path. Other less pleasant beasts might be attracted by sounds of battle." And so we waited for near upon an hour, and still the lazy Kagouti did not move; perhaps they were enjoying the splendid rays of the sun much as we were. At length, Harrison could no longer wait "Though the weather is fine this morn" he told us, "I cannot rely on the mercy of the Ashlands. No more time can be spared."<BR>
<BR>
And so he told us again to wait, while he trod up the path toward the five Kagouti. Curious it was, for he looked unconcerned as he strode up to the snarling beasts without so much as drawing his blade. The aggressive animals charged Harrison, but he grasped the lead beast by its great tusks and stared it in the eye as its hungry maw sought his darkened flesh.<BR>
<BR>
He muttered something inaudible from our distance, and suddenly the pack turned from Harrison and fled as quickly as their powerful legs would take them. As he returned to the group, we were dumbfounded. At our questioning glances, he explained that he had used a Demoralize Creatures spell. As our group were simple laymen of the Temple, and unfamiliar with the school of Illusion, we were naturally curious. Seeing as much, he elaborated:<BR>
<BR>
"When you look at me, you see a lean, wiry-haired Redguard. When Kagouti look at us, they see food. I cast the spell on them, and look the same to you, but to the Kagouti I appear to have become a beast quite a bit more formidable than they. As they saw us, they imagined I saw them, and so they fled in fear of their lives. What sort of terrible beast they imagine they see, I know not."<BR>
<BR>
Harrison then prompted us to continue onto the stronghold of Ghostgate, and we quickly complied. With the fellow's sense of humor, some among us thought that if we dragged our feet he would make us see all sorts of horrible things, to turn our steady pace into a sprint in order to make up for the lost time. <BR>
"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>

拉伦·罗萨达斯回忆录页<BR>

大约是在初种月12日的霍吉图姆节日前后，我们出发前往骄傲圣祠朝圣。大家都认为那是个宜人的日子，有利的天气促使我们这群人踏上艰难的旅程。尽管灰烬之地一如既往，只提供最微不足道的款待，但头顶太阳高悬，万里无云，它们看起来似乎不那么令人恐惧。我们相当自信，直到带领我们队伍的勇敢红卫人哈里森叫我们停下。<BR>
<BR>
“前方有五只盾角蜥，”他警告说，“我们该等一等，让它们从路上离开。战斗声可能会引来其他更不友善的野兽。”于是我们等了将近一个小时，而那些懒惰的盾角蜥仍然不动；也许它们和我们一样在享受灿烂的阳光。最后，哈里森不能再等了。“尽管今早天气不错，”他告诉我们，“但我不能依赖灰烬之地的仁慈。不能再浪费时间了。”<BR>
<BR>
于是他再次让我们等待，自己则沿小路向那五只盾角蜥走去。这很奇怪，因为当他大步走向那些咆哮的野兽时，他看起来毫不在意，甚至没有拔出他的刀。那些好斗的动物冲向哈里森，但他抓住领头野兽的巨大獠牙，盯着它的眼睛，同时它饥饿的大嘴正试图咬向他深色的肌肤。<BR>
<BR>
他喃喃说了些我们听不清的话，突然间那群盾角蜥从哈里森身边转身，以它们强壮腿脚能及的最快速度逃走了。当他回到队伍中时，我们都目瞪口呆。面对我们询问的目光，他解释说，他使用了“挫败生物”法术。由于我们这群人都是神殿的普通信众，不熟悉幻术系，自然感到好奇。看到我们这样，他详细解释道：<BR>
<BR>
“当你们看着我时，你们看到一个精瘦、毛发粗硬的红卫人。当盾角蜥看着我们时，它们看到的是食物。我对它们施了法术，在你们看来我还是老样子，但在盾角蜥看来，我似乎变成了一只比它们可怕得多的野兽。当它们看到我们时，它们以为我看到它们（变成可怕的样子），于是它们为了保命而逃跑了。它们以为自己看到了什么可怕的野兽，我不知道。”<BR>
<BR>
然后哈里森催促我们继续前往幽魂之门要塞，我们连忙照办。鉴于这位老兄的幽默感，我们中有些人觉得，如果我们拖拖拉拉，他会让我们看到各种可怕的东西，以便让我们把稳健的步伐变成冲刺，来弥补损失的时间。<BR>

Three Sonnets<BR>
By Santillia Phineran<BR>

1. Direction<BR>

You're a soldier, and you're on a beach.<BR>

<BR>
This pearl in your hand, with the foil flaking away? No, no, not that.<BR>
<BR>
Something in your other hand? Don't think about that. Just wait for that cold, pulsing light to get here. It hurts to look at, but you can't turn away. Just feel the waves lap at your feet, like when--<BR>
<BR>
You're a kid sitting on the beach as your father gets the flatboat ready. You can't wait to go out again, fresh in love with the sea. There's a gentle autumn breeze behind you, carrying the scents of breadpalm and prickle-spice. Your father is showing you how to put the sail out. "This is called the serpent-hitch. Watch. Now here's how to loosen it. Are you paying attention?" You nod at your father, but you're paying more attention to the feel of the knife in its sheath digging into your leg; a real knife, not a toy, for your birthday, and the waves lapping at your feet, like when--<BR>

You buried your father, your sister, your wife. You hear pottery falling and breaking in the house, and your feet sink into the sand, and you want it to pull you all the way in. You haven't slept in days. Your hands, your arms, your feet, your heart -- nothing but ache. Your life simplified from dreams of a family and a ship of your own to digging one more grave. To eat one more fish? Of course you should face death, but what if death refuses to face you again and again? The bells... You get up, stiff and hot, and draw a bucket from the well. You drink and feel strong enough to shuffle into town. It's empty now, but other ragged survivors are coming in, too. The captain waits until the remnants gather. The captain unrolls a scroll and begins reading. The Admiral has a plan. He wants volunteers. Any man capable. Crown, Forebear, farmer, merchant, doesn't matter. You thought you had come to the end of yourself, but what they did--<BR>

You hand the sword to the next recruit and sit on the bench, rubbing your shoulder and wonder for the hundreth time what you're doing here.<BR>
<BR>
"Who did you lose?" asks the recruit next to you. You've answered the question a hundred times. The recruits here never say "Good morning" or "Nice day for it." It's always "Who did you lose?"<BR>
<BR>
"Everyone," you say. You stare at the sunset. "Except my mother. She died years ago."<BR>
<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

<BR>
The cold, black light rushes overhead and the beach tilts violently. You hear a crash, like a thunderclap, but muffled. You almost slip into the sea. It won't be long now. You grit your teeth in fierce joy. But why? You lift your arm to look at the pearl in your hand. It's still partly wrapped in foil. You lift your other arm to peel it away . . . but your arm doesn't move. It must be broken, like that toy soldier whose arms--<BR>

Oh, please run away!" The airship lands in the sea near one of the little ships and there's a blinding spark and the ship breaks in half, its tiny crewmembers flying through the air. The kid is flung away, too, far out into the sea. You try to reach for him, but your hand--<BR>

Still, you pray all night for Tu'whacca to take you instead, but by morning he has taken--<BR>

You have to keep her moving. Have to get to the target. You hear the remaining crew behind you firing the cannons, but all you're thinking of is how to turn the ship to let them hit one of the huge sea monsters or the even larger slimy islands that keep swimming into your path. 隆隆声变成了剧烈的颠簸起伏，比任何马都糟，比风暴中的平底船还糟，比那次地震还糟，那次地震 -- <BR>
<BR>
船猛地向前冲去，甲板在你脚下打滑。奥莱塔绊倒了，你抓住她，能抱着她总是让你激动，总是惊讶于她感觉起来那么小。你出发了，听着神殿的钟声渐远。你感觉到蜂蜜蛋糕，像铁砧一样沉在胃里，记得那些歌和第一支舞。你感到奥莱塔的温暖，突然四处寻找韦恩，但又放松下来，因为你记起你结婚了，她的父亲肯定不能再反对 -- <BR>
<BR>
你踉跄着，沙子像水一样流动。你无助地看着墓穴被填满。你所有的功夫都白费了。这是你在同样多天里挖的第五个坟墓。你看着你的兄弟，裹在帆布里，匆忙染成黑色和红色。“对不起，德塞克，”你喘息着说。“你值得更好的，但现在没有更好的了。”你埋葬了你的父亲，你的妹妹，你的妻子。你听到陶器在屋里掉下来摔碎，你的脚陷入沙里，你想让沙子把你整个拉进去。你已经好几天没睡了。你的手、你的胳膊、你的脚、你的心 -- 只有疼痛。你的人生从拥有一个家庭和一条属于自己的船的梦想，简化为再挖一个坟墓。再一个就结束了。你听到村里的钟声，低头看，但那里什么也没有，没有人。只是地震 -- <BR>
<BR>
但钟声响了。还有人剩下吗？你俯瞰村庄，港里有艘船。一艘巨大的船。你已经好几个星期没把平底船开出去了。有什么意义？为了多吃一条鱼？当然你应该面对死亡，但如果死亡一再拒绝面对你呢？钟声......你站起来，浑身僵硬发热，从井里提了一桶水。你喝了水，觉得有力气了，就拖着脚步走进镇子。现在镇子空了，但其他衣衫褴褛的幸存者也在进来。船长一直等到残余的人聚集起来。船长展开一卷卷轴，开始宣读。上将有个计划。他需要志愿者。任何有能力的人。王权派、先驱派、农民、商人，都没关系。你原以为自己已经走到尽头了，但他们做的 -- <BR>
<BR>
你不是士兵，但你又击打了假人，这次在木臂转过来之前躲开了。“太慢了，”军士说。“但今天尼蒙少挨了顿打。下一个！”你把剑递给下一个新兵，坐在长凳上，揉着肩膀，第一百次问自己到底在这里做什么。<BR>
<BR>
“你失去了谁？”你旁边的新兵问。这个问题你已经回答过一百次了。这里的新兵从不说“早上好”或“天气真好。”总是问“你失去了谁？”<BR>
<BR>
“所有人，”你说。你凝视着落日。“除了我母亲。她多年前就去世了。”<BR>
<BR>
“我的父亲，我的小妹妹，”她说。作为北方人她还可以，但她的名字有点奇怪和陌生。也许是埃弗拉腊。<BR>
<BR>
“你知道剑术训练怎么帮我们航行得更快吗？”你问。<BR>
<BR>
她笑了。“你觉得这奇怪，我可只打算施放冰霜碎片。”你迅速抬头看了一眼她的头发，她的笑容加深了。“我知道，”她说。“大家都觉得我该是个火焰法师。”然后她的笑容消失了。“我们会抓住那些混蛋的。”<BR>
<BR>
“我们会 的，”你说着点点头。但你不是士兵。这些人也都不是。直到 -- <BR>
<BR>
那冰冷的、黑色的光从头顶掠过，海滩剧烈倾斜。你听到一声撞击，像雷鸣，但很沉闷。你差点滑进海里。快了。你咬紧牙关，心中涌起狂热的喜悦。但为什么？你抬起胳膊看手里的珍珠。它上面还包着一些箔片。你抬起另一只胳膊想把它剥掉......但你的胳膊动不了。一定是断了，就像那个玩具士兵，他的胳膊 -- <BR>
<BR>
你在玩“海盗与船长”。“我们就这么干，”你自言自语。小小的模型船散落在整个海滩上。“史上最庞大的海军。而且不只是船，”你说。“巫师、精灵、蟹灵、甚至还有龙！”<BR>
<BR>
“它们都难对付得很，孩子。”但那孩子继续说下去，移动着小船，摸着腰带上崭新的刀。“大的炮舰会留在后面，这里、这里和这里。这些精灵船和长船会在梦幻礁这里、这里投炸弹，同时海精灵从下面攻击。龙会从东边和西边来对付飞船，同时蟹灵攻击珊瑚塔。但所有这些船，”孩子的手臂在成片的玩具船上方划过，“所有这些船要做的，就是穿过飞船和海怪。”<BR>
<BR>
小小的模型炮开火了，你听到了。你听到了。不远，但很沉闷。就在孩子旁边，一条龙喷火烧了一艘飞船，飞船迅速坠落，被火焰吞没。“快走，孩子。哦，快跑！”飞船落在海里，靠近一艘小船，一道炫目的火花闪过，船断成两截，微小的船员在空中飞舞。那孩子也被抛了出去，远远地落进海里。你想伸手抓他，但你的手 -- <BR>
<BR>
抓住了奥莱塔的手，她在颤抖，汗珠顺着她的脸滚落。她很虚弱，但她握你的手握得那么紧，都疼了，你让她握着。当第一批村民开始生病时，祭司们说他们很困惑，他们的祈祷和法术治不了他们。很快所有祭司都死了。你仍整夜向图'瓦卡祈祷，让他带走你代替她，但到早晨他带走的却是 -- <BR>
<BR>
“奥莱塔，”你低语。你应该试着救......点什么。你单手从腰带袋里掏出那颗珍珠，试图用拇指擦掉箔片。现在没什么可做的了。你在目标上了。<BR>
<BR>
那冰冷的、黑色的光现在在你身后，渐渐消退。紫色的云消散了，只留下星星。身下的海滩再次扭动，这次更弱了，酸液刺痛你的背，就像那时 -- <BR>
<BR>
又一只海怪擦过“自由猎鹰号”的左舷，一只挂在怪物鳃上的肥硕蛞蝓，向船长胸口射出一支毒箭。于是你掌起了舵。怪物的毒血几乎把左舷烧到水线，船开始严重倾斜。没人能操作水泵了。但它还在前进，还在前进。你必须让它继续前进。必须到达目标。你听到身后剩下的船员在开炮，但你满脑子想的都是怎么转舵，让他们能击中那些巨大的海怪，或者甚至更大、不断游进你航线的粘滑岛屿。在没有划手和调整船帆的情况下，你尽可能长久地坚持。<BR>
<BR>
船越来越慢，但你到了。目标。那艘精灵船和不到十二艘护航舰就在你身后。那个北方人，她叫什么名字？她不幸被虫灼伤，被困在精灵船上了。你想知道她是否还活着。<BR>
<BR>
一艘飞船在你前方坠下，燃着大火。你看见一团穿着黑袍的苍白肉体，悬在飞船的厨房上。它转向你，扭动着粘滑的手臂，朝你头顶射出一道闪电，爆裂声比任何炮声都响，在你身后爆炸。“自由猎鹰号”断成两半，你缓慢而无声地被抛到空中。你落在目标上，浑身沾满浓稠灼热的粘液，然后 -- <BR>
<BR>
现在你明白了。你就要这个。你想要 -- <BR>
<BR>
“复仇，”你嘶哑地说。<BR>
<BR>
你自愿来的，可怜的傻瓜。你终究是个战士。黑色的球体完成了它的任务，海滩最后一次隆起，然后它开始倾斜着沉入大海。<BR>
<BR>
“所有的船都很重要，”你仍在玩“海盗与船长”时说。“但这艘船尤其重要。”你拔出刀，轻敲着那艘载满巫师和那个看着刺眼的黑色球体的船。你必须让那艘船冲过去，不惜任何代价。<BR>
<BR>
你抬不起胳膊，因为它没了。炮声很沉闷，因为你的耳膜破了。那颗珍珠是块记忆石，是你从那个眼神不安、长着银色眼睛的精灵那里赢来的。<BR>
<BR>
你记起来了。你全都记起来了。而且你一点都不会后悔。<BR>
<BR>
“以塔瓦的吐息起誓，”你低语着，独自死在瑟拉斯的尸体上。“我们做到了。”<BR>
<BR>
“你能做到的，孩子。”<BR>
<BR>
"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
A Crook-Tailed Khajiit, on the Lunar Lattice
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[As told by a crooked-tailed Khajiit, found begging on the steps of the Temple of Zenithar in Leyawiin.]<BR><BR>

You ask this one to tell you what Khajiit believe? This one does not often give voice to his beliefs, it is true. It is not Khajiit's way, but not out of any respect to differences, no. Worry about this is the way of the mewling cub, always going back to the warmth of the certain dam's-milk, or the way of the politician, with their words of many-roads-diguised-as-one and their own vanity, a dirty word. Now this one is here, with these strange bent-lovers in their tall heavy buildings, saying words of devotions to still figures all painted in glass who do not hear. This is not Khajiit's way, so this one understands your confusion, and your question.<BR><BR>

Instead, look above, if you would ask. This one will show you. See the moons dancing across the sky, over and again? This is the Khajiit way. Turning with the moons, our skins mimicking the pattern, and so too do our feet. What else can Khajiit do, those not dancing like mer but dumb beasts? The world-changers would have us think differently of them, of course.<BR><BR>

Do you? See now the curl of the moon-smoke and the glitter of the sweetness! Twinkling this way and that in the light, never still, like this and this. The sugar is in Khajiit's blood, whispering life-leading-along. So does this one go with eyes alight like fire and shaking with moon songs from the rain!<BR><BR>

You would call Khajiit a lush, this one sees, for misunderstanding the tremor in this one's paws. Still you do not see? Look at the water under the docks if you wish to know its true worth. See the water pull in and out, at the beck and call of the moons, cladding the beach in sparkle and memory? The sea sways to the moon-songs too, yes? So do we, the dancing cats with the deft paws. What is music if it stays only on one note? If it sounds once, long and fading, never again like your dull stones of devotion? So the pipers trill and the drummers drum, so the Khajiit move up and down the scales instead of playing to just eight or nine, all-in-a-chord in your chapels. So the Khajiit follow the moons, and not the still painted figures who hear much but say nothing!<BR><BR>

Dance and twist, sway and spin, following the moons across the skies. This is the Khajiit way. To remain still is to remain always-there, and that is not the name of this one's home, you see.<BR><BR>
 
Now, this one has elsewhere to be, and look! You are one step closer to enlightenment. Do not be angry! This one shows you the meat of his beliefs, as you have asked. This one considers this coin of yours fair payment, and will sing your sweet praises to the moons tonight. Can you truly say the sour gold would have been so filling in your own mouth?<BR><BR>"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
一只弯尾卡吉特谈月之栅栏
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[据一只弯尾卡吉特所述，发现于利雅文的泽尼萨尔神殿台阶上乞讨。]<BR><BR>

你让这只告诉你卡吉特的信仰？这只确实不常说出他的信仰。这不是卡吉特的方式，但并非出于对差异的任何尊重，不。担忧这个，是喵喵叫的幼崽的方式，总是回到确定无疑的母乳的温暖；或是政客的方式，用他们那许多道路伪装成一条道路的言辞，以及他们自己的虚荣 -- 一个肮脏的词。现在这只在这里，与这些奇怪的、喜欢弯曲的人在他们高大沉重的建筑里，对着那些用玻璃绘制的、听不见的静止雕像说着虔诚的话语。这不是卡吉特的方式，所以这只理解你的困惑，以及你的问题。<BR><BR>

如果你要问，不如仰望上方。这只指给你看。看到月亮在天空中一遍遍舞动了吗？这就是卡吉特的方式。随着月亮转动，我们的皮肤模仿其图案，我们的脚步亦然。那些不跳得像精灵而像哑巴野兽的卡吉特又能做什么？当然，改变世界者想让我们对他们有不同的看法。<BR><BR>

你呢？现在看看那月烟之卷和那甜美的闪光！在光中这般那般闪烁，永不停歇，像这样又像那样。糖在卡吉特的血里，低语着引领生命前行。这只便这样走去，眼中燃着火般的光，随着雨中传来的月之歌而颤抖！<BR><BR>

你会叫卡吉特酒鬼，这只看得出来，因为你误解了这只爪子里的颤抖。你还是不明白？若想知道水的真正价值，看看码头下的水。看看那水随着月亮的召唤进进出出，让沙滩披上闪烁与记忆？大海也随着月之歌摇摆，对吧？我们这些有着灵巧爪子的跳舞猫也一样。如果音乐只停留在一个音符上，那算什么音乐？如果它只响一次，又长又渐弱，永不再来，就像你们那些呆板的虔诚石块？所以风笛手颤音，鼓手击鼓，卡吉特便上下移动音阶，而不只是在你们的礼拜堂里奏八个或九个音，全部和声。所以卡吉特跟随月亮，而不是那些静止的、彩绘的、听得很多却不说话的形象！<BR><BR>

舞蹈、扭动、摇摆、旋转，跟随月亮穿越天空。这就是卡吉特的方式。保持静止就是永远停留在那里，而这不是这只家园的名字，你明白吗。<BR><BR>

> BOOK.FNAM T_bk_OrcsuranceTR
Orcsurance, a One-Act Comedy
兽人保险，独幕喜剧

> BOOK.TEXT T_bk_OrcsuranceTR
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Orcsurance<BR>
A One-Act Comedy<BR>
by Surru Runuril
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
(Publisher's note: This short farce originally premiered during an interlude at the birthday party of Llathsa Indarys, a House Hlaalu councillor, in 3E 405. Among the guests was the then-director of the East Empire Company in Kragenmar who reportedly took offence at the play because he felt one of its two characters was based on him. We'll let the reader guess which one.)
<BR><BR>
The setting is a cave high up on the Velothi Mountains, home to a clan of Malahk-Orcs. On the cave wall is an impressive arsenal of barbaric weapons; on the stone floor there are straws spread and a few small bones. MULLUG, an orcish chieftain, sits at a grinding wheel sharpening a battle-axe. BASILIUS, an Imperial insurance salesman, has climbed the steep steps on the mountainside and arrives at the cave entrance.]
<BR>
BASILIUS [Out of breath]. Hello.
[MULLUG takes an uninterested look at the stranger and continues his work.]
MULLUG [Grunts aside]. Is long climb for skinny man.
BASILIUS. Is this the Malahk residence?
MULLUG. Is home cave of Clan Malahk.
<BR>
[BASILIUS catches his breath and approaches MULLUG with his arm extended, attempting a handshake. MULLUG ignores the foreign gesture.]
<BR>
BASILIUS. Lovely. I am Basilius Mercater of the East Empire Company. Do I have the privilege of speaking with the head of this household?
MULLUG. I am Mullug of Clan Malahk. What skinny man say that skinny man is?
BASILIUS. I am with the EEC. Could you spare a moment from your busy schedule to hear about an offer we have for you?
MULLUG [Puts the axe away, stands up]. Speak, skinny man of Clan Eeck-Eesh.
BASILIUS. May I inquire of you as to the status of your insurance plan?
MULLUG. What is this... insurance?
BASILIUS. I'm glad you asked. Here's a brochure. [Hands a parchment which MULLUG holds upside down.] As you can see, the East Empire Company's insurance policy is tailor-made, or should I say blacksmith-made, for mercenaries and veteran warriors. It provides protection should you ever have, ahem, a work-related injury. Broken nose, loss of limb, decapitation... you name it, for an annual fee of just 400 septims, we've got you covered.
MULLUG. Mullug already has protection, has axe and shield. What good is paper?
BASILIUS. Well, should your axe and shield ever fail you in a combat situation, there's still your family to think of. In an unfortunate event of a violent death our company would, for example, cover all material expenses of the funeral ceremony. Your people have funerals, don't you?
MULLUG. Yes. Throw body into fire, then throw ashes into woods.
BASILIUS. I see. Minimalistic and efficient, how trendy. Our company would be more than happy to provide the fire with the most luxurious, high burn rate Argonian ironwood.
[A beetle crawls on the floor. MULLUG notices it]
MULLUG. If bug has gold, skinny man would sell insurance paper to bug?
BASILIUS. Well, hypothetically, yes. If the beetle had a steady source of income and knew how to spell its name, I guess there's no legal reason it couldn't be insured. Why do you ask?
[MULLUG crushes the the beetle with the heel of his foot. He gestures at it.]
BASILIUS. Oh.
MULLUG. Explain what good is paper for bug now?
BASILIUS. Well, let's assume that prior to his crushing the beetle had been blessed with a family. The East Empire Company would pay the family of deceased a predetermined sum of beneficiary gold.
MULLUG. You pay for dead bug?
BASILIUS. That is correct.
MULLUG. So Mullug not have to pay blood-money to Clan Bug?
BASILIUS. Yes, I suppose, that's one way to look at it.
MULLUG [Thinks and nods]. Is useful.
BASILIUS [Relieved]. It is, isn't? I see now you're as much a man of reason as you're a man of action. So, my observant friend, how about we sign some papers now?
MULLUG. Skinny man has shiny boots.
BASILIUS. Well, thank you. Real tiger leather, you know. I use Dreugh wax on them. How kind of you to notice. Now back to signing papers...
MULLUG. You have insurance?
BASILIUS. Why, of course. I wouldn't be much of an EEC representative if I didn't believe in--
MULLUG. So if Mullug kill you, take your shiny boots and throw body into fire, Mullug no have to pay blood-money to Clan Eeck-Eesh?
BASILIUS [Laughs nervously]. That is amusing. You are quite the comedian.
<BR>
[MULLUG doesn't seem to listen. Eyes his weapons leaning against the wall. Grabs the axe from earlier.]
<BR>
MULLUG. Mullug knows no joke.
BASILIUS. Surely, you don't mean--
MULLUG. Skinny man run now.
<BR>
[Both exit, running. A scream is heard.]
<BR>
[MULLUG enters. He is carrying the shiny boots and the axe, which is now bloody.]
<BR>
MULLUG [To the audience]. Is useful insurance. Much useful.
<BR>
[MULLUG throws the boots to the audience. He bows. Exit.]
<BR>
End.
<BR>"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
兽人保险<BR>
独幕喜剧<BR>
苏鲁·鲁努里尔 作
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
（出版者注：这部短闹剧最初于第三纪元405年，在哈拉鲁家族议员拉萨·因达瑞斯的生日派对间隙首演。宾客中包括时任东帝国公司驻克拉根穆尔主任，据报道他对该剧不满，因为他觉得剧中两个角色之一是以他为原型的。我们让读者猜猜是哪一个。）
<BR><BR>
场景是维洛提山脉高处的一个洞穴，是某马拉赫-兽人部族的家园。洞穴墙上挂着令人印象深刻的野蛮武器库；石地上铺着稻草，散落着几根小骨头。穆鲁格，一个兽人酋长，坐在磨刀石前打磨一把战斧。巴西利乌斯，一个帝国保险推销员，爬上山腰陡峭的台阶，到达洞穴入口。]
<BR>
巴西利乌斯 [气喘吁吁]。你好。
[穆鲁格无兴趣地瞥了陌生人一眼，继续他的工作。]
穆鲁格 [旁白咕哝]。瘦子爬得真远。
巴西利乌斯。请问这是马拉赫家吗？
穆鲁格。是马拉赫部落的家穴。
<BR>
[巴西利乌斯喘过气来，走近穆鲁格，伸出胳膊想握手。穆鲁格无视这陌生的举动。]
<BR>
巴西利乌斯。太好了。我是东帝国公司的巴西利乌斯·梅尔卡特。我能有幸与户主谈谈吗？
穆鲁格。我是马拉赫部落的穆鲁格。瘦子说瘦子是什么？
巴西利乌斯。我在东帝国公司工作。你能百忙之中抽点时间听听我们为你准备的方案吗？
穆鲁格 [放下斧子，站起来]。说吧，埃克-埃什部落的瘦子。
巴西利乌斯。我能请问一下你保险计划的状况吗？
穆鲁格。这......保险是什么？
巴西利乌斯。很高兴你问起。给你本手册。[递过一张羊皮纸，穆鲁格倒着拿着。] 如你所见，东帝国公司的保险单是为雇佣兵和资深战士量身定制的，或者我该说铁匠定制的。万一你，呃，发生工伤，它提供保障。断鼻、断肢、斩首......凡是你想得到的，每年只需400塞普汀，我们全包。
穆鲁格。穆鲁格已有保护，有斧头和盾牌。纸有什么用？
巴西利乌斯。嗯，万一在战斗中你的斧头和盾牌不管用了，还有你的家人需要考虑。如果不幸发生暴力致死事件，例如，我们公司将承担葬礼的所有物料费用。你们人有葬礼，对吧？
穆鲁格。对。把尸体扔进火里，然后把骨灰撒进树林。
巴西利乌斯。我明白了。极简且高效，真时髦。我们公司很乐意提供最豪华、高燃烧率的阿尔贡铁木来生火。
[一只甲虫在地上爬行。穆鲁格注意到了它。]
穆鲁格。如果虫子有金子，瘦子会把保险纸卖给虫子吗？
巴西利乌斯。嗯，理论上说，是的。如果甲虫有稳定的收入来源，并且知道怎么拼写自己的名字，我想没有法律理由不能给它投保。你问这个干嘛？
[穆鲁格用脚后跟碾死了甲虫。他朝它做了个手势。]
巴西利乌斯。哦。
穆鲁格。解释一下现在纸对虫子有什么好处？
巴西利乌斯。嗯，我们假设在被碾死之前，这甲虫有幸成家了。东帝国公司会向死者家属支付一笔预定的受益金。
穆鲁格。你为死虫子付钱？
巴西利乌斯。没错。
穆鲁格。所以穆鲁格不必付血钱给虫子部落？
巴西利乌斯。是的，我想，可以这么说。
穆鲁格 [想了想，点头]。有用。
巴西利乌斯 [松了口气]。确实有用，对吧？我现在明白了，你既是行动家也是理性人。那么，我细心的朋友，我们现在就签些文件如何？
穆鲁格。瘦子有闪亮的靴子。
巴西利乌斯。哦，谢谢。真虎皮，你知道的。我用蟹灵蜡保养它们。多谢你注意到。现在回到签文件......
穆鲁格。你有保险吗？
巴西利乌斯。哦，当然。如果我不相信 -- 那我就不配当东帝国公司代表 -- 
穆鲁格。所以如果穆鲁格杀了你，拿走你的闪亮靴子，把尸体扔进火里，穆鲁格就不必付血钱给埃克-埃什部落？
巴西利乌斯 [紧张地笑]。真有趣。你真是个喜剧家。
<BR>
[穆鲁格似乎没在听。眼睛盯着靠在墙边的武器。拿起之前那把斧子。]
<BR>
穆鲁格。穆鲁格不开玩笑。
巴西利乌斯。你当然不是 -- 
穆鲁格。瘦子现在跑吧。
<BR>
[两人都跑了出去。听到一声尖叫。]
<BR>
[穆鲁格上。他拿着闪亮的靴子和斧子，斧子上沾着血。]
<BR>
穆鲁格 [对观众]。保险真有用。太有用了。
<BR>
[穆鲁格把靴子扔给观众。他鞠躬。下。]
<BR>
剧终。
<BR>"""

As an Itinerant Priest, I aim to live and act virtuously in all that I do. I should always look to help and protect others. I should look to live a life of charity, wisdom, and service. 作为一名巡游祭司，我立志于所言所行皆合乎美德。我应当时常扶助并保护他人。我应当过一种布施、智慧与侍奉的生活。我应当追随自己的内心、头脑与灵魂，努力成为那个能令自己引以为傲的人。我绝不可偷窃其他成员的财物，并应避免伤害任何人，除非万不得已。 {工作}

> INFO.NAME t_rules_janatta 2240665302699320123
These are the rules of the Ja-Natta Syndicate. In the Syndicate, everything I do, I do for The Boss. Whatever The Boss needs doing, I have to do it, no questions asked. The Boss would prefer it if I didn't kill or steal from other members, but if some of them are asking for it, and if I find myself expelled, I have to talk to a Taskmaster to make amends.
此乃贾-纳塔辛迪加之规则。在辛迪加，我所做的一切皆为头目。凡头目所需，我必行之，不问缘由。头目虽不乐见我杀害或偷窃其他成员，但若有那自寻死路之徒，而若我因此遭逐，则须向工头陈情，以求补偿。 {规定}

> INFO.NAME t_rules_king_anv 884712446346527010
As a member of the Kingdom of Anvil, my loyalties are to the Kingdom, the Queen, and my fellow citizens. I am not to harm another servant of the Kingdom unless in self-defense. 身为安维尔王国之臣，吾之忠心归于王国、女王及吾之同胞。吾不得伤害王国其他仆从，除非出于自卫。吾绝不可窃取王国其他仆从之物。最后，无论何处，凡遇对安维尔王国之威胁，吾必迅疾除之。

> INFO.NAME betmeri 1295126430281209071
The peaceful Khajiit and Argonian races are the most numerous and culturally advanced of the Beast races; the war-loving Orc tribes are relatively few in number and widely scattered, but notable as superior warriors and weapon crafters. Other smaller Beast races, like Goblins, Apemen, and Giants, are limited to mountainous areas in the west and north of Tamriel, and seldom encountered in the East.
爱好和平的卡吉特和阿尔贡是野兽种族中数量最多、文化最发达的种族；好战的兽人部落数量相对较少，而且分布很广，但作为优秀的战士和武器制造者却很引人注目。其他较小的野兽种族，如哥布林、猿人和巨人，仅限于泰姆瑞尔西部和北部的山区，在东部很少遇到。

The Empire of Tamriel encompasses the nine Imperial provinces: Skyrim, High Rock, Hammerfell, Summerset Isle, Valenwood, Elsweyr, Black Marsh, Morrowind, and the ancient Imperial province itself, Cyrodiil. Dating from the First Era Cyrodilic Empire, the Empire is almost 4000 years ago. > INFO.NAME enchant 184682796852297580
The enchant discipline concerns imbuing physical items with magical properties called enchantments. The simplest enchantment are magical scrolls with a single enchantment that are destroyed with one use. The most complex enchantments are enchanted artifacts, objects with one or more magical effects powered by built-in soul gems. Skilled enchanters also use enchanted items more efficiently, with less waste of the magicka trapped in the soul gems.
附魔师的职责是为物理物品注入被称为附魔之术的魔法属性。最简单的附魔是带有单一附魔的魔法卷轴，使用一次就会销毁。最复杂的附魔是附魔神器，即由内置灵魂石提供一种或多种魔法效果的物品。熟练的附魔师还能更有效地使用附魔物品，减少对灵魂宝石中蕴藏的魔能的浪费。

> INFO.NAME high rock 28327841077617580
High Rock encompasses the many lands and clans of Greater Betony, the Dellese Isles, the Bjoulsae River tribes, and, by tradition, the Western Reach. The rugged highland strongholds and isolated valley settlements have encouraged the fierce independence of the various local Breton clans, and this contentious tribal nature has never been completely integrated into a provincial or Imperial identity. Nonetheless, their language, bardic traditions, and heroic legends are a unifying common legacy.
高岩囊括了大贝托尼许多的土地和部族，德莱斯群岛、彼欧塞河部落，以及传统意义上西境的河流。崎岖的高地堡垒和与世隔绝的山谷聚居地促使当地各布莱顿人氏族激烈独立，这种争斗不休的部落性质使其从未完全融入省级或帝国的身份认同中。尽管如此，他们的语言、吟游诗人传统和英雄传说仍是统一的共同遗产。 {帝国人}

> INFO.NAME unarmored 1289482622364524459
Monks dedicated to the ascetic philosophies of Elsweyr have long cultivated the unarmored martial arts traditions called the 'Rain-of-Sand' fighting styles. The Mages Guild and other societies have had some success adapting these styles for self-defense training of wizards and other armor-averse vocations. 长期以来，奉行艾斯维尔苦行哲学的僧侣们一直在修炼被称为“沙之雨”格斗术的无甲武术传统。法师公会和其他社团对这些武术的改编取得了一定的成功，用于巫师和其他不喜欢穿戴盔甲的职业的自卫训练。学习无甲格斗术的学生几乎不穿盔甲，而是依靠闪避和偏转来避免受伤。

> INFO.NAME blades 30795194081326326215
The Blades is an prestigious service order for citizens demonstrating the greatest loyalty to the Emperor. To be named to the Blades by the Emperor is a great honor, and publicly acknowledged members serve openly in noble courts and diplomatic posts. Privately, many Blades members act as the Empire's intelligence agency. Such agents conceal themselves with secret identities, operating in disguise as couriers, observers, and spies throughout the Empire.
刀锋是为那些对皇帝表现出最大忠诚的公民设立的荣誉勋章。被皇帝任命为刀锋是一种极大的荣誉，公开承认的成员会在贵族宫廷和外交岗位上公开服务。私下里，许多刀锋成员充当帝国的情报机构。这些特工隐藏着自己的秘密身份，伪装成信使、观察员和间谍在泰姆瑞尔帝国各地活动。

> INFO.NAME cyrodiil 143268184985624871
Cyrodiil is the cradle of Human Imperial high culture on Tamriel. It is the largest region of the continent, and most is endless jungle. The Imperial City is in the heartland, the fertile Nibenay Valley. The densely populated central valley is surrounded by wild rain forests drained by great rivers into the swamps of Argonia and Topal Bay. The land rises gradually to the west and sharply to the north. Between its western coast and its central valley are deciduous forests and mangrove swamps.
西罗帝尔是泰姆瑞尔人类帝国人高级文化的摇篮。它是大陆上最大的地区，大部分地区都是一望无际的丛林。帝国人的帝都位于中心地带，即肥沃的尼本内山谷。人口稠密的中部山谷被荒凉的雨林环绕，雨林被大河排入阿尔贡尼亚和托帕尔湾的沼泽。地势向西逐渐上升，向北急剧上升。西部海岸和中部峡谷之间是落叶林和红树林沼泽。

> INFO.NAME morrowind 163381573717612566
Morrowind, homeland of the Dunmer peoples, is the northeastmost province of the Tamrielic Empire. Most of the population is gathered in the high uplands and fertile river valleys of central Morrowind, especially around the Inland Sea. The island Vvardenfel is encircled by the Inner Sea, and is dominated by the titanic volcano Red Mountain and its associated ash wastelands; most of the island's population is confined to the relatively hospitable west and southwest coast.
晨风，丹莫的家乡，是位于泰姆瑞尔泰姆瑞尔帝国最东北部的一个省。大多数人集中在晨风中部的高地以及肥沃的河谷部分，尤其是内海的附近。瓦登费尔区域包括了瓦登费尔岛和环绕周遭的内海，以巨型火山--红山，以及周围伴随着的灰烬之地为主。岛上的大多数人口仅限于相对好客友善的西海岸和西南海岸。

> INFO.NAME illusion 2690293951224516758
The illusion discipline is the mastery of the spell effects of the College of Illusion. The illusion spells affect the perception and mind of living subjects. Illusion effects include blinding, paralyzing, and silencing subjects, calming and enraging subjects, and distracting observers so they do not notice the caster -- the invisibility effect.
幻术系学科是对幻术系学派法术效果的掌握。幻觉类法术会影响生物的感知和思维。幻术效果包括致盲、麻痹和使对象沉默，使对象平静和愤怒，以及分散观察者的注意力，使他们注意不到施法者--隐形效果。

> INFO.NAME imperial 3091230971363131382
The Imperials are the educated and well-spoken natives of the civilized, cosmopolitan province of Cyrodiil. Imperials are known for their enlightened rule of law and government, and the discipline and training of their citizen armies. Though physically less imposing than the other races, they are shrewd diplomats and traders. Their legions have enabled them to subdue all the other nations and races of Tamriel, and to have erected the monument to peace and prosperity that comprises the Glorious Empire.
帝国人是西罗帝尔这个文明的国际大都会中受过良好教育、能说会道的本地人。帝国人以其开明的法律和政府，以及其公民军队的纪律和训练而闻名。虽然他们的体格不如其他种族强壮，但他们是精明的外交家和贸易商。他们的军团使他们能够征服泰姆瑞尔的所有其他国家和种族，并促成了泰姆瑞尔帝国这座和平与繁荣的荣耀丰碑。

> INFO.NAME dwemer 649251751575116628
Dwemer -- literally, 'the Deep, or Deep-Counseled or Secretive People' -- are the fabled lost Dwarven race whose ruins and splendid artifacts are scattered across Tamriel. Elves use the term 'Dwemer,' connoting variously 'deep-delving,' 'profound,' and 'close-counseled'; Imperial usage is 'Dwarven,' derived in fable from the affectionate regard of the Giant races for their 'little' Dwemer friends.
锻莫--字面意思是“深渊，或深谋远虑或神秘的人”--是传说中失落的矮人种族，他们的遗迹和绚丽的文物散落在泰姆瑞尔各地。精灵族使用“锻莫”一词，其含义包括“深潜”、“深邃”和“亲密无间”；帝国人则使用“矮人”一词，源自巨人族对其“小”锻莫朋友的深情厚谊。

> INFO.NAME valenwood 11339248402376163
Valenwood is a largely uninhabited forest wilderness. The coasts of Valenwood are dominated by mangrove swamps and tropical rain forests, while heavy rainfalls nurture the temperate inland rain forests. The Bosmer live in timber clanhouses at sites scattered along the coast and through the interior, connected only by undeveloped foot trails. The few Imperial roads traverse vast dense woodlands, studded with tiny, widely separated settlements, and carry little trade or traffic of any kind.
瓦伦伍德是一片基本无人居住的森林荒野。瓦伦伍德的海岸主要是红树林沼泽和热带雨林，而暴雨则孕育了温带内陆雨林。波斯莫居住在散布于沿海和内部的木制氏族房屋中，只有未开发的小径将他们连接起来。为数不多的帝国公路穿越广袤茂密的林地，沿途分布着许多相距甚远的小定居点，几乎没有任何贸易或交通往来。 {瓦伦森林,帝国人}

> INFO.NAME restoration 258271276781527104
The Restoration discipline is the mastery of the spell effects of the College of Restoration. The restoration spells heal, restore, and fortify the body's attributes and abilities, cure disease, and protect it from other malign influences. The primary spells of this college heal wounds, cure disease, and restore lost vitality, but can also augment strength, endurance, intelligence, agility, and other bodily attributes.
恢复系掌握恢复系学派的法术效果。恢复系法术可以治疗、恢复和强化身体的属性和能力，治愈疾病，保护身体免受其他有害影响。该学派的主要法术可以治愈伤口、治疗疾病、恢复失去的活力，还可以增强力量、耐力、智力、敏捷和其他身体属性。

> INFO.NAME the rules 288072812254417506
Rule Number One: The boss says you do business with him, or you don't do business. You don't know who the boss is? Then you don't do business. Simple. Rule Number Two: You do business, but it is not with the boss, because you have broken Rule Number One. So Rule Number Two is that now I visit you, and after this visit, you never do anything ever again. Except feed the worms. And Rule Number Three is don't push your luck with me. Or I kill you. Nothing personal. Just part of my job.
规则一：老板说你能和他做生意，要不你就别做生意。你不知道老板是谁？那就别做生意，很简单。规则二：你能做生意，但不是和老板，因为你违反了规则一。所以规则二是，我现在来拜访你。这次拜访之后，你就什么都别再做了，除了喂虫子。规则三：别在我面前嘴硬，否则我杀了你。不是针对你，这只是我工作的一部分。

> INFO.NAME dunmer 132192738930502258

In the Empire, 'Dark Elves' is the common usage.

> INFO.NAME imperial culture 898177182078427647
Imperial culture is a pragmatic melting pot of the various contrasting cultures of the Imperial provinces, unified by a strong hereditary emperor and bureaucracy, the rule of law, a powerful professional army, and tolerance of disparate polytheistic cult worships. Education and wealth is broadly distributed through all social classes where Imperial culture has flourished; many citizens are literate and protected under Imperial law.

We also say -- do not harm one another. It is forbidden to attack another person of the Imperial cult, and of course, forbidden to kill another member. We look to the Nine Divines as models for living a good and virtuous life. Each of the Nine represent different aspects of life, and how it should be lived. But the simplest statement of our doctrines is -- help and protect one another. The stronger one is, the wealthier one is, the more one bears responsibility for helping and protecting others. One's first duty, of course, is to one's fellow members of the Imperial Cult. But after that, one should help and protect any needy persons.
我们将九圣灵视为美好和贤德生活的楷模。九圣灵中的每一位都代表着生活的不同方面，以及应该如何生活。但我们的教义最简单的表述就是--互相帮助、互相保护。一个人越强大、越富有，就越有责任帮助和保护他人。一个人的首要职责当然是帝国教团的同伴。但在此之后，也应该帮助和保护任何需要帮助的人。 {帝国人}

But the simplest statement of our doctrines is -- help and protect one another. The stronger one is, the wealthier one is, the more one bears responsibility for helping and protecting others. One's first duty, of course, is to one's fellow members of the Imperial Cult. But after that, one should help and protect any needy persons.
我们将九圣灵视为美好和贤德生活的楷模。九圣灵中的每一位都代表着生活的不同方面，以及应该如何生活。但我们的教义最简单的表述就是--互相帮助、互相保护。一个人越强大、越富有，就越有责任帮助和保护他人。一个人的首要职责当然是帝国教团的同伴。但在此之后，也应该帮助和保护任何需要帮助的人。 {帝国人}

> INFO.NAME hand to hand 2310118776196853298
The hand-to-hand discipline is the martial art of unarmed combat. Inspired by the mystical martial arts disciplines of the Khajiit, this unarmed combat style has been adopted in the West by agents and thieves whose scruples forbid them to seriously injure or kill their opponents. Unlike weapon attacks, which only injure and kill, defeating an opponent in hand-to-hand combat renders him unconsciousness and helpless. However, once a target is unconscious, hand-to-hand attacks cause wounds and death.
徒手搏斗学科是不使用武器战斗的武术。受卡吉特神秘武术门派的启发，这种徒手格斗方式在西方被特工和盗贼所采用，因为他们的顾忌禁止重伤或杀死对手。与武器攻击只能造成伤害和死亡不同，徒手搏击击败对手后，对手会失去知觉，束手无策。然而，一旦目标失去知觉，徒手攻击就会造成伤口和死亡。
